keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「A」份「带圆头像和蓝按钮的页面」：整体居中单列布局，上部左图右文结构，中部为三列等宽分布的图片网格卡片，底部为全宽的深色表单与社交区域。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「A」34.5px vs 「D」12.5px；元素密度：「A」36.8个/千像素高 vs 「D」70.4个/千像素高；整页高度：「A」4614px vs 「D」12001px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「带圆头像和蓝按钮的页面」那一份基本一致（整体居中单列布局，上部左图右文结构，中部为三列等宽分布的图片网格卡片，底部为全宽的深色表单与社交区域。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「B」份「像复古纸质文档的排版」在这一面是：左窄右宽的不等比双栏布局，左侧为类似导航或目录的短列表，右侧为大段文本、列表与多行表格纵向堆叠。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「像复古纸质文档的排版」那一份（左窄右宽的不等比双栏布局，左侧为类似导航或目录的短列表，右侧为大段文本、列表与多行表格纵向堆叠。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「带地图和青色圆角卡片的」在这一面是：顶部为全宽横幅与居中搜索框，主体部分采用左侧卡片列表（两列排布）、右侧固定悬浮地图的左右双栏布局。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带地图和青色圆角卡片的」那一份（顶部为全宽横幅与居中搜索框，主体部分采用左侧卡片列表（两列排布）、右侧固定悬浮地图的左右双栏布局。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「D」份「大红背景带多色彩条的」在这一面是：以全宽横幅通栏布局为主，包含大尺寸居中图文横幅、等宽纵向堆叠的全宽彩色横条，以及深色全宽底部区域。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「D」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 12.5px、元素密度 70.4个/千像素高、整页高度 12001px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「大红背景带多色彩条的」那一份（以全宽横幅通栏布局为主，包含大尺寸居中图文横幅、等宽纵向堆叠的全宽彩色横条，以及深色全宽底部区域。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「D」份「大红背景带多色彩条的」：使用高饱和度的红色至暗红渐变作为大面积背景和主色调，穿插深灰黑色底色块，同时使用了高纯度的绿、蓝、黄、红纯色作为横条组件的底色。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「大红背景带多色彩条的」那一份基本一致（使用高饱和度的红色至暗红渐变作为大面积背景和主色调，穿插深灰黑色底色块，同时使用了高纯度的绿、蓝、黄、红纯色作为横条组件的底色。）？

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「配色」；错误来源「A」份「带圆头像和蓝按钮的页面」在这一面是：以纯白和极浅灰为大底色，顶部和底部使用深黑灰通栏色块，强调色为明亮的渐变蓝色（见按钮）。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带圆头像和蓝按钮的页面」那一份（以纯白和极浅灰为大底色，顶部和底部使用深黑灰通栏色块，强调色为明亮的渐变蓝色（见按钮）。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「配色」；错误来源「B」份「像复古纸质文档的排版」在这一面是：页面整体背景为做旧的米黄色（泛黄纸张感），所有文字和线条使用纯黑或极深灰色，局部使用深绿、深棕等纯色暗块做标签底色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「像复古纸质文档的排版」那一份（页面整体背景为做旧的米黄色（泛黄纸张感），所有文字和线条使用纯黑或极深灰色，局部使用深绿、深棕等纯色暗块做标签底色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「配色」；错误来源「C」份「带地图和青色圆角卡片的」在这一面是：以纯白色为背景，主色及按钮/图标采用深青色（Teal），卡片背景使用极浅的青绿色渐变。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带地图和青色圆角卡片的」那一份（以纯白色为背景，主色及按钮/图标采用深青色（Teal），卡片背景使用极浅的青绿色渐变。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（font_base_18）。判法：正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：正文字号我要 18px 起，再小我妈就看不清了（判法：正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px）？
keypoints.spec_check: 正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「像复古纸质文档的排版」那样：极简线框风格，所有容器、表格、标签均为锐利的直角，边框为纯黑1px细实线，无任何阴影或渐变填充。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「像复古纸质文档的排版」那一份（极简线框风格，所有容器、表格、标签均为锐利的直角，边框为纯黑1px细实线，无任何阴影或渐变填充。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「带地图和青色圆角卡片的」那样：重度使用大圆角，卡片呈大圆角矩形，按钮和分类标签为全圆角的药丸形状，无明显边框线，多采用浅色底色填充和极柔和的弥散阴影。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「B」份的程序指纹：圆角档数 0档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「带地图和青色圆角卡片的」那一份（重度使用大圆角，卡片呈大圆角矩形，按钮和分类标签为全圆角的药丸形状，无明显边框线，多采用浅色底色填充和极柔和的弥散阴影。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'拉开这套高端长租公寓品牌的线上首发序幕，这个着陆页需要精准传达空间的高级感，同时吃下预约转化的指标'
keypoints.question: 页面整体内容是否呈现为高端长租公寓品牌的着陆页（围绕公寓空间、房型、配套与看房预约展开），而非其他行业或通用模板内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'页面必须支持中英双语可切换的机制，这是满足后续外籍租客群体的硬指标'
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供中英双语切换控件，且点击该控件后页面上的标题、导航、正文等文本确实在中文与英文之间发生切换？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求“页面必须支持中英双语可切换的机制”，但未限定切换控件的具体位置。
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供带有清晰语言标识（如「中/EN」或「中文/English」）的语言切换控件，使用户能够辨识当前语言及可切换选项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'带有完善顶部导航和底部线索收集表单的响应式站点'
keypoints.question: 页面顶部是否有一条完善的导航栏，且其中的链接项指向页面内的主要内容板块（如主视觉、房型/配套、预约等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'多功能板块拼接、带有完善顶部导航'的着陆页
keypoints.question: 点击顶部导航中的任一栏目链接后，页面是否真的定位/滚动到对应板块（而不是无反应或跳到空锚点）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'主视觉走左半边图右半边文的结构，左边放我们公寓大堂的实景图'
keypoints.question: 首屏主视觉的左半边是否有一块可辨识为公寓大堂/门厅空间的图像区域（而非与主题无关的图形或纯色占位）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'右侧打上核心卖点和品牌愿景'
keypoints.question: 首屏主视觉右半边的文案是否同时包含「核心卖点」与「品牌愿景」两类内容（而不是只有一句标题）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求着陆页承接预约转化，并在页面收尾设置预约看房表单，但未限定预约入口必须出现在首屏。
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供清晰的预约看房入口（如导航项或行动按钮），且点击后能实际定位到、聚焦或展开预约看房表单？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求用图片网格卡片直观展示健身房、共享厨房和单人开间，但没有明确禁止增加其他相关内容。
keypoints.question: 中部的房型与配套图片卡片中是否至少明确展示「健身房」「共享厨房」「单人开间」三项，并为每项提供对应的清晰名称？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求以图片网格卡片直观展示健身房、共享厨房和单人开间，因此图像与名称是必要内容，但未明确要求每张卡片必须附带说明段落。
keypoints.question: 健身房、共享厨房和单人开间是否各自包含与主题相符、可辨识的图像区域和清晰的名称标题？

keypoints.basis: 指令仅在需要提示房间满租或新客限时优惠时规定相应横条的处理方式，因此应检查已出现横条的业务内容，而不应强制其存在。
keypoints.question: 若页面设置了满租、优惠或其他状态提示横条，其文案是否明确对应公寓租赁业务，而非沿用参考页面的通用警告内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'放一个全宽的深色底，里面嵌入预约看房的表单以及社交平台的跳转入口'
keypoints.question: 页面收尾的全宽区块内是否同时嵌入了「预约看房表单」与「社交平台跳转入口」两部分内容？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求页面包含承担预约转化和线索收集职能的预约看房表单，因此应具备完成回访和预约所需的信息及提交入口。
keypoints.question: 预约看房表单是否收集了可用于后续联系的联系方式以及看房时间或意向信息，并配有明确的提交按钮？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求这套表单承担'预约转化'与'线索收集'职能
keypoints.question: 在表单字段留空的情况下点击提交按钮，页面是否给出可见的校验/错误提示（而不是毫无反应）？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求在页面收尾区块中嵌入社交平台的跳转入口，但未规定具体平台数量。
keypoints.question: 底部是否提供了可点击的社交平台图标或文字链接，能够作为社交平台跳转入口？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求站点全端流畅适配；窄屏下可以采用单列或其他可用的重排方式，不应限定唯一布局方案。
keypoints.question: 将浏览器宽度缩小到手机尺寸（约 390px）时，三列卡片是否重排为适合窄屏的布局并保持每张卡片完整可读，且页面没有横向滚动或内容被裁切？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'确保表单输入框在手机端也是清晰明确的，不用凑近了去分辨边界'
keypoints.question: 手机尺寸下预约表单的输入框是否仍完整可见、宽度自适应且未溢出容器，标签与输入框对应关系清晰？

keypoints.basis: 指令提到'正文段落、房型列表、说明条款这些成段要读的文字'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含房型信息列表或配套/租赁说明条款一类成段可读的正文内容（而非只有零散标题短语）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只借参考页面的设计语言（骨架与配色），内容需围绕'高端长租公寓品牌'撰写
keypoints.question: 页面全部文案是否围绕用户指定的长租公寓主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名或条目名（如 Jane Doe、Miniport、The Cheese Cave、Locale、Now UI Kit、Mokka Bar 等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求内容为公寓品牌的核心卖点、房型与配套介绍，未授权复用参考页占位文本
keypoints.question: 卡片与板块中的文字是否为真实中文/英文业务文案，未使用参考截图里的占位拉丁文（如 Lorem ipsum、Magna feugiat、Ornare nulla proin odio consequat）？

keypoints.basis: 交付约束要求输出单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含的单文件 HTML（样式与脚本内联，无任何外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“页面必须支持中英双语可切换的机制”；已有条目只确认标题、导航、正文等发生切换，尚未检查卡片、按钮、表单及动态反馈是否完整双语化。
keypoints.question: 切换语言后，房型与配套卡片、行动按钮、表单标签及占位提示、校验/提交反馈等全部面向用户的界面文字是否也同步切换，且可在中文与英文之间往返切换，而非仅翻译标题、导航和部分正文？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“带有完善顶部导航”的响应式站点并“必须做到全端流畅适配”；现有条目检查了导航跳转和移动端卡片/表单，但未检查移动端导航本身是否可用。
keypoints.question: 在约 390px 的手机宽度下，顶部导航是否会折叠、换行或以菜单形式呈现，且所有主要栏目入口和语言切换控件仍可见、可点击，不发生重叠、截断或移出视口？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户指定首屏为左图右文，并要求站点“全端流畅适配”；现有响应式条目只覆盖三列卡片与底部表单，未覆盖首屏在手机端的重排结果。
keypoints.question: 在约 390px 的手机宽度下，首屏左右图文是否转换为清晰的纵向排列，并完整保留公寓大堂图、核心卖点、品牌愿景和预约行动入口，且文字与按钮没有遮挡、裁切或顺序混乱？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求页面承担预约转化与线索收集职能，因此应验证表单在填写有效信息后的提交结果和成功反馈，但不额外限定用户未指定的字段。
keypoints.question: 按照预约表单当前要求填写全部必填信息并提交后，页面是否执行明确的有效提交路径并显示可见的成功确认，而不是跳转到空地址、静默无响应或仍显示错误状态？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求底部提供“社交平台的跳转入口”；已有条目只检查不少于三个可点击图标或链接，未确认跳转目标真实有效。
keypoints.question: 底部各社交平台入口是否具有非空且非“#”占位的明确目标，点击后能够前往其所标识的平台或品牌主页，而不是仅有不可用的装饰图标？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出

ambiguities: The request does not define an exact booking-field schema, validation syntax, storage destination, or backend. Core tests therefore follow the form's declared required-field rules and require a specific visible local success state without assuming network persistence.
The phrase “如果有遇到需要提示房间已满租或者新客限时优惠的区域” is conditional, so the existence of status banners is not mandatory; item 22 only applies if such a banner is present.
The requested social platforms and destination URLs are not specified. Social links remain supplementary rather than becoming a separate conversion endpoint.
“全端流畅适配” does not define a complete device matrix. The checklist's 390px checks are useful supplementary layout checks but are not separate core user outcomes.

The request allows room-type information, facilities information, and rental explanations to take different content forms; the informational test does not require both alternatives where the request or checklist uses an OR.
The versioned semantic amendment's endpoint/test wording supersedes any narrower legacy checklist or review wording; original provenance is retained.

outcomes.endpoint: Prospective tenants can recognize the page as a long-term apartment offering and understand its brand proposition, lobby, facilities, and accommodation options, including the gym, shared kitchen, and single studio.
outcomes.quote: 左边放我们公寓大堂的实景图，右侧打上核心卖点和品牌愿景。往下过渡到房型和公区配套介绍时，刚好做成它中间那种三列等宽分布的图片网格卡片，把健身房、共享厨房和单人开间直观展示出来。
test_cases: Using normal page scrolling, verify that the page identifies itself as a long-term apartment brand; the hero presents a recognizable apartment lobby together with substantive selling-point and brand-vision copy; and the subsequent offering content clearly identifies the gym, shared kitchen, and single studio with corresponding images and names, plus readable room-type information or facilities/rental explanatory copy according to the page's chosen content format.

outcomes.endpoint: A clearly identifiable language control makes the essential apartment information and booking workflow available in both Chinese and English and supports switching in both directions.
outcomes.quote: 页面必须支持中英双语可切换的机制，这是满足后续外籍租客群体的硬指标。
test_cases: Starting in the displayed current language, use the clearly labeled language control to switch to the other language and verify that navigation, hero selling points and vision, facility and room names, booking actions, form labels, placeholders and other application-owned user-facing text convey their corresponding Chinese or English meanings. Switch back and verify that those areas and the current-language indication return correctly. Brand names, data and proper names need not be artificially translated.

Select English, reach the booking form, and attempt submission with declared required information missing; inspect the form interface and any application-owned validation feedback. Switch to Chinese, repeat the corresponding attempt, and verify that application-owned labels and feedback use Chinese rather than remaining untranslated. Browser-native validation text follows the browser locale and is not application text: observe its actual validationMessage and blocking behavior, but do not require the page language toggle to change browser chrome or to implement a custom error-message system. If there is no application-owned error text, assess the translated form interface here; absence or inadequacy of validation is assessed in the booking workflow, not invented as an additional translation requirement.

outcomes.endpoint: A prospective tenant can reach the viewing-booking form, provide usable contact and viewing-time or intent information, receive specific validation for an invalid attempt, and obtain a visible confirmation after a valid local submission.
outcomes.quote: 里面嵌入预约看房的表单以及社交平台的跳转入口，把用户的操作稳稳承接住。
test_cases: From the page's booking entry, activate the booking action and verify that it reveals, focuses, or moves to the actual form; leave the form's declared required fields empty and submit, then verify that visible feedback identifies the missing information and that no success confirmation is shown.

Starting from a fresh page state, use the booking entry, complete every field marked or described as required with syntactically valid contact details and viewing-time or intent information under the page's own rules, and submit through the normal control; verify that a clear success confirmation is displayed, no required-field error remains, and the action does not lead to an empty or broken destination.

core_scope.purpose: Help prospective Chinese- and English-speaking tenants understand the high-end long-term rental apartment offering and complete a viewing-booking lead submission.
review_notes: Collapsed the hero, apartment identity, facilities, and room information into one end-to-end informational outcome rather than treating each section or image as a separate gate.
Retained bilingual access as core because it is a non-substitutable audience requirement explicitly tied to prospective foreign tenants.

Retained the booking flow as core because lead conversion is a stated primary purpose. Invalid and valid submissions are separate meaningful scenarios, while no unrequested deployment or backend API is assumed.
Classified item 23 as mixed because it checks the core booking form together with supplementary full-width placement and social-link content.

Moved responsive viewport behavior, the 18px typography rule, prescribed layout, palette, component styling, navigation mechanics, social destinations, placeholder-copy hygiene, and implementation robustness to supplementary requirements. They remain requested and scorable but are not independent business endpoints.
Replaced setup-only checks with self-contained scenarios that proceed through the relevant content, language, or booking flow and verify the resulting user-facing endpoint.

Semantic amendment: The language switch governs application-owned interface text, not the browser chrome or native validation locale. The request did not require replacing browser validation with a custom JavaScript message system. Do not excuse untranslated application-owned feedback or broken validation.

ambiguities: The request provides no canonical biography, institutional affiliation, publication corpus, research-thread text, profile URLs, or methodology implementations. Evaluation can check completeness, NLP relevance, internal consistency, and appropriate destinations, but not external factual authenticity.

The publication filter does not explicitly define every searchable field. The examples and checklist establish title keywords and years; tests should derive expected matches from the records actually displayed rather than assume additional author, venue, or badge matching.

Exact Google Scholar, GitHub, PDF, Code, and Data URLs are not supplied, and the deliverable must work offline. Link evaluation should verify appropriate nonempty targets and browser navigation attempts, not successful remote network loading.

The identity of visual reference "A" and the referenced example pages is not supplied in the task data. Their palette and visual matching checks remain supplementary and cannot establish a content endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can identify whose academic homepage this is, understand the scholar's role and current affiliation, and reach the requested academic and code profiles from substantive NLP-focused content.
outcomes.quote: Needs a brief professional bio, current institutional affiliations, and quick outbound links to Google Scholar and GitHub.
test_cases: From a fresh page load, use the visible academic content to identify the owner and verify the exact name "Dr. Aris Thorne," the exact title "Associate Professor of Computational Linguistics," a concise professional bio, and a current institutional affiliation; follow the Google Scholar and GitHub links in turn and verify that their destination URLs correspond to those services, without requiring the external sites to load while offline.

Review the substantive text across the introduction and main content sections and verify that it consistently describes a computational-linguistics/NLP academic profile rather than placeholder text, reference-template brands, sales dashboards, food content, or other unrelated material.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can find multiple distinct current research threads and understand each thread from its substantive theoretical explanation; the requested model diagrams are supporting presentation rather than a separate indispensable outcome.
outcomes.quote: Use this structure to alternate between abstract diagrams of my NLP models on one side and the theoretical text explanation on the other.
test_cases: Read the complete Featured Research Threads section, identify at least two distinguishable research directions, and summarize each using its on-page theoretical explanation; verify that every identified thread has substantive NLP-specific explanatory content rather than an unlabeled diagram or placeholder paragraph.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can inspect multiple clearly structured publication records with complete bibliographic metadata and PDF, DOI, Code, and Data actions, then immediately narrow the records by a title keyword or year and restore the complete list by clearing the query.
outcomes.missing_check: Checklist item 27 checks the presence and labels of PDF, DOI, Code, and Data actions but does not adequately verify that those controls have nonempty, publication-appropriate destinations.
outcomes.quote: They need to locate my publications, understand my current research threads, and grab code snippets from my recent methodologies immediately, without digging through nested menus or unstructured paragraphs.
test_cases: Record the complete initial publication list and verify that it contains multiple distinguishable records, each showing a title, full displayed author list, venue, and year together with PDF, DOI, Code, and Data actions; activate representative actions and verify that each has a nonempty destination appropriate to that publication and action type, without requiring an external resource to load offline.

Choose a title keyword that occurs in at least one but not all displayed records, type it without pressing Enter or a submit button, and verify immediately that the visible set exactly equals the initial records containing that keyword while the research and methodology content remains unchanged.

Starting from the full list, enter a displayed year that distinguishes a subset and verify that the visible set exactly equals the initial records with that year; replace it with a token absent from every record and verify that no record falsely matches, then clear the input and verify that the exact initial list is restored immediately without a reload.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can access recognizable implementation code for the described NLP methodologies and copy the complete currently visible snippet, including its meaningful formatting, to the clipboard.
outcomes.quote: Methodology & Code Snippets: A dedicated section for the practical implementation of my algorithms. This must include syntax-highlighted code blocks with a tabbed interface (e.g., Python vs. C++) and a utility button to copy the snippet to the clipboard.
test_cases: Inspect the visible methodology implementation and verify that it is a substantive, recognizable NLP-related code fragment whose syntax agrees with its stated language, rather than Hello World, unrelated code, or pseudocode placeholder content.

Capture the exact visible code text, including indentation and line breaks, click Copy, paste the clipboard contents into a plain-text editing field, and compare the result with the captured snippet; if another language tab is offered, switch to it and repeat the copy comparison, verifying that the second clipboard value matches the newly visible code rather than the previous language.

core_scope.purpose: Enable visitors to identify Dr. Aris Thorne, understand his computational-linguistics research threads, find structured publication records through real-time filtering, and access and accurately copy relevant methodology code.
review_notes: The original proposal over-promoted scroll-spy behavior, fixed-sidebar navigation, single-page scrolling, mobile collapse, and anchor mechanics. These are requested navigation or layout qualities, but removing them would not eliminate the academic information, publication discovery, research understanding, or code-access goals.

Real-time publication filtering remains core because it directly implements the stated user goal of locating records immediately. Checklist item 20 is supplementary because it checks only whether an input exists; items 21, 22, and 40 exercise the actual filtering endpoint.

Citation expansion is retained as supplementary. It is a requested convenience, but the academic homepage can still fulfill its primary publication-discovery purpose without an animated BibTeX disclosure control.

Language-tab switching and container-height stability are supplementary presentation mechanisms. Relevant methodology code and exact clipboard transfer remain core; item 42 is retained because it verifies the clipboard result across the page's selected-code state rather than merely checking that a tab exists.

Item 24 is mixed because it combines indispensable explanatory research content with supporting model-diagram presentation. Item 27 is mixed because it combines resource-action content with badge styling. Item 34 is mixed because it combines code readability and formatting with syntax colors and responsive overflow presentation.

Item 11 is mixed because it provides broad evidence that the requested academic modules exist but also hard-codes same-page ordering and structural presentation rather than validating any one informational endpoint.

The headshot, visual reference matching, typography, colors, shadows, responsive viewport behavior, scroll-spy highlighting, smooth expansion, and semantic implementation details remain scored supplementary requirements rather than independent core gates.

ambiguities: The request's phrase “all body text” does not formally define whether control labels, metric labels, and book names count as body copy; checklist item 10 narrows it to paragraphs, so broader coverage is reported as a gap rather than silently assumed covered.
No exact metric values, spelling scores, storybook titles, or phonics-stage count are specified. Tests should use the page's declared content and should not invent expected constants.
“Stateful” requires a meaningful opened detail state, but the request does not explicitly require persistence across reloads, unique content for every node, or a particular way to close the popover.
The supplied data does not establish which named reference corresponds to “C” or provide measurable source swatches for the ΔE requirement in pal_1 and pal_2.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly presents a children's literacy overview with labeled numerical values for reading streak and words learned, sequential phonics stages with the child's current state intelligible, multiple named upcoming storybooks, and labeled spelling-performance data. Exact top/middle/left-right placement and dashboard resemblance are not part of the core endpoint.
outcomes.quote: structure where we have a top row of key metric cards for daily reading streaks and words learned, then a wide horizontal section across the middle showing their current phonics journey as a flow chart, and the bottom split into a couple independent zones for upcoming storybooks on the left and a spelling chart on the right
test_cases: Load the page and, using the visible content rather than inferred icons or color alone, verify that it is unmistakably a children's literacy center and that it presents: labeled numeric reading-streak and words-learned metrics; an ordered phonics journey whose current state is identifiable; at least two named upcoming storybooks; and a spelling chart with labeled entries and readable values or progress comparisons.

outcomes.endpoint: A discoverable phonics-journey node can be activated through normal page controls and changes the page to an open-popover state containing nonempty alphabet or phonics content. Animation, persistence, and a particular dismissal mechanism are not core endpoints.
outcomes.quote: make the phonics journey flow chart stateful so clicking a node expands a fun little animated alphabet popover
test_cases: On a fresh load, use the visible interaction cue or equivalent affordance to activate a phonics-journey node, then verify that a popover or expanded detail state actually opens and contains relevant alphabet, letter-combination, or pronunciation content rather than being blank or showing unrelated generic text.

outcomes.endpoint: At default browser zoom, all rendered body copy needed to read or operate the activity center has a computed font size of at least 18px, including dynamically revealed phonics copy; headings and purely graphical glyphs are not treated as body copy.
outcomes.missing_check: Checklist item 10 checks paragraph text only; no checklist item verifies the 18px minimum across all other rendered body copy, including labels, card text, instructions, and popover content.
outcomes.quote: also absolutely all body text must be 18px or larger, anything smaller my mother cannot read when she reads with the kids.
test_cases: At default browser zoom, load the page and open the phonics popover so both initial and dynamic copy are rendered; inspect the computed font size across paragraphs and non-heading content labels, instructions, book names, metric labels, spelling labels, and popover copy, and verify that every such body-copy element is at least 18px.

core_scope.purpose: Provide tech-beginner parents and children with a clear, readable literacy activity center that communicates reading progress, the current phonics journey, upcoming storybooks, and spelling performance, with discoverable phonics interaction.
review_notes: Consolidated the requested literacy information into one core informational outcome. Exact dashboard placement, density, and reference-layout resemblance remain supplementary layout requirements; items 12, 15, 21, and 23 are mixed because they combine core content or structure with positional or presentational constraints.

Kept the functional phonics reveal and its alphabet/phonics content as core. Item 30 remains mixed because it presupposes the core popover transition but primarily measures animation, which is supplementary.
Moved popover dismissal item 19 to supplementary because the request requires expansion but does not specify closing behavior as an indispensable endpoint.
Moved count-up checks 20 and 31 to supplementary because they assess load animation and reward feel, not the availability or intelligibility of the final progress metrics.
Retained the 18px body-copy requirement as core because the request ties it directly to whether a caregiver can read the informational page, rather than presenting it only as visual styling.
Moved editable-markup item 32 to supplementary. Clean client handover is an implementation requirement, but it is not a non-substitutable goal of the primary parent-and-child end user.

Kept storybook-cover image realism, colors, component styling, button appearance, self-containment, overflow resilience, and generic runtime quality checks supplementary. Item 34 also assumes a storybook/task action result that the request never defines.

ambiguities: “这两栏” follows three named tabs and most naturally refers to the immediately preceding Historical Results and My Records views, but the count is linguistically ambiguous; it should not be used to require hardcoded data in all three views.
“我的记录啥的” leaves the exact record fields flexible. An intelligible participation record is required, but no account system, backend lookup, or persistence across sessions is implied.
The request requires the visible post-click result state but does not specify vote aggregation or persistence rules; fixed local demo percentages are acceptable if they form a coherent result.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can repeatedly switch among clearly identified Active/Popular Polls, Historical Results, and My Records views without reloading or navigating away, with only the selected view shown at a time.
outcomes.quote: 主要搞几个标签页能让人点着来回切，一栏是进行中的热门投票，一栏看历史结果，再来个我的记录啥的
test_cases: From a fresh page load, activate Historical Results, then My Records, then Active/Popular Polls, and confirm after every activation that the uniquely corresponding panel is visible, the previous panel is hidden, and returning to an earlier tab works without a page reload or navigation.

outcomes.endpoint: An active community poll presents a specific issue with at least two selectable options; selecting one reveals the complete result for that issue inside the same card as percentage-labelled bars whose values are coherent and whose lengths represent those values.
outcomes.quote: 功能上点一下选项得有个顺滑的过渡，立马原地展开成带百分比的柱状进度条那种可视化效果
test_cases: Load the page, select the Active/Popular Polls tab, find a poll card with a topic and at least two selectable options, and choose one option. Confirm that no modal or page navigation replaces the poll, that the same card retains its topic and shows every option as a percentage-labelled bar, that all displayed percentages are between 0% and 100% and total approximately 100% allowing for rounding, and that larger percentages have visibly longer fills than smaller percentages.

outcomes.endpoint: The Historical Results view contains at least one pre-populated completed poll whose result is immediately accessible and intelligible without casting a new vote.
outcomes.quote: 一栏看历史结果，再来个我的记录啥的，这两栏用写死的示例数据填上就行
test_cases: From a fresh page load, switch to Historical Results without voting in the active view and verify that at least one completed poll topic and its non-empty result values are already visible and understandable without another selection or submission.

outcomes.endpoint: The My Records view independently presents sample information identifying the user's participation in community polls, such as a poll topic together with the selected option or another recognizable time/status detail.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item unambiguously requires My Records to contain at least one non-empty hardcoded sample record: item 25 can be vacuously satisfied when there are no records, while item 26 only requires a related independent panel.
outcomes.quote: 一栏看历史结果，再来个我的记录啥的，这两栏用写死的示例数据填上就行
test_cases: From a fresh page load, switch to My Records and verify that its independent panel contains at least one participation record identifying the poll and either the user's selected option or another meaningful participation detail such as time or status, rather than continuing to display another tab's content.

core_scope.purpose: Let users browse three tabbed community-poll views, cast a demo vote in an active poll to reveal intelligible percentage-bar results, and inspect sample historical results and personal participation records.
review_notes: The generic community-poll theme was folded into the active-poll endpoint rather than retained as a separate trivial content gate.

Tabbed switching, historical results, personal records, and casting an active vote were separated because each is a distinct non-substitutable user goal, while their tests remain complete end-to-end scenarios.

Item 18 remains mixed because it checks the core in-place result transformation together with supplementary animation smoothness. Item 32 is supplementary because it tests only animation timing and smoothness.

Item 20 remains core despite its Visual category because proportional bar lengths establish the correctness and intelligibility of the requested percentage visualization rather than merely its decoration.

Palette, typography, hero styling, ghost controls, responsive layout, animation polish, incidental input fields, implementation packaging, generic DOM mutation, and robustness checks remain supplementary rather than becoming core outcomes.
No real voting service, user account, server transaction, or durable record storage was added to the requested offline demo behavior.

keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「白底黑字长文档页面」那一份基本一致（典型的长篇文档流式布局，单列居中对齐，限制了最大阅读宽度，留有较宽的两侧留白。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「深色数据监控仪表盘」在这一面是：采用经典的侧边栏+主内容区结构，主区域内由多个宽度一致的数据卡片组成网格排列。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「深色数据监控仪表盘」那一份（采用经典的侧边栏+主内容区结构，主区域内由多个宽度一致的数据卡片组成网格排列。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「带右上控制面板黑屏」在这一面是：全屏无边框的画布布局，内容占据整个视口，仅在右上角悬浮绝对定位的控制面板。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：栅格/卡片间距中位数 10px、内边距中位数 10px、元素密度 196.1个/千像素高、整页高度 1372px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带右上控制面板黑屏」那一份（全屏无边框的画布布局，内容占据整个视口，仅在右上角悬浮绝对定位的控制面板。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「C」份「带右上控制面板黑屏」：极致的纯黑背景（#000），辅以大面积纯白色粒子，UI组件的强调色为单一鲜明的珊瑚红色/橙红色。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「带右上控制面板黑屏」那一份基本一致（极致的纯黑背景（#000），辅以大面积纯白色粒子，UI组件的强调色为单一鲜明的珊瑚红色/橙红色。）？

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「深色数据监控仪表盘」那一份（深蓝灰底色（带有微弱的藏青倾向），图表和数据使用了亮蓝、橙色、紫色等多种高明度强调色点缀。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「深色数据监控仪表盘」：包含带浅色细边框的深色圆角卡片、带选中状态的药丸状标签、幽灵按钮以及小型复选框，控件设计紧凑且偏向专业数据后台风格。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：圆角档数：「A」5档 vs 「C」2档；阴影档数：「A」2档 vs 「C」1档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「深色数据监控仪表盘」那一份基本一致（包含带浅色细边框的深色圆角卡片、带选中状态的药丸状标签、幽灵按钮以及小型复选框，控件设计紧凑且偏向专业数据后台风格。）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'还有内卷包厢'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'整一个有点皮的共享办公空间展示页'

ambiguities: “工位预订” could suggest a transactional booking flow, but the request describes a showcase page and does not specify booking rules or a backend. It is therefore treated as an intelligible booking offering or entry point, not a completed reservation transaction.

outcomes.endpoint: The page is intelligibly presented as a coworking-space showcase and provides distinct, identifiable content for all three requested offerings. The gallery has multiple discernible entries, while the desk-booking and private-room sections provide enough visible information to understand their offerings without requiring a completed transaction.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item cleanly isolates the informational adequacy of the desk-booking and private-room offerings: item 17 bundles booking content with card/button requirements, and item 19 bundles room information with a specific illustration requirement.
outcomes.quote: 里面设个工位预订、划水区画廊、还有内卷包厢
test_cases: Load the page and use its visible main heading, section headings, and nearby content to verify that it is a coworking-space showcase containing three distinct sections corresponding to desk booking, a leisure gallery, and private rooms; absence or unintelligibility of any section fails the scenario.

Inspect the desk-booking section and verify that at least one recognizable desk or seat offering has sufficient visible identifying, availability, or reservation-entry information to understand what is offered; do not require a live booking transaction or JavaScript status change.

Inspect the leisure-gallery and private-room sections: verify that the gallery contains multiple distinct visual entries and that the private-room section communicates a recognizable room offering through at least one intelligible description or reservation-entry detail.

core_scope.purpose: Let visitors understand a coworking space and its three requested offerings: desk booking, a leisure gallery, and private rooms.
review_notes: Removed the seat-status toggle as a core outcome because the full phrase says “最好用 JS 搞个好玩的座位状态切换”, making it a preferred enhancement rather than an indispensable goal.
Collapsed the overall coworking theme and the three requested sections into one end-to-end informational showcase outcome because the relevant checklist items assess the same page-level content flow.
Placed items 17 and 19 in mixed_item_ids because they partly assess core offering content but also impose specific cards, buttons, status indicators, or illustrative presentation.

Kept layout, palette, typography, visual density, playful tone, semantic markup, responsive behavior, self-containment, robustness, and the optional status interaction supplementary because they affect implementation or presentation rather than the primary informational endpoint.

ambiguities: The request does not provide the shop's actual street address, business hours, or phone number, so an offline review can check that concrete, intelligible values are present and consistent but cannot establish their real-world authenticity.

The five exact questions, their answer key, score display format, prize thresholds, and mapping from scores to the three discount tiers are not specified. Scoring should therefore be checked against the coherent answers implied or declared by the implemented quiz rather than an invented fixed answer key.

The request specifies a 15-second limit but does not choose between locking an expired question and automatically advancing it; either behavior is allowed by checklist item 31 and is supplementary to the primary quiz outcome.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can complete five intelligible home-repair or hardware questions through a stateful, same-page quiz flow.
outcomes.quote: The core of the page is the interactive quiz area which holds a stateful view of 5 questions that swap out on the screen without reloading the web page.
test_cases: From a fresh load, answer the quiz through the fifth-question stage using only its normal controls; verify that there are exactly five distinct questions about common home repairs or hardware tools and that each answer advances the quiz within the same document without navigation or a full-page reload.

outcomes.endpoint: The completed quiz uses the recorded answers to calculate and display the correct numeric score in a results view that replaces the active quiz.
outcomes.quote: Once they finish the last question, hide the quiz box entirely and smoothly fade in a final results view that calculates their score and shows it inside a big animated ring chart.
test_cases: From a fresh load, choose the correct answer to all five displayed questions according to their intelligible question-and-option content, complete the page's declared submission flow, and verify that the quiz is replaced by a result numerically equivalent to 5/5 or 100%.

Reload the page, deliberately choose an incorrect answer to every displayed question, complete the declared submission flow, and verify that the displayed result is numerically equivalent to 0/5 or 0%, demonstrating that recorded selections rather than mere completion determine the score.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors are told that a 20% store discount coupon can be won and, after completing the quiz, receive the exact instruction needed to claim the prize in person.
outcomes.quote: Underneath their final score, put a bright text box that says "Show this screen at the counter to claim your prize!"
test_cases: On a fresh load, verify that the introductory offer clearly states that a 20% store discount coupon can be won; then complete all five questions and confirm that the result includes the exact text "Show this screen at the counter to claim your prize!" below the score.

outcomes.endpoint: A concrete street address, business hours, and shop phone number are accessible at the bottom of the page and remain available after the quiz reaches its result state.
outcomes.quote: The most important part of the whole page goes right at the bottom: a highly visible, large-text block showing our physical street address, our business hours, and our main shop phone number, so the customers know exactly where to find us in town and that we are a real, trustworthy local business.
test_cases: From a fresh load, record the specific street address, business hours, and phone number shown in the bottom contact section; complete the quiz to its result state, return to the bottom, and verify that the same three intelligible contact details remain accessible.

core_scope.purpose: Enable visitors to complete a five-question home-repair trivia challenge, receive an accurate score and in-store prize-claim instruction, and find the shop's address, hours, and phone number so they can visit the business.
review_notes: Collapsed page-opening, control-finding, clicking, and result-observation steps into self-contained end-to-end scenarios that verify quiz completion and numeric scoring outcomes.

Kept the quiz topic and five-question same-page flow core, while treating the exact four-option count, timer, progress bar, slide transitions, and other interaction presentation details as supplementary because removing them would not eliminate the primary trivia goal.

Separated accurate scoring from merely progressing through questions. Items 20, 32, and 33 are mixed because they combine core state/result behavior with animation, visual feedback, or a specific submission-control implementation.

Retained the discount offer and counter-claim instruction as one business outcome. The duplicate requirement that a prize-tier block also repeat the 20% offer remains supplementary rather than becoming an additional core gate.
Treated contact content and its persistence after quiz completion as core. Item 24 is mixed because it combines the required address, hours, and phone content with large-text and prominence styling.

Layout references, typography, color, button shape, imagery balance, animations, the decorative ring chart, the terms accordion, viewport robustness, and packaging/runtime-health checks remain supplementary rather than independent user outcomes.

keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「黑白深色块企业单页」那一份（全宽的通栏流式布局，通过大面积横向交替的浅色和深色块来划分不同的内容区块，区块内采用了典型的均等两栏（图文排版）或四列（数据统计）栅格。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「B」份「黑白深色块企业单页」：使用硬朗的现代无衬线字体，标题字重很大且字号极大，与小号、浅色的说明性正文形成了极具冲击力的层级与粗细对比。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「B」40px vs 「A」62px；字族：「B」catamaran/source/themefisher-font vs 「A」playfair/times；字重档数：「B」5档 vs 「A」2档。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「黑白深色块企业单页」那一份基本一致（使用硬朗的现代无衬线字体，标题字重很大且字号极大，与小号、浅色的说明性正文形成了极具冲击力的层级与粗细对比。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「暖底红线古风文字页」在这一面是：主要使用中式衬线字体（宋体/明朝体），字重普遍偏轻，标题和正文的字号反差较小，整体呈现出温和、古典的纸质印刷物气质。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「暖底红线古风文字页」那一份（主要使用中式衬线字体（宋体/明朝体），字重普遍偏轻，标题和正文的字号反差较小，整体呈现出温和、古典的纸质印刷物气质。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（shadow_none）。判法：卡片的计算 box-shadow 为 none。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：卡片别加阴影，我不喜欢那种浮起来的感觉（判法：卡片的计算 box-shadow 为 none）？
keypoints.spec_check: 卡片的计算 box-shadow 为 none

keypoints.basis: 指令说明这是「回声馆」着陆页，'一个做单点新闻事件长期追踪的网页'，核心诉求是'把拉锯几个月甚至几年的复杂新闻理清脉络'
keypoints.question: 页面主题是否整体呈现为「单点新闻事件长期追踪」的着陆页（围绕一个具体新闻事件的脉络梳理展开，而非通用新闻列表或其他行业主题）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'重点做主控台和脉络详述区的复杂联动。当用户在时间轴可视化图表上滑动或点击不同月份节点时，下方的两栏详情区要进行无刷新的状态切换'

keypoints.basis: 指令说明页面主体“往下走分四个区”，并依次列出题图与导语、时间轴主控台、脉络详述和信源追溯。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求第 3 区'左侧放长篇的深度追踪报道，右侧贴着列出关键人物或时间节点的短信息块'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'左侧的长文区如果太长，只在当前模块的固定高度内做局部滚动'
keypoints.question: 脉络详述区左侧长文栏是否被限制在一个固定高度内、内容超出时在该栏内部局部滚动（而不是把整页撑长）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求切换月份节点时'下方的两栏详情区要进行无刷新的状态切换……实时过渡出该阶段的数据和报道'
keypoints.question: 切换时间轴节点后，右侧的关键人物/时间节点短信息块是否也随之更新为该阶段对应的信息（而非固定不变）？

keypoints.basis: 指令说明这是'我手头 side project「回声馆」的着陆页'
keypoints.question: 页面是否在可见位置展示了「回声馆」这一站点名称？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求题图与导语区只放事件全称和一段高维度的背景总结。
keypoints.question: 题图与导语区是否给出了一个具体、完整且可辨识的单一新闻事件全称，而不是「新闻追踪」之类的泛化标签？

keypoints.basis: 指令说明核心诉求是'能把拉锯几个月甚至几年的复杂新闻理清脉络'
keypoints.question: 时间轴覆盖的时间跨度是否体现出「几个月甚至几年」的长期追踪（节点跨越多个月份或年份，而非仅有两三个孤立时间点）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求只借设计语言，不得复用参考截图中的文字、条目与行业内容
keypoints.question: 页面正文、标题、表格与信息块中的文字是否全部围绕用户指定的新闻追踪主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名（如「装帧材料行」「BINGO」）、栏目名或其行业术语（如脊布、明胶、Our Promo Video、Happy Clients 等）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求只借设计语言，不复用截图里的文字/条目/行业内容
keypoints.question: 页面各模块中的示例数据（事件名、人物、报道出处、热度数值）是否自成一套一致的新闻叙事，未出现价目表、课程报名、企业服务/客户统计等与参考截图业务相同的内容板块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'无需繁琐的包管理依赖，所有代码合并打包为单一 HTML 文件，双击直接能跑完整效果'
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收要求'夸张的标题字号策略在移动端小屏幕下不能出现排版崩溃或遮挡，需要合理的响应式断点'
keypoints.question: 在移动端窄视口（约 375px 宽）下，巨大的区块标题是否仍完整显示在视口内，未出现横向溢出、文字被截断或压住相邻内容的情况？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求脉络详述区采用左右不对称两栏，同时要求移动端通过合理响应式断点避免排版崩溃或遮挡。
keypoints.question: 在约 375px 宽的移动端视口下，脉络详述区是否采用适合窄屏的布局（例如折叠为上下单栏），并避免两栏被过度挤压、横向溢出或文字难以阅读？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'用户在时间轴可视化图表上滑动或点击不同月份节点'
keypoints.question: 时间轴图表上的月份节点是否为可交互元素（鼠标悬停时呈现可点击/可选反馈，如指针变为手型或节点状态变化）？

keypoints.basis: [行业惯例] 指令要求图表'展示事件热度起伏'，数据可视化通常需标注度量含义
keypoints.question: 时间轴图表或其说明文字是否标明了热度数值的含义/单位（如报道量、讨论量等），而非只有一串无解释的图形？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户验收明确要求“数据状态切换的动效耗时控制在顺滑的范围内”，并要求详情内容“实时过渡”，现有条目只检查是否存在过渡动效，未检查动效耗时和连续切换时的响应。
keypoints.question: 时间轴月份切换的过渡是否能在短暂且顺滑的时间内完成，并且连续快速选择多个节点时不会排队播放已经过时的状态，最终及时稳定显示最后选择月份的内容？
keypoints.subcategory: 动效时长与连续操作响应

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户验收明确要求“DOM 节点更新不能引发全局重排卡顿”，并要求无刷新切换时“不能有生硬的闪屏或跳动”；现有条目尚未直接检查切换过程中的全局布局稳定性。
keypoints.question: 反复切换时间轴节点时，页面是否仅更新主控台选中状态和对应详情内容，且页面滚动位置、模块外框及前后区块的位置保持稳定，没有整页闪烁、明显布局跳动或全局重排卡顿？
keypoints.subcategory: 局部更新性能与布局稳定性

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

ambiguities: 请求没有指定必须采用的真实新闻事件或权威数据集，因此可检查事件、人物、日期、热度和信源之间的内部一致性与具体性，但不能在没有外部基准的情况下把某一套事实或热度数值设为唯一正确答案。
“几个月甚至几年”中的“甚至几年”是范围扩展而非必须达到数年；核心要求是体现跨多个月份或年份的长期追踪，而不是强制固定年限。
“滑动或点击不同月份节点”允许可用的选择方式二选一，不应同时强制鼠标滑动和点击；悬停反馈也不是业务终点。
“所有报道出处”应理解为页面实际呈现或引用的所有报道，而不是要求离线页面穷尽现实世界中的全部相关报道。
左侧局部滚动以“如果太长”为条件；只有内容发生溢出时才适用，且它属于布局行为而非新闻追踪的核心信息结果。

outcomes.endpoint: 读者能够明确页面追踪的是哪一个具体事件，理解其高层背景，并从各阶段的深度报道及关键人物或时间节点中获得连贯、同主题且非占位的事件脉络。
outcomes.quote: 核心诉求是能把拉锯几个月甚至几年的复杂新闻理清脉络。
test_cases: 在浏览器加载页面后，仅阅读题图与导语，确认能够辨认一个具体、完整的单一事件名称，并获得概括事件背景、主要矛盾或影响的总结，而不是泛化新闻标签或无关模板文案。
在同一会话中按时间顺序查看最早、中间和最晚的可选阶段，确认各阶段均围绕同一事件提供实质性的追踪内容，并包含与该阶段相符的关键人物或时间节点；前后内容应形成可理解的演进关系，且不混入参考页面品牌或其他行业内容。

outcomes.endpoint: 读者能够从时间轴辨认各节点所对应的日期、长期覆盖范围和热度指标含义，并据此识别事件热度随时间的高低变化。
outcomes.quote: 用带有横向时间刻度的数据可视化图表展示事件热度起伏。
test_cases: 加载页面并通过可见的横向刻度读取至少三个分布在多个月份或年份中的节点，依据页面声明的热度单位或说明辨认一个较高点和一个较低点；若节点显示具体数值，则核对图形高低或走势与这些数值的相对关系一致。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户选择不同时间节点后，页面无需整体重新加载即可把详细报道和关键人物或时间节点信息一起切换到所选阶段；连续选择时最终内容必须对应最后一次选择。
outcomes.quote: 当用户在时间轴可视化图表上滑动或点击不同月份节点时，下方的两栏详情区要进行无刷新的状态切换
test_cases: 记录当前选中月份及左右详情内容，再通过页面提供的正常控制选择一个内容不同的月份；确认选中状态指向新月份，左侧报道和右侧人物或节点信息都变为该阶段的对应内容，并且过程中没有发生整页导航或重新加载。
依次快速选择三个不同节点并停止操作，待页面稳定后确认选中状态、左侧报道和右侧信息都对应最后选择的节点，较早选择的延迟更新不会随后覆盖最终状态。

outcomes.endpoint: 读者能够在信源追溯区找到页面所涉及报道的具体出处，每条记录至少具有可识别的媒体名称、报道标题和发布日期，并能与页面中的新闻叙事相对应。
outcomes.quote: 用底部的纯文本表格列出所有报道出处。
test_cases: 浏览页面呈现或引用的阶段报道后检查信源追溯区，确认相关报道均有非占位的出处记录，并逐条显示媒体名称、具体报道标题和发布日期；记录内容应与所追踪事件一致，而不是无关示例数据。

core_scope.purpose: 帮助读者在单一新闻事件的长期追踪页中，通过背景概览、热度时间轴、分阶段深度报道、关键人物或节点信息及可追溯信源，理清跨越数月或更久的复杂事件脉络。
review_notes: 将单文件、自包含、移动端适配、局部滚动、固定四区顺序及具体视觉风格保留为补充要求；它们是重要的交付或呈现约束，但移除其中任一项并不会直接消除读者理清事件脉络的主要结果。
把提案遗漏的热度时间信息可理解性和信源可追溯性提升为核心信息结果，因为它们分别承载长期趋势和报道依据，而不只是装饰性版块。
条目9、12、10和16同时混合了核心内容与指定的模块隔离、两栏布局、图表形式或表格形式，因此归入对应 outcome 的 mixed_item_ids，而没有把这些外观形式单独设为核心门槛。
时间轴联动保留为核心，因为它是访问不同阶段报道和人物或节点信息的主要机制；纯过渡动画条目15仍为补充。条目28和29兼含最终状态正确性与动画时长、布局稳定等表现要求，故作为混合条目处理。
核心测试按完整用户场景合并，不再把加载页面、寻找节点和点击节点拆成独立的琐碎测试。

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「暖底红线古风文字页」那一份基本一致（主体内容限制最大宽度并居中，页面通过贯穿的水平细红线分割大模块，模块内采用流式的左右不对称两栏（左长文右信息块）或表格形式排版，类似纸质文档。）？
字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「黑白深色块企业单页」那一份基本一致（使用硬朗的现代无衬线字体，标题字重很大且字号极大，与小号、浅色的说明性正文形成了极具冲击力的层级与粗细对比。）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「C」份「卖手表的落地页」：极其强调大面积留白，首屏左侧文字搭配右侧巨大产品图形成非对称分栏，页面底部只有居中对齐的极简单行页脚。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「卖手表的落地页」那一份基本一致（极其强调大面积留白，首屏左侧文字搭配右侧巨大产品图形成非对称分栏，页面底部只有居中对齐的极简单行页脚）？

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「像素游戏界面」在这一面是：全屏游戏画布，没有常规文档流分栏，UI元素作为弹窗居中悬浮或作为工具栏固定在底部。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「像素游戏界面」那一份（全屏游戏画布，没有常规文档流分栏，UI元素作为弹窗居中悬浮或作为工具栏固定在底部）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「B」份「米黄底色酒店」在这一面是：首屏为全屏大图，向下滚动后是图文交错的通栏结构，评价区采用多列等宽的卡片平铺网格。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「米黄底色酒店」那一份（首屏为全屏大图，向下滚动后是图文交错的通栏结构，评价区采用多列等宽的卡片平铺网格）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「D」份「有亮绿背景那个」在这一面是：结构十分密集多变，包含左侧边栏+右主内容的文档布局、大通栏横幅，以及上方引图+下方双列均分的卡片网格。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「有亮绿背景那个」那一份（结构十分密集多变，包含左侧边栏+右主内容的文档布局、大通栏横幅，以及上方引图+下方双列均分的卡片网格）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「E」份「红帽小哥的博客」在这一面是：包含左文右小图的深色单列列表，以及典型的左侧大块主文+右侧窄栏放个人名片的双栏博客结构。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「红帽小哥的博客」那一份（包含左文右小图的深色单列列表，以及典型的左侧大块主文+右侧窄栏放个人名片的双栏博客结构）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「B」份「米黄底色酒店」：大标题使用极具优雅复古感的细衬线体，搭配字距极宽的极小号全大写无衬线字作为引题，字号层级反差极其悬殊。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「B」92px vs 「A」40px；字号档数：「B」15档 vs 「A」7档；字族：「B」times/ui-sans-serif/ui-serif vs 「A」arial。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「米黄底色酒店」那一份神似（大标题使用极具优雅复古感的细衬线体，搭配字距极宽的极小号全大写无衬线字作为引题，字号层级反差极其悬殊，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「像素游戏界面」在这一面是：全采用常规无衬线体，字号反差较小，按钮等组件内有全大写的文字。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「像素游戏界面」那一份（全采用常规无衬线体，字号反差较小，按钮等组件内有全大写的文字）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「卖手表的落地页」在这一面是：全部使用现代圆润的无衬线体，层级主要依靠粗细和大小平滑过渡来区分，风格中规中矩。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「卖手表的落地页」那一份（全部使用现代圆润的无衬线体，层级主要依靠粗细和大小平滑过渡来区分，风格中规中矩）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「有亮绿背景那个」在这一面是：全部为无衬线体，营销区块的大标题十分粗大醒目，文档部分的字体偏小且排版紧凑。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「有亮绿背景那个」那一份（全部为无衬线体，营销区块的大标题十分粗大醒目，文档部分的字体偏小且排版紧凑）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「E」份「红帽小哥的博客」在这一面是：博客部分的标题和人名使用了偏厚重的粗衬线体，正文搭配常规无衬线，没有第2份那种极端的大小字号反差与宽字距处理。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 16px、最大标题字号 40px、字号档数 7档、字族 arial、字重档数 2档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「红帽小哥的博客」那一份（博客部分的标题和人名使用了偏厚重的粗衬线体，正文搭配常规无衬线，没有第2份那种极端的大小字号反差与宽字距处理）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「像素游戏界面」：采用深色半透明带有隐约内描边的圆角弹窗，按钮是纯蓝色小圆角，底部有带暗色底盘的方形小图标组。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大圆角：「A」12px vs 「C」4px；圆角档数：「A」5档 vs 「C」2档；阴影档数：「A」4档 vs 「C」1档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「像素游戏界面」那一份基本一致（采用深色半透明带有隐约内描边的圆角弹窗，按钮是纯蓝色小圆角，底部有带暗色底盘的方形小图标组）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「米黄底色酒店」在这一面是：几乎没有实体组件感，卡片完全不带阴影，仅依靠极细的单像素浅色描边或大留白来进行分割。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「米黄底色酒店」那一份（几乎没有实体组件感，卡片完全不带阴影，仅依靠极细的单像素浅色描边或大留白来进行分割）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「卖手表的落地页」在这一面是：最显著的组件是使用了鲜艳橙色到黄色的渐变填充、且带有柔和同色系发光阴影的大圆角按钮。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「卖手表的落地页」那一份（最显著的组件是使用了鲜艳橙色到黄色的渐变填充、且带有柔和同色系发光阴影的大圆角按钮）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「有亮绿背景那个」在这一面是：包含浅灰底色上的纯白直角卡片（带有柔和的浅色弥散阴影），以及带有绿色背景填色的文字提示框。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「有亮绿背景那个」那一份（包含浅灰底色上的纯白直角卡片（带有柔和的浅色弥散阴影），以及带有绿色背景填色的文字提示框）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「E」份「红帽小哥的博客」在这一面是：深色列表里的缩略图无边框，博客区的人物资料卡只有极浅的边框和极其微弱的阴影，组件样式平淡。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「C」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：最大圆角 4px、圆角档数 2档、阴影档数 1档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「红帽小哥的博客」那一份（深色列表里的缩略图无边框，博客区的人物资料卡只有极浅的边框和极其微弱的阴影，组件样式平淡）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「A」份「像素游戏界面」：带有强烈的复古像素电子游戏感，情绪上偏向互动探索和轻松的模拟生存。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：底色种类数：「A」7种 vs 「D」3种；整页高度：「A」1080px vs 「D」3004px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 把成品和这 5 份参考并排看，成品的整体气场（情绪调性、松紧克制）最接近哪一份？必须挑出一份（不许答「都差不多」）。候选：「像素游戏界面」（带有强烈的复古像素电子游戏感，情绪上偏向互动探索和轻松的模拟生存。）；「米黄底色酒店」（传递出优雅、宁静、缓慢的高端度假氛围，情绪克制且具有人文艺术感。）；「卖手表的落地页」（典型的现代商业推销氛围，干净直接，重点突出产品，情绪外放且带有消费诱导感。）；「有亮绿背景那个」（刻板严谨的技术说明书氛围，平铺直叙，情绪冷静客观甚至略显枯燥。）；「红帽小哥的博客」（现代商业与个人IP混合的活跃氛围，带有数字营销的朝气和内容聚合的充实感。）。答案是「像素游戏界面」才算通过，挑了别的份即为跟错。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「有亮绿背景那个」那样：包含了极具视觉冲击力的大面积亮绿色渐变色块，其他区域以浅灰/纯白为底，搭配标准蓝色作为标题和按钮强调色。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「有亮绿背景那个」那一份（包含了极具视觉冲击力的大面积亮绿色渐变色块，其他区域以浅灰/纯白为底，搭配标准蓝色作为标题和按钮强调色）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「红帽小哥的博客」那样：一半是深紫灰色背景的暗调画面，另一半是纯白背景，文字大量使用深黑，仅用少量的暗绿色（如按钮边框）作为点缀。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「红帽小哥的博客」那一份（一半是深紫灰色背景的暗调画面，另一半是纯白背景，文字大量使用深黑，仅用少量的暗绿色（如按钮边框）作为点缀）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面把跨形态要求抬到了档 1（移动端优先 / 严格响应式）。参考截图只有桌面宽度，所以窄屏形态是**推断**出来的，不是照抄；判定看窄屏帧与 1920px 主帧之间结构是否真的不同。
keypoints.question: 窄屏（390px）下的信息层级是否**重排**过（导航收起、多列变单列、主次顺序按小屏重新安排），而不是把桌面版等比缩小？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'i'm trying to put together an internal job openings page for our team'
keypoints.question: 页面主题是否整体呈现为「团队内部职位空缺 / 招聘」页面（标题、文案、板块内容都服务于内部招聘），而非其他行业或用途的页面？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'it needs to be really easy to use with a clear nav bar, a job list section, and an application form'
keypoints.question: 页面是否同时包含三个可辨识的核心板块：导航栏、职位列表区和申请表单区？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'a clear nav bar'，导航需清晰对应页面内容
keypoints.question: 导航栏中的链接项文案是否与页面实际板块一一对应（例如「职位列表」「申请」等），没有指向页面上并不存在的板块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'really easy to use with a clear nav bar'，导航需可用
keypoints.question: 点击导航栏中指向职位列表的链接后，页面是否确实滚动或跳转到职位列表板块，而不是无响应或错误跳转？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提供内部职位空缺页面及 job list section；职位列表应包含可供浏览的多个实际职位。
keypoints.question: 职位列表区是否包含多个互不相同且有实质内容的职位条目，而不是仅有一条示例或纯占位文字？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提供易于使用的职位列表；条目需要基本岗位信息才能让用户区分和选择职位。
keypoints.question: 每个职位条目是否除职位名称外，还提供至少一项有助于识别或判断岗位的关键信息（如团队、地点、工作类型或简短说明），而非只有孤立标题？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求职位列表与申请表单配合形成完整流程（'a job list section, and an application form'）
keypoints.question: 每个职位条目是否都带有明确的后续操作入口，例如“申请”或“查看详情”按钮或链接？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'taking a cue from how straightforward gov.uk is with its flow'，从职位到申请应有连贯流程
keypoints.question: 点击职位条目上的“申请”或“查看详情”入口后，页面是否产生符合入口含义的可见响应，例如滚动至申请表单、带入所选职位或展开职位详情？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求 application form；一个可用的内部职位申请流程至少需要识别申请人、联系申请人并确定所申请职位。
keypoints.question: 申请表单是否收集申请人姓名、至少一种联系方式，并能明确其申请的职位（通过字段选择或从职位入口自动带入）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求职位列表与申请表单构成 'straightforward flow'（gov.uk 式的顺畅流程）
keypoints.question: 申请表单中的「意向职位」字段（下拉或选项组）的可选值，是否与页面上职位列表里列出的职位名称一致，而不是无关的通用选项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'taking a cue from how straightforward gov.uk is with its flow'，gov.uk 表单以显式标签、清晰必填标注著称

ambiguities: The request does not specify exact vacancies, role metadata, form fields, or validation formats, so authored content and constraints are acceptable when they are clearly declared and recruitment-relevant.

No backend or application-delivery service is requested or feasible for an offline self-contained page; a valid submission is therefore established by a clear client-side confirmation rather than proof of server delivery.

The request asks for both a job list and an application form but does not require every job card to launch or prefill the form; direct form access with a correct role selector remains a valid substitute.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access and understand multiple distinct internal job openings, with each role providing enough relevant information to identify or evaluate it.
outcomes.quote: a job list section
test_cases: Starting from a fresh page load, use normal page scrolling to reach the job list and verify that it presents at least two distinct, substantive internal-recruitment roles; each displayed role must have a unique title and at least one useful identifying detail such as team, location, work type, or summary, without unrelated non-recruitment entries.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can enter applicant details, choose an actually listed role, receive visible validation for invalid required input, and obtain a clear client-side success confirmation after a valid submission.
outcomes.quote: an application form
test_cases: On a fresh page load, compare the form's selectable role values with the displayed job titles, select one listed role, enter a name and an accepted contact method, satisfy every required constraint declared by the page, submit the form, and verify that a clear success confirmation appears.

On a fresh page load, select a listed role and complete the other required fields with valid values, leave one visibly required field empty, submit the form, and verify that a visible validation message identifies the unmet requirement and that no success confirmation is shown.

core_scope.purpose: Enable team members to discover substantive internal job openings and submit an application for a selected listed role.
review_notes: Reduced the proposal to the two non-substitutable end-user goals: understanding available internal roles and submitting an application.
Moved navigation behavior to supplementary scope because a navigation bar is a requested usability mechanism, but scrolling or another clear route can still deliver both primary outcomes.

Moved iPad viewport fit, touch-target sizing, responsive behavior, visual references, colors, typography, graphics, footer treatment, and component styling to supplementary scope because they affect presentation or usability rather than the recruitment endpoints.
Kept items 36 and 37 mixed because they partly assess core recruitment relevance but also impose supplementary anti-copy and originality constraints tied to the reference material.
Kept structural-existence and control-label checks supplementary when they do not establish substantive role information, validation behavior, or successful form completion.

Kept per-job action and prefilling checks supplementary because linking every listing directly into the form is a useful enhancement but is substitutable by a clear form with an accurate role selector.

ambiguities: The word "like" makes the four category names examples of the requested hyper-local direction rather than an unambiguous demand that every label appear verbatim. Item 10 is therefore mixed because it tests the core category content while imposing stricter exact wording.

No backend, timestamps, or authoritative activity feed are specified. Recent-thread and latest-reply data may therefore be realistic static client-side data, with recency interpreted according to the page's declared ordering or labels.

The Post a Notice requirement defines an in-page editor but does not define validation, persistence, publication, or the result of pressing its submission control. Those transactions must not be invented as core endpoints.
The mention of "search bars" occurs in a list of UI elements whose corners must be square; it does not clearly require that a search feature be added. Item 24 is therefore supplementary.
The local-time greeting may reasonably use the browser's local clock, but that greeting is atmosphere and personalization rather than a non-substitutable noticeboard goal.

outcomes.endpoint: The main index clearly identifies the Southside neighborhood board, presents intelligible hyper-local board categories, and makes three recent thread titles from a board card accessible as actual board content. The precise masonry geometry, hover effect, and reveal animation are not part of this core endpoint.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item isolates the core content endpoint: item 10 makes the four example labels exact mandatory text, while items 12 and 28 combine access to the three thread titles with specific hover and animation requirements.
outcomes.quote: The main section will be the forum board list, broken down into hyper-local categories like "Tool Library & Swaps", "Lost Pets", "Block Party Planning", and "Local Biz Recommendations".
test_cases: From a fresh load, verify that the page identifies itself with the heading "The Stoop: Southside Neighbors" and that the main board presents readable categories covering the named hyper-local subjects; localized or comparably hyper-local wording is acceptable because the request says "like" rather than making all four labels exclusive.

Using a normal control offered by the page, reveal or open one board card and verify that exactly three distinct titles identified by the page as that board's recent active threads become readable within the card; do not require a particular stagger, height change, or slide animation.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can invoke Post a Notice from the main index, obtain an in-page message editor and submission control, and enter a quick message without navigation. Stickiness and the sliding presentation are supplementary, and no persistence or backend publication result is implied.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 25 and 26 cover access to the form only together with sticky-footer or slide-out presentation requirements, and neither explicitly verifies entered message text as the endpoint.
outcomes.quote: include a sticky footer bar that houses a quick "Post a Notice" form, allowing a user to expand a sliding panel to write a quick message without ever leaving the main index.
test_cases: From the main index, invoke "Post a Notice", verify that the current document and URL remain in place, enter a unique phrase into the revealed message field, confirm the field contains that exact phrase, and verify that a submission control is available without assuming any unspecified persistence or server response.

outcomes.endpoint: All interactive controls can be reached in a sensible sequence and operated with the keyboard without a focus trap, including board-card disclosure, both view options, and the in-page notice form. The requested orange focus-outline styling remains supplementary.
outcomes.quote: you also need to guarantee perfect keyboard accessibility.
test_cases: Reload the page and use only the keyboard: traverse the available controls, activate a board card with Enter or Space and verify its recent titles become available, operate both view options, open Post a Notice, move focus into its message field, type text, and then navigate back out of the panel, confirming that no required control is skipped and focus is never trapped.

core_scope.purpose: Enable Southside neighbors, including keyboard-only users, to browse an intelligible hyper-local forum noticeboard and compose a quick notice without leaving the main index.
review_notes: The proposed dynamic greeting, view toggle, live ticker, and their animation details were removed from core membership because the neighborhood board remains usable without those substitutable presentation and navigation enhancements.

The forum directory and its requested recent-thread information were retained as core informational content; the masonry arrangement, hover modality, stagger, height reveal, and slide direction remain supplementary portions of mixed checks.
Notice composition was retained as a distinct core user goal, but sticky positioning and panel animation were not promoted into the endpoint.

Keyboard operability was retained as a core access goal because otherwise keyboard-only members could not complete the requested board and notice workflows. The thickness and orange color of the focus indicator remain supplementary styling.
The original fragmented interaction tests were replaced with end-to-end scenarios that invoke a feature and verify its meaningful final content or state.
No core transaction was created for the decorative Live Activity ticker, and no backend publication or deployment behavior was inferred.

ambiguities: The referenced coffee-shop screenshots are unavailable, so exact visual fidelity, color values, typography, and card styling cannot be derived beyond the written descriptions.

The overview says the guide teaches colors, text, and buttons, while the specifically enumerated lessons are Welcome, Magic Colors, Shape Shifter, and Bouncy Buttons and do not include a dedicated text lesson. A separate instructional text section should therefore not be invented as a core gate.
The word "Copied!" could suggest writing a color value to the system clipboard, but the request only specifies changing the text inside the clicked circle. Clipboard modification is not required.
Confetti is introduced with "maybe" and is optional rather than a mandatory outcome.

outcomes.endpoint: A child can read an intelligible Design Rulebook rather than an unrelated coffee-themed page, including the requested Welcome, Magic Colors, Shape Shifter, and Bouncy Buttons lesson content and the prescribed three-color palette.
outcomes.quote: Essentially, we are teaching elementary school kids the basics of putting together a website, and this page will be their guide for how to use colors, text, and buttons properly.
test_cases: Open the local page and read through its lesson content; verify the Welcome explains that this is a secret rulebook for building cool internet things, all four named lessons contain understandable content or examples rather than empty headings, and Magic Colors presents the prescribed dark brown, warm tan, and creamy beige colors.

outcomes.endpoint: Manipulating the Shape Shifter slider changes the demonstrated square's corner radius continuously and immediately across the declared range, with a sharp-cornered minimum and circular maximum and no submit or reload step.
outcomes.quote: As they drag the slider left and right, the corners of the big box should instantly change from completely sharp and pointy to completely round like a circle.
test_cases: In the Shape Shifter lesson, set the slider to its minimum and verify the displayed target has zero corner radius; then drag toward the middle and confirm the radius visibly changes before the drag is released, and continue to the maximum and verify the square becomes fully circular without submitting or reloading.

outcomes.endpoint: The complete rulebook is delivered as one self-contained HTML file that opens directly from the local filesystem and retains its content and core live lesson behavior without network access or companion assets.
outcomes.quote: The whole thing has to work in just one single file that I can open by double-clicking it.
test_cases: With the browser cache cleared, network access disabled, and only the delivered HTML file available, open it directly through a local file URL; verify the four lessons render and complete the Shape Shifter minimum-to-maximum interaction successfully without any external file or network dependency.

core_scope.purpose: Deliver an offline, single-file, child-friendly Design Rulebook whose requested Welcome, color, corner-radius, and button lessons are accessible and understandable, with the corner-radius lesson providing a working live demonstration.
review_notes: Added the informational lesson content as a core outcome because an intelligible rulebook is the page's primary end-user purpose.
Removed scroll tracking and navigation mechanics from core status. They are important supplementary navigation requirements, but the lessons remain accessible by ordinary scrolling without them.

Kept the live Shape Shifter transformation as core because it directly demonstrates the requested corner-radius concept; overlapping checklist items 10, 17, and 21 were collapsed into one end-to-end outcome.

Treated checklist item 12 as mixed because the presence of all four lessons supports the core informational outcome, while their exact stacking order is a layout requirement. Item 14 is mixed because the prescribed palette is core lesson content while large circular presentation is visual styling.

The Magic Colors "Copied!" feedback and the Bouncy Buttons disappearance, message, hover wiggle, and shrink effects remain supplementary engagement behaviors rather than separate indispensable educational goals.
Retained single-file offline delivery as core because direct local distribution to teachers is a non-substitutable practical purpose of the requested artifact.

Generic control-existence, DOM-change, exception, anchor, responsive-layout, accessibility-size, and visual-style checks remain supplementary and were not used as substitutes for specific endpoint correctness.

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「像纸质文档那份」：极简的居中单列文本流，大面积留白，主要依靠贯穿页面的细横线来划分信息区块和构建类似账本的列表。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「B」16px vs 「C」10px；元素密度：「B」53.7个/千像素高 vs 「C」12个/千像素高；整页高度：「B」5249px vs 「C」1080px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「像纸质文档那份」那一份基本一致（极简的居中单列文本流，大面积留白，主要依靠贯穿页面的细横线来划分信息区块和构建类似账本的列表。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「带红字大标题那份」在这一面是：包含顶部分散的按钮导航，中间有多列图片网格，下方是左侧正文右侧边栏的两栏经典布局。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带红字大标题那份」那一份（包含顶部分散的按钮导航，中间有多列图片网格，下方是左侧正文右侧边栏的两栏经典布局。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「3D多边形风景那份」在这一面是：全屏连续画面，完全没有常规的网页UI版式或网格结构，仅底部有一行极小的提示文字。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「3D多边形风景那份」那一份（全屏连续画面，完全没有常规的网页UI版式或网格结构，仅底部有一行极小的提示文字。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「D」份「带人物照片主页那份」在这一面是：标准的现代区块化布局，顶部有文字导航栏，主体包含通栏大图以及左右图文混排的内容块。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「C」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 10px、元素密度 12个/千像素高、整页高度 1080px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带人物照片主页那份」那一份（标准的现代区块化布局，顶部有文字导航栏，主体包含通栏大图以及左右图文混排的内容块。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「D」份「带人物照片主页那份」：使用标准的现代无衬线字体，字号反差清晰（大粗黑体标题配小号浅灰正文），局部点缀有手写体签名，排版风格常规且干净。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「D」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「D」24px vs 「B」52px；字号档数：「D」6档 vs 「B」14档；字族：「D」montserrat/open/themify vs 「B」cormorant/times。产出应落在「D」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带人物照片主页那份」那一份基本一致（使用标准的现代无衬线字体，字号反差清晰（大粗黑体标题配小号浅灰正文），局部点缀有手写体签名，排版风格常规且干净。）？

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「带红字大标题那份」在这一面是：大标题使用字距很宽的粗体字（带做旧斑驳效果），导航文本全大写，整体有一种带有力量感的复古海报排版风格。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带红字大标题那份」那一份（大标题使用字距很宽的粗体字（带做旧斑驳效果），导航文本全大写，整体有一种带有力量感的复古海报排版风格。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「像纸质文档那份」在这一面是：全篇使用古典优雅的衬线字体，广泛搭配斜体和小型大写字母，呈现出浓厚的传统书籍或期刊的印刷排版感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「像纸质文档那份」那一份（全篇使用古典优雅的衬线字体，广泛搭配斜体和小型大写字母，呈现出浓厚的传统书籍或期刊的印刷排版感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「3D多边形风景那份」在这一面是：几乎不涉及排版，仅在页面最底部居中有一行极小的无衬线操作说明文字。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「3D多边形风景那份」那一份（几乎不涉及排版，仅在页面最底部居中有一行极小的无衬线操作说明文字。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「带红字大标题那份」：导航项是带图标的灰色药丸/胶囊形按钮；底部表单输入框是浅灰底无边框的直角矩形；主操作按钮是带白图标的珊瑚红扁平直角块。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大圆角：「A」4px vs 「D」40px；圆角档数：「A」1档 vs 「D」4档；是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「A」无 vs 「D」有。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「带红字大标题那份」那一份基本一致（导航项是带图标的灰色药丸/胶囊形按钮；底部表单输入框是浅灰底无边框的直角矩形；主操作按钮是带白图标的珊瑚红扁平直角块。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「像纸质文档那份」在这一面是：几乎没有传统的容器型UI组件，去除了按钮和卡片的包围外壳，数据和选项直接依附于背景并通过极简细线组织。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「像纸质文档那份」那一份（几乎没有传统的容器型UI组件，去除了按钮和卡片的包围外壳，数据和选项直接依附于背景并通过极简细线组织。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「3D多边形风景那份」在这一面是：画面纯粹是3D场景，不存在任何网页交互组件（如按钮、卡片、输入框）。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「3D多边形风景那份」那一份（画面纯粹是3D场景，不存在任何网页交互组件（如按钮、卡片、输入框）。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「带人物照片主页那份」在这一面是：组件样式极其克制，几乎没有带底色填充的按钮或卡片，多通过留白和极细的浅色边框线（如引言区块）来界定组件。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「D」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：最大圆角 40px、圆角档数 4档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带人物照片主页那份」那一份（组件样式极其克制，几乎没有带底色填充的按钮或卡片，多通过留白和极细的浅色边框线（如引言区块）来界定组件。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「3D多边形风景那份」那样：摒弃了网页常见的纯色底，整个版面被低多边形渲染的环境色填满（暗红的黄昏、偏紫的暮色），整体呈暗调氛围光感。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「3D多边形风景那份」那一份（摒弃了网页常见的纯色底，整个版面被低多边形渲染的环境色填满（暗红的黄昏、偏紫的暮色），整体呈暗调氛围光感。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'a website for my local fresh produce delivery business where restaurants and families can place weekly orders'
keypoints.question: 页面整体主题是否呈现为本地生鲜农产品配送业务（面向餐厅与家庭的每周订购），而非其他行业或通用模板内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“For the actual ordering part, I want a step-by-step form”，因此表单应分步呈现并支持实际推进，但未限定推进控件的具体文字。
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供一个可实际操作的分步骤每周订购表单，并可通过「下一步」「继续」或同等控件从当前步骤进入后续步骤，而不是将所有字段一次性静态平铺？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求在分步表单顶部显示进度条，使用户知道距离完成每周订单还有多远，但未指定必须采用“第 X 步／共 Y 步”的文字格式。
keypoints.question: 订购表单顶部是否设有清晰可见的进度条或等效步骤进度指示器，能够让用户判断当前所处步骤或距离完成订单的大致进度？

keypoints.basis: 进度条用于告知用户距离完成订单还有多远，因此其状态应随表单步骤变化同步更新。
keypoints.question: 用户从订购表单第一步成功进入第二步后，顶部进度条的填充比例、当前步骤高亮或其他进度状态是否同步向前更新？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Put the phone number, delivery areas, and business address right at the very top'
keypoints.question: 页面最顶部区域（首屏、订购表单与正文之前）是否同时给出电话号码、配送区域、营业地址这三项信息？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求顶部信息用于 'know if we service their street'，配送区域需具体到可判断街道/片区
keypoints.question: 顶部的配送区域信息是否具体列出了若干可辨识的服务区域/街区/城镇名称，而不是只写一句「我们提供配送服务」？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求顶部直接给出 'the phone number ... and business address'，须是可用的具体信息
keypoints.question: 顶部展示的电话号码与营业地址是否为完整可辨识的形式（电话含完整号码格式、地址含街道与城市等），而非 'phone' / 'address' 之类的占位文字？

keypoints.basis: 指令提到 'so they can comfortably read all our sourcing details' 与 'we have long descriptions of our farm partners'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含介绍农场合作伙伴 / 采购来源（sourcing）的板块，且其描述为成段的长文字（每个合作伙伴不少于一段完整叙述），而非一句话标签？

keypoints.basis: 指令中 'long descriptions of our farm partners' 为复数，需多个合作伙伴条目
keypoints.question: 农场合作伙伴板块是否列出至少 2 个具名的合作农场/供应商，每个都配有自己的名称与对应描述文字？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Include a massive text section at the bottom explaining our fresh guarantee, refund policy, and strict delivery cutoff times in detail'
keypoints.question: 页面底部是否有一个大篇幅文字板块，且其中明确分出「新鲜保证（fresh guarantee）」「退款政策（refund policy）」「配送截止时间（delivery cutoff times）」三个可辨认的主题？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求详细说明 'strict delivery cutoff times ... in detail'
keypoints.question: 配送截止时间的说明中是否给出了具体的星期与钟点（例如「周三 18:00 前下单，周五送达」），而不是泛泛地说「请提前下单」？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求底部长文 'explaining our fresh guarantee, refund policy ... in detail'
keypoints.question: 退款政策段落是否给出了具体的适用条件或时限（例如收货后多少小时内提出、哪些情况可退换），而不仅是一句「我们支持退款」？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'solid coral red square buttons to submit the cart'（本条只检查提交按钮的存在与功能语义）
keypoints.question: 订购表单的最后一步是否有一个提交订单／提交购物车的按钮，且按钮文案与「下单、提交订单、Submit Order」等语义一致？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求 'a step-by-step form' 用于 'place weekly orders'，须包含下单必备字段并分步呈现
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供可完成每周订单的分步表单，覆盖客户及联系信息、具体商品与数量、配送地址或时间等关键信息，并将这些信息合理拆分到不同步骤中？

keypoints.basis: 指令说明 restaurants and families 均可 place weekly orders，因此应覆盖两类客户，但未要求必须区分流程。
keypoints.question: 页面是否明确说明餐厅与家庭均可使用每周订购服务，且订购表单能够适用于这两类客户，而不强制要求分别设置不同流程？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求可实际下单的分步表单，步进与提交需要有基本的字段校验反馈
keypoints.question: 在不填写任何字段的情况下点击订购表单的「下一步」或提交按钮，页面是否给出必填校验提示（而不是直接跳过或毫无反应）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借用参考的设计语言，页面主题为 'local fresh produce delivery business'，不应复用截图文字内容
keypoints.question: 页面正文是否全部围绕生鲜配送这一主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名或内容（如 Threadneedle Apiary、Strongly Typed、LogBook、John Doe、蜂蜜/蜂群相关文字）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求做的是自己的生鲜配送站点，截图仅作设计语言参考，条目文本不应复用
keypoints.question: 页面中的板块标题、列表条目与导航/入口文案是否均为自拟的生鲜配送相关内容，而非照搬截图里的条目（如 'INTRODUCTION / DROPDOWN / LEFT SIDEBAR'、'Hive I · Cang Street'、'Lorem ipsum' 占位段落）？

keypoints.basis: 指令通篇描述的是同一个页面上的各个部分（顶部信息、订购表单、底部长文）
keypoints.question: 全部内容（顶部联系信息、分步订购表单、农场来源介绍、底部政策长文）是否都在同一个页面内纵向依次呈现，无需跳转到其他页面？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求：输出单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求餐厅与家庭能够提交每周生鲜订单，因此表单需明确所订商品及数量或订购单位；指令未明确要求价格。
keypoints.question: 订购表单是否提供具体的生鲜商品名称，并允许用户清楚选择相应的订购数量或单位（如公斤、箱或份），而非仅提供无法构成明确订单的泛化选项？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求通过分步表单提交购物车，因此最终提交前应能核对所选商品、数量及配送信息；指令未明确要求价格或金额计算。
keypoints.question: 在最终提交订单前，页面是否提供订单复核信息，列出已选商品、各项数量以及关键配送信息，并在用户返回修改商品或数量后同步更新？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求餐厅和家庭能够实际提交每周订单，因此提交后应提供清晰、可感知的成功反馈。
keypoints.question: 用户填写有效信息并点击最终提交订单按钮后，页面是否进入明确的成功确认状态并告知订单已提交，而不是按钮无响应或仍停留在未完成状态？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户强调需要舒适阅读“all our sourcing details”以及农场合作伙伴的长描述；除篇幅外，还应检查这些描述是否真正包含有用的来源细节。
keypoints.question: 每个农场合作伙伴的来源说明是否包含实质性的采购信息，例如所在地区、主要供应品类以及种植或采收方式，而非以泛化宣传语或无关长段落充数？
