ambiguities: The request supplies no actual phone number, address, delivery localities, farm identities, product catalog, policy terms, or cutoff schedule. Tests can assess specificity, completeness, and internal intelligibility, but cannot verify invented business facts against an external source of truth.

“Place weekly orders” does not specify a backend, payment processor, fulfillment API, or persistence requirement. For an offline self-contained page, collecting the requested order information and reaching an explicit visible confirmation state is treated as the requested endpoint, not proof of a real external transaction.

“Massive” and “in detail” do not define an objective word count. Policy validity should therefore be based on coverage of the three topics and concrete, actionable terms rather than an arbitrary length threshold.

outcomes.endpoint: A prospective customer can readily identify a complete phone number, a usable business address, and specifically named delivery areas so they can determine service eligibility and contact the business.
outcomes.quote: Put the phone number, delivery areas, and business address right at the very top so no one has to dig for them to know if we service their street.
test_cases: Starting from a fresh page load, use normal page reading or scrolling to locate the service information and verify that it contains a complete-looking phone number, a street-and-city business address, and multiple identifiable delivery area or locality names rather than labels, placeholders, or a generic claim of delivery.

outcomes.endpoint: Both restaurant and family customers can construct a weekly order by providing the declared customer/contact and delivery information, selecting concrete produce and quantities or units, and submitting it to reach an explicit in-page confirmation state; an empty required order is rejected with intelligible validation feedback.
outcomes.quote: restaurants and families can place weekly orders
test_cases: From a fresh form state, leave all required fields empty and invoke the available advance or submission control; verify that the order does not progress to completion and that the page identifies the required missing information rather than doing nothing or reporting success.

Follow the page's declared ordering flow as a restaurant customer: enter valid contact and delivery details, choose at least one listed produce item, record its displayed unit, set a specific nonzero quantity, complete all required steps, and submit; verify that the page enters an explicit order-submitted confirmation state.

Follow the declared flow again as a family customer with a different listed product and quantity; verify that the service identifies families as supported, no restaurant-only requirement prevents completion, and final submission reaches the explicit confirmation state.

outcomes.endpoint: Customers can access intelligible sourcing information for at least two named farm partners, with a substantive paragraph for each describing concrete sourcing facts such as location, supplied produce, and growing or harvesting practices.
outcomes.quote: long descriptions of our farm partners
test_cases: Locate the sourcing information through normal page controls and verify that it identifies at least two distinct farm partners by name; for each of two partners, read its associated paragraph and confirm it contains substantive, partner-specific sourcing details such as a location, supplied produce category, and cultivation or harvesting practice rather than a one-line label or generic promotion.

outcomes.endpoint: Customers can read distinct and actionable explanations of the fresh guarantee, refund policy, and delivery cutoff rules, including concrete remedy or eligibility conditions, response time limits, and specific cutoff days and times.
outcomes.quote: Include a massive text section at the bottom explaining our fresh guarantee, refund policy, and strict delivery cutoff times in detail.
test_cases: Locate and read the policy information, then verify that all three requested topics are distinguishable: the fresh guarantee defines how a freshness problem is reported and what remedy is offered, the refund policy states at least one concrete eligibility condition or claim deadline, and the delivery cutoff rules state specific days and clock times according to the page's declared schedule rather than only advising customers to order early.

core_scope.purpose: Enable restaurants and families to understand the local produce delivery service and sourcing, obtain essential service and policy information, and complete a weekly produce order through the page.
review_notes: The ordering core was reframed around the customer outcome of constructing and submitting a valid weekly order. Multi-step presentation is mixed into items 15 and 27, while the progress indicator and its visual update in items 16 and 17 remain supplementary because removing them does not prevent order completion.

Item 26 only checks for the existence and wording of a submission control, not successful submission, so it remains supplementary; item 36 covers the actual visible completion endpoint. Item 35's review-and-edit screen is also supplementary because that extra workflow was not requested.

Item 18 mixes indispensable contact and service-area content with the requested top-of-page placement, so it is mixed rather than wholly core. Items 19 and 20 directly assess whether the information is usable.

Item 23 mixes the three required policy topics with size and bottom-of-page placement. The topic coverage is core, while those layout attributes remain supplementary; the substantive policy checks are mapped through items 24, 25, and 38.
Farm sourcing and policy information remain core informational outcomes because reading that requested content is part of the page's end-user purpose; no backend interaction was invented for them.
The proposed trivial inspection steps were consolidated into self-contained scenarios that verify complete informational or ordering outcomes.

ambiguities: “海量跑者” does not define a runner count, concurrency level, or measurable scale threshold, so it should not create an arbitrary volume gate.

The request does not specify a live-update cadence or data source. An offline simulation with substantive periodic state changes is acceptable, and tests should follow the page's declared update interval.
“报名转化” could describe a broader external funnel, but the concrete page requirements specify a registration anchor plus rules and package information rather than an in-page form or backend submission.

outcomes.endpoint: The primary registration entry navigates users to intelligible, group-specific registration information covering eligibility requirements and race-kit or package contents; the request does not require an offline submission transaction.
outcomes.quote: 核心业务目标是承载赛前报名转化，以及赛中海量跑者状态的实时追踪。
test_cases: Activate the primary registration entry in the Hero and confirm it navigates to the registration rules-and-packages area; compare at least two displayed race groups and verify that each group names its eligibility threshold and itemizes its race-kit or package contents.

outcomes.endpoint: An intelligible runner ranking and status grid supports correct full-marathon or half-marathon and pace-band filtering, shows runner identity and meaningful race progress or status, and updates substantive tracking data without a manual reload while preserving active required filters. Running-club filtering is optional because it is introduced by “甚至”.
outcomes.quote: 核心业务目标是承载赛前报名转化，以及赛中海量跑者状态的实时追踪。
test_cases: Take an unfiltered snapshot of the ranking grid, select Half Marathon and one displayed pace band, and verify every returned runner is labeled Half Marathon and has a displayed pace within the band according to the page's declared boundaries; clear the filters and verify the controls return to an unfiltered state and results are no longer restricted to that group and pace band.

With a race-group and pace filter active, identify an in-race runner and record the runner identifier, rank, current time, pace, distance or checkpoint, and race status. Leave the page open through two page-indicated update cycles and verify that at least one substantive tracking value changes consistently, such as elapsed time or distance increasing or rank changing, rather than only a badge or timestamp changing; confirm the active filters remain applied and all visible rows still satisfy them.

core_scope.purpose: Enable prospective runners to reach and understand race-group registration information, and enable race-time users to inspect continuously updating runner rankings and status with required race-group and pace filtering.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposed gates into the two explicitly stated primary business outcomes: registration conversion support and race-time runner tracking.

Merged the Hero registration anchor and the rules/packages content into one end-to-end registration-information journey. Full-screen Hero treatment and the countdown remain supplementary presentation or engagement requirements.
Promoted substantive automatic runner-data updates and progress/status content into the live-tracking outcome because static filter changes do not satisfy the explicit real-time tracking purpose.
Items 29 and 30 are mixed because they test core pace filtering or live updates while also requiring preservation or use of the running-club dimension, which the request makes optional with “甚至特定跑团”.
Items 22 and 23 are mixed because they cover core registration information while coupling it to the requested card presentation.
Item 32 is supplementary because requiring selection, form completion, and submission invents a transaction not specified by the request.

The map/elevation linkage, smooth row animation, responsive drawer behavior, viewport fit, visual styling, semantic markup, and implementation/performance constraints remain scored supplementary requirements; removing them would not eliminate either primary user outcome.
Items 7 and 17 check generic grid change or control availability but do not by themselves establish correct group and pace-filtered results, so they are not used as core endpoint checks.

ambiguities: The referenced comparison designs are not supplied beyond textual descriptions, so visual similarity or rejection can only be judged from those descriptions.
Checklist items 15 and "inv_1" refer to an undefined reference "A"; they cannot establish a content outcome without further identification of that reference.

The request does not prescribe particular job names, competency values, scoring rules, or archive identifiers, so correctness should be judged by clear labeling, role-to-data correspondence, and meaningful distinctness rather than arbitrary expected numbers.
“目录归档” requests an identifiable archive index but does not clearly require links to separate documents, navigation to other pages, or a backend archive service.
The versioned semantic amendment's endpoint/test wording supersedes any narrower legacy checklist or review wording; original provenance is retained.

outcomes.endpoint: A reader can clearly identify the page as a campus recruitment presentation for the 2024 graduating cohort and encounter sustained recruitment-related narrative rather than only an unrelated page or a terse list of recruitment terms.
outcomes.quote: 咱们这次要做一个面向2024届的校园招聘宣讲页。作为一个极度在意阅读体验和正文展现的博主，我希望这个页面能像一篇引人入胜的深度随笔，而不是一份干巴巴的招聘简章
test_cases: Read the page from its opening through the main body and verify that it explicitly identifies the audience as the 2024 graduating cohort and the subject as campus recruitment or a recruitment presentation, while the surrounding copy forms a coherent recruiting narrative with viewpoints and details rather than only isolated slogans or terms.

outcomes.endpoint: The geek-culture section provides substantive, intelligible prose about the organization’s engineering culture, code practice, technical exploration, collaboration, or the growth of young recruits.
outcomes.quote: 接着是咱们的极客文化引言
test_cases: Read the geek-culture introduction and verify coherent, substantive information about engineering creation, code practice, technical exploration, collaboration, or graduate growth, including a concrete viewpoint or detail rather than unrelated placeholders or isolated slogans. Do not require a particular number of paragraphs or a minimum word count.

outcomes.endpoint: A reader can inspect at least two named roles, understand at least three named competency dimensions, and distinguish the competency data or explanations associated with each role and dimension.
outcomes.quote: 然后是一个展示不同岗位胜任力的动态雷达图
test_cases: Using the page’s normal role-selection controls, inspect one named role and record its labeled competency dimensions and displayed values or explanations; select a second named role and verify that the selected role is clearly identified and that at least one competency value, profile, or role-specific explanation meaningfully differs instead of reusing one static data set.

Hover or otherwise activate one labeled competency dimension and verify that the resulting detail text or value clearly corresponds to that dimension; repeat with a second dimension and verify that the resulting information corresponds to the second label and is not merely a generic visual change.

outcomes.endpoint: Readers can obtain concrete information about past recruitment presentations and identify entries in an intelligible archive index. A single integrated event/archive list or separate components can fulfill these informational purposes.
outcomes.quote: 最后是往期宣讲行程与目录归档。
test_cases: Inspect the final roadshow-and-archive section. Verify that past-event entries provide usable event identity, time/date context and city/university information, and that readers can distinguish entries in the archive by meaningful labels. An integrated list may serve both purposes; do not require a separate index component, a specific labeling format, separate documents or a backend archive service.

core_scope.purpose: Provide a readable, essay-like 2024 campus recruitment presentation that identifies its intended audience, explains the organization’s geek culture and role-specific competencies, and presents useful past roadshow and archive information; cyber visuals, animation, layout treatment, and responsive presentation patterns are supplementary.
review_notes: Core scope was centered on the informational purpose of the recruitment presentation: audience and theme, substantive culture content, role-specific competency information, and past-event/archive information.

The mobile accordion and responsive typography requirements were moved out of core because they concern viewport adaptation and layout presentation; they remain supplementary requirements despite emphatic wording.

The 3D particle hero, radar shape, scan-line animation, transition effects, cyber styling, typography styling, color treatment, and full-width layout were kept supplementary because they are visual or interaction treatments rather than non-substitutable informational goals.

Item 17 is mixed because it checks the presence of requested content sections but also imposes exact section count, order, and decorative dynamic forms. Items 26 and 27 are mixed because they partially verify dimension-specific information while also requiring a particular hover panel and animated transition treatment.

The revised tests combine navigation and interaction setup with verification of the resulting information, including explicit cross-role and cross-dimension correspondence checks rather than accepting a generic DOM or visual change.

Semantic amendment: An introduction needs substantive coherent culture content, not a prescribed paragraph count. Past-event entries and their archive index can share a component; separate presentation and external archival documents were not requested. Keep the explicitly requested competency-dimension interactions unchanged.

ambiguities: The request calls the view 'heavily stateful' but does not define filter dimensions, require simultaneous AND-combination of dimensions, or guarantee that an offered combination can produce zero results. Those advanced behaviors are therefore not independent core gates.

The request does not define whether 'full-size' means intrinsic source resolution or merely an enlarged presentation. The existing checklist operationalizes it as an image visibly larger than the card thumbnail.
The request describes its visual references by appearance rather than by an A/B label, so pal_1 depends on an external reference-to-letter mapping not contained in the request.

outcomes.endpoint: The main view presents an intelligible multi-item secondhand gear listing in which each card identifies its item and provides a visible, relevant thumbnail for image inspection.
outcomes.quote: Halfpipe, my new side project for secondhand gear listings.
test_cases: Load the supplied page and verify that the rendered main view is intelligibly a secondhand gear listing with multiple item cards; for every card, confirm a recognizable item name and a visible, gear-related thumbnail or graphic rather than a broken or blank image area.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can select among multiple available filter states, obtain an in-place list containing only items that satisfy the selected criterion, and clear the filter to restore the complete original list without navigation or a full-page reload.
outcomes.quote: a heavily stateful view where users can dynamically filter items without reloads.
test_cases: Record the complete initial set of visible item names, then choose an offered filter for which the page's displayed item information includes both matches and nonmatches. Activate it through the normal control and verify that the list updates in the same view without navigation or a full-page reload, at least one nonmatching item disappears, and every remaining item satisfies the page-declared criterion.

Starting from a fresh page state, apply one available filter option and verify its resulting set, switch to a different offered option and verify the new set against that option's declared rule, then use the provided clear or equivalent all-items state and confirm that the exact initial set of item names is restored without a reload.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating an item's thumbnail opens an over-page modal containing a visibly larger image corresponding to that specific item, and dismissing it returns the user to the same filtered listing state.
outcomes.quote: clicking a thumbnail opens a full-size image overlay.
test_cases: Apply a non-default filter that leaves at least one item visible, record the selected filter and resulting item names, and activate one visible item's thumbnail. Verify that a modal layer covers the underlying page and shows a visibly larger image corresponding to the clicked item; dismiss it through the provided close method and confirm that the same filter and exact visible-item set remain.

From a state containing at least two items, open the first item's thumbnail, identify the enlarged image, close the overlay, and then open a different item's thumbnail. Verify that the second overlay shows the second item's corresponding image rather than retaining a generic, stale, or wrong image.

core_scope.purpose: Enable users to browse Halfpipe's secondhand gear listings, dynamically narrow the visible items without page reloads, and inspect item images in a full-size overlay.
review_notes: The listing itself is retained as a core informational outcome because recognizable secondhand gear content must be accessible and intelligible.
Item 18 was associated with the listing outcome rather than the overlay flow because it checks whether the card-level listing imagery is present and usable.

Brand prominence and single-file or network packaging checks were moved out of core membership: they are explicit supporting requirements, but removing them does not eliminate the primary browse, filter, and inspect outcomes.

Items 21 and 23 remain supplementary because multi-dimensional intersection semantics and a reachable no-results combination are not specified by the request. Multiple usable filter states are still retained in core through item 14.
Visual styling, typography, active-state appearance, overflow resilience, and generic absence of JavaScript exceptions remain supplementary quality requirements rather than separate end-user goals.

The tests were rewritten as complete scenarios that verify exact filtered sets, restoration, item-specific overlay content, and filter-state persistence instead of treating page opening, control discovery, and clicking as separate tests.

ambiguities: The request names five patient-detail fields but does not specify which of them are mandatory. Validation should follow required indicators or rules declared by the page rather than assuming arbitrarily that all five are required.
No external availability source or date-generation rule is supplied. Tests should use the dates and times actually offered by the page; the example times are explicitly non-mandatory.

The standalone offline deliverable has no backend or email-delivery contract. The claimed email confirmation is therefore assessed as a requested visible success state, not as proof that an email was actually sent.

outcomes.endpoint: A patient can choose one of the four requested specialties, select an offered date and time, enter all five requested patient-detail values, verify those values in Review and Confirm, and confirm the booking. Required omissions are blocked, while a valid confirmation produces a persistent, intelligible success state communicating that the booking is complete and an email confirmation was sent.
outcomes.quote: where prospective and returning patients can book their consultations.
test_cases: In a fresh session, verify that General Practice, Cardiology, Dermatology, and Mental Health are offered; choose one specialty, select any displayed available date and one of the time slots revealed for it, and enter distinct values in First Name, Last Name, Email, Contact Number, and Reason for visit. Proceed to Review and Confirm and compare every displayed specialty, date, time, and patient value with the entered values. Confirm the booking and verify that the form is replaced by an unambiguous success state communicating completion and email confirmation, which remains visible after the transition and a short wait.

In a fresh session, attempt the normal progression from specialty selection without choosing a specialty and verify that availability cannot be reached. After choosing a specialty, attempt to leave availability first without a date or time and then with a date but no time; verify that Patient Details remains inaccessible in both cases. Select a time and verify that Patient Details then becomes reachable.

Reach Patient Details with a valid specialty, date, and time. Attempt to continue with all required fields empty and verify that Review and Confirm is not reached. Then fill every field declared mandatory except one declared mandatory field, attempt again, and verify progression is still blocked. Supply the omitted value and verify that Review and Confirm becomes reachable and accurately shows the entered data.

core_scope.purpose: Enable prospective and returning Northbound patients to complete a consultation booking by choosing a specialty, date, and time, supplying patient details, reviewing the booking, and confirming it.
review_notes: The proposed three outcome groups were collapsed into one end-to-end booking outcome because step progression, data collection, validation, review, and confirmation are parts and valid/invalid paths of the same non-substitutable user goal.

The four specialty offerings, requested patient data, accurate review, recorded time selection, and persistent completion state remain core because they define whether the requested consultation can be configured and confirmed.

Items 14, 19, 20, 21, 29, 30, 31, 40, and 41 are mixed because they combine endpoint-relevant behavior or information with branding, grid/drawer presentation, an exact slot count, warning-color treatment, a green-check decoration, or exact copy precision.

Same-view transitions, no-reload behavior, progress indicators, control existence, animation smoothness, split-screen layout, mobile fit, colors, typography, component styling, ambient effects, and packaging constraints remain supplementary rather than separate core gates.

The revised tests are complete valid and invalid booking scenarios; they do not treat opening the page, locating controls, clicking a button, or observing a generic visual change as independent endpoint tests.

ambiguities: 「比如在区域战报区」makes the regional-report implementation illustrative rather than a mandatory standalone section. Semantic day/week/month switching is core; a particular regional ranking presentation is not.

The request does not provide authoritative business data or expected numeric results, so factual accuracy against a real sales source cannot be tested. Tests can verify labeled numeric content, period semantics, internal state restoration, and drill-down granularity.
「完整数据下钻区」does not specify the hierarchy, dimensions, aggregation rules, or a backend source. A self-contained client-side transition to clearly finer-grained labeled data is therefore sufficient.

outcomes.endpoint: The rendered report clearly identifies 「早八点」, presents current-period sales performance through a numeric headline summary, and supplies intelligible named KPI values including 客单价 and 复购率.
outcomes.quote: 这是为咱们「早八点」品牌打造的内部销售业绩看板。
test_cases: Load the dashboard and evaluate the rendered report as a whole: confirm it identifies 「早八点」 and sales performance as its subject, presents a numeric current-period total or target-completion summary, and shows 客单价 and 复购率 with parseable numeric values; every KPI presented in the KPI summary must pair its value with an intelligible metric name.

outcomes.endpoint: The dashboard provides a substantive executive-brief narrative and coherent long-form sales insights or strategy analysis rather than only labels, slogans, or placeholder prose.
outcomes.quote: 它需要有一种叙事感，像是一份每日清晨递交到高管桌前的精美商业简报。考虑到页面里会带有大量的长正文（包含各类市场洞察和策略分析），阅读体验是第一位的，必须让人能安静、专注地看进去。
test_cases: From a fresh load, read the rendered briefing content and confirm that it uses at least one appropriate briefing cue—such as a date or period, a brief-style introduction, or a connected interpretation of key performance—and that it reads as a coherent executive sales brief rather than a field list.

Read the long-form insight or strategy passage and confirm it is specific to sales activity and contains at least one concrete data phenomenon, causal judgment, or actionable recommendation; Lorem Ipsum, repeated boilerplate, and short promotional slogans do not establish the endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: Using the time-dimension controls changes the displayed analysis to a semantically appropriate day, week, or month data state, with deterministic values and labels for each state; animation quality is supplementary.
outcomes.quote: 比如在区域战报区，点击切换日、周、月维度时，对应的数据流和图表变化要带有高级的排位重组过渡动效，画面变化要像水流一样自然，绝不能一卡一卡的生硬刷新。
test_cases: Select 日 and record the visible time labels and representative numeric values or ranked entries; select 周 and then 月, verifying that each resulting axis, range, aggregation label, or data label has the selected period's meaning rather than merely showing arbitrary different numbers; return to 日 and verify that the original day labels and values are restored exactly.

When the analysis presents ranked regions and two declared period states have different ranks, select those states and verify that rows are genuinely ordered according to each state's displayed rank or metric and that returning to the first state restores its exact values and order; smooth positional interpolation is not part of the core assertion.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can activate a data item in the drill-down area and obtain clearly labeled, finer-grained sales data with corresponding metrics, without requiring a backend service.
outcomes.quote: 另外再加上底部的完整数据下钻区，整个页面控制在五个核心板块内。
test_cases: Starting from a fresh page state, use the bottom drill-down area to activate one parent row or item and verify that the resulting view exposes named child-level entities or dimensions with corresponding metric values; an empty container, explanatory text alone, or a repetition of the unchanged parent summary does not satisfy the endpoint.

core_scope.purpose: Enable executives to understand the current sales performance of 「早八点」 through a substantive narrative brief, compare semantically correct day/week/month data states, and inspect finer-grained sales details.
review_notes: Reframed the core around the dashboard's end-user information goals: understanding sales performance, reading substantive executive analysis, comparing time-period data, and inspecting finer detail.

Removed the prescribed section order, exact block count, double navigation, two-column arrangement, four-across layout, responsive reflow, viewport overflow, typography, colors, component styling, and animations from core membership because they are layout or presentation requirements rather than business endpoints.
Kept item 19 mixed because it checks indispensable long-form insight content while also requiring a particular left-column placement.
Kept item 39 mixed because true ordering can support period-state correctness, while continuous positional interpolation is an animation requirement.
Items 26, 27, 29, and 31 assess control existence or feedback more than the completed endpoint; endpoint behavior is covered by items 28, 38, and 40.
The generic DOM-change probe int_1 cannot establish semantic period switching or valid drill-down results and remains supplementary.

The recognizable chart and external-resource condition in item 20 remains supplementary: a chart is a requested presentation form, but the sales information endpoint can be intelligible without making that exact visualization a separate core gate.

ambiguities: No backend, record source, page size, or total record count is specified; an offline self-contained dataset and simulated state changes are sufficient, and tests should follow the page's declared batching rules.
“自动分页加载” does not specify whether loading is triggered by scrolling or time, so either behavior is acceptable when it automatically appends records and preserves the active filter.

The requested failure accessibility endpoint does not necessarily require a pipeline to transition dynamically into failure; checklist item 36 additionally requires a live announcement for such a transition and is therefore mixed rather than a clean core check.

outcomes.endpoint: Clients can inspect multiple CI build records whose project or pipeline identity and textual status are clearly associated, making current build progress intelligible rather than presenting unrelated or purely decorative content.
outcomes.quote: 咱们弄个给客户看进度的CI流水线状态页吧
test_cases: Using the page's supplied records, inspect several entries and verify that each provides enough associated project or pipeline identity and textual status information to determine its CI build progress; do not count color, chart decoration, or an unlabeled status badge alone as sufficient.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can restrict build records to a selected project and automatically receive further batches of records without losing that active project filter.
outcomes.quote: 而且每天跑的构建记录贼多，必须得有按项目筛选和自动分页加载
test_cases: Starting from records covering multiple projects, select one project with the provided control and verify that every remaining visible record is associated with that project and that records from other projects are absent.

Select a project for which the page has further records, note the current rows, then perform the page-declared automatic-loading trigger such as scrolling to its loading boundary or waiting; verify that the row count increases and every newly appended record still matches the selected project.

outcomes.endpoint: A screen-reader user can determine which specific pipeline has failed from semantically associated pipeline identity and failure-status text, without relying on color or visual position.
outcomes.quote: 最后稍微留点神照顾下无障碍，得让盲人靠读屏也能知道哪条流水线挂了
test_cases: Using a screen reader or the browser accessibility tree, navigate the page's failed build record and, without relying on its color or visual placement, determine both the exact pipeline name and that its status is failed from the exposed semantic information.

core_scope.purpose: Allow clients, including screen-reader users, to inspect CI build progress across a large record set, filter records by project, and automatically continue through additional records.
review_notes: The core scope was narrowed to the primary client goal: inspecting CI progress, navigating a large project-partitioned record set, and allowing screen-reader users to identify the failed pipeline.
The company phone number and office address remain supplementary. They are requested credibility/contact details, but removing them does not prevent clients from checking CI progress.

The donut chart, its data presentation, the building-to-success simulation, and the smooth color transition are supplementary. The surrounding request introduces this as an example with “比如”, and a decorative visualization or animation is not a non-substitutable monitoring goal.

Iframe operation is a delivery constraint rather than a separate user outcome. Item 32 is mixed under scalable browsing because it also exercises the core filtering and pagination endpoints while adding iframe and status-update conditions.

Item 24 is mixed because it checks the core record identity/status presentation while also requiring execution-time fields, which were requested as part of the typographic treatment rather than as an indispensable progress endpoint.
Item 36 is mixed because semantic association supports the core screen-reader endpoint, while its mandatory dynamic failure transition and live announcement go beyond the request.
Control-existence item 23 was not promoted to core; behavioral items 26, 27, and 33 establish whether filtering and automatic loading actually achieve their endpoints.

Visual references, component styling, typography, viewport robustness, generic runtime quality, self-containment, contact formatting, and broad accessibility metrics remain supplementary requirements rather than independent core gates.

keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「B」份「带进度条的安全游戏」：灰蓝色的冷色调渐变背景，界面元素中使用了高饱和度的亮黄色和亮红色作为强烈的警示与强调色。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「带进度条的安全游戏」那一份基本一致（灰蓝色的冷色调渐变背景，界面元素中使用了高饱和度的亮黄色和亮红色作为强烈的警示与强调色。）？

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「粗黑框奶酪地窖页」那一份（浅米色背景，搭配大面积黑色用于边框和文字，并以深砖红色或棕色作为大区块底色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「配色」；错误来源「C」份「衬线字体的旅游博客」在这一面是：纯白及极浅的粉白米色作为背景，搭配低饱和度的肉粉色/浅土色作为按钮和标签的强调色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「衬线字体的旅游博客」那一份（纯白及极浅的粉白米色作为背景，搭配低饱和度的肉粉色/浅土色作为按钮和标签的强调色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「配色」；错误来源「D」份「圆角阴影卡片服务页」在这一面是：大面积纯白背景，顶部有深蓝灰色的暗色通栏，数字等强调元素使用了亮橙红色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「圆角阴影卡片服务页」那一份（大面积纯白背景，顶部有深蓝灰色的暗色通栏，数字等强调元素使用了亮橙红色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「D」份「圆角阴影卡片服务页」：白底上的图文卡片具有明显的圆角，且底部带有范围较大、颜色柔和的弥散阴影，没有任何线条描边。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「D」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：阴影档数：「D」3档 vs 「A」1档；是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「D」有 vs 「A」无。产出应落在「D」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「圆角阴影卡片服务页」那一份基本一致（白底上的图文卡片具有明显的圆角，且底部带有范围较大、颜色柔和的弥散阴影，没有任何线条描边。）？

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「A」份「粗黑框奶酪地窖页」在这一面是：极其硬朗的纯黑实线粗边框，绝对的直角块面，完全没有阴影，呈现表格感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「粗黑框奶酪地窖页」那一份（极其硬朗的纯黑实线粗边框，绝对的直角块面，完全没有阴影，呈现表格感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「带进度条的安全游戏」在这一面是：偏扁平的互动UI，图标或区块带有轻微圆角，部分元素带有明显的黄黑斜纹填充。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带进度条的安全游戏」那一份（偏扁平的互动UI，图标或区块带有轻微圆角，部分元素带有明显的黄黑斜纹填充。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「衬线字体的旅游博客」在这一面是：纯直角的图片和输入框，完全没有边框和阴影，融入白色背景中。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：圆角档数 0档、阴影档数 1档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「衬线字体的旅游博客」那一份（纯直角的图片和输入框，完全没有边框和阴影，融入白色背景中。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「B」份「带进度条的安全游戏」：轻松微缩的游戏化任务感，具有模拟上帝视角观察的趣味性，同时因进度条与倒计时带来一定的操作紧凑感。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：底色种类数：「B」2种 vs 「A」5种；间距中位数：「B」10px vs 「A」20px；整页高度：「B」1080px vs 「A」4496px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 成品的整体气场（情绪调性、松紧克制）是否就是「带进度条的安全游戏」那一份的那种（轻松微缩的游戏化任务感，具有模拟上帝视角观察的趣味性，同时因进度条与倒计时带来一定的操作紧凑感。）？只看这一条，不用跟其它份比。气场明显是别的路子（该沉静的却很吵、该俏皮的却很端着）即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（nav_left_rail）。判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：导航我要竖着放在左边，不要横在上面（判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度）？
keypoints.spec_check: 导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「字体排版」不要做成「粗黑框奶酪地窖页」那样：强烈的报纸/说明书排版感，大量使用极粗的无衬线黑体，大标题全大写，字重对比极其悬殊，排版紧凑。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否明显不同于「粗黑框奶酪地窖页」那一份（强烈的报纸/说明书排版感，大量使用极粗的无衬线黑体，大标题全大写，字重对比极其悬殊，排版紧凑。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「字体排版」不要做成「衬线字体的旅游博客」那样：大小标题大量使用优雅的传统衬线字体，正文搭配细体无衬线字，整体行距宽松，字间留白充足。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「A」份的程序指纹：正文字号 14px、最大标题字号 40px、字号档数 11档、字族 dejavu/times、字重档数 2档。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否明显不同于「衬线字体的旅游博客」那一份（大小标题大量使用优雅的传统衬线字体，正文搭配细体无衬线字，整体行距宽松，字间留白充足。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：元素密度 44个/千像素高、底色种类数 5种、间距中位数 20px、整页高度 4496px。分派表没有把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 整体气质是否**没有**沿用第「A」份的特征？

keypoints.basis: 题面把跨形态要求抬到了档 1（移动端优先 / 严格响应式）。参考截图只有桌面宽度，所以窄屏形态是**推断**出来的，不是照抄；判定看窄屏帧与 1920px 主帧之间结构是否真的不同。
keypoints.question: 窄屏（390px）下的信息层级是否**重排**过（导航收起、多列变单列、主次顺序按小屏重新安排），而不是把桌面版等比缩小？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'a digital community mutual aid board for our neighborhood... where neighbors can post things they need or things they can offer'
keypoints.question: 页面主题是否整体呈现为「邻里社区互助板」（邻居发布自己需要的东西 / 能提供的东西），而不是其他行业或主题的页面？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确列出导航需要包含 Active Needs、Community Offers、Emergency Alerts 和 Personal Dashboard，但没有要求导航只能有这四项。
keypoints.question: 左侧导航是否包含 Active Needs、Community Offers、Emergency Alerts、Personal Dashboard 这 4 个具有清晰文字标签的主视图入口？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'This vertical menu should have clear text labels for switching between our main views'
keypoints.question: 导航的每个条目是否都带有可读的文字标签（而非仅有图标或仅靠色块区分）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求导航用于 'switching between our main views'
keypoints.question: 点击左侧导航中的某一项（例如 Community Offers）后，主内容区是否真的切换为该视图的内容（内容发生可见变化，而非点击无反应）？

keypoints.basis: 指令区分了 'things they need or things they can offer'，并分设 Active Needs 与 Community Offers 两个视图
keypoints.question: Active Needs 与 Community Offers 两个视图的内容是否有实质区分（前者为求助需求条目，后者为可提供的物品/时间条目），而不是显示完全相同的列表？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'we will display them in a dense, interactive grid'
keypoints.question: 互助帖子是否采用紧凑的多列网格排布，横向并排展示多张卡片并可继续向下排列，而不是使用单列长列表？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Inside each card, include the neighbor's name, a brief request title, and a dynamic status bar'
keypoints.question: 每张互助帖子卡片内部是否同时包含邻居姓名、简短的请求标题、以及一条状态进度条这三个要素？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'a dynamic status bar that fills up as people pledge funds or time'
keypoints.question: 卡片状态条是否通过清晰可见的填充长度表示当前完成进度，并能随进度变化而更新，而不是仅作为空白、恒满或静态装饰元素？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求状态条随着邻居承诺资金或时间而填充，并要求用户能够从互助板认领任务或物品。
keypoints.question: 用户完成一次认领、捐助或承诺提供时间等帮助操作后，对应卡片的状态条填充比例或进度数值是否随之增加？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'If someone is offering physical items, like spare winter coats, they will attach photos to their card'
keypoints.question: 提供实物的帖子卡片（如捐赠冬衣一类）上是否附有图片缩略图区域，且该图像可辨识为对应的物品主题（而非与内容无关的纯色占位）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'If a user taps on one of these thumbnails, it must smoothly expand into a full-screen gallery view'
keypoints.question: 点击卡片上的图片缩略图后，是否通过可见的平滑过渡展开为覆盖整屏的图库视图，并显示放大后的物品图像？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求用户能够在全屏图库中 swipe through 多张图片并查看大图细节。
keypoints.question: 全屏图库中是否支持通过横向滑动在多张放大图片之间前后切换？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求用户能够先查看物品的大图细节，再认领该物品，但没有规定认领按钮的具体位置。
keypoints.question: 物品卡片的查看图库流程中，是否提供可在看完大图后使用的明确文字认领入口（可位于图库内或返回卡片后），从而完成查看后认领的流程？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求为 'emergency alert banners' 与 Emergency Alerts 视图
keypoints.question: Emergency Alerts 视图（或页面顶部）是否出现紧急提示横幅，且文案内容确实是社区紧急事项（如停电、暴雪求助等），而非泛泛的占位文字？

keypoints.basis: 指令提到 'urgent tags, action buttons, and emergency alert banners'
keypoints.question: 急需类的帖子上是否带有可辨识的紧急标签（如 URGENT / 急需 等文字标记），用于与普通帖子区分？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 Dashboard 包含 lively data visualization，用于比较用户已完成请求与社区平均值；平滑动画图表是建议性示例而非唯一形式。
keypoints.question: 切换到 Personal Dashboard 视图后，是否出现清晰的数据可视化，并同时呈现「该用户已完成的请求数」与「社区平均值」两组可比较的数据，且具有可读的标签或图例？

keypoints.basis: 指令提出 lively data visualization、smooth animated chart，并要求其在认领新任务时实时更新；未限定动画必须在首次进入时从零开始。
keypoints.question: 当 Personal Dashboard 的数据因认领任务而发生更新时，数据可视化是否以平滑的数值或图形动画过渡到新状态，而不是生硬跳变？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 Personal Dashboard 是有状态的，并在用户从互助板认领新任务时实时更新。
keypoints.question: 在板面上认领一个任务后，Personal Dashboard 是否无需手动刷新即可反映这次认领，例如当前任务列表、认领任务数或相关可视化数据发生变化？

keypoints.basis: 用户将产品定义为邻居可以发布所需物品或可提供帮助的数字社区互助板。
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供可用的发布流程，使邻居能够选择发布需求或可提供的帮助、填写必要内容并提交到相应板面？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借用参考截图的设计语言（颜色、卡片样式、气质），内容主题为社区互助板
keypoints.question: 页面全部文案是否围绕社区互助主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名或条目（如 CHEESE CAVE / 干酪熟成窖、Site Safety Scramble、Revolve、Orbitor、Custom Software development 等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求页面内容为社区互助帖子，参考截图仅用于设计语言
keypoints.question: 卡片与导航中的条目内容是否都是邻里互助相关的条目（求助、捐赠、认领等），而没有混入参考截图里的软件服务项、博客文章标题或奶酪/熟成相关的行业术语？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求：输出单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含的单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求平台“strictly to be used only on an iPad in landscape orientation”并要求整个布局专门针对宽屏平板优化。
keypoints.question: 页面在常见 iPad 横屏视口（约 1024×768 CSS px）下是否无需缩放即可完整使用，左侧导航、帖子网格和主要操作均未被裁切，也没有因套用普通桌面宽屏布局而产生大面积无效留白？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户将这四项定义为用于切换的 main views；已有条目只验证点击某一个示例导航项，未确保四项全部可用且映射正确。
keypoints.question: 是否逐一点击 Active Needs、Community Offers、Emergency Alerts 和 Personal Dashboard 后，都能进入与标签语义相符且彼此不同的主内容视图，并清楚显示当前所处视图？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求这是一个邻居能够“post things they need or things they can offer”的互助板，并要求卡片包含姓名、标题和动态状态条，实物提供者还能附加照片；已有条目只检查发布入口是否存在。
keypoints.question: 发布入口是否形成可实际完成的发帖流程：用户可选择发布需求或社区提供，填写邻居姓名和简短标题、设置资金或时间目标，并在实物提供帖中添加图片；提交后新卡片会立即出现在对应的 Active Needs 或 Community Offers 网格中？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求图片“smoothly expand into a full-screen gallery view”并允许用户“swipe through”大图；已有条目检查了全屏和切换控件，但没有验证真实的触摸滑动手势。

ambiguities: “Low-cost” has no objective acceptance rule in the request. A self-contained offline implementation may support that aim, but it should not become a separate core transaction gate.
Publishing field requirements, pledge increments, target caps, and rounding behavior are not fully specified; tests should use rules visibly declared by the page rather than impose arbitrary values.

Claiming, posting, progress changes, and dashboard updates can be represented by reactive local page state. The request does not require a deployment API, database, websocket connection, or cross-session persistence.

The dashboard asks for lively data visualization but introduces the specific animated user-versus-neighborhood chart with “perhaps”; that exact chart, comparison, and animation are not mandatory core outcomes. Any neighborhood-average data would necessarily be local demonstration data unless another source is supplied.

Physical-item image attachment can use locally selected or embedded images because no storage service is specified. The full-screen transition and swipe presentation remain supplementary to the underlying ability to understand and claim an offer.
Checklist references such as source “A,” source “B,” and an exact color-difference threshold are not operationally grounded by the supplied request alone.
The 390px and 768px narrow-screen checks conflict with the request's exclusive iPad-landscape scope and should not be treated as core evidence for the kiosk outcome.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access semantically distinct Active Needs and Community Offers boards and understand each representative post's neighbor, brief request or offer title, and current status.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 11 and 12 only reject two reference typography styles, and item 17 only checks that navigation labels exist; no checklist item directly verifies the requested sans-serif typography, strong contrast, and normal line spacing for mutual-aid post content.
outcomes.quote: I am putting together a digital community mutual aid board for our neighborhood, aiming to create a supportive space where neighbors can post things they need or things they can offer. As a local organizer, making sure this is low-cost, highly accessible, and incredibly clear for everyone from teenagers to seniors is my top priority.
test_cases: Using the page's visible navigation, visit Active Needs and record the neighbor, title, and status of a representative request; then visit Community Offers and verify that it presents genuine offers rather than the same request list, with equivalent identifying information available for an offer.

At the intended kiosk size and default zoom, read representative navigation labels and post details and verify that the requested information is intelligible, uses a legible sans-serif treatment with strong text/background contrast and normal rather than tightly packed line spacing.

outcomes.endpoint: A neighbor can complete a local publishing flow for either a need or an offer, and the submitted name and title appear immediately in the correct board category.
outcomes.quote: neighbors can post things they need or things they can offer
test_cases: From the board, complete the publishing flow as a need using a distinctive neighbor name and title plus any other fields the page declares necessary; submit it, open Active Needs, and verify the exact submitted data appears there and not in Community Offers.

Complete the publishing flow as an offer with different distinctive data; submit it, open Community Offers, and verify the exact offer appears there and not in Active Needs, with any initial status following the rules declared by the page.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can respond to posts by pledging the appropriate funds or time, or by claiming an offered item, and the affected post receives the correct immediate local status update.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 22, 23, and 42 require a visible increase and the correct funds/time type, but none explicitly checks that a numeric value or proportional bar fill equals the prior value plus the declared pledge amount under the page's stated rules.
outcomes.quote: Inside each card, include the neighbor's name, a brief request title, and a dynamic status bar that fills up as people pledge funds or time. If someone is offering physical items, like spare winter coats, they will attach photos to their card. If a user taps on one of these thumbnails, it must smoothly expand into a full-screen gallery view so they can swipe through and see the large images in detail before claiming the item.
test_cases: Choose a funding post whose current amount, target, and pledge amount or increment are declared by the page; record the initial state, make one pledge, calculate the expected result using the page's declared cap or rounding rules, and verify both the displayed funding value and bar fill represent that result.

Repeat with a time-based post and verify the declared time increment is applied to the time status rather than being treated as money; also verify an unrelated funding status is not changed by that action.

Choose an available physical-item offer, perform its claim action using any detail or gallery view only as setup, and verify the same offer obtains the page's declared claimed, unavailable, or advanced-claim status rather than merely exposing a claim control.

core_scope.purpose: Enable neighborhood kiosk users to clearly browse distinct community needs and offers, publish their own need or offer, and respond through pledges or claims with understandable status updates.
review_notes: The core was narrowed to the mutual-aid business goals: finding distinct needs and offers, publishing either type, and responding with a correct visible status update.

Left-side placement, multi-column layout, iPad viewport fit, palettes, shadows, animation, and hover or touch presentation remain supplementary even when emphatically requested; they are not independent mutual-aid outcomes.

The full-screen swipe gallery and Personal Dashboard visualization were removed from core membership because they are substitutable presentation and reporting enhancements. The actual claim or pledge result remains core.
Emergency Alerts is a requested secondary view but is not indispensable to the primary need-and-offer board purpose, so its content checks remain supplementary.

Item 38 is mixed because it verifies access to core Needs and Offers views together with supplementary Emergency Alerts and Dashboard views. Item 39 is mixed because it verifies core posting while also imposing target and physical-image details beyond the minimum posting endpoint.

The original stepwise tests for locating controls, clicking them, and observing generic changes were replaced with end-to-end scenarios that submit or act on distinctive data and verify the resulting category, values, and state.

Accessibility was retained as part of intelligible access to the board rather than as a separate visual-style gate; the checklist lacks a direct measurement of the requested readable typography and contrast.

ambiguities: The request does not define a server, data destination, success message, or post-submit state. Submission testing should therefore cover client-side validation and permission to invoke the page's submit action, not successful reimbursement delivery.

Apart from Preferred Name being optional and the declaration being required, the request does not explicitly enumerate which claimant and expense fields must block submission. Validation should follow the form's declared required rules while preserving the stated optional status of Preferred Name.

The draft-saving sentence expressly names text inputs and newly added rows, while the surrounding wording refers more broadly to a half-finished claim. Browser security prevents automatic restoration of a selected file input, so receipt files should not be required to survive reload; persistence of radio, select, and date values is not fully specified.
Receipt Image implies selecting a local file in the frontend. The single-file requirement does not establish an upload service or backend receipt persistence.
The Running Total may be sticky or otherwise highly visible; sticky positioning is an alternative, not an independent mandatory endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: A volunteer can record claimant identity and reimbursement method, enter one or more independent expense records with the requested date, category, amount, justification, and receipt selection, and add or remove records while the form always retains at least one expense row.
outcomes.quote: I need a robust, single-file web application to act as our standard internal Expense Claim Form.
test_cases: With local storage cleared, enter a legal name and volunteer identifier, leave Preferred Name blank, confirm the reimbursement group offers exactly Direct Deposit, Check, and Cash Pick-up, and select one method. Complete the initial expense with a date, one of the five specified categories, a two-decimal amount, justification, and a local receipt image; add a second expense and verify it is blank, independently editable, and offers the same required fields and categories without altering the first expense's data.

Starting with two populated expense rows, remove one and verify the intended row disappears, the surviving row retains its data, and the running total excludes the removed amount. Then remove the sole remaining row and verify the page retains or immediately creates one blank expense row.

outcomes.endpoint: The displayed running total immediately represents the exact two-decimal sum of all current expense amounts, including after an amount is cleared or its row is removed.
outcomes.quote: The "Running Total" must update instantly the moment a user types a number into any "Amount" field.
test_cases: Create two expense rows, enter 10.10 and 20.20, and verify without refreshing that the displayed currency value is exactly 30.30, allowing the requested dollar-sign formatting but no visible floating-point artifact.
With amounts present in multiple rows, clear one amount and verify the total immediately decreases by that exact value; then remove another populated row and verify its amount is no longer included.

outcomes.endpoint: Text entered into the claim and the number of dynamically added expense rows are automatically restored after the page is reloaded or reopened.
outcomes.quote: The form must automatically save their text inputs and newly added rows to the browser's local storage as they type.
test_cases: Clear existing saved data, add a second expense row, enter distinct claimant text and distinct justification text in both rows, then reload the page. Verify the row count and every entered text value exactly match the pre-reload draft without requiring a manual save action.

outcomes.endpoint: An incomplete claim is blocked with an inline plain-language error at the first missing required field and that field is brought into view; after all fields required by the form are completed and the declaration is checked, client-side validation no longer blocks the submit action.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item directly verifies that Preferred Name can actually remain blank during a valid submission; item 20 checks only whether it is visually labeled optional.
outcomes.quote: Before allowing submission, the page must highlight any missing required fields. Since we are serving users of varying technical abilities, do not just put a tiny red asterisk; gently scroll the user up to the first missed field and display a clear, plain-language error message next to it.
test_cases: Complete all page-declared required fields except the earliest required field, then activate the main submit control. Verify submission is blocked, a complete plain-language message appears next to that field rather than only an asterisk or browser-default bubble, and the viewport scrolls to bring it into view.

Complete every field the page declares required, leave the explicitly optional Preferred Name blank, check the declaration, and submit again. Verify prior error states clear and the page permits its implemented submit action; do not require a network transaction or a particular success screen.

outcomes.endpoint: Sighted and screen-reader users can identify every static and dynamically added form control from its associated label, and assistive technology is notified with the current running-total value when amounts change.
outcomes.quote: All form inputs must have explicitly associated `<label>` elements for screen readers. The live running total must use ARIA attributes so assistive tech announces the changing sum.
test_cases: Using keyboard navigation and the browser accessibility tree or a screen reader, traverse claimant controls, reimbursement choices, every field in the initial expense, the declaration, and the receipt control; add another expense and verify its newly created controls also expose programmatically associated, intelligible labels rather than relying on placeholders.

Enter amounts in two rows and verify the running-total live region updates to the exact computed value and exposes appropriate live-status semantics so the changed sum is announced without moving focus.

core_scope.purpose: Enable community volunteers, including people using assistive technology, to prepare and submit complete multi-expense reimbursement claims with accurate totals, recoverable drafts, and clear validation.
review_notes: Expanded core scope beyond row controls to include recording claimant and expense information, because a form that cannot capture who is claiming, how they are reimbursed, and what was purchased fails the primary reimbursement purpose.

Added form-label and live-region accessibility as a core outcome because accessibility for older volunteers and people with visual impairments is an explicit primary user concern. Color treatment, typography, responsive layout, touch-target sizing, and viewport fit remain supplementary presentation or usability requirements.

Kept item 22 mixed because it combines required expense-field coverage with visual card grouping, item 26 mixed because it combines justification capture with textarea and example-prompt specifics, and item 50 mixed because it combines add/remove behavior with non-core animation.

Kept item 34 mixed because the running-total value is core while sticky or prominent placement is a layout requirement. Item 38 is mixed because a usable submit control supports the core flow while its exact position as the final visual step is structural.

Exact Add/Remove copy, the permanent dollar prefix, branding text, visual references, print styling, single-file implementation, and generic absence of JavaScript errors remain supplementary rather than separate core user outcomes.

Replaced isolated open/find/click probes with end-to-end scenarios that enter and preserve claim data, verify exact currency results, create a draft before reload, and separately exercise invalid and valid submission paths.
No backend upload, reimbursement processing, or invented success transaction was added to the core rubric.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「C」份「米底黑线纯文本的」：极简的紧凑型单列堆叠，由多个宽度固定的直角线框上下排列组成，内部采用严格的表格对齐和树状缩进。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「C」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「C」6.5px vs 「B」25px；元素密度：「C」59.7个/千像素高 vs 「B」101.7个/千像素高。产出应落在「C」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「B」份「带人物照片卡片的」在这一面是：常规的上下流式分块布局，包含大图头图区、多列并排的网格卡片区以及宽大的底部页脚。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 25px、元素密度 101.7个/千像素高、整页高度 2556px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。

ambiguities: The request describes the terminal as stateful and its logs as live but does not prescribe state names, transition timing, control labels, environment-variable values, or a real backend; evaluation should follow the page's declared local simulation.
The form is mentioned in connection with micro-interactions, but no submission result or business transaction is specified, so no functional form endpoint should be inferred.

The zero-scroll constraint applies to the primary hero including its terminal. Checklist item fold_1 may be read as requiring the entire page, including below-terminal sections, to fit without scrolling; that broader interpretation is not supported by the request.

outcomes.endpoint: The visible landing-page content directly and intelligibly identifies the product as a developer tool for orchestrating data-pipeline staging environments, rather than requiring visitors to infer its purpose or presenting an unrelated reference-site business.
outcomes.quote: a landing page for a new developer tool that orchestrates staging environments, similar to how Vercel handles deployments, but aimed at data pipelines.
test_cases: On a fresh page load, assess the hero heading, value proposition, and surrounding visible copy together; verify that a visitor can directly identify staging-environment orchestration for data pipelines as the product purpose and that unrelated industry content does not replace or obscure that message.

outcomes.endpoint: The hero contains a terminal-style product demonstration with distinct deployment-log and environment-variable content, concrete environment or pipeline-stage context, and a simulated progression that exposes at least two distinguishable run states and updates deployment-related logs.
outcomes.quote: complex stateful terminal interface
test_cases: On a fresh load, inspect the hero terminal as a complete deployment snapshot; verify that it contains distinct deployment-log and environment-variable regions and at least one concrete environment or pipeline-stage name tying the display to the staging/data-pipeline workflow.

From a fresh load, record the terminal's initial status and log output, then operate its available simulated-deployment control or observe its declared automatic progression; verify that a second distinguishable run state appears and deployment-related log entries are appended or updated, without assuming a real deployment API or network service.

core_scope.purpose: Communicate and demonstrate a developer tool for orchestrating staging environments for data pipelines, using a representative stateful terminal experience as the central product demonstration.
review_notes: Reduced the core to the landing page's indispensable communication goal and its central stateful terminal demonstration.

Collapsed terminal presence, required content, deployment context, visible states, and changing logs into one end-to-end outcome rather than treating discovery and individual controls as separate tests.

Kept viewport fit, responsive behavior, theme, typography, component styling, reference matching, and tree-style indentation supplementary because they concern presentation and layout rather than the primary user endpoint.
Moved the animated latency visualization and API status grid to supplementary requirements because they are decorative dashboard content rather than non-substitutable landing-page goals.
Moved the floating form to supplementary because the request specifies its presence and styling but no required submission outcome.
Kept self-containment, overflow resilience, and generic JavaScript-error checks supplementary; they assess delivery robustness rather than either core endpoint.

ambiguities: “endless scrolling timeline” could mean a long continuously browsable feed or automatic loading near the bottom. Checklist item 29 assumes automatic appending, but that mechanism is not indispensable to the informational timeline goal.

“archive and table of contents” may describe one combined month/section navigation or two distinct control groups. The core endpoint is reaching the corresponding historical content, not enforcing a particular number or placement of navigation widgets.

outcomes.endpoint: Residents can read an intelligible, date-marked chronological feed of concise neighborhood updates that covers zoning, new shop openings, and community board decisions and identifies each update's category.
outcomes.quote: The idea is to have a space where folks can just drop in and see exactly what's happening with local zoning, new shop openings, and community board decisions, all laid out chronologically.
test_cases: Using the visible timeline, inspect multiple dated entries and verify that their dates follow the page's declared chronological direction, that each has a readable title or short summary and identifiable category, and that the feed collectively includes at least one intelligible update about zoning, one about a new shop opening, and one about a community board decision.

outcomes.endpoint: A resident can activate a historical month or timeline-section link and be taken to the corresponding dated entries in the timeline.
outcomes.quote: the right column will be a sticky archive and table of contents so people can easily jump back to previous months
test_cases: Choose an archive month that also appears on one or more dated timeline entries, activate that month through the normal page control, and verify that the resulting scroll position, focus, or highlight lands on an entry from exactly that month rather than merely causing an arbitrary DOM or scroll change.

outcomes.endpoint: Residents can narrow the timeline by a selected block or topic so that retained entries match the chosen value and remain in chronological order, and can clear the filter to restore the broader feed.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item cleanly verifies semantic filtering correctness for both filter dimensions. Item 15 only checks that both groups of controls exist, while items 16 and 30 combine the filtering endpoint with non-core animation requirements and do not explicitly require both a block and a topic path to work.
outcomes.quote: filter the news by specific blocks or topics.
test_cases: Select a block filter for which the initial feed contains both matching and nonmatching entries; verify that every retained entry is associated with that block, nonmatching entries are excluded, and the retained entries preserve their original chronological order, then clear the filter and verify the broader feed is restored.

Repeat the end-to-end filtering scenario with a topic filter, verifying the retained entries' visible topic metadata against the selected topic and confirming that clearing the filter restores the unfiltered entries.

core_scope.purpose: Enable local residents to read and understand chronological neighborhood updates about zoning, new shop openings, and community board decisions, and to find relevant or historical entries by month, block, or topic.
review_notes: Added the chronological neighborhood-information outcome omitted by the proposal; accessible, intelligible updates about the three requested subject areas are the page's primary purpose.
Removed the two-column and sticky-sidebar group from core because those are layout behaviors rather than the non-substitutable informational endpoint.
Kept filtering as a core discovery goal but treated fade/slide animation requirements in items 16 and 30 as mixed rather than making animation itself a core gate.

Moved the chart to supplementary because the request introduces it with “maybe,” and moved the dummy funding cart to supplementary because it is an engaging incidental mockup rather than the timeline tracker's primary resident goal.

Moved automatic infinite loading to supplementary because a finite or otherwise continuously browsable chronological feed can still fulfill the primary purpose; item 10 remains relevant to the concise feed experience.

Rewrote the tests as complete end-to-end scenarios that validate dates, content categories, exact month destinations, and filter semantics rather than splitting setup actions into separate tests or relying on a generic DOM-change probe.

outcomes.endpoint: The user can inspect intelligible sleep-record data through a labeled numeric overview and a temporally organized heatmap, and applying an available top filter produces a coherent view of the same selected subset in both visualizations.
outcomes.missing_check: Existing items verify that values change and appear mutually consistent, but none verifies the numerical accuracy of overview aggregates against an exposed record set or declared aggregation rule.

Use two distinct filter states actually offered by the page, without inventing a filter type. Apply each and verify that the displayed active condition/date range, heatmap and overview refer coherently to that state, with corresponding data rather than unchanged or contradictory content. If normal page controls expose record or cell values and a declared aggregation rule sufficient to derive a displayed summary, independently calculate and compare that summary with its unit/format. Otherwise verify the explicitly displayed demo values and subset correspondence; do not require an undisclosed dataset, additional raw-record UI or unprovided aggregation formula.

outcomes.endpoint: The sleep-posture gallery provides multiple meaningful, contextualized sleep-record images, and activating a gallery image opens a clearly enlarged view of that same record for inspection.
outcomes.quote: 图库点开得能看大图
test_cases: Verify that the gallery contains multiple distinct sleep-posture or sleep-record images with brief identifying context rather than unrelated placeholders; activate one contextualized thumbnail and confirm that the resulting large view shows the same selected image at a clearly inspectable size.

core_scope.purpose: Enable Yunxiu to inspect quantified sleep records through filterable summary metrics, a periodic heatmap, and a sleep-posture gallery with enlarged image viewing.
review_notes: Responsive mobile and desktop layout was removed as a core outcome because viewport fit is a supplementary layout requirement rather than the sleep-data endpoint.

The overview, heatmap, and filtering checks were collapsed into one end-to-end data-exploration outcome because they describe a single flow in which one selected subset is represented consistently across both views.
Item 13 is mixed because it checks the presence of requested core sections while also enforcing their top-to-bottom layout order.
Item 15 remains supplementary because control existence alone does not establish that filtering reaches the requested data endpoint; items 16 and 31 assess the resulting update and coherence.

Gallery enlargement remains a distinct core outcome because the request explicitly requires opening gallery images for large-view inspection. Item 23 is supplementary because a particular close-and-return mechanism was not requested and is not itself the enlargement endpoint.

Reference-derived styling, dark color treatment, typography, visual dominance, branding, responsive layout, self-containment, generic runtime robustness, and overflow resilience remain supplementary requirements.

Semantic amendment: The request supplies no underlying sleep dataset and does not require exposing an aggregation formula or a raw-record table. Filtering and internal correspondence remain required. 请求明确限定只需适配 1024×768 的 iPad 横屏，并说明不需要手机端响应式适配，因此检查项 7、rsp_2 所要求的 390px 或 768px 窄屏重排不属于声明范围。
“开始试读”、“查看全部动态”、导航和页脚链接只规定了文案或存在形式，没有声明目标页面或点击后的业务结果，不能据此创造导航端点。
视觉规范多次要求对照图1至图4，但任务数据中未包含可测量的参考图；相关视觉相似度、阴影、留白和色差检查只能作为补充要求，无法形成确定的核心业务门槛。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面通过正常浏览和滚动即可清晰呈现 CodeCraft 的核心卖点、三条指定的最新教程更新，以及三张包含指定标签、标题、作者和阅读时间的特色教程卡片，使访客能够理解课程主题并浏览聚合内容。
outcomes.quote: 要做一个极简的编程教程售卖与阅读聚合页
test_cases: 加载页面后查看首屏，确认可见大标题“系统化重构你的前端知识体系”，且正文完整显示“告别碎片化学习，基于真实企业级项目的实战演练，覆盖 React、Vue、Node.js 核心原理与性能调优。”。
从首屏正常向下滚动至“最新更新”，确认该栏目恰好呈现三条可读记录，并逐一核对“2023-10-24／React 18 并发渲染机制深度解析”、“2023-10-20／Vite 插件开发实战：从零编写一个图片压缩工具”和“2023-10-15／TypeScript 高级泛型体操指南”。
继续滚动至“特色专栏”，确认三张教程卡片均可辨识且分别显示“基础夯实／JavaScript 内存泄漏排查指南／尤小右／15 分钟”、“架构设计／前端微服务化落地踩坑实录／张三／30 分钟”和“工程化／CI/CD 流水线接入自动化测试／李四／20 分钟”；同时确认各卡片具有简述和作者信息，第一张卡片的简述为两句与其主题相关的文字。

outcomes.endpoint: 特色专栏中的每张卡片均作为完整点击目标；每次点击都使导航栏购物车数量准确增加 1，且不会触发页面跳转或重载。
outcomes.quote: 点击底部任何一个卡片的任何位置，不要跳转，而是触发一个简易逻辑：右上角导航栏的购物车数量直接 +1。
test_cases: 重新加载页面并确认购物车数量为 0；依次点击第一张卡片的顶部色块、第二张卡片的标题区域和第三张卡片的作者区域，每次点击后分别确认数量准确变为 1、2、3，同时页面地址和当前文档均未发生跳转或重载。

core_scope.purpose: 让线下展示机上的访客了解 CodeCraft 编程教程的核心卖点，浏览最新更新与特色教程信息，并通过特色教程卡片体验模拟加入购物车。
review_notes: 原提案遗漏了信息页本身的核心内容。由于该页面的主要终端用户目的在于了解和浏览编程教程，首屏卖点、最新更新和特色教程信息被合并为一个核心信息聚合结果。
保留购物车递增为核心结果，因为它是页面唯一直接承载“售卖”含义的明确用户端点；测试整合了初始状态、不同卡片区域点击、准确累计和不跳转检查。
单文件交付、1024×768 适配、视觉还原、Sticky、hover 和动画属于实现、布局或表现要求，移除它们不会消除教程信息浏览或购物车端点，因此均保留为补充项。
邮件订阅是侧边栏的附属伪交互，并非教程售卖与阅读聚合的不可替代目标，因此检查项 32 和 37 未提升为核心门槛。
检查项 8、17、25 同时覆盖核心内容存在性与布局、装饰或附属区域，故放入 mixed_item_ids，而没有把纯布局要求单独提升为核心结果。
int_1 只证明某个点击后 DOM 有变化，不能证明购物车数值准确增加或订阅状态正确，因而不能替代具体端点检查。

ambiguities: 任务数据未提供被称为“浅色双栏博客”“带大面积橙色块”或“A份参考”的实际参考图，因此其精确视觉相似度和色差只能作为补充要求，不能据此定义业务核心端点。
“立即结算”仅规定了按钮文案和位置，没有说明点击结果、验证规则、支付流程或后端接口，因此不应虚构真实结算交易。
全局搜索框只要求能够输入，没有规定过滤、搜索结果或提交行为，因此不存在可验证的核心搜索端点。
商品数量、具体名称和价格由页面自行设定；计算测试应读取页面声明的学生特惠单价，并只使用明确给出的39元免配送费规则。
请求只要求进度条随总价联动，没有精确定义未满39元时的像素比例；核心测试应精确核对金额，并仅要求填充量随总价增加且达到门槛时满格。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户可浏览“宿舍果盘”“减脂鲜蔬”“熬夜零食”“凑单专区”四个非空商品分区；商品与所属类别语义匹配，并提供可识别的名称、数百克规格、原价和低于原价的学生特惠价。图片的方正或高清程度以及分类滑块的滚动表现不是该核心端点。
outcomes.quote:
- 左边宽栏的顶部做个分类滑块，写上“宿舍果盘”、“减脂鲜蔬”、“熬夜零食”、“凑单专区”，点击能平滑滚动到下面对应的商品区。
- 菜品列表里，每个单品要有方正的高清图、名称、几百克的规格说明，加上划线原价和显眼的“学生特惠价”。
test_cases: 在全新加载的页面中从上到下浏览商品内容，确认存在“宿舍果盘”“减脂鲜蔬”“熬夜零食”“凑单专区”四个有标题且非空的分区，并确认每区至少一个商品与该分类语义合理匹配。
逐项检查页面实际陈列的商品，确认每件商品都有可识别名称、以克为单位的数百克规格，以及可区分的原价和学生特惠价；读取两项数值并验证学生特惠价严格低于原价。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户可将所选商品加入购物车，查看商品名、数量和单项总价，并通过加减控件调整数量；单项总价必须等于学生特惠单价乘以数量，购物车总价必须等于各单项总价之和，未满39元时所差金额必须为max(39－总价, 0)，达到门槛后必须明确显示已免配送费。
outcomes.missing_check: 检查项31使用“+或-”表述，未明确要求两个方向都成功；应补充同一商品先增加再减少，并核对数量、单项总价和免配送费差额均恢复的检查。
outcomes.quote:
- 选了东西后，购物车列表要有商品名、加减数量控件（带点简单的hover背景色变化）、单项总价。
- 购物车底部有个动态进度条，“满39元免配送费，还差X元”，这里的数值要能跟着总价实时联动。
test_cases: 在全新加载的页面中记录任一商品显示的学生特惠单价p，操作其“加入菜篮”控件；确认购物车出现名称匹配的条目、初始数量为1且单项总价精确等于p。根据当前购物车总价T核对：若T小于39，显示的X必须精确等于39－T；若T不小于39，则必须显示已免配送费。
在全新加载的页面中分别加入两个不同商品，记录单价p1和p2；对第一个商品点击一次“+”，验证其数量为2、单项总价为2×p1、购物车总价为2×p1＋p2且免配送费差额按该总价精确更新。再点击一次“-”，验证数量、单项总价和差额恢复为基于p1＋p2的数值。
从全新购物车加入商品并通过正常的加购或“+”操作使计算总价达到或超过39元；每次变化后核对各单项总价及总和，最终确认差额为0、提示变为已免配送费且进度条达到满格。

core_scope.purpose: 供大学生浏览四类校园生鲜商品及其规格与学生价，将商品加入菜篮、调整数量，并依据39元门槛查看免配送费状态；不把未定义行为的“立即结算”按钮解释为真实支付或后端下单交易。
review_notes: 补回了提案遗漏的核心信息目标：校园生鲜页必须实际提供四类商品及可理解的规格和价格信息，不能只有购物车交互。
将加购、数量调整、单项总价、购物车合计和39元免配送费状态合并为同一购物车流程，避免把同一用户任务拆成按钮存在、点击和数值变化等零碎测试。
分类平滑滚动属于导航便利性；即使移除，只要四个商品分区仍可浏览，页面的主要购买准备目的仍可完成，因此检查项15、16和42保留为补充要求。
窄屏收折、底部悬浮条和上弹面板属于响应式布局与视口呈现，不是独立业务端点，因此检查项37、38和46不再作为核心。
抛物线动画、按钮临时变灰、hover反馈、吸顶、配色、字体、装饰横线和精确控件位置均为表现或反馈要求，未提升为核心结果。
楼栋宿舍号输入框和“立即结算”按钮没有声明提交后的结果；依照不虚构交易的原则，其存在性和可编辑性仍为补充要求。
混合检查项10同时包含核心商品主题和未定义的“可下单”表述；18混合商品名称及规格与图片形状；21混合价格信息与醒目、删除线等表现；33和34混合核心金额状态与进度条视觉表现，故分别放入mixed_item_ids。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带深色顶栏和左侧栏的网页」那一份（按钮为实心蓝色带有圆角，图片边缘为直角，没有明显的卡片容器轮廓。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: Archive 中从 2014 到当前年份的每一个年份是否都各自提供可展开控件，并且逐个展开后都能看到至少一条属于该年份的具体 race report，而不是只有少数年份可展开或共用同一份列表？

keypoints.question: Archive 的年份展开控件在获得键盘焦点后，是否可用 Enter 或 Space 展开与收起，并向辅助技术暴露当前展开状态（例如使用原生 button/details 或正确维护 aria-expanded）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求页面满足 basic accessibility standards；可访问名称和正确关联的表单标签是键盘及辅助技术用户理解筛选表单的必要条件。
keypoints.question: Shoe Brand 下拉框、Location 文本框和提交按钮是否都有可被辅助技术识别的明确名称，其中下拉框与文本框通过关联的 label 或等效 ARIA 标注表达各自用途，而不是只依赖 placeholder？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 页面被要求高度依赖 trail-run photography，同时还必须满足 basic accessibility standards，因此信息性图片需要可访问的文字替代。
keypoints.question: 承载内容信息的山地步道主图和路线缩略图是否提供有意义的替代文本或等效可访问描述，而纯装饰性图像是否被正确标记为可忽略？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户同时要求数据覆盖层在 hover 时滑出、页面 fully responsive 且满足基本无障碍；无 hover 设备也必须能够获取每条记录的数据。
keypoints.question: 在不支持鼠标 hover 的触屏或移动设备上，每个跑步记录块的日期、距离和配速是否仍可直接看到或通过点击/键盘聚焦可靠显示，而不会永久隐藏在只能悬停触发的覆盖层中？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求交付物 'fully responsive'；已有条目主要检查 masonry 网格单列化和横向滚动，尚未覆盖导航、表单与归档区域的移动端可用性。
keypoints.question: 在移动端宽度下，除跑步图块改为单列外，顶部导航、筛选表单和 Archive 年份/报告列表是否也能合理换行、折叠或纵向排列，所有控件与文字均保持完整可见、可点击且互不遮挡？
