ambiguities: The age-stage and topic labels follow “比如” and are therefore examples rather than independent core gates; the core test uses the age and topic choices the page actually declares.
The request expressly permits either previous/next pagination or load-more, so neither implementation may be required exclusively.
Keyword matching semantics are not specified. Tests should follow any rule declared by the page, otherwise use direct matching against visible titles or summaries.
The material cart and claim form are explicitly frontend simulations. No backend submission, persistence, inventory, or deployment API is required.
Contrast requirements for white overlay text are conditional on the page using gradient-backed image cards.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access an intelligible parenting-knowledge feed whose entries communicate the topic through a meaningful title and summary and provide a concrete estimated reading time.
outcomes.quote: 每篇资料展示标题、预计阅读时间、摘要和加购按钮。
test_cases: From the knowledge feed, inspect at least three entries and verify that each is recognizably about parenting, has a meaningful title and summary, and shows a numeric estimated duration such as a number of minutes; confirm the text is readable rather than an empty or generic placeholder.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can narrow the knowledge feed by age, topic, keyword, or a logical intersection of the available filter dimensions.
outcomes.quote: 比如按月龄（0-3个月、半岁、一岁以上），按主题（辅食制作、睡眠引导、日常小病护理），还得有个大点的搜索框以便直接查病因。
test_cases: Choose an available non-default age and topic whose separate result sets have at least one article in common. With filters cleared between runs, collect the result titles for the age alone and topic alone using the page's traversal mechanism, then apply both and verify that the combined result set equals their intersection.

With filters cleared, take a distinctive term from a visible article title or summary, enter it in search, and verify that the source article remains in the results and that every returned entry satisfies the page's declared matching rule; if no rule is stated, verify the term appears in its title or summary.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can reach knowledge entries beyond the initially displayed subset through either complete previous/next pagination or a load-more flow without encountering an operational dead end.
outcomes.quote: 条目太多，所以下拉到底部需要有明确的“下一页/上一页”翻页机制，或者明显的“加载更多”直角按钮。
test_cases: With filters cleared, record the initial article titles and use the provided long-list mechanism. If it is pagination, go to the next page, verify a different set containing previously hidden entries, return to the prior page and compare it with the recorded set, then verify invalid directions are unavailable at the first and last pages. If it is load-more, verify each activation retains existing entries and adds new unique entries, then continue to exhaustion and verify the control is disabled, hidden, or replaced by a clear no-more-content message.

outcomes.endpoint: Older, low-vision, and screen-reader users can operate the knowledge-discovery flow, understand substantive imagery, and enlarge text without losing access to the information.
outcomes.quote: 信息呈现必须清楚，而且要重点照顾到可无障碍访问（很多长辈或者视障家长也会用）
test_cases: Using only the keyboard, operate search and at least one filter, move through the resulting articles, and invoke the pagination or load-more mechanism; verify each required control is reachable, operable, and exposes an intelligible accessible name or label, and verify the feed reaches the expected updated result state.

Record the computed size of representative knowledge text, activate the font-enlargement tool using its normal control, and verify that the same text remains available at a strictly larger computed size.

Traverse substantive images in the initial feed and one additional result batch with a screen reader or browser accessibility tree, verifying that each has a non-empty description identifying its parenting-related content; for any white text placed over a gradient image, measure contrast at the actual text position and verify WCAG AA thresholds of 4.5:1 for normal text or 3:1 for large text.

core_scope.purpose: Enable local families, including older and visually impaired parents, to find, browse, and understand a large collection of parenting knowledge on an accessible web page.
review_notes: The core was refocused on the primary end-user purpose: finding, browsing, and understanding parenting knowledge with meaningful accessibility support.
The material-cart flow was moved to supplementary scope. It is a requested hook and service interaction, but removing it would not defeat the page's primary purpose as a parenting knowledge station.
Single-column width, viewport behavior, colors, typography, card appearance, transitions, and the cart bounce animation remain supplementary presentation requirements rather than core outcomes.

Exact example filter labels, search-box size, and mere control existence were not used as core endpoint checks; functional filtering, searching, intersections, and result traversal are covered by correctness items instead.
The exact 200-item quantity and rapid-click performance target remain scored supplementary requirements rather than separate user-goal gates.

Item 16 is mixed because it jointly checks core article information and the supplementary add-to-cart control. Item 38 mixes accessibility with conditional visual treatment, while item 39 bundles core knowledge controls with supplementary cart and form controls.

The proposed feed-presentation group was split by user endpoint: article information, relevant filtering, and access beyond the initial result subset. The single-column layout portion was removed from core scope.

Core tests were rewritten as complete scenarios that operate controls and verify specific final content sets, numeric text enlargement, reversible or terminating list traversal, and accessibility results.

ambiguities: The request specifies no pricing formula, parameter ranges, or plan-eligibility rules. Exact tests must therefore use rules declared by the page rather than imposing arbitrary benchmark values.

The request does not specify customer fields, validation rules, persistence, or a backend. A visible, internally consistent local confirmation is sufficient; a real quote-service transaction must not be inferred.

The checklist references sources labeled “A” and “C” without mapping those labels to the named references in the supplied request, and exact screenshot color values are not available in the text. These visual checks remain supplementary and should not become core gates.

outcomes.endpoint: The buyer can intelligibly compare at least two data-pipeline plans by name, price or billing basis, concrete technical parameters, and differentiated API tier limits, while seeing the concrete features active for the current selection.
outcomes.quote: side-by-side plan comparisons and data filtering inputs
test_cases: Using the visible plan comparison, compare at least two plans and verify that each has a distinct name, a price or billing parameter, numeric data-pipeline technical limits with units, and a common API-limit dimension; confirm that at least one API limit differs between tiers and that the current selection identifies concrete active data-pipeline features rather than placeholders.

outcomes.endpoint: The buyer can change multiple labeled data-pipeline pricing parameters or filters, and the selected plan, parameter readouts, eligible content, and estimated quote update consistently and numerically according to the page's declared pricing and eligibility rules.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 24 and 39 establish visible change and cross-component consistency but do not independently verify an exact quote calculation against declared pricing rules for known inputs, including boundary values.
outcomes.quote: the interactive filtering elements and data readouts must be precise
test_cases: Select a plan, set at least two labeled pricing parameters to specific non-default values through normal controls, calculate the expected estimate from the pricing or tier rules declared on the page, and verify the displayed plan, exact parameter values and units, and estimated quote all match that calculation.

Set the adjustable parameters to their declared minimum and maximum boundary values in turn, and verify the exact resulting readouts and estimates against the page's declared rules rather than merely observing that some number changed.

Apply a declared filtering condition such as a usage band or deployment option and verify that the comparison or data readouts show only the plans or values satisfying the page's stated eligibility rule, then remove or reverse the condition and verify the result returns consistently.

outcomes.endpoint: After configuring the quote, the buyer can submit the request and receive visible local confirmation or a quote summary that accurately reflects the submitted plan, parameters, and estimate; no real deployment or backend transaction is required.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 29 permits any feedback, including only a validation message, and does not ensure that a valid request can complete successfully or that the resulting confirmation accurately reflects the submitted configuration.
outcomes.quote: interactive enterprise quote request interface for our new data pipeline product
test_cases: Select a plan, set non-default pricing parameters, complete any visibly required request fields with valid values, submit through the normal page controls, and verify that a visible success confirmation or quote summary repeats the selected plan, exact submitted parameter values and units, and the same estimated quote.

core_scope.purpose: Enable an enterprise buyer to compare data-pipeline plans, configure usage and pricing conditions, and submit a coherent quote request.
review_notes: Collapsed API limits and active-feature content into the plan-comparison outcome instead of treating every requested detail as a separate core gate.
Kept plan comparison, pricing configuration, and quote submission as distinct non-substitutable buyer goals: removing any one would materially break the requested quote workflow.
Moved donut-chart presence and proportional rendering to supplementary scope. The requested chart modality is a visualization requirement, not the business endpoint of obtaining a quote.

Kept layout, responsive footer behavior, typography, colors, atmosphere, component styling, page length, self-containment, and long-string robustness supplementary even where the request emphasizes them.
Checklist items 23, 28, and 38 check the existence or labeling of controls rather than the completed business result, so they are supplementary setup requirements rather than core endpoint evidence.

Item 34 is mixed because it combines core technical information with supplementary visualization balance. Item 37 is mixed because it checks business relevance across both core plan data and supplementary charts or decorative tags.
Replaced fragmented open/find/click probes with end-to-end scenarios that configure known values and verify the resulting comparison, exact estimate, filtering behavior, or submitted summary.

ambiguities: The word "robust" does not define which fields are required, so validation scenarios should follow the form's visible declared rules rather than assuming every available field is mandatory.
"central scrolling feed" does not clearly require an independently scrolling pane rather than ordinary page scrolling; either mechanism can provide access to the full feed.
The request names upvote and reply actions but does not request reply-content submission, persistence after reload, or a backend transaction, so those behaviors should not be inferred.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can browse multiple meaningful Blue Hour question entries whose titles, tags, and timestamp metadata are intelligible and associated with the correct entry.
outcomes.quote: main community Q&A feed for our Blue Hour project
test_cases: In the initial feed state, confirm the page identifies the Blue Hour Q&A context, then scroll from the first through the last rendered question and verify that multiple independent entries are present and every entry has a specific, semantically complete question title, at least one tag, and intelligible timestamp metadata.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can submit a valid new inquiry into the feed, while an empty submission is rejected with visible, field-relevant feedback.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item explicitly compares the appended entry's displayed title or collected tag with the submitted values; item 30 may be satisfied by observing only an increased entry count. Add a check that the resulting entry corresponds to the submitted inquiry.
outcomes.quote: robust inline form at the bottom to submit new inquiries
test_cases: Record the current feed, leave every field that the page declares required empty, activate submission, and verify that visible feedback identifies the missing requirements and that no blank question is added to the feed.

Complete the form according to its visible rules using a unique question title and details, plus a tag if the form collects one, submit it, and verify that exactly one corresponding feed entry appears with the unique title and any submitted metadata that the feed declares it displays, rather than accepting an unrelated count-only or generic DOM change.

core_scope.purpose: Enable Blue Hour community members to browse an intelligible feed of questions and submit a new inquiry from the same page.
review_notes: Reduced the core to the two non-substitutable user goals: reading the Blue Hour question feed and submitting a new inquiry.

Filtering, upvoting, and opening a reply state remain scored supplementary functionality. They enhance the feed but their removal does not prevent the primary browse-and-ask purpose, and no reply-submission transaction was requested.
Item 21 is mixed because it assesses core feed content together with scrolling/layout behavior.
Item 39 is mixed because it combines field-relevant validation feedback with programmatic assistive-technology association.

Form placement, exact control inventory, navigation, responsive layout, visual styling, keyboard/accessibility implementation details, and self-containment remain supplementary requirements rather than separate business outcomes.
The revised tests combine setup and interaction into end-to-end scenarios and strengthen successful submission verification beyond merely observing that an entry count changed.

ambiguities: The request does not enumerate which fields constitute the plus-one guest details, so testing should follow the labels and required rules actually declared by the page rather than assume specific fields.

The dietary list is described as multi-select but does not state whether “None” must be mutually exclusive with allergy or preference selections; that behavior should not become an arbitrary hard gate.
The atmospheric Kyoto sentence is introduced with “For example,” so the milestones need short descriptions but do not need to reproduce that sample sentence verbatim.

The calendar invitation's time zone and event duration are not specified. Any supplementary calendar-content check should accept a reasonable floating/local 4:00 PM representation and should not invent a duration or time zone.
A photo gallery is referenced while discussing spacing, but no gallery assets, content, or placement are specified.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly identifies the couple as Elena and Marcus and makes the three specified relationship milestones, in chronological order and with intelligible short descriptions, accessible to guests.
outcomes.quote: interactive, vertical timeline detailing our relationship milestones
test_cases: From a fresh load, read the prologue and continue to The Archive using normal page controls; verify the site identifies the couple as “Elena & Marcus” and presents “2018: The First Coffee,” “2020: Surviving Lockdown Together,” and “2023: The Proposal in Kyoto” in chronological order, with an intelligible short description accompanying each milestone.

outcomes.endpoint: Guests can access and understand the exact wedding date, time, location, and dress code.
outcomes.quote: logistical details of the event
test_cases: From a fresh load, navigate or scroll to The Logistics and verify it associates “October 14th, 2024,” “4:00 PM,” “The Glasshouse Botanical Gardens,” and “Semi-formal, but wear shoes you can actually dance in.” with the wedding event.

outcomes.endpoint: A guest can use an in-page RSVP flow to provide first and last name, disclose and enter a plus-one when applicable, select multiple applicable dietary requirements, receive useful feedback for missing required names, and obtain a personalized confirmation after a valid submission without a page reload.
outcomes.quote: culminating in an engaging, interactive RSVP experience
test_cases: From a fresh load, go to the RSVP form, focus and leave each required First Name and Last Name field blank before submitting, and verify field-specific conversational feedback appears while the form remains available; then attempt submission and verify that no success confirmation is shown until the declared required-name rules are satisfied.

From a fresh load, verify the RSVP is an in-page form rather than a mailto link, enter “Alex” and “Rivera,” toggle the plus-one option to Yes, verify guest-detail controls appear without a reload, and complete any exposed required guest fields according to their labels. Verify Vegan, Gluten-Free, Nut Allergy, and None are available; select Vegan and Nut Allergy and confirm both remain selected simultaneously. Submit and verify, without a page reload, that the form is replaced by a personalized confirmation reflecting the entered attendee identity.

core_scope.purpose: A single-page wedding site that lets guests understand Elena and Marcus's relationship story and event logistics, then complete the requested client-side RSVP flow with relevant guest and dietary information and receive personalized confirmation.
review_notes: Collapsed couple identification and relationship-history presentation into one informational narrative outcome rather than treating the hero, section order, and timeline presentation as separate core gates.

Timeline milestone content and descriptions remain core, while vertical layout, SVG connecting lines, scroll-triggered fades, and mobile animation reliability are presentation or motion requirements. Items 4, 6, and 9 are mixed because they combine core identity/content coverage with page-format or layout conditions.
Kept exact event logistics as a distinct core informational outcome because guests need those details for the page to serve its wedding-information purpose.

The RSVP is not an incidental form: it is the requested culmination of the page. Its valid submission path, plus-one state, dietary selection, and missing-name handling are therefore assessed end to end.

Items 21 and 37 are mixed because they cover meaningful missing-name feedback while also prescribing blur timing, highlighting, and presentation. The core scenario checks useful invalid-input handling rather than making visual gentleness an independent gate.

Item 20 is mixed because personalized post-submission confirmation is part of the core RSVP endpoint, while the calendar-download convenience bundled into the same item is supplementary. Item 36, which only checks calendar-file correctness, remains supplementary.

Theme switching, persistence, system-preference initialization, transition timing, visual styling, viewport fit, animations, anchor-scroll behavior, gallery presentation, semantic implementation details, and self-containment remain scored supplementary requirements rather than separate primary-purpose outcomes.

No real RSVP backend, attendance database, or deployment transaction is inferred. The request specifies a stateful page and confirmation state, which is feasible as a self-contained offline experience.
The generic DOM-change probe cannot establish any specific wedding-information or RSVP endpoint and therefore remains supplementary.

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「黑线网格留声机页」那一份（中文排版，全页字号差异极小，大量堆叠同等大小的正文信息，仅靠局部加粗和方格约束来划分信息层级，阅读感沉闷干瘪。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

ambiguities: “条目非常多” does not establish an exact required species count. The applicable checklist distinguishes a meaningful library from a three-to-five-item demo, so the core test uses that qualitative boundary rather than inventing a larger quota.

No canonical source or exact values are specified for the environmental indicators or warming series. They can be tested for meaningful labels, units, trend readability, internal numerical consistency, and obvious factual errors, but not against an unstated dataset.
“动态图表” may refer to loading animation, playback, or interaction. Animation itself is supplementary; the indispensable informational endpoint is a readable and self-consistent global-warming trend.

The intended primary-school grade and reading level are not specified. Intelligibility should therefore be judged through plain Chinese and explanations of necessary terminology rather than a rigid vocabulary or sentence-length formula.
No source or live update rule is given for the participant count, so it should be treated as requested presentation content rather than an authenticated or backend-driven total.

outcomes.endpoint: The rendered page clearly communicates an environmental advocacy message, including a complete and meaningful slogan, with explanatory content that is intelligible to its primary-school audience.
outcomes.quote: 搞个环保倡议的单页站，单文件直接写完就能上的那种。这东西主要在小学公开课用
test_cases: Render the page and read the slogan plus representative text from the species, indicator, and climate sections; verify that the slogan is a complete, coherent environmental call to action, that the page consistently concerns environmental protection, and that the main Chinese explanations use child-accessible wording or briefly explain necessary technical terms.

outcomes.endpoint: A meaningfully populated library provides identifiable endangered animals and plants, and its clickable filters produce correct, nonempty subsets and can restore the complete collection.
outcomes.quote: 往下是濒危动植物库，由于条目非常多，这部分必须要做带状态平滑切换的点击筛选功能。
test_cases: Inspect the unfiltered library and verify that it contains meaningfully more than a three-to-five-item demo, including more than one real animal and more than one real plant; each entry must have an identifiable species name and a category or conservation-status label, without obvious classification, status, or internal-consistency errors.

Record the complete set of displayed species names and their declared category or status labels, then operate every non-“全部” filter through the visible controls; for each option, verify that the result is nonempty and that every remaining entry matches that option under the page's declared filtering rules. Finally select “全部” and verify that the exact original set of species is restored.

outcomes.endpoint: The page communicates multiple concrete environmental indicators through clear names and interpretable numerical values.
outcomes.quote: 介绍几个核心环保指标时，也像那个工艺页里那样，一字排开画几个纯线框的圆形把数据填进去。
test_cases: Inspect the complete environmental-indicator section and record every indicator's name, value, and displayed unit where applicable; verify that multiple distinct indicators are present, each value is numerical and meaningfully associated with its label, and none is irrelevant or obvious placeholder data.

outcomes.endpoint: The page provides an intelligible data visualization of global warming over time, with chronologically ordered data and a visually and numerically self-consistent upward trend.
outcomes.quote: 结尾放一个呈现全球变暖趋势的数据可视化动态图表。
test_cases: Inspect the global-warming visualization and record its time labels, temperature or warming units, and multiple plotted values or bars; verify that the times are chronologically ordered, the plotted positions or heights agree with the displayed values and axis scale, and the complete series communicates an overall rise rather than merely showing an unlabeled or arbitrary changing graphic.

core_scope.purpose: Provide an intelligible environmental advocacy page for elementary-school classroom presentation, using endangered-species information, environmental indicators, and a readable global-warming trend to support the message.
review_notes: Collapsed the overall environmental theme, meaningful slogan, and primary-school intelligibility into one communication outcome instead of treating theme checks as supplementary.

The participant count was not retained as a separate core gate because removing that incidental headline statistic would not defeat the page's environmental teaching and advocacy purpose. Item 12 is mixed because it checks both the core slogan and the supplementary count/first-screen arrangement; item 14 is supplementary.
Retained the species library and correct filtering, the substantive environmental indicators, and the readable global-warming trend as distinct non-substitutable informational or functional goals.

Moved typography, dark color treatment, section layout, circular metric styling, responsive behavior, container styling, selected-filter styling, transition effects, chart animation, and section ordering to supplementary scope. Items 1 and 4 do not validate the substantive metric or slogan endpoints.
Item 23 is mixed because it establishes the core chart's existence while also requiring the supplementary layout detail that it appear specifically at the page ending.
Single-file packaging, generic runtime cleanliness, overflow resistance, and stress-layout checks remain important supplementary delivery requirements rather than primary end-user outcomes.

Replaced separate existence, click, and observation steps with end-to-end scenarios that verify exact filter subsets and restoration, substantive metric values, and consistency between chart labels, numerical values, and plotted geometry.

ambiguities: No reference screenshots are included in the task data, so exact visual, palette, typography, and resemblance requirements cannot be independently grounded here; they remain supplementary requirements.

The request does not define a word count or a mandatory historical syllabus. Long-form substance should therefore be judged through meaningful English prose across multiple relevant sections without inventing arbitrary length or fact-coverage gates.

outcomes.endpoint: Readers can access and understand a substantial English long-form article whose title, section structure, and body content coherently discuss the history of Victorian handmade lace rather than presenting placeholder, game, product, or unrelated reference content.
outcomes.quote: 面向海外英语用户的核心单篇长文落地页，主要探讨维多利亚时期的手工蕾丝历史
test_cases: Starting at the article title, scroll through the complete article using normal browser controls; inspect the opening, multiple headed sections across the middle, and the conclusion, and verify that they form a substantive English reading flow consistently discussing the history of Victorian handmade lace rather than brief, placeholder, game, product, or unrelated screenshot-derived content.

While traversing the article from top to bottom, verify that its title, headings, and historical prose remain available and intelligible as a coherent article; assess substance from the meaningful multi-section treatment requested by the page rather than imposing an unstated word-count threshold.

core_scope.purpose: Provide overseas English readers with an accessible, substantive single-page long-form article about the history of Victorian handmade lace.
review_notes: Collapsed topic, target language, article substance, and readable article flow into one core informational outcome because they describe the same end-to-end reading goal.

Moved the progress indicator, crinoline lace-layer visualization, knowledge-point unlocking, and glossary modal out of core. They are explicitly requested enhancements, but removing them does not make the page cease to serve its primary purpose as an English historical long-form article.

Kept visual replication, three-column layout, typography, color, animation smoothness, navigation, tags, decorative cards, distraction-free styling, and packaging/runtime constraints supplementary rather than treating presentation or implementation details as separate business endpoints.

Items 9, 23, 25, and 29 are mixed because they partly assess the core article's English language, identification, topical content, or long-form accessibility while also bundling non-core UI text, author metadata, sidebar content, or desktop column layout.
Replaced the proposal's separate locate, scroll, click, and observe steps with complete article-traversal scenarios that verify the final informational endpoint.

ambiguities: The request identifies beta-application conversion as a primary KPI and separately requests a footer email form, but it does not explicitly state that the footer form is the beta application. The footer form can satisfy the beta outcome only when the page clearly labels that relationship.
No product repository URL is supplied, so GitHub correctness can establish a non-dead GitHub project destination but not a particular repository or a completed authenticated Star action.

No required ecosystem partners or exact integration commands are specified. Tests should accept intelligible, middleware-relevant partners and executable-looking steps declared by the page rather than impose unstated brands or commands.

outcomes.endpoint: Developers can immediately identify the product as an open-source distributed database middleware for high-concurrency scenarios and can read its three substantive core features, five-minute integration guidance, and identifiable ecosystem-partner information.
outcomes.quote: 一款针对高并发场景的开源分布式数据库中间件
test_cases: From a fresh page load, verify the first-screen content clearly identifies the product as an open-source distributed database middleware for high-concurrency scenarios, without requiring the user to scroll to discover its purpose.

On a fresh load, inspect the product-detail sections and verify there are exactly three titled features with distinct, intelligible descriptions relevant to distributed database middleware, followed by a guide that explicitly claims five-minute integration and contains multiple concrete integration actions.

On a fresh load, navigate through the page to the ecosystem section and verify that each displayed partner entry has an intelligible name or recognizable logo representation rather than an empty placeholder.

outcomes.endpoint: A developer can activate a clearly labeled GitHub or Star call to action and be directed to a non-dead GitHub project destination; completing an authenticated GitHub Star transaction is not required.
outcomes.quote: 直接拉升我们的GitHub Star数
test_cases: From a fresh page load, activate the CTA that explicitly refers to GitHub or starring the project and verify that the current page or newly opened tab targets a non-empty, non-fragment GitHub project URL, without requiring the remote site to finish loading.

outcomes.endpoint: A developer can activate an explicitly labeled beta-application entry, reach a fillable area that clearly states the email is being collected for beta access, submit a valid email, and receive a visible in-page accepted or recorded confirmation without requiring a real backend.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item unambiguously verifies completion of the beta application itself: item 30 stops at reaching a fillable application area, while item 31 verifies only generic footer-email success and does not require the confirmation to be beta-specific.
outcomes.quote: 开发者的内测申请转化率
test_cases: From a fresh page load, activate the beta-application CTA, verify that it scrolls, navigates, or expands to a fillable area explicitly associated with beta access, enter dev@example.com through normal controls, submit it, and verify that a visible confirmation specifically indicates the beta application or email was recorded.

core_scope.purpose: Enable developers to understand the open-source distributed database middleware and convert through usable GitHub and beta-application paths.
review_notes: Consolidated product positioning, features, quick-start guidance, and ecosystem information into one informational core outcome; these sections collectively let developers understand and evaluate the product.
Kept GitHub conversion and beta application as distinct core outcomes because they are the two stated primary KPIs and neither substitutes for the other.

Removed the footer email collector as an independent core outcome because an incidental form is not a separate primary user goal. Its success behavior is only mixed evidence for beta conversion unless the page explicitly identifies it as the beta form.

Moved slogan exactness, numbered-indicator sequencing, partner-card presentation, CTA-copy refinements, branding, layout, typography, color, responsive fit, and implementation constraints to supplementary scope because they affect presentation or requirement fidelity rather than the primary business endpoints.

Item 25 remains mixed because it combines core informational-section presence with first-screen, footer, and overall layout placement. Item 32 remains mixed because it combines core conversion controls with a supplementary mobile-viewport condition and spans both conversion paths.
Existence-only CTA and form checks 12, 22, and 23 remain supplementary because stronger checks 29 and 30 assess whether the corresponding user paths actually lead somewhere meaningful.

ambiguities: “真实接入的配置代码块” does not establish a requirement for a live API or valid production credentials; for an offline self-contained page, a plausible and internally coherent representative configuration is sufficient.
The request does not specify how many deployment stages must be shown. Checklist item 23 introduces a threshold of at least three stages that should not become an arbitrary core gate.

The reference-source labels in the visual checklist are inconsistent with parts of the prose request, and “第「B」份参考” is not defined in the supplied request. These visual-reference checks remain supplementary.
No successful lead-submission destination or backend transaction is specified. The form can be assessed as an incidental local interface without inventing a server-side submission endpoint.

The API search behavior is not prescribed as server-side or client-side; an offline filter or highlight could satisfy it, but search remains a supplementary convenience rather than an indispensable procurement-information outcome.

outcomes.endpoint: An enterprise buyer can identify the product as an enterprise browser plugin, understand a concrete efficiency problem it addresses, and read a coherent representative integration configuration rather than placeholder or unrelated content.
outcomes.quote: 首屏左侧写清楚插件解决的效率痛点，右侧直接摆一个真实接入的配置代码块，必须带有代码高亮和快速复制功能。
test_cases: Load the page and review the hero and integration material as an enterprise buyer: verify that it identifies an enterprise browser plugin, names at least one concrete workflow efficiency pain, and presents a legible configuration containing recognizable keys, values, or initialization syntax rather than filler; also confirm that unrelated reference brands or industries do not replace this information.

outcomes.endpoint: An enterprise buyer can determine that private deployment, SSO connectivity, and a local data sandbox are supported and can understand the named deployment journey from obtaining access through organization-wide availability, regardless of whether that information uses a decorative progress widget.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist cleanly verifies the requested deployment-stage information without adding an unstated “≥3 stages” threshold; item 23 provides partial coverage but is over-prescriptive about the count.
outcomes.quote:
特性说明部分用严谨的列表项展开，挨个列举私有化部署、单点登录连通、本地数据沙箱这些关键的企业级能力。
- 中间区域专门放一个部署沙箱的进度条或者完成度展示面板，让决策者直观看到从拿到权限到全员可用需要经过哪几个节点。
test_cases: Following the page’s normal reading flow, review the enterprise capability and deployment information: verify that private deployment, SSO connectivity, and local data sandbox are all explicitly identified, then follow a coherent named sequence beginning with obtaining access and ending with organization-wide availability, using the page’s declared stages without imposing an unstated stage count.

outcomes.endpoint: An enterprise buyer can compare each declared functional module across the available versions because every module-version intersection has an explicit, intelligible support status or a clear no-data marker.
outcomes.quote: 技术规格板块用一张二维表格来呈现，行标明功能模块，列标明不同版本的支持度，无数据的地方要求用短横线严谨补齐。
test_cases: Review the technical specifications using the page’s declared module names, version names, and support vocabulary: read across every module-version intersection and verify that each contains an explicit status such as supported, limited, optional, or a dash for no data, with no blank ambiguous intersection preventing comparison.

core_scope.purpose: Enable enterprise procurement decision-makers to understand the browser plugin’s concrete value, integration shape, enterprise readiness and deployment path, and version-level support differences.
review_notes: The proposed annotation promoted the sidebar layout, API search, clipboard action, and lead-form validation into separate core outcomes. These are navigation, convenience, or incidental interaction requirements; removing them does not eliminate the page’s primary enterprise-procurement information goal.

Core scope is limited to the non-substitutable information a buyer needs: the plugin’s value and integration shape, its named enterprise capabilities and deployment journey, and comparable version support information.

Syntax highlighting and copying remain supplementary. Item 19 covers the indispensable configuration content, while items 12 and 36 assess presentation or clipboard behavior rather than the informational endpoint.

The deployment stages are core information, but the progress bar or completion panel is a presentation choice. Item 22 is therefore supplementary, and item 23 is mixed because it checks the needed stage content while adding an unsupported numeric threshold.

Item 24 is mixed because its module/version dimensions contribute to the comparison endpoint while its mandatory two-dimensional table form is structural. Item 37 is mixed because it checks the presence of core sections together with right-column and form-placement requirements.
List formatting, dash typography, fixed columns, responsive folding, mobile overflow behavior, colors, typography, component styling, and self-containment remain scored supplementary requirements.

Item 34 is supplementary because originality relative to reference screenshots is not itself an indispensable buyer goal; thematic relevance and absence of unrelated replacement content are already represented by item 33.

ambiguities: The word "stateful" is interpreted as retaining data while navigating among steps in the current page session. The request does not specify persistence after a reload, browser restart, or server round trip.
"Real-time" is interpreted as immediate client-side presentation of the selected node and valid configuration edits without refresh; no live ingestion service or backend synchronization is requested.
API-key generation is treated as generating and displaying a usable-looking local token. The request does not require provisioning or validating a real server credential.

The request targets a global English user base, so intelligible English action labels and statuses support the core flow; checklist item 22 is mixed because requiring every incidental piece of interface copy to be English is broader than endpoint usability.

outcomes.endpoint: An English-speaking user can use the wizard controls to reach each of the three requested views as the current view, then revisit prior steps without losing node configuration, generated-key, or workspace-mapping state.
outcomes.quote: the wizard flow needs three distinct stateful views
test_cases: Starting in the node view, set a distinctive valid node configuration value; navigate to the API-key view and generate a key; navigate to the workspace view and change one labeled mapping. Use the wizard controls to revisit all three views and verify that the central content corresponds to the selected step and that the exact node value, generated key, and mapping state remain unchanged. The controls, essential labels, and resulting statuses must be intelligible in English, without requiring every incidental string to be audited.

outcomes.endpoint: The first view provides a node-network representation in which selecting a node exposes editable configuration associated with that specific node, and valid edits are reflected immediately without a page refresh.
outcomes.quote: users click a node to configure it in the side panel which updates in real-time
test_cases: In the first view, identify two distinct nodes in the connected-node representation. Select the first and verify that an editable configuration panel identifies or contains data for that node; select the second and verify that the panel now identifies or contains data for the second node rather than repeating the first node's fixed content.

Select a node, change an editable control to a distinctive valid value following any displayed constraints, and verify that the exact new value is presented as that node's current configuration without reloading. Select another node and then return to the edited node to verify that the value remains associated with the correct node.

outcomes.endpoint: In the second view, generating an API key displays a recognizable non-placeholder key, automatically places that exact key on the clipboard from the generation action, and immediately confirms the copy.
outcomes.quote: second state for api key generation with auto-copy feedback loops
test_cases: Navigate to the API-key view and activate its generation control once. Record the exact nonempty, non-placeholder key displayed and verify that immediate copied confirmation appears. Without invoking any separate copy control or copy command, focus the browser address bar, paste the clipboard contents without navigating, and verify that the pasted text exactly equals the displayed key.

outcomes.endpoint: The third view presents labeled row and column objects whose intersection cells let the user establish and cancel specific workspace mapping relationships with an unambiguous state change.
outcomes.quote: finally a workspace mapping matrix
test_cases: Navigate to the third view, choose a cell by its visible row and column labels, and record its initial state. Activate that cell and verify that the exact row-column relationship is visibly marked as changed or mapped; activate the same cell again and verify that the relationship returns to its initial unmapped state.

core_scope.purpose: Enable an English-speaking user to complete a three-step stateful onboarding configuration by configuring ingestion nodes, generating and automatically copying an API key with confirmation, and establishing or canceling labeled workspace mappings without losing in-page progress.
review_notes: Navigation and in-session persistence were consolidated into one end-to-end wizard-flow outcome rather than treating opening, clicking, active-step highlighting, and view replacement as separate core gates.

The bottom timeline's placement, exact visual treatment, and moving active indicator remain supplementary. Functional access to all three requested views is covered by checklist item 8 and the integrated flow test.

Checklist items 10 and 13 are mixed because they combine the core node-selection/configuration behavior with central-canvas positioning or slide-out presentation. Item 16 remains mixed because it combines exact state updating with decorative micro-interaction feedback.
Network animation and fluid transition effects remain supplementary even though they are emphasized visually; the indispensable node goal is selecting and configuring distinct nodes.

Theme, typography, spatial arrangement, self-contained packaging, generic JavaScript cleanliness, and long-string viewport resilience remain supplementary implementation or presentation requirements rather than business endpoints.
The API-key scenario verifies display, automatic clipboard transfer, and feedback in one end-to-end action instead of treating button discovery, generation, and confirmation as separate tests.
No real ingestion backend, credential provisioning service, workspace backend, or final submission transaction was added because the request only requires a self-contained stateful interface.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「深色页头的图文页」：全宽的深色页头，主体内容采用左宽右窄的两列布局（左侧文章主图，右侧图文列表），底部有横向排列的三列内容区和页脚。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「B」69.5px vs 「A」26.5px；元素密度：「B」113.6个/千像素高 vs 「A」56.9个/千像素高；整页高度：「B」1620px vs 「A」4819px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「深色页头的图文页」那一份神似（全宽的深色页头，主体内容采用左宽右窄的两列布局（左侧文章主图，右侧图文列表），底部有横向排列的三列内容区和页脚。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「带侧边栏的数据面板」在这一面是：左侧固定垂直导航栏，右侧内容区采用多行多列的网格化排列，放置各种矩形数据卡片、图表和表格。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。

ambiguities: The request does not specify actual API paths, schemas, parameter values, or the number of interfaces. Core verification should therefore use the page's declared interfaces and test their concreteness and internal consistency rather than imposing invented API details.

The online testing panel is introduced by “最好能有”, and no backend API is supplied. It is therefore supplementary; if implemented in the offline page, a front-end simulation may provide its loading and response states without implying a real deployment API.
Checklist item pal_1 refers to reference “A”, but the task data does not identify which of the two references is labeled A, so that item cannot independently determine the intended palette source.

outcomes.endpoint: The page presents intelligible technical API documentation in which each documented interface has a concrete name or path, HTTP method, request parameter names, and a corresponding request code example whose path, method, and parameters are internally consistent.
outcomes.quote: 我现在需要弄一个开发者 API 文档的网页。说白了就是给那些程序员同行看的使用说明书。
test_cases: After loading the page, inspect each documented interface and use only its visible documentation to identify the interface name or path, HTTP method, and request parameter names; compare these declarations with the corresponding code example and verify that the example uses the same path, method, and listed parameters rather than unrelated or undeclared values.

outcomes.endpoint: Developers can determine from the page how to obtain the authorization code needed to use the service, through a concrete application entry, process, or stated prerequisites rather than a heading alone.
outcomes.quote: 一块放怎么拿授权码的说明
test_cases: At the bottom of the page, read the authorization section and verify that it provides enough concrete information to determine how to obtain an authorization code, such as an application entry, actionable process, or necessary conditions, without requiring an invented backend transaction.

outcomes.endpoint: The bottom of the page exposes concrete company support details consisting of a telephone number, technical-support email address, and physical office address, rather than labels or placeholders.
outcomes.quote: 最后一块老老实实写咱们的联系电话、技术支持邮箱和具体的办公地址。
test_cases: At the bottom of the loaded page, locate the support contact information and verify that a specific telephone number, valid-looking support email address, and street or place-level physical office address are all visibly provided together and are not empty labels or placeholders.

core_scope.purpose: Provide programmers with a concise, usable API reference that explains how to form requests and obtain authorization, while making concrete company support contact information readily accessible.
review_notes: Collapsed the interface names, methods, parameters, code examples, and their consistency into one API-reference outcome instead of treating discovery and inspection as separate tests.

Kept authorization guidance as a distinct core informational goal because obtaining the authorization code is necessary for developers to use the described customer API; no real authorization transaction is required.

Separated concrete support contacts from the rest of the footer because the request explicitly describes phone and physical address accessibility as most important. SDK links and exact footer geometry remain supplementary.

Classified item 10 as mixed because it checks required code-example content while also prescribing placement in the wide column. Classified item 13 as mixed under authorization because it partially checks that section but bundles it with exact three-column layout and unrelated footer content.

Demoted the language switcher and its transition to supplementary requirements: they enhance presentation of code samples but are substitutable and are not necessary for the documentation to communicate the request.

Demoted the entire online testing, loading-animation, chart, and collapsible-tree flow because it is expressly phrased as preferable rather than mandatory and is not the primary documentation endpoint.

Typography, palette, atmosphere, viewport resilience, navigation behavior, selected-tab styling, self-containment, and general JavaScript robustness remain supplementary rather than separate core user outcomes.
Rewrote all core tests as complete scenarios that verify the final informational endpoint rather than splitting page opening, locating controls, and individual clicks into trivial tests.

ambiguities: The maturity text and value are introduced with “e.g.”, so “Current Aggregate Maturity: 94.2%” is illustrative rather than mandatory exact copy or data.

“Perfectly accurate” and “real-time” metrics cannot be independently validated because the request provides no authoritative dataset, calculation formula, update cadence, or live source; an offline single-file page should not be required to invent a backend feed.

The request asks the form to capture order details but does not specify a submission result, confirmation state, persistence rule, or backend transaction. A submit control remains supplementary rather than creating an unrequested order-fulfilment endpoint.

The request explicitly defines ascending-then-descending behavior for Price/100g. It requires sorting by Protein/100g and Caloric Density too, but is less explicit about their initial direction and repeated-click reversal; item 40 therefore mixes required sorting with a stronger uniform-toggle interpretation.

outcomes.endpoint: The header exposes an intelligible, labeled numeric active-inventory count and a labeled daily freshness or aggregate-maturity percentage; the illustrative 94.2% value is not required.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 14–15 check visible presence and formatting only. No checklist or supplied reference data verifies that either metric is accurate, current, or derived from a declared inventory source.
outcomes.quote: the active inventory count, the daily average freshness index
test_cases: Load the page and verify the header presents both a non-placeholder numeric active-inventory count and a clearly labeled numeric freshness or maturity percentage, with each value distinguishable from surrounding text.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can review the requested Leafy Greens, Root Vegetables, and Cruciferous catalog categories, with concrete SKU, price-per-ounce, glycemic-index, and fiber-content values available and intelligible for every category.
outcomes.missing_check: The checklist verifies that metric fields are present but supplies no authoritative product dataset or consistency rule with which to validate the factual accuracy of SKU, price, glycemic-index, or fiber values.
outcomes.quote: One side will be a solid background containing the hard data (SKU, price per ounce, glycemic index, fiber content), and the other side will be a full-height, edge-to-edge image of the produce category.
test_cases: Review the complete catalog and verify that all three named categories are present and that each category exposes a concrete, non-placeholder value for SKU, price per ounce, glycemic index, and fiber content with units or labels sufficient to interpret the values.

outcomes.endpoint: A populated produce table provides concrete numeric values for Price/100g, Protein/100g, and Caloric Density and reorders the same records by actual numeric value. Price/100g explicitly sorts low-to-high on the first activation and high-to-low on the second; the other requested metric headers also perform numerical sorting.
outcomes.missing_check: The sorting checks establish numerical ordering but do not validate whether the underlying protein, calorie, or price values are factually accurate; no source dataset or calculation rules are supplied for that purpose.
outcomes.quote: This should be a dense, interactive data table allowing users to sort produce by Price/100g, Protein/100g, and Caloric Density.
test_cases: Record every product row and its three displayed metric values, confirming that each is parseable as a number under the column's declared unit. Activate Price/100g once and verify the complete value sequence is nondecreasing, including cases such as 9.5 versus 12.0; activate it again and verify a nonincreasing sequence, with the same product-row multiset after both operations and no page reload.

Starting from the recorded rows, activate Protein/100g and Caloric Density in turn and verify that each operation reorders the unchanged row set into a numerically monotonic sequence matching the control's declared direction rather than lexicographic order.

outcomes.endpoint: The order form can hold structured delivery-logistics data, a substitution preference, and one or more explicitly selectable dietary-restriction flags. No backend order placement or confirmation transaction is assumed.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 30–32 verify the form and control categories but do not exercise whether a complete set of entered values is actually accepted and retained as coherent form state.
outcomes.quote: a structured order form at the bottom capturing delivery logistics, preferred substitution rules, and dietary restriction flags.
test_cases: Using the visible form controls, enter representative delivery logistics, choose an offered substitution rule, and select at least two applicable dietary-restriction flags; move through the rest of the form and return to verify that the exact entered and selected state remains represented in the appropriate controls.
Change only the substitution choice and one dietary flag, then verify those selections update while the previously entered delivery information remains unchanged.

outcomes.endpoint: The core inventory, catalog, sorting, and ordering content is exposed through semantic regions and a native data table; form controls have programmatically associated visible labels; sort state is accurately conveyed; and users can reach and operate the core interactions in predictable keyboard order without a trap.
outcomes.quote: a core business requirement is that this interface must serve users with accessibility needs, meaning semantic structure, high legibility, and predictable keyboard navigation are absolutely non-negotiable.
test_cases: From initial load, use only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, and standard form-control keys: reveal and activate the skip link and verify focus or navigation reaches main content, operate a sortable header, enter and change order-form values, and traverse back through the controls without a keyboard trap or an order inconsistent with the rendered reading sequence.

Using the browser accessibility representation, verify recognizable header, main, section, and form regions; a coherent heading hierarchy; a native table with named column headers; and visible form labels programmatically associated with every input, select, textarea, and checkbox. Clicking each visible form label must focus or toggle its corresponding control.

Sort Price/100g in both directions and then sort another metric using the keyboard; after every activation, verify the active header's aria-sort value matches the actual numeric row direction and that a previously active header no longer announces a stale sort state.

core_scope.purpose: Enable users, including keyboard and screen-reader users, to review intelligible fresh-grocery inventory, nutrition, and pricing data, sort the nutritional pricing matrix numerically, and capture delivery, substitution, and dietary-restriction choices in an order form.
review_notes: Added the omitted header inventory and freshness information as a core informational outcome because current inventory metrics are central to the stated data-analysis purpose.

Removed 50/50 geometry, side alternation, responsive stacking, gallery arrangement, dark theme, typography, tags, atmosphere, and other appearance requirements from core membership. They remain supplementary even where emphatically requested because they are substitutable presentation choices rather than business endpoints.
Kept the Seasonal Bulk gallery and its scrolling controls supplementary: removing the showcase would not prevent users from reviewing procurement data, sorting the matrix, or entering order details.

Separated accessibility into a core cross-cutting outcome. Exact 2px white focus styling is mixed because visible keyboard location supports core operation while its color and thickness are appearance specifications. Items 43 and 45 are mixed because they also cover supplementary gallery imagery or extra product controls.
Moved ARIA sort-state checks to the accessibility outcome rather than treating them as proof of numerical sorting correctness.
Removed catalog image placement and left/right alternation from the catalog core; the non-substitutable catalog goal is access to the named categories and requested hard data.
Did not treat a functional backend order transaction as core. The specified endpoint is structured capture of delivery, substitution, and dietary-restriction information.
Flagged the absence of source data needed to test factual metric accuracy instead of pretending that field presence or row movement proves the numbers are correct.

ambiguities: The request says to use native HTML and CSS without a framework, but the required validation and state transitions imply client-side behavior; vanilla JavaScript is therefore reasonably permitted, while a real backend is not implied.
The exact email regular expression is unspecified. Tests should follow the page's declared reasonable rule, while a string missing "@" is explicitly suitable as an invalid example.

Preferences are selected "按需" and the named topics are examples, so no particular option or minimum number of selected preferences should be required for submission unless the page declares such a rule.
Successful submission is a requested client-side confirmation state for an offline self-contained page; it must not be interpreted as requiring a real newsletter or deployment API.

outcomes.endpoint: Visible primary content clearly identifies the offering as a technical weekly newsletter for experienced developers and makes the purpose of the subscription form intelligible.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item cleanly isolates whether visible content explains what newsletter the user is subscribing to. Items 13 and 14 partly assess this but also impose supplementary requirements about operating data or complete absence of any unrelated copy.
outcomes.quote: 面向资深开发者的硬核技术周刊订阅中心
test_cases: Load the page and verify that its visible heading or explanatory copy makes clear that the user is subscribing to a technical weekly newsletter intended for experienced developers, rather than presenting an unrelated dashboard, restaurant, shop, or generic blog.

outcomes.endpoint: The user can enter a valid email, progress in the same module to choose relevant technical preferences, submit, and reach a success stage displaying the exact submitted email; an invalid email cannot advance, and correcting it permits recovery.
outcomes.quote: 核心交互是一个分步骤引导的订阅流转模块
test_cases: Starting from a fresh state, enter an email that violates the page's declared format rule, such as "invalid-email", attempt to continue, and verify that the module remains at the email stage with an intelligible format error. Replace it with "dev@example.com" and verify that the error clears and the same module can advance to the preference stage.

Starting from a fresh state, enter "senior.dev@example.com", advance without a page navigation, verify that stage two offers multiple selectable technical-domain preferences, select two available preferences using normal keyboard controls, submit, and verify that stage three appears in the subscription module with a success confirmation containing the exact address "senior.dev@example.com".

core_scope.purpose: Enable experienced developers to understand what technical weekly newsletter they are joining and complete its multi-step subscription flow, including recovery from an invalid email and confirmation of the submitted address.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposed subscription and email-validation groups because they describe one end-to-end signup flow; retained invalid-input recovery and valid completion as separate meaningful scenarios within that outcome.
Removed mobile responsiveness from core membership because sidebar collapse, single-column layout, and horizontal viewport fit are layout requirements rather than the subscription endpoint.
Added a newsletter-identity outcome because users must be able to understand what they are subscribing to. Existing content checks are mixed rather than clean endpoint checks.

Kept operating metrics, dashboard cards, archive navigation, grid construction, colors, typography, focus styling, animations, and responsive behavior supplementary even where explicitly requested, because removing them does not prevent the primary subscription goal.
Item 23 is mixed because invalid-email feedback supports the core recovery path, while its immediate timing and below-field presentation are supplementary interaction details.
Item 36 is mixed because keyboard completion bears on access to the core flow, while its bundled label and assistive-announcement implementation details are broader accessibility requirements.

Item 38 is mixed because preserving the submitted address for confirmation supports the core result, while clearing hidden form state after success is not necessary for the user to complete the subscription goal.
Initial control existence in item 21 is setup rather than an end result, and the generic DOM-change probe in "int_1" cannot establish successful subscription behavior.

ambiguities: The request does not specify the exact kids-industry matter, audience segment, or required action, so correctness should follow the coherent scenario declared by the page rather than imposing an invented event or transaction.
“bouncy” is subjective and may refer to tone or visual treatment; it is a supplementary presentation preference rather than a separate indispensable informational outcome.

outcomes.endpoint: The page presents an intelligible notice clearly associated with Two Rivers, identifies a concrete kids-industry matter and its intended audience, and communicates the relevant action or key arrangements rather than only generic promotion or placeholder copy.
outcomes.quote: Two Rivers kids industry notice
test_cases: Load the page and read the rendered notice using visible navigation controls if needed; verify that a clear main title or title area identifies it as a notice, that the exact name “Two Rivers” is visibly associated with it, and that its subject is recognizably related to the kids industry rather than an unrelated generic site.

On a fresh load, read the substantive notice content and verify that it describes a specific matter, identifies the applicable audience, and explains an action they should take or a key arrangement they need to know; assess these details according to the scenario declared by the page and reject placeholder-only or generic promotional copy.

core_scope.purpose: To inform visitors about a specific Two Rivers kids-industry matter, including who it affects and the action or key arrangements they need to understand.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposed content checks into one end-to-end informational outcome covering identity, subject, audience, and actionable or key notice details.

Removed pill-tab interaction as a core outcome. Pill tabs are a requested presentation and navigation mechanism, but their removal would not inherently defeat the primary purpose of communicating the notice; tab styling and behavior remain supplementary requirements.
Moved the lively or “bouncy” tone check to supplementary scope because tone affects presentation but is not required for the notice information to remain accessible and intelligible.
Kept item 14 as mixed because substantive non-placeholder notice copy supports the core endpoint, while requiring such copy in every pill-tab panel also depends on the supplementary tab structure.
