ambiguities: The request requires a checkout button but specifies no checkout transaction, payment flow, or backend behavior; button presence is not treated as a real purchase endpoint.

Price-bound inclusivity, slider step size, the shipping threshold, and the mapping from inStock values to inventory-bar length are not fixed. Tests should follow rules declared by the page rather than impose arbitrary values.
The example product object is introduced as a structural reference, so its exact sample record and wording are not mandatory data.
No cart persistence, quantity-editing, removal, or stock-decrement behavior is requested.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can identify the NodeCraft marketplace and browse an intelligible collection of distinct products whose displayed details correspond to the page's declared mock product data.
outcomes.quote: 为精品手作市集「匠造节点 / NodeCraft」构建单页电商数字店面。
test_cases: Set the price controls to their full declared range, then verify that both brand names are visible and that the rendered product set corresponds to the page's embedded mock records. For each rendered product, compare its identity, artisan, numeric price, material, and availability information with the corresponding declared record, and confirm that the product can be distinguished from the other products.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can select a price interval and the product grid then contains exactly the products allowed by that interval under the page's declared boundary rules.
outcomes.quote: 采用直方图组件（Histogram）展示当前市集作品的价格分布特征，用户可通过拖拽区间滑块（Brush）进行价格区间筛选。
test_cases: From the full catalog, choose a proper price subrange with the Brush controls. Using the embedded product prices and the page's declared boundary convention as the oracle, verify that the visible product identities exactly equal the records within the selected bounds and that every out-of-range record is absent.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can add products, receive an exact cart-count update, and open a cart drawer that identifies the products they selected.
outcomes.quote: 沉浸式购物车抽屉：从右侧平滑滑出的 Cart Drawer，内含已选商品列表、动态运费进度条和结账按钮。
test_cases: Reload into a clean cart state, note the initial count, and add two distinct visible products once each. Verify that the cart count increases by exactly one after each addition; then open the cart and verify that its selected-item list identifies exactly those two products rather than unrelated products or a generic placeholder.

outcomes.endpoint: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can operate the storefront's product, filter, and cart flows, perceive focus and text, and remain correctly contained within the modal cart while it is open.
outcomes.quote: 目标受众包含对设计敏感的高净值人群以及具备无障碍需求的用户，因此在追求极致美学的同时，必须保证底层结构的语义化和可访问性。
test_cases: Using only the keyboard, traverse the closed page and verify that every button, link, add-to-cart control, and price handle receives a clearly visible focus indicator. Adjust both price handles with arrow keys and verify that the resulting visible product set exactly matches the selected numeric range.

Using only the keyboard, activate a product's add control and open the global cart. Cycle forward and backward through the drawer's focusable controls for more than one complete cycle and verify that focus never reaches the obscured page; press Esc and verify that the drawer closes and the underlying page is operable again.

With the cart open and the market data panel updating, inspect the accessibility tree and computed styles: verify ordered semantic page structure, dialog semantics with aria-modal="true", aria-live="polite" on the updating panel, usable accessible names for controls, and a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for all text.

core_scope.purpose: Provide an accessible single-page NodeCraft storefront where users can identify and browse the handmade-product catalog, filter products by price, add selected products, and review them in a cart drawer.
review_notes: Made catalog discovery, price filtering, cart review, and accessible operation the core user outcomes, and collapsed overlapping add/count/open/list checks into one end-to-end cart flow.

Kept the Hero dashboard, typewriter effect, dark palette, typography, masonry geometry, responsive column count, blur, FLIP motion, particle and spring effects, and other visual treatments supplementary because they do not establish the storefront's business endpoints.

Moved checks that combine a core endpoint with appearance or incidental content into mixed_item_ids, including the histogram control's prescribed form, animated right-side drawer checks, the bundled drawer contents check, and product-card checks containing visual stock treatments.
Kept single-file packaging, external-resource restrictions, generic exception checks, and stress-layout probes supplementary engineering requirements rather than separate end-user core goals.

Retained accessibility as core because users with accessibility needs are an expressly identified audience and the request requires semantic, keyboard-operable, perceivable interaction; no backend checkout capability was invented.

Replaced stepwise existence/click tests with self-contained scenarios that verify exact filtered membership, exact cart-count changes and selected products, keyboard completion of flows, modal focus containment, semantics, and contrast.

ambiguities: The phrase "like About, Lab, Archive, and Notes" presents those labels as examples, so requiring exactly those four names and four distinct non-empty destinations is stronger than the request unambiguously establishes.

The request definitely asks for an animated data visualization, but "maybe a dynamic chart showing my coding activity" makes the exact chart type and data subject an example rather than a fixed business result.
GitHub star counts appear in "like the year or my GitHub star counts" as examples of numbers to emphasize typographically, so their presence is not clearly mandatory.
Extra pop-up boxes and dropdowns are conditional in "If I need any extra pop-up info boxes or dropdowns" and should not be treated as required component existence.
The numbered-step styling is described as something the creator "can use" to rank favorite repositories; this does not clearly establish the ranking section as a non-substitutable portfolio outcome.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can recognize the page as a hobbyist's personal coding portfolio and understand the displayed projects or experiments from meaningful project titles and directly associated short descriptions.
outcomes.quote: create a personal website to showcase my coding projects and late-night experiments.
test_cases: Load the page and use its visible controls and normal scrolling to inspect the complete project showcase; verify that it is intelligibly presented as one hobbyist's coding-project or late-night-experiment portfolio and that every displayed project entry has a meaningful, non-placeholder title with a directly associated short descriptive blurb that distinguishes or explains it.

core_scope.purpose: Let visitors discover and understand the creator's personal coding projects and late-night experiments through an intelligible personal portfolio.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposal's separate layout, navigation, ranking, and chart groups into the single indispensable informational outcome: visitors must be able to understand the personal coding projects and experiments being showcased.

Moved the four-column/year organization, exact navigation arrangement, favorite-repository ranking, chart placement and behavior, animation, visual styling, performance, and source-size constraints to supplementary scoring because removing any one of them would not eliminate the portfolio's primary end-user purpose.
The animated chart remains an important requested supplementary feature, but a decorative visualization and its transition animation are not core business endpoints.

Items 31 and 36 are mixed: they partially assess core portfolio relevance or actual project content, while also imposing broader anti-reference-copy or exact four-year-grid conditions that are not independently core.

Replaced the proposal's stepwise locate/check/click tests with one self-contained end-to-end content scenario that verifies the actual informational result rather than control existence or generic visual change.
No project-detail transaction, deployment API, or distinct backend behavior was invented; the request is satisfied at core by accessible and intelligible portfolio content.

ambiguities: The request does not specify question wording, required-versus-optional status, validation rules, slider parameters, or a submission payload, so tests must use the labels and constraints declared by the page.

A final submission CTA is requested, but no backend, destination, or confirmation design is specified. The feasible endpoint is therefore a discernible self-contained client-side completion result, not proof of remote delivery.

Previous-step or review navigation is not explicitly required; answer retention should be verified through whatever review, return, or completion feedback the implementation declares rather than imposing a particular navigation design.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can answer intelligible feedback questions through the client-side step sequence using operable radio, range, and textarea controls, retain those answers as steps change, and invoke the form-associated final submission action to reach the page's declared self-contained completion result; no remote backend transaction is implied.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 27 and 28 cover control operation, answer retention, and an associated submit control, but no checklist item directly verifies the post-submit client-side completion result or the exact submitted values. No network delivery or backend persistence should be inferred.
outcomes.quote:
- The active question sequence containing radio inputs, a slider, and a text area.
- A final submission CTA block.
test_cases: From a fresh load, follow the survey's declared controls to select a specific radio answer, set the slider to an exact permitted value derived from its declared range and verify that exact value is reported, enter a unique textarea response, and advance through every question without a document reload. Activate the form-associated final submit control and verify the declared local completion result preserves the exact radio choice, slider value, and text rather than defaults or stale values.

Repeat the complete flow from a fresh load with a different radio choice, a different non-default legal slider value, and distinct text; verify step changes retain the new answers and the final local completion result reflects this second set rather than the prior run. Apply only validation or required-field rules that the page itself declares.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a user to answer and complete a self-contained, multi-step user feedback survey using the requested question types and a final submission action.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposed survey-form and transition groups into one end-to-end survey-completion flow because question entry, step changes, retained state, and final submission are parts of the same user goal.

Removed the dark theme, viewport lock, side-by-side grid, responsiveness, typography, card styling, animation smoothness, and progress presentation from core membership. They remain scored requirements but are substitutable presentation or layout choices rather than the survey's business endpoint.
Items 21 and 26 are mixed because they test core step switching and no-reload state behavior together with supplementary animation or progress-indicator requirements.

Structural block existence, semantic elements, focus styling, packaging, CSS variables, and control-existence-only checks remain supplementary. Functional item 27 provides the stronger coverage for the requested radio, slider, and textarea interactions.
Added a missing-check note because an operable submit control alone does not establish the actual completion result or verify the exact collected answers.

ambiguities: The request does not name the two languages or require simultaneous display; either two clearly accessible languages shown together or reached through an explicit switch is acceptable.

The word "stateful" does not specify the state dimension, transition rules, initial values, persistence, or whether the mechanism is an alert, region, language, or data-update control. Tests should follow the page's declared states and rules rather than inventing a backend or expected dataset.

No authoritative emergency dataset, scenario, units, or numeric ground truth is supplied, so emergency relevance, visible labeling, internal consistency, and reproducible state mapping can be checked, but real-world factual accuracy cannot be assumed.
The three visual references are identified relationally; their exact visual similarity is not fully measurable from the request text alone.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access the current emergency status, emergency-related metrics and visualization, and concrete action guidance in two languages; critical meanings are equivalent across languages and the content is intelligible rather than placeholder or generic business material.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 15 and 17 check the presence and emergency relevance of the visualization, but no dedicated checklist item verifies that its labels, scales, legends, and values are sufficiently legible and intelligible to interpret.
outcomes.quote: bilingual emergency guidance data-viz
test_cases: From a fresh load, locate the current emergency status and highest-priority action guidance, using the visible language control if the languages are not shown together. Read both language versions and verify that each provides concrete, executable actions, that the status and actions have equivalent meanings, and that neither version substitutes placeholders or unrelated content for critical safety information.

In the current displayed state, inspect the metrics and main visualization and determine from their visible titles, labels, legends, scales, or values what emergency condition they represent. Verify that they communicate emergency-related information that is consistent with the surrounding status and guidance rather than unrelated commercial data.

outcomes.endpoint: At least one user-observable mechanism moves the dashboard between declared states, and the current-state indication plus all text, metrics, and visualization outputs relevant to that state remain synchronized; no real backend transaction is required.
outcomes.quote: stateful
test_cases: From a fresh load, record the visible current state and the associated safety title, guidance, KPI numbers, and chart labels or values. Use a provided alert-level, region, language, update, or other declared state control to enter another state; verify that the selected state is explicit and that every relevant output corresponds to that state under the page's visible labels or rules rather than only the control styling changing. If the mechanism is reversible or cyclic, return to the original state and verify that the recorded text and numeric/chart values are restored exactly.

core_scope.purpose: Enable TV viewers to understand the current emergency situation and act on clear, equivalent bilingual guidance, supported by interpretable emergency data visualization and coherent observable state changes.
review_notes: Collapsed bilingual content, actionable guidance, emergency metrics, and visualization into one informational core outcome because together they deliver the primary viewer-facing emergency information.
Retained statefulness as a separate functional core outcome, while limiting it to coherent visible UI states rather than inventing a deployment, live-data, or backend requirement.

Moved dark theme, TV viewport fit, sidebar/grid arrangement, typography, dividers, circles, responsive reflow, and overflow handling to supplementary scope because color, layout, visual styling, and viewport fit are not business endpoints.
Kept item 15 as mixed because it checks core emergency status, visualization, and action content while also prescribing presentation in explicit sections.

Moved item 14 to supplementary because its absolute prohibition on every stray reference term is broader than the indispensable emergency-information endpoint, although content cleanliness remains a scored requirement.

Sidebar navigation behavior, single-file packaging, external-resource restrictions, and JavaScript robustness remain supplementary implementation or navigation requirements rather than separate core user goals.

ambiguities: No canonical department name or real-world contact values are supplied, so correctness can establish that the values are explicit, plausible, and intelligible, but not that they belong to an actual institution.

“一眼能找着” is subjective and appears alongside the instruction to place the information at the very bottom. It is interpreted as conspicuous and clearly labeled, not as a requirement that the contacts appear above the fold.
“正经点” and “看着得靠谱” are subjective presentation goals without an objective correctness threshold; the requested visual styling remains supplementary.

outcomes.endpoint: The visible page clearly identifies a specific university department and presents intelligible department-related content rather than an unrelated business or generic template.
outcomes.quote: 帮我搞个正经点的大学院系主页
test_cases: Load the page in a browser and use its visible heading and main content to identify the named department; verify that a clear department name is shown and that the surrounding material consistently reads as university-department content rather than an unrelated industry or template.

outcomes.endpoint: A conspicuous final contact area provides separately identifiable, readable values for the department office phone, detailed street/building or room address, and email address.
outcomes.missing_check: Only mixed checklist items are mapped; a standalone endpoint assessment is required.
outcomes.quote: 最底下必须把院办电话、详细门牌号和邮箱放醒目点，平时打交道谈事儿找不着人可不行。
test_cases: Starting from the normally loaded page, use ordinary scrolling or visible page navigation to reach the final contact area without browser text search or source inspection; verify that it clearly labels and displays a nonempty office phone number, a detailed door-number-level address, and an email address, with all three readily distinguishable from surrounding content.

core_scope.purpose: Provide a credible, identifiable university department homepage whose office phone, detailed address, and email are easy for visitors to locate and understand.
review_notes: Core scope was narrowed to the two non-substitutable end-user goals: recognizing the page as a university department homepage and locating complete department contact information.

Item 8 is mixed because its department-identity assessment supports the core outcome, while its examples also imply breadth across speech, faculty, and achievement sections that is not independently indispensable to the stated contact-focused purpose.
Items 23 and 24 are mixed because they verify the required contact values while also coupling them to bottom-of-page placement and visual-prominence methods.

The vertical navigation layout, carousel timing and progress animation, faculty tab mechanics, dynamic line-chart presentation, consultation form, visual references, and delivery constraints remain supplementary even though they are explicit requirements; removing any one of them would not eliminate the page’s primary informational purpose.
The revised tests combine setup, navigation, and endpoint verification into self-contained browser scenarios rather than treating opening, finding, and observing as separate tests.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「黑框网格排版的材料页」：极其明显的黑线网格布局，所有内容区块、信息列表甚至导航元素都被明确的黑色实线边框（粗细不一）包裹或分割，呈现出强烈的表格和模块化特征。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「B」9.5px vs 「A」34.5px；元素密度：「B」61.1个/千像素高 vs 「A」36.8个/千像素高。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「黑框网格排版的材料页」那一份神似（极其明显的黑线网格布局，所有内容区块、信息列表甚至导航元素都被明确的黑色实线边框（粗细不一）包裹或分割，呈现出强烈的表格和模块化特征。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「带圆形头像的个人主页」在这一面是：典型的现代通栏单页布局，各版块通过不同底色区分，内部元素（如卡片、图标）主要依靠留白和无形的简单网格进行排列，无可见边框。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带圆形头像的个人主页」那一份（典型的现代通栏单页布局，各版块通过不同底色区分，内部元素（如卡片、图标）主要依靠留白和无形的简单网格进行排列，无可见边框。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「A」份「带圆形头像的个人主页」：西文无衬线排版，字号层级反差大（尤其是首屏大标题），大量使用浅灰色作为副标题或说明文字，整体气质现代且轻盈。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「A」26px vs 「B」14px；最大标题字号：「A」56.5px vs 「B」36px；字号档数：「A」8档 vs 「B」15档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带圆形头像的个人主页」那一份神似（西文无衬线排版，字号层级反差大（尤其是首屏大标题），大量使用浅灰色作为副标题或说明文字，整体气质现代且轻盈。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「黑框网格排版的材料页」在这一面是：中文排版，整体字号差异较小且排列紧密，绝大多数文字为纯黑色，配合直线框呈现出类似说明书或老式报纸的严谨、平实质感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「黑框网格排版的材料页」那一份（中文排版，整体字号差异较小且排列紧密，绝大多数文字为纯黑色，配合直线框呈现出类似说明书或老式报纸的严谨、平实质感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（radius_zero）。判法：按钮/卡片的计算 border-radius 全部 = 0。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：按钮和卡片我要方角，一点圆角都别留（判法：按钮/卡片的计算 border-radius 全部 = 0）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'受托给街坊们常去的家庭牙科诊所搭个网站'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'一开始先放诊所的招牌和一句简单的问候语'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求首屏放置“一句简单的问候语”，因此应检查文案的简短程度与问候性质，但不应限定渲染行数。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'接着列出像儿童涂氟、日常洗牙这几个核心项目'

keypoints.basis: 指令点名了'像儿童涂氟、日常洗牙这几个核心项目'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“列出像儿童涂氟、日常洗牙这几个核心项目”，可据此检查多项目并列呈现，但不能额外规定至少三项或逐项说明。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'用一小段话介绍一下主治大夫的资历'
keypoints.question: 页面是否有一段介绍主治大夫的内容板块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'用一小段话介绍一下主治大夫的资历'
keypoints.question: 主治大夫介绍是否为一小段文字，并包含至少一项具体资历表述（如执业年限、毕业院校/学历、职称或擅长方向），而不是只写了姓名？

keypoints.basis: 指令给出明确顺序：'一开始先放诊所的招牌和一句简单的问候语，接着列出…核心项目，然后…介绍主治大夫的资历，最后底部留一个…预约…表单'
keypoints.question: 页面从上到下的内容顺序是否为：诊所招牌与问候语 → 核心诊疗项目 → 主治大夫介绍 → 预约表单（表单位于页面底部）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'最后底部留一个让街坊直接预约看牙时间的表单'

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求预约看牙时间，并特别要求避免填错电话，因此联系电话与预约日期/时间字段具有直接依据。
keypoints.question: 预约表单是否包含联系电话字段以及用于选择预约日期和时间的字段或控件，并通过标签或占位文字清楚标明其用途？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'带个基本的前端输入校验免得大家填错电话'

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'带个基本的前端输入校验'
keypoints.question: 在所有字段留空的情况下点击提交按钮，页面是否阻止提交并给出必填提示？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求提供能让街坊直接预约看牙时间的表单，因此合法填写后应产生可观察的提交结果，但不应限定题面未指定的具体字段组合。
keypoints.question: 在预约表单当前设置的必填项（包括有效联系电话和期望预约时间）均填写合法后点击提交，页面是否接受提交并给出可见的成功或预约已收到反馈？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'整个单页配上顶部的常驻导航，方便邻居们随时找信息'
keypoints.question: 向下滚动到页面中部（如医生介绍或表单位置）后，顶部导航是否仍然固定可见？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求顶部常驻导航方便邻居们随时查找页面中的核心项目、医生介绍和预约等主要信息。
keypoints.question: 顶部导航是否提供通往核心项目、主治大夫介绍和预约表单等主要信息板块的清晰条目，且条目标签能够准确反映其目标板块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'整个单页配上顶部的常驻导航，方便邻居们随时找信息'
keypoints.question: 点击顶部导航中的某一项（例如指向预约表单的那一项）后，页面是否真的滚动/跳转到该板块（锚点生效，而非无反应或死链）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'整个单页配上顶部的常驻导航'
keypoints.question: 所有内容是否都在同一个可连续滚动的页面里（招牌问候、项目、大夫、预约都能通过滚动看到，没有需要跳转到另一页面才能看到的主要板块）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'页面在适配各种屏幕的同时最好能以桌面宽屏的呈现为主'
keypoints.question: 在窄视口（约 768px 宽）下浏览时，内容是否重排为更窄的单列/少列形式且不出现横向溢出或文字被截断？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“页面在适配各种屏幕的同时最好能以桌面宽屏的呈现为主”；现有条目只检查了约 768px 下的窄屏重排，未检查桌面宽屏是否为主要呈现形态。
keypoints.question: 在约 1440–1920px 的桌面宽屏视口下，页面是否采用充分利用横向空间的桌面布局（例如主要信息适度并列或分栏），而不是仍以移动端式窄单列集中在很小区域或被无意义地拉伸？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“带个基本的前端输入校验免得大家填错电话”；现有检查只以“abc”验证非数字输入，尚未覆盖更贴近实际误填情形的号码长度错误。
keypoints.question: 电话字段输入仅由数字组成但明显过短或过长的号码（如“12345”或超长数字串）并提交时，是否同样会显示电话格式错误并阻止成功提交，而不只是拦截含字母的内容？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

ambiguities: The request does not specify an exact accepted telephone format or country-specific length. Validation should follow rules communicated by the page while still rejecting nonnumeric and unambiguously implausible values; it should not be judged against an invented fixed regex.

“直接预约” does not establish an available backend transaction in this offline single-file setting. The covered endpoint is client-side acceptance and visible acknowledgment, not proof that a real clinic received or confirmed an appointment.
No exact clinic name, greeting wording, or dentist credential is supplied, so meaningful dental-specific content should be accepted rather than requiring invented fixed text.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can clearly identify the page as a family dental clinic and access intelligible content containing the clinic sign/name, a brief welcoming greeting, distinguishable core services explicitly including 儿童涂氟 and 日常洗牙, and at least one specific qualification of the chief dentist.
outcomes.quote: 诊所的招牌和一句简单的问候语，接着列出像儿童涂氟、日常洗牙这几个核心项目，然后用一小段话介绍一下主治大夫的资历
test_cases: Load the page and, using normal scrolling, verify that it is clearly for a family dental clinic and that the accessible content includes a clinic sign or name, a brief welcoming greeting, distinguishable service entries explicitly naming 儿童涂氟 and 日常洗牙, and a chief-dentist introduction with at least one concrete qualification such as experience, education, title, or specialty.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can use a client-side appointment-request form to provide a contact phone number and desired appointment date/time; empty or clearly invalid submissions are blocked with visible guidance, while values satisfying the form's declared rules produce an explicit on-page acceptance acknowledgment without implying a real backend booking.
outcomes.quote: 让街坊直接预约看牙时间的表单，带个基本的前端输入校验免得大家填错电话
test_cases: Starting with a fresh form, leave the required booking information empty and submit; verify that submission is blocked, visible required-field guidance is shown for the contact and appointment-time information needed by the form, and no success acknowledgment appears.

Starting with a fresh form, provide any other required values and submit first with “abc” as the phone number, then with a digits-only value that is clearly too short or too long under the form's displayed or declared phone rules; verify each attempt produces a visible phone-validation error, remains unaccepted, and never shows the success state.

Starting with a fresh form, fill every field marked required using a phone number and appointment date/time that satisfy the page's declared constraints, submit through the normal control, and verify that the page displays an explicit message stating that the appointment request was accepted or received.

core_scope.purpose: Help local residents identify the family dental clinic, understand its key services and dentist qualifications, and submit an appointment request with basic client-side phone validation.
review_notes: Consolidated the requested clinic identity, greeting, services, and dentist qualifications into one informational outcome rather than treating each section or placement instruction as an independent core gate.

Kept the appointment request and its valid-input and invalid-input paths as one functional outcome. The tests verify specific rejection or acceptance states rather than merely checking that controls exist or that the DOM changes.

Classified items 7, 8, 9, 12, 14, 15, and 23 as mixed because they combine core content or form availability with first-screen placement, dedicated-section structure, exact ordering, bottom placement, or single-page arrangement.

Kept the black-grid layout, typography inspiration, square corners, sticky navigation, anchor behavior, viewport reflow, desktop composition, self-contained implementation details, generic JavaScript cleanliness, and overflow stress test supplementary because removing those presentation or implementation properties would not eliminate the clinic-information or appointment-request goals.
The booking endpoint is intentionally limited to feasible browser-side behavior and does not invent a deployment API or completed real-world reservation.

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「带红色图标的联系页面」：主体内容高度集中在页面中央，上部为横向等宽排列的三个卡片，下部为居中对齐、限制最大宽度的表单区。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「B」73.8px vs 「A」40px；元素密度：「B」114.6个/千像素高 vs 「A」44.9个/千像素高；整页高度：「B」1815px vs 「A」5990px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「带红色图标的联系页面」那一份神似（主体内容高度集中在页面中央，上部为横向等宽排列的三个卡片，下部为居中对齐、限制最大宽度的表单区，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「带黄色色块的个人页」在这一面是：包含占据大半个屏幕的顶部全宽背景，下方内容区以两列平行的图文列表为主。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带黄色色块的个人页」那一份（包含占据大半个屏幕的顶部全宽背景，下方内容区以两列平行的图文列表为主）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「粗黑实线框的中文网页」在这一面是：类似报纸的网格化排版，由大量大小不一的矩形区块紧密拼接构成复杂的瀑布流或多列网格。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「粗黑实线框的中文网页」那一份（类似报纸的网格化排版，由大量大小不一的矩形区块紧密拼接构成复杂的瀑布流或多列网格）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「D」份「深色背景图表控制面板」在这一面是：页面分为上下两部分，上方为满宽的图表展示区（内嵌左侧浮动面板），下方为横向平铺多列的控制面板。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 40px、元素密度 44.9个/千像素高、整页高度 5990px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「深色背景图表控制面板」那一份（页面分为上下两部分，上方为满宽的图表展示区（内嵌左侧浮动面板），下方为横向平铺多列的控制面板）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「D」份「深色背景图表控制面板」：整体为暗黑模式，背景为极深的蓝黑色，使用亮蓝、翠绿、粉红等多种高亮荧光色作为数据图和滑块的强调色。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。

ambiguities: The request does not prescribe particular parameters or output mappings: the stateful parameter generator is introduced with "maybe," so tests must follow the page's declared interaction rules rather than require recipient, tone, slider, or preview controls.

The request does not specify A4 orientation, exact margins, or bleed. Core printing should therefore require a complete, clean single-sheet A4 result without imposing unstated measurements beyond the declared A4 size.

"Final result" most naturally refers to the greeting/card rather than the editing workspace, consistent with checklist items 27 and 33; ancillary UI need not be categorically hidden if it does not intrude on or disrupt the printed result.

outcomes.endpoint: The user can reach a clear, readable holiday greeting/card result through at least one meaningful behavior beyond a static display. A parameter-driven stateful generator is a suggested implementation, not the only acceptable realization.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item tests the broader required non-static holiday experience without also requiring the merely suggested parameter-control-and-preview implementation. Item 19 establishes the theme, while items 20 and 26 only partially cover the endpoint through that narrower generator design.
outcomes.quote: a holiday greeting page. It needs to be a bit more advanced than a static page, maybe a stateful greeting generator where users tweak parameters to create a custom digital card
test_cases: From a fresh load, follow the page's declared primary holiday-card interaction, make an allowed non-default choice or input, and complete any stated Apply, Generate, or Reveal action; verify that a readable, explicitly holiday-related greeting is produced, revealed, or updated exactly as the interface promises, rather than remaining unchanged, placeholder, or unrelated content.

outcomes.endpoint: The final holiday greeting state can be sent through a real page or browser print flow and appears completely and legibly on one A4 sheet without clipping, overlap, overflow, bad pagination, or editing UI obscuring the result.
outcomes.quote: the final result prints out perfectly on A4 paper without anything breaking or looking messy
test_cases: Starting from a fresh page, complete its primary holiday-greeting interaction and make a recognizable choice or input if offered, then invoke the provided print action or the browser's native print command and select A4; verify in print preview that the resulting greeting reflects the completed state, fits wholly on one A4 sheet, remains clear and readable, is not clipped, overlapped, overflowed, or split across pages, and is not obscured by editing controls.

core_scope.purpose: Deliver an intelligible, meaningfully non-static holiday greeting/card experience whose final result prints cleanly on A4.
review_notes: Restored the sentence context around "maybe": parameter-driven generation is an optional suggested realization and cannot be the sole core gate. Generator-specific persistence, parameter, form, and control checks were therefore made supplementary; items 20 and 26 remain mixed because they also partially assess the mandatory non-static holiday result.

Removed the analytical lab aesthetic, reference-derived layout, colors, typography, component styling, responsive layout, and theme wording from the core purpose. These remain scored supplementary requirements rather than non-substitutable user outcomes.
Kept A4 output as a distinct core outcome because the request expressly requires the final result to print cleanly on A4.
Replaced separate print-dialog setup and observation steps with one self-contained end-to-end scenario that creates a final greeting state, prints it, and verifies the actual A4 endpoint.
Items 24 and 25 are supplementary because the top-card placement and under-card form arrangement are requested structure, while their generator mechanics depend on the optional implementation choice.

ambiguities: No scholar, authoritative dataset, fixed year range, or fixed taxonomy of research dimensions is supplied, so data and filter correctness must be checked against the page’s own declared labels and internally consistent values rather than external facts.
“研究维度” may be implemented as research fields, directions, or another explicitly explained scholarly categorization; no single taxonomy should be imposed.
The request’s WCAG AA wording is broader than checklist item a11y_2, which samples only body-text contrast and therefore cannot establish complete WCAG AA conformance.

outcomes.endpoint: The page communicates the scholar’s identity, concretely labeled publication and impact metrics, a substantive literature list, and intelligible citation-network and time-series views rather than decorative chart placeholders.
outcomes.quote: 搭建一个高级克制风的学者学术主页。核心诉求是通过数据可视化直观展示论文产出与影响力指标。
test_cases: Load the page and identify the scholar by name plus role or institution; verify that H-index and at least one publication-output metric have unambiguous labels and finite non-negative numeric values, and that the literature list contains at least two distinct titled papers with meaningful metadata such as year, field, or citation count.

Using the chart titles, legends, axes, data labels, or equivalent data presentation, verify that the citation network contains identifiable nodes joined by meaningful edges and that the line chart reports a publication or citation trend over labeled years with numeric values; for at least two declared year/value pairs, confirm that the plotted ordering or position agrees with those values.

outcomes.endpoint: Applying a year, research dimension, or both updates the citation network and line-chart datasets to the corresponding filter state without top-level navigation or a full document reload, while preserving other active conditions.
outcomes.quote: 点击左侧条件时，右侧的引用关系网络图和平滑折线图需进行无刷新状态切换
test_cases: Starting from the initial state, select one of the page’s declared years or year ranges and confirm that no top-level navigation or document reload occurs; verify from the charts’ labels, summaries, or data that both outputs now represent that year scope rather than merely changing appearance.

Starting from the initial state, select a declared research dimension and verify that both the network’s node or edge data and the line chart’s reported series correspond to that dimension according to the page’s own labels and dataset, without a full-page refresh.

Apply both a year condition and a research-dimension condition, then change only the year; verify that the dimension remains selected and that both visualizations report data for the resulting intersection of the two current conditions.

outcomes.endpoint: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can identify every filter, understand its current state, activate it without a pointer, and obtain an equivalent explanation of the resulting chart information.
outcomes.quote: 受众包含无障碍需求用户，要求信息呈现绝对清晰、零干扰阅读。
test_cases: With the mouse unused, use Tab and Shift+Tab to visit every year and research-dimension option with a visible focus indication, activate one option from each group using Enter or Space, and verify that their exposed selected states update and both charts reach the corresponding filtered state.

Inspect the browser accessibility representation after applying a filter: verify that each filter group and option exposes an understandable name, control role, and current checked, pressed, or selected state, and that each chart has an accessible name plus a data summary or equivalent explanation that conveys its key result without relying only on color, node position, or line shape.

core_scope.purpose: Present an identifiable scholar’s publications, research output, and impact through clear, accessible data visualizations whose year and research-dimension filters produce coherent linked states.
review_notes: Collapsed scholar identity, metrics, publications, and the two requested visualizations into one informational core outcome. Item 16 remains mixed because it combines required content presence with its right-column placement; item 18 remains mixed because it combines readable chart data with the visual choice of a smooth curve.

Kept linked filtering as one end-to-end outcome. Items 13–15 only establish that controls and labels exist, so they remain supplementary rather than substitutes for checks that the resulting graph states are correct.
Retained keyboard activation, exposed control state, and nonvisual chart explanations as core because users with accessibility needs must be able to reach the same information and filtering result.

Node-reorganization animation is not a non-substitutable data-filtering goal. Items 25 and 36 are supplementary, while item 23 is mixed because it combines the core no-refresh state change with the animation requirement.

Layout references, typography, monochrome styling, pill-shaped buttons, mobile text fit, contrast styling, self-containment, long-string robustness, and generic runtime quality remain supplementary requirements rather than separate core outcomes.

ambiguities: The request supplies no actual dispatch number, warehouse address, logo, update feed, or authoritative news source, so tests can validate presence, intelligibility, and internal consistency but cannot require particular real-world values.

“Up-to-the-minute” does not specify a data source or refresh mechanism and is paired with an offline self-contained HTML requirement. It is therefore treated as the intended character and recency of embedded updates, not as a mandatory live backend or deployment API.

The named categories are introduced with “like,” so they are examples rather than an exhaustive mandatory taxonomy. Functional filtering should be checked against the categories the page declares rather than imposing exactly those four labels.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can obtain the displayed 24/7 dispatch number and main warehouse street address and can invoke a telephone call through a dialable link whose target matches the displayed number.
outcomes.quote: our 24/7 dispatch phone number and our main warehouse physical address must be massive and impossible to miss right at the very top
test_cases: In a mobile-sized browser, load the page and use the top contact area to identify a non-empty 24/7 dispatch number and an intelligible warehouse street address; activate the phone link and verify its `tel:` target, after normalizing formatting characters, matches the displayed number.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can read a chronological collection of meaningful freight and logistics updates, with each update communicating its date, category, and specific event headline and with historical position remaining intelligible from the dates or grouping labels.
outcomes.quote: I need a single-file web page built that functions as a strict, up-to-the-minute news timeline tracker for our industry updates.
test_cases: Load the timeline and inspect multiple updates across its displayed date range; verify every inspected update has a date, category, and specific non-placeholder freight or logistics headline, that month or year grouping labels agree with their entries where used, and that parsed dates follow one consistent declared newest-first or oldest-first order.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can narrow the timeline by an offered category or by text contained in headline strings, and the resulting visible rows exactly match the selected category or current search query.
outcomes.quote:
Since it's a rapidly updating timeline, the filtering has to be snappy and stateful. When a user clicks a category tag like "Port Delays", the irrelevant rows shouldn't just vanish instantly; I want the grid boxes to slide shut smoothly, with the remaining headlines snapping up to fill the empty gaps in the grid.

The text search bar needs to work in real-time as they type, instantly highlighting the matching words within the headlines and filtering out the rest.
test_cases: In a fresh page session, record the baseline rows and their displayed category tags, then activate each offered category filter in turn and verify the visible rows exactly equal the baseline rows carrying that category, with no row from another category remaining.

In a fresh page session, choose an exact headline substring that occurs in at least one but not all baseline headlines and type it one character at a time; after every keystroke, verify without submitting that the visible rows exactly equal the baseline rows whose headline contains the current typed string under the page's declared matching rules.

In a fresh page session, enter a string absent from every baseline headline and verify that no timeline row remains; clear the input through normal editing controls and verify that the original baseline rows return.

core_scope.purpose: Enable clients and dispatchers to quickly read relevant freight and logistics updates, narrow them to the issue of interest, and immediately access the dispatch phone number and warehouse address when assistance is needed.
review_notes: Reduced the contact outcome to the non-substitutable communication result: readable phone and address information plus a working dial target. Massive sizing, centering, fixed positioning, and viewport persistence remain supplementary layout or prominence requirements.

Kept substantive logistics timeline information as core. Items 20 and 21 are mixed because they combine necessary timeline content or multiplicity with stricter incidental constraints such as allowing no extra body text or requiring enough length to force scrolling.
Collapsed category and text filtering into one user outcome—finding relevant updates—while retaining independent end-to-end scenarios for the two distinct input paths.

Smooth collapsing, gap-closing animation, match highlighting, sticky controls or date labels, and active-button styling were not made core gates because they affect presentation and interaction polish rather than the correctness of the filtered result.

The single-file implementation, absence of reloads, generic DOM mutation, mobile stacking, visual theme, borders, typography, contrast styling, and resilience probes remain scored supplementary requirements rather than separate business outcomes.
Generic item int_1 was not mapped to filtering correctness because an unspecified DOM change cannot establish that the visible result set matches a category or headline query.

ambiguities: The word "stateful" does not specify persistent filters, saved state, or restoration after reload. The explicitly requested hover-driven tooltip and API-code state is therefore sufficient for core scope; checklist item 30's additional filter controls remain supplementary.

"live API query syntax" could be read as either dynamically generated query text or an actual live API transaction. The sentence specifically requests code blocks showing syntax, and the deliverable must remain feasible offline, so no backend call is treated as required.

"The charts" suggests that each user-facing data chart should support the interaction, but it is unclear whether tiny decorative sparklines are intended to count as charts. The core test applies to visualizations the page presents as inspectable data charts, not purely decorative marks.

No authoritative dataset or API schema is supplied. Numeric units and query correspondence must therefore be checked against the metric names, labels, parameters, and selection rules declared by the page rather than against invented external values.

outcomes.endpoint: The main dashboard presents intelligible energy-usage summary metrics with meaningful metric names, parseable numerical values, and units or other context appropriate to each value.
outcomes.quote: energy usage dashboard for our public data portal, structured for rapid metric retrieval.
test_cases: Using the dashboard's visible labels and declared data context, inspect the complete summary-metric area and verify that it is about energy usage, that each displayed summary metric has a meaningful name and parseable numeric value, and that energy, power, percentage, emissions, and count values use compatible units or otherwise clearly state their data context.

outcomes.endpoint: Every visualization presented as a data chart expresses an intelligible energy metric over time or category, and hovering its data points shows point-specific values while updating an adjacent code block with recognizable API query syntax semantically corresponding to the hovered point and any currently exposed selection state. Displaying the query is sufficient; no real network request or deployment API is required.
outcomes.quote: The charts require interactive hover tooltips that dynamically update adjacent code blocks showing the live API query syntax.
test_cases: For every visualization the page presents as a data chart, choose two points with different declared time or category labels. Hover the first point and verify that its tooltip contains that point's label and numeric value with an appropriate unit, while the chart's adjacent code block contains a recognizable endpoint or structured query whose metric, time/category, region or energy type, and any currently exposed filter state agree with the tooltip and chart context. Then hover the second point and verify that both the tooltip and the same adjacent code block update, with the point-dependent query parameter changing to correspond to the second point rather than remaining fixed.

core_scope.purpose: Provide public-portal users with a stateful energy-usage dashboard for rapidly understanding key metrics and inspecting chart points together with the corresponding dynamically generated API query syntax.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposed dashboard-content checks into one complete metric-retrieval outcome and incorporated chart existence and intelligibility into the end-to-end chart interaction flow.
Removed the separate state-control outcome because time-range, region, and energy-type controls are examples introduced by checklist item 30 rather than controls explicitly required by the request.

Multi-level navigation, mixed-size grid arrangement, and the narrow alert sidebar are requested supporting structure and content, but they are not non-substitutable endpoints for the primary goals of retrieving energy metrics and inspecting chart-derived API queries; their checks remain supplementary.
Color sourcing, typography, flat component styling, wireframe tags, overflow handling, self-containment, and general runtime robustness remain supplementary rather than core outcome gates.
Retained the every-chart coverage of item 35 because the request uses the general plural "The charts require," while limiting the endpoint to actual user-facing data charts.

Replaced separate open/find/click or hover/observe steps with self-contained scenarios that verify meaningful metric semantics, exact tooltip content, recognizable query syntax, semantic parameter correspondence, and a point-dependent change across two hovered data points.

ambiguities: The request does not specify destination URLs or actual subforum pages. A corresponding local destination or explicit in-page placeholder is therefore sufficient; no backend or real forum transaction should be inferred.
「先点到这几个核心版块即可」 is treated as requiring the three named sections, not as an unambiguous prohibition on every additional section.
The three announcement blocks are requested structurally, but their actual announcement subjects are not specified, so no particular announcement message can be made a core information gate.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly identifies itself as the 「北纬三十」 forum lobby and provides an intelligible, usable directory containing the three requested sections with their correct purposes and corresponding section-entry behavior.
outcomes.quote:
具体展示上，先点到这几个核心版块即可：
- 「寻路者笔记」：专门沉淀长篇的自驾游记和硬核路线攻略。
- 「装备折腾局」：大家买的各类户外装备开箱和二手回血都在这里。
- 「闲聊篝火」：完全不设限的日常水区，想到啥发啥。
test_cases: Starting from a fresh page load, confirm that the visible title or surrounding context identifies 「北纬三十」 and makes clear that this is a community/forum section lobby; then locate all three requested entries and verify their exact names and that their descriptions respectively convey long-form self-driving travel and route guides, outdoor-equipment unboxing and second-hand trading, and unrestricted daily chat.

Using normal page controls, activate each of the three section entries in turn, returning to or reloading the lobby between attempts if needed; verify that each activation produces a corresponding local destination or clear in-page placeholder identifying the selected section, rather than an unrelated, duplicate, or dead result.

core_scope.purpose: Provide a clear, usable forum section directory for the 「北纬三十」 community so visitors can understand and access the three requested core sections.
review_notes: Collapsed lobby identity, requested section information, and usable directory navigation into one end-to-end core outcome because they jointly serve the page's primary purpose.

Removed the announcement-block presentation, image areas, hover activity charts, suggestion form and validation, prescribed layout, responsive behavior, styling, performance, and packaging checks from core membership. They remain scored supplementary requirements but are substitutable enhancements or incidental functions rather than the main directory endpoint.
Items 32 and 33 are mixed because they assess the topical correctness of core directory copy while also covering supplementary announcements and other whole-page content.
Replaced separate presence, hover, and click-style probes with scenarios that verify the final informational and navigation results.

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「B」份「黑底亮绿强调色的峰会页」：极高对比度的暗黑主题，采用纯黑背景，搭配白色文字，并使用高亮荧光绿色（#1DB954左右）作为唯一的强调色（按钮、倒计时、高亮边框）。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「黑底亮绿强调色的峰会页」那一份基本一致（极高对比度的暗黑主题，采用纯黑背景，搭配白色文字，并使用高亮荧光绿色（#1DB954左右）作为唯一的强调色（按钮、倒计时、高亮边框）。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「配色」；错误来源「A」份「带大粉红横幅的深色页」在这一面是：深灰黑色底色，主要搭配浅色文字，局部使用高饱和度的大面积亮粉红色作为强对比色块（如图4）。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带大粉红横幅的深色页」那一份（深灰黑色底色，主要搭配浅色文字，局部使用高饱和度的大面积亮粉红色作为强对比色块（如图4）。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「配色」；错误来源「C」份「带蓝紫渐变头的中文页」在这一面是：典型的明亮主题，以大面积留白和浅灰蓝背景为主，强调整体使用深蓝色至紫色的平滑渐变（主视觉底色、卡片装饰线）。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带蓝紫渐变头的中文页」那一份（典型的明亮主题，以大面积留白和浅灰蓝背景为主，强调整体使用深蓝色至紫色的平滑渐变（主视觉底色、卡片装饰线）。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「A」份「带大粉红横幅的深色页」：使用英文无衬线体，核心特征是极度偏好细字重（Thin/Light），包括大标题在内都显得纤细空灵，字距较疏。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「A」25px vs 「B」16px；最大标题字号：「A」50px vs 「B」136px；字号档数：「A」6档 vs 「B」10档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带大粉红横幅的深色页」那一份基本一致（使用英文无衬线体，核心特征是极度偏好细字重（Thin/Light），包括大标题在内都显得纤细空灵，字距较疏。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「黑底亮绿强调色的峰会页」在这一面是：使用英文无衬线体，主标题使用了极具分量感的超粗字重（Black/Heavy），与正常字重的正文形成极其暴力的粗细层级反差。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「黑底亮绿强调色的峰会页」那一份（使用英文无衬线体，主标题使用了极具分量感的超粗字重（Black/Heavy），与正常字重的正文形成极其暴力的粗细层级反差。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「带蓝紫渐变头的中文页」在这一面是：使用中文无衬线体，各级标题和正文维持了常规的中规中矩的字重对比，排版平稳，没有极端的粗细倾向。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 16px、最大标题字号 136px、字号档数 10档、字族 times、字重档数 6档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带蓝紫渐变头的中文页」那一份（使用中文无衬线体，各级标题和正文维持了常规的中规中矩的字重对比，排版平稳，没有极端的粗细倾向。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（nav_left_rail）。判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：导航我要竖着放在左边，不要横在上面（判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度）？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「带蓝紫渐变头的中文页」那样：大量使用白色圆角卡片来承载内容模块，带有轻微投影，最显著的特征是每个卡片顶部都带有一条贯穿的蓝紫色渐变细条作为装饰边界（如图10-12）。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「C」份的程序指纹：最大圆角 24px、圆角档数 4档、阴影档数 2档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「带蓝紫渐变头的中文页」那一份（大量使用白色圆角卡片来承载内容模块，带有轻微投影，最显著的特征是每个卡片顶部都带有一条贯穿的蓝紫色渐变细条作为装饰边界（如图10-12）。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'倒腾一个同城的技能交换公告板，主要是给咱们附近的小微企业主和个体户用的，大家互通有无'

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求匹配时进行平滑状态切换、两张卡片吸附到一起，并弹出闪烁的绿色通话按钮。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'页脚记得把底下那些公司基本信息、营业执照和备案号写得一清二楚'

keypoints.basis: 作答要求只借设计语言，不得复用参考截图中的文字、条目与行业内容

keypoints.basis: 作答要求只借设计语言，不得复用参考截图里的条目与行业内容
keypoints.question: 页面是否没有出现与技能交换无关、明显来自参考截图的板块内容（如会议日程表、演讲嘉宾头像墙、门票价格档位、课程模块与论文资源列表、Lorem ipsum 拉丁占位文案）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含的单文件（样式与脚本内联，未引用任何外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [行业惯例] 指令要求'这板子的操作逻辑得像 itch.io 那么顺手，找服务或者发布需求都干脆利落'
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供搜索框或技能分类筛选入口，方便用户快速找到某类服务？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求地图密集展示手艺人的位置和状态，并要求点开任何人后进入突出核心联系信息的视图。
keypoints.question: 点击地图上的任意手艺人标记后，是否能打开被点击者对应的全屏或近全屏个人详情视图，而不是无响应或显示成其他人物？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确表示客人应最快找到电话和地址，并要求点开任何人后第一眼就在核心位置看到联系电话。
keypoints.question: 打开个人详情后，联系电话是否作为首屏核心信息清晰、醒目地显示，使用户无需继续查找即可获取号码？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“这个地址点一下就能直接跳转手机里的导航软件”；现有条目只检查可点击和提示文案，未验证真实导航目标。
keypoints.question: 点击实体店面地址后，是否确实触发有效的地图或导航深链（如 geo 链接或带目的地的地图链接），并把该店地址作为导航目的地，而不是只有按钮外观或无效跳转？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求展示“微信二维码”；现有条目只验证视觉上像二维码，仍可能让不可扫描的装饰图案通过。
keypoints.question: 详情中的微信二维码是否为能够被二维码解码器识别的有效二维码，并承载对应联系人的微信联系信息，而非仅用于模拟二维码外观的随机点阵？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“找服务或者发布需求都干脆利落，一气呵成”，且大厅分为“我能提供”和“我需要”；仅展示表单与提交按钮不足以证明流程闭环。
keypoints.question: 发布流程是否允许用户明确选择发布类型为「我能提供」或「我需要」，且提交后新条目会出现在对应的信息流分类中并给出清晰的成功反馈？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求找服务的操作“干脆利落，一气呵成”；现有条目只检查搜索或筛选入口是否存在，未检查其实际工作。
keypoints.question: 使用搜索框或技能分类筛选后，地图标记和信息流结果是否会按输入的技能或类别实际更新，并能清除条件恢复完整结果？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“平滑的状态切换动画”“两张卡片啪的一下吸附到一起”以及“弹出一个闪烁的绿色通话按钮”；现有条目未检查平滑过渡和按钮闪烁。
keypoints.question: 触发技能匹配时，两张卡片是否通过可见且平滑的位移动画吸附到一起，并且随后出现的绿色通话按钮具有持续可辨识的闪烁或脉冲反馈，而非瞬间静态换位？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把 palette 指给了「B」份
keypoints.question: 整体配色是否取自第「B」份参考，而不是别的份？

ambiguities: “密密麻麻”没有给出最低点位数量，因此核心测试只要求地图具有足以形成可用本地看板的多个真实条目，不设任意数量阈值。
“像 itch.io 那么顺手”和“干脆利落”没有声明特定搜索、筛选或导航机制；搜索框和联动筛选可以提升体验，但不能据此成为唯一核心实现。
请求明确说到“发布需求”，但没有同样明确要求用户必须能够发布“我能提供”的服务；因此需求发布是核心，而同时支持两种发布类型的检查项属于混合项。
微信二维码应当可解码并对应联系人，但请求没有规定其必须编码微信号、个人名片 URL 还是其他微信联系载荷，也不要求离线页面实际连接微信服务器。
在桌面或离线测试环境中无法保证手机导航应用真正启动；可验证的核心终点是点击后确实发起有效地图或导航 URI，并携带正确目的地。
绿色水波纹和技能匹配吸附动画的触发方式未定义；这些是补充动效要求，不据此增加核心业务流程。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够通过本地手艺人地图和可切换的供需信息流浏览技能交换信息；地图点位提供可辨识的人员状态，信息流条目明确给出供需类型、技能或服务以及发布者身份。
outcomes.quote: 网站进去一开始得是个大地图看板，上面密密麻麻标着各种手艺人的位置和状态。这板子的操作逻辑得像 itch.io 那么顺手，找服务或者发布需求都干脆利落，一气呵成。地图下面是个能随时切换状态的信息流大厅，分“我能提供”和“我需要”两拨。
test_cases: 全新加载页面后，使用地图选择两个状态标识不同的手艺人；确认地图提供多个可区分的位置点，每个所选点都有可理解的状态信息，且状态含义与页面自己的图例或详情说明一致，不对“密密麻麻”设置任意固定数量门槛。
在“我能提供”信息流中记录至少一个条目的发布者和技能，切换到“我需要”并确认列表实际变为明确标注需求、包含发布者和技能的不同条目，再切回并确认原提供条目恢复；不把动画速度或过渡样式作为核心通过条件。

outcomes.endpoint: 从人员条目或地图点位进入对应人员详情后，用户能够取得其联系电话、有效的微信联系二维码和实体店地址；点击该地址会实际发起包含该目的地的地图或导航链接。
outcomes.quote: 点开任何人，第一眼必须是铺满屏幕的核心位置显示联系电话、微信二维码和实体店面地址，而且这个地址点一下就能直接跳转手机里的导航软件。
test_cases: 从信息流选择一名身份明确的发布者，确认打开的是同一人的详情，并能读取联系电话、实体店地址和微信二维码；对二维码图像进行离线解码，确认其承载该联系人的微信联系信息，而不是随机点阵或空白占位。
从地图选择另一名手艺人的点位，记录详情中显示的实体店地址后点击导航入口；确认浏览器实际尝试打开有效的 geo 或地图 URI，且其中的地址或坐标与该详情声明的目的地一致。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够填写所需技能或服务以及相关联系方式和位置，提交一条“我需要”需求，并在对应信息流中看到准确的新条目。
outcomes.quote: 找服务或者发布需求都干脆利落，一气呵成。
test_cases: 从全新页面状态进入发布流程，选择“我需要”，填写唯一的需求名称、联系方式和位置并提交；随后切换到“我需要”信息流，确认新条目准确显示刚才填写的发布类型、需求、联系方式和位置，并且没有被错误加入“我能提供”分类。

core_scope.purpose: 为附近的小微企业主和个体户提供同城技能交换公告板，使用户能够浏览本地服务供需，快速取得发布者的电话、微信二维码和实体地址并从该地址发起导航，同时能够发布一条服务需求。
review_notes: 将地图与供需信息流合并为一个本地技能发现结果，避免把加载页面、找到标签和点击标签拆成多个琐碎核心测试。
联系电话、微信二维码、实体地址和有效导航目的地直接服务于请求所称的首要目标，因此保留为独立核心结果。
发布核心范围收窄为请求明确提到的“发布需求”，没有把发布服务这一扩展能力擅自设为独立硬门槛。
地图大小、首屏位置、信息流位于地图下方、左侧竖向导航、无滚动可见性及全屏详情均涉及布局或视口呈现；与业务终点混在同一检查项时归入 mixed_item_ids，纯布局项保留为补充要求。
信息流实际切换属于核心，但检查项同时要求平滑更新；因此相关项目归为混合项，而动画平滑度本身不作为核心结果。
颜色、字体、卡片造型、悬停或匹配动画、页脚资质信息、长文本适配、自包含实现和无异常运行仍可评分，但移除它们不会破坏技能发现、取得联系方式或发布需求的主要用户目标。
二维码外观检查本身不能证明二维码有效，因此外观项保留为补充要求，能够解码且承载对应联系信息的检查映射到核心结果。

keypoints.question: 页面主体是否清晰组织了个人简介、专长项目、过往案例和预约这四个核心内容主题，并同时呈现题面另行要求的服务流程步骤和可折叠常见问答？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'电话和具体地址最好一进门就能显眼地看见'
keypoints.question: 首屏（无需滚动、无需点击展开）是否同时直接显示出具体的电话号码文字和具体的地址文字？

keypoints.basis: 指令称'做了小二十年社区维修的老个体户'，并要求'个人简介交代底细'
keypoints.question: 个人简介板块的文案里是否写明了约二十年的社区维修从业年限或相当表述？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'最上面一屏左边放我的大标题介绍'
keypoints.question: 首屏大标题是否是一句介绍本人身份（含姓名或"维修/师傅"这类身份说明）的个人化主标题，而不是与本人无关的通用模板标语？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求设置“过往案例”来展示手艺，因此应包含多个具有实质说明的案例，但未指定必须达到三个。

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求首屏右侧并排放置联系表单；表单应能收集访客的回联方式和联系需求并提供提交入口。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“一列可以点开折叠的常见问答”，但没有指定所有问答的初始展开状态。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求顶部设置常驻导航，并明确页面包含个人简介、专长项目、过往案例和预约四个主要内容板块。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'顶上要有一直挂着的导航'
keypoints.question: 向下滚动到页面中部或底部后，顶部导航栏是否仍然固定停留在视口顶部可见？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求导航'用手机点开也能缩放适配好'

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借鉴参考页面的设计语言（布局/配色/排版/组件），内容须围绕本人的维修简历

keypoints.basis: 指令仅要求对标深色数据大屏的"颜色"，其数据监测内容不应出现在个人简历页中

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联且不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“用手机点开也能缩放适配好”；现有条目只检查了移动端导航，没有覆盖其余页面内容的响应式表现。

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确依次提出“个人简介交代底细、专长项目列清能干啥、过往案例亮亮手艺，最后加上个预约版块”；现有条目检查了四块是否存在，但未检查顺序及预约是否收尾。
keypoints.question: 页面四个主要内容板块是否按个人简介、专长项目、过往案例、预约的叙事顺序组织，并确保预约是最后一个主要板块？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“键盘按着也能顺畅游走”；现有条目仅检查可聚焦及焦点指示，尚未验证键盘能否执行菜单展开、FAQ 折叠和按钮提交等操作。

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求满足基本无障碍；可用表单除键盘聚焦外，还需让字段用途、必填状态及错误归属可被用户和辅助技术识别。
keypoints.question: 联系表单和预约表单中的每个输入控件是否都有清晰可见或程序可识别的字段名称，且必填状态与校验错误能明确对应到具体字段？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求首屏联系表单和可直接操作的预约板块；现有条目只检查空字段提交时的错误反馈，未检查有效提交后的结果反馈。
keypoints.question: 在联系或预约表单填写有效内容并提交后，页面是否给出明确可见的成功确认或下一步说明，而不是刷新、静默失效或仍停留在无反馈状态？

keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

ambiguities: “最好一进门就能显眼地看见” makes initial-viewport prominence a preference. Concrete phone and address content remains central to the electronic-card purpose, but exact above-the-fold fit should not be a standalone core gate.

No real name, phone number, address, service inventory, or case history was supplied. Tests can establish that the page contains concrete, contextually plausible values and substantive copy, but cannot establish their real-world truth.

No submission recipient or backend was specified. A valid offline form endpoint is visible validation followed by a local acknowledgment or next-step instruction, not proof that a real appointment or message was transmitted.

“基本无障碍” does not name a complete accessibility standard. The 4.5:1 body-text threshold and keyboard scenarios are retained as measurable interpretations of the specifically requested contrast and keyboard usability.

outcomes.endpoint: The electronic business card provides a concrete telephone number and concrete address that visitors can readily identify as this repairer's contact details. Their exact above-the-fold placement is a supplementary layout preference rather than the core endpoint.
outcomes.missing_check: Only mixed checklist items are mapped; a standalone endpoint assessment is required.
outcomes.quote: 电话和具体地址最好一进门就能显眼地看见
test_cases: Starting from the top of the page and using ordinary reading or scrolling, locate the repairer's contact information and verify that both a concrete phone value and a concrete address value are intelligibly presented, rather than empty labels or generic placeholders.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly presents an individual community repairer rather than a company or reference-template brand, with a personalized identity and introduction that communicates roughly twenty years of relevant experience.
outcomes.quote: 我是个在咱们这片做了小二十年社区维修的老个体户，最近想自己弄个在线简历网页，当是给街坊邻里发电子名片
test_cases: Read the main heading and personal introduction together and verify that they identify an individual repairer or master, describe approximately twenty years of community repair experience, and do not read like an anonymous company template.

Continue through the full page and verify that its substantive content remains about this repairer, without copied reference-brand text, dashboard metrics, Lorem ipsum, or other unrelated modules that obscure the personal résumé.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can understand the concrete repair services offered and assess the repairer's experience through multiple substantive past-case entries.
outcomes.quote: 专长项目列清能干啥、过往案例亮亮手艺
test_cases: Read the Specialties and Past Cases content in sequence; verify that Specialties contains multiple distinct, concrete repair services and that multiple cases each have an identifiable title plus a meaningful description of the problem, work performed, or result, rather than placeholders or title-only cards.

outcomes.endpoint: A visitor has a direct contact or appointment path: the requested contact form collects a callback method and request/message, and the booking section exposes at least one clear actionable route. Forms use understandable field names, reject data that violates their declared rules with field-specific feedback, and provide a visible local confirmation or next-step message after valid submission; no real backend delivery is required.
outcomes.quote: 最后加上个预约版块，讲究个实在直接
test_cases: Using the contact form, leave fields marked as required empty or otherwise violate a displayed input rule, submit once, and verify that visible feedback identifies the affected fields without showing a false success state.

Fill the contact form with values satisfying all displayed rules, submit it, and verify a clear success acknowledgment or next-step instruction; then continue to the booking section and exercise one offered route, confirming that it reaches the stated form, booking action, or concrete telephone contact rather than doing nothing.

outcomes.endpoint: Essential information has sufficient readable contrast, and visitors can use the page's interactive controls with the keyboard while retaining a visible indication of focus.
outcomes.quote: 做的时候稍微留意下满足基本无障碍，屏幕对比度得够，键盘按着也能顺畅游走
test_cases: Without using a pointer, use Tab and Shift+Tab to traverse the navigation, contact-form controls, FAQ controls, and booking action; verify visible focus throughout, activate applicable controls with Enter or Space, and complete the contact-form flow through its visible result.
Using rendered foreground and background colors, calculate WCAG contrast for representative normal-size body text, form labels, and other essential reading text, and verify a ratio of at least 4.5:1.

core_scope.purpose: Enable neighbors to understand who the individual community repairer is, what services and experience he offers, and how to contact or book him, while remaining usable for older customers needing basic visual and keyboard accessibility.
review_notes: Separated the indispensable résumé information into personal profile, concrete capabilities/work evidence, contact details, and one collapsed contact/booking flow.

Removed visual-reference matching, exact section arrangement, fixed navigation, mobile reflow, viewport fit, typography, palette, component styling, and implementation packaging from core membership because they affect presentation rather than the page's primary informational and contact endpoints.

Service-process and FAQ content and behavior remain supplementary: they are explicitly requested and should still be scored, but removing them would not by itself eliminate the personal résumé/electronic-card purpose.

Checklist 18 is mixed because it combines the four core résumé themes with supplementary process and FAQ requirements. Checklist 19 is mixed because it combines required contact content with preferred initial-viewport placement.

Checklist 24 is mixed because it combines the substantive contact-form fields with hero-side placement. Checklist 43 is mixed because clear labels and field-specific errors support the core form, while its wording can be read as assuming a separate booking form that the request does not require.

Keyboard checklist items 35 and 42 are mixed because they cover essential form access together with supplementary navigation, FAQ, and mobile-menu controls. Basic contrast and keyboard usability remain core due to the expressly identified older customers.

items.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「深色数据监测大屏」那一份基本一致（典型的暗夜模式，深蓝色和深灰黑色背景，搭配青绿、亮蓝、橙红等高亮发光色用于图表数据。）？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「D」份「带定价大卡片那个」：主体视觉为三列等宽但高度突出的巨型卡片横排居中展示，下方接续两列并排的小卡片。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「D」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「D」32.5px vs 「A」64px；整页高度：「D」8871px vs 「A」4179px。产出应落在「D」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「带定价大卡片那个」那一份神似（主体视觉为三列等宽但高度突出的巨型卡片横排居中展示，下方接续两列并排的小卡片。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「深色渐变首屏那个」在这一面是：整体结构包括全屏居中首屏、两行两列四宫格区块以及全宽纯色横幅堆叠。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「深色渐变首屏那个」那一份（整体结构包括全屏居中首屏、两行两列四宫格区块以及全宽纯色横幅堆叠。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「B」份「带人物大图那个」在这一面是：偏重单列阅读排版，主要元素为左对齐的大标题直接下接占满内容宽度的单张大图。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带人物大图那个」那一份（偏重单列阅读排版，主要元素为左对齐的大标题直接下接占满内容宽度的单张大图。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「有不规则切图那个」在这一面是：首屏为左文右图不对称双栏结构，下方主要包含等宽的三栏图标或图文卡片并排排布。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 64px、元素密度 42.1个/千像素高、整页高度 4179px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「有不规则切图那个」那一份（首屏为左文右图不对称双栏结构，下方主要包含等宽的三栏图标或图文卡片并排排布。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「B」份「带人物大图那个」：使用常规现代无衬线字形，但标题字号庞大、字重加粗且多居左，与细小的正文形成强烈的粗细与大小层级反差。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「B」15px vs 「A」21.3px；最大标题字号：「B」50px vs 「A」74.5px；字族：「B」hanskendrick/open/themify vs 「A」source/times。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带人物大图那个」那一份基本一致（使用常规现代无衬线字形，但标题字号庞大、字重加粗且多居左，与细小的正文形成强烈的粗细与大小层级反差。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「深色渐变首屏那个」在这一面是：采用极细的无衬线字形，整体字重非常轻，呈现出纤弱轻量感，各级层级大小反差小。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「深色渐变首屏那个」那一份（采用极细的无衬线字形，整体字重非常轻，呈现出纤弱轻量感，各级层级大小反差小。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「有不规则切图那个」在这一面是：中庸的无衬线字形排版，标题字号和粗细均较为节制，正文字色偏浅灰，整体无夸张字形对比。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「有不规则切图那个」那一份（中庸的无衬线字形排版，标题字号和粗细均较为节制，正文字色偏浅灰，整体无夸张字形对比。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「带定价大卡片那个」在这一面是：除使用特大号字体的数字价格外，其余文本均为中规中矩的无衬线字，层级对比属于常规水平。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 21.3px、最大标题字号 74.5px、字号档数 7档、字族 source/times、字重档数 2档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带定价大卡片那个」那一份（除使用特大号字体的数字价格外，其余文本均为中规中矩的无衬线字，层级对比属于常规水平。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（ground_dark）。判法：渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：整页底色我要深的，字浮在深底上（判法：渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35）？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「深色渐变首屏那个」那样：按钮为带浅色细线描边的透明或白底矩形，图标背景为没有阴影的纯色正圆形，整体风格极简平面。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「深色渐变首屏那个」那一份（按钮为带浅色细线描边的透明或白底矩形，图标背景为没有阴影的纯色正圆形，整体风格极简平面。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「有不规则切图那个」那样：按钮为高饱和绿色的全圆角胶囊状实心填充，图标的浅色圆形背景板带有明显的错位偏移叠加设计。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「A」份的程序指纹：最大圆角 6px、圆角档数 4档、阴影档数 3档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「有不规则切图那个」那一份（按钮为高饱和绿色的全圆角胶囊状实心填充，图标的浅色圆形背景板带有明显的错位偏移叠加设计。）？跟成了即为不通过。

ambiguities: The phrase “比如” introduces Total Spend, Impressions, and CPA as examples, although the detailed English labels and checklist treat them as the expected KPI set; equivalent daily advertising KPIs may be acceptable if the request is interpreted illustratively.
The request includes both a selectable statistics period and metrics described as today’s data, but it does not state whether selecting a range must recalculate every dashboard value.
The quick-bid area is explicitly for pretending to tune parameters during a presentation; no backend transaction, persistence across reloads, or exact confirmation format is specified.
Phone adaptation is explicitly deferred, so the 390px reflow requirement conflicts with the requested scope; 768px and long-string resilience remain supplementary robustness checks.

outcomes.endpoint: The visible page is clearly an advertising monitoring dashboard, and all user-facing dashboard copy is intelligible English with no Chinese UI text.
outcomes.quote: 面向海外英语用户的广告投放看板
test_cases: Load the dashboard and review all visible headings, labels, campaign information, metric labels, control labels, and feedback messages; verify that the subject is advertising monitoring and that the user-facing copy is English without Chinese remnants.

outcomes.endpoint: The campaign area communicates the currently active campaigns, with an English name, a meaningful budget-consumption indicator, and a Running status for each listed campaign.
outcomes.quote: 左边第一个用来列表展示当前 Active 的广告计划（Campaign），要显示英文名、预算消耗进度条和绿色的 Running 状态标
test_cases: Review every campaign entry in the active-campaign area and verify that each has a nonempty English name, a Running status, and a quantitative budget-progress representation; where both a numeric percentage or spent/limit value and a fill are shown, verify that the fill is reasonably consistent with the displayed value.

outcomes.endpoint: A recognizable world-map visualization with geographically distributed click markers makes global incoming traffic understandable; a real external live-data service is not required.
outcomes.quote: 中间那个巨型卡片放一张全球实时流量地图，就类似 FlightRadar24 追踪全世界飞机那种感觉，要在地图上不断有小光点亮起代表各个国家实时进来的点击，主要是借用它那种直观监控动态的逻辑，长得像个极客风的监控图表就行。
test_cases: Load the dashboard and verify that the traffic area contains recognizable world geography and multiple markers distributed across different regions, with its title, legend, or surrounding context making clear that the markers represent incoming clicks rather than unrelated decoration.

outcomes.endpoint: The KPI area presents intelligible daily advertising figures for Total Spend, Impressions, and CPA, with values formatted according to their meanings and an explicit current-day time context.
outcomes.quote: 右边第三个大卡片用来堆叠当天的核心数据指标，比如总花费（Total Spend）、总曝光量（Impressions）和单次点击转化成本（CPA），超大号的数字底下衬着半透明的迷你折线图。
test_cases: Review the KPI area on initial load and verify that Total Spend, Impressions, and CPA each have a nonempty parseable value; Total Spend and CPA must be recognizable USD amounts, Impressions must be a count or K/M quantity, and the area must identify the figures as Today, the current date, or the currently selected single day.

core_scope.purpose: Provide overseas English-speaking viewers with an intelligible presentation dashboard for monitoring active advertising campaigns, global click activity, and daily advertising KPIs.
review_notes: Removed layout, iPad viewport fit, dark theme, typography, component styling, and responsive behavior from core membership because they are presentation and layout requirements rather than the dashboard’s business outcome.
Removed the fixed navigation, avatar menu, and calendar interaction from core membership because they are supporting controls; the main monitoring information remains usable without them.
Kept campaign status semantics as core, while item 21 is mixed because it combines the core Running status with the supplementary green-color treatment.
Kept global click geography and marker meaning as core. Items 24 and 37 are mixed because they combine that information with flashing or continual animation, which is supplementary motion styling.
The large-number treatment, translucent sparklines, and related chart styling in items 26 and 41 are supplementary; the core KPI endpoint is the intelligible daily values and their correct formats.

The banner gallery, enlargement modal, and quick-bid form are secondary demonstration features rather than non-substitutable monitoring goals. The bid form is also described as a mock presentation interaction, so it is not treated as a real deployment or financial transaction.
Single-file packaging, external-resource restrictions, JavaScript cleanliness, and stress-layout checks remain supplementary implementation-quality requirements.

test_cases: Using the normally rendered page, verify that a visitor can identify it as a hair-salon booking experience and find at least two specifically named hair services, whether presented in the content area or as understandable form choices.

outcomes.endpoint: A visitor can enter valid appointment details under the form's declared rules and receive a clear booking confirmation state, while an incomplete required submission is rejected with meaningful validation.
outcomes.quote: 带导航和表单的美发预约网页
test_cases: Starting from a fresh page state, enter valid values in every field the form declares required, using its displayed formats or options, submit through normal controls, and verify that a clear appointment-success or confirmation message appears rather than only a cosmetic control change.

Starting from a fresh page state, leave required appointment information blank and submit; verify that no success confirmation is shown and that browser or in-page validation identifies the missing required input.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a visitor to understand the hair services offered and complete a mock salon appointment through a usable form; no real booking backend is required.
review_notes: Collapsed the primary experience into two non-substitutable user goals: understanding the available hair services and completing the appointment flow.

Theme switching, responsiveness, fixed two-column composition, navigation mechanics, visual references, component styling, viewport fit, packaging, and generic runtime robustness remain supplementary even where the request emphasizes them; removing them would not eliminate the visitor's ability to understand services and make the mock appointment.
Item 24 is mixed because it checks core content and form legibility, but only within the supplementary theme-switching presentation requirement.

Items 14–16, 25, and 29 describe form controls, a particular field set, labeling, or input implementation rather than independently proving the completed booking endpoint. The end-to-end success and invalid-submission checks are provided by items 26 and 17.
The core submission endpoint requires visible offline confirmation and validation states, not a real reservation backend. Generic DOM-change item int_1 is insufficient to establish either state.

ambiguities: 趋势图说明同时要求“放一个折线图”并表示“这里先占好 DOM 结构”，因此实际非空数据序列是否为本次交付的强制要求并不明确；不应在未澄清时任意规定具体趋势数值。
商品类目和时间维度没有声明筛选后的数据规则；仓库切换联动则出现在“加分项重点”且以“能不能实现”引出，因此不能推断三个筛选器都必须产生特定业务数据结果。
“导出报表”只被明确要求作为次级按钮出现，没有规定文件格式、文件内容或必须下载；检查项 33 的真实文件生成要求超出了已声明的验收细节。
分页器只在键盘可达性描述中被提及，没有声明页大小、总页数或换页数据规则，因此不能把完整分页交易当作核心业务端点。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够一眼读出四项指定的总体库存周转 KPI，以及请求中给出的精确数值和补充说明。
outcomes.quote: 在筛选器下方，横排紧密放置四个数字卡片。这里是我们突出数字的地方。
test_cases: 加载默认状态的看板后，一次性核对四项 KPI：综合周转天数为 42.5 天并显示“较上周期下降 1.2 天”；库存资金占用为 ¥ 14,520,300 并显示“其中呆滞资金 ¥120,000”；低周转 SKU 数为 145；整体动销率为 89.3%，且四项信息分别清晰呈现。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够在可见的趋势区域中识别“近 30 天整体周转趋势”，并理解横轴表示日期、纵轴表示周转率百分比。
outcomes.missing_check: 现有检查只验证标题、坐标含义和可承载图表的区域，没有验证是否存在非空且可辨识的折线或数据序列；若请求中的“放一个折线图”被理解为需要实际趋势数据，则该端点尚未被完整覆盖。
outcomes.quote: X 轴是日期（如 10-01 至 10-30），Y 轴是周转率百分比。标题写“近 30 天整体周转趋势”。
test_cases: 加载默认状态的看板后，检查趋势区域具有可见且非零尺寸的绘图区，标题为“近 30 天整体周转趋势”，横轴呈现近 30 天日期刻度，纵轴明确使用百分比表达周转率。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够通过有实际内容的 SKU 明细表查看每个商品的库存流转字段和状态评估，并据此区分健康与低周转或积压商品。
outcomes.missing_check: 没有检查要求表格中实际出现至少一个可辨识的低周转或积压商品，也没有检查状态与周转信息是否足以支持这种区分；仅要求状态文案非空及示例行显示“健康”，不足以证明页面实现了识别积压商品的核心目的。
outcomes.quote: 这个页面的核心价值在于帮助库管和财务人员一眼看出哪些货卖得好、哪些货积压了。
test_cases: 加载默认状态的看板后，核对明细表从左到右具有指定的 9 个表头，至少显示 10 行数据，并确认每行的 9 个单元格均有可读内容。
在同一明细表中定位 SKU A902-11，核对商品名称为“智能温控水杯-曜石黑”、当前结存为 4,210、周转天数为 12，状态评估为“健康”。
依据页面自身声明的状态含义或分类规则检查数据集，确认用户至少能够从状态评估和周转信息中分别识别健康商品与低周转或积压商品。

core_scope.purpose: 让库管和财务人员通过总体周转指标、近 30 天趋势和 SKU 明细状态理解库存周转情况，并识别畅销与积压商品。
review_notes: 将原方案的七个核心组收敛为三个不可替代的信息目标：总体 KPI、时间趋势和 SKU 级诊断；这些内容直接支持库存周转监控与识别积压商品的主要用途。
筛选控件、重置、导出、排序、吸顶、分页和仓库联动均保留为补充要求。尤其排序动画、骨架屏和淡入淡出位于“加分项重点”且由“能不能实现”引出，不应成为核心失败门槛。
键盘可达性、对比度、布局、配色、自包含性和健壮性仍是应评分的重要补充质量要求，但不是独立的库存分析业务结果。
检查项 4 同时混合核心数据区块存在性、筛选区和页面呈现类型，检查项 12 混合四项 KPI 内容集合与单行布局，因此归入 mixed_item_ids；检查项 18 混合趋势区域存在性与尺寸布局，也归入 mixed_item_ids。
测试已改为完整场景：每个场景直接核对最终可读的数据或诊断结果，而不是把打开页面、寻找控件和点击动作拆成多个琐碎测试。
