keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「带环形图表的仪表盘」：紧凑的仪表盘布局，页面分为上下两大板块，上方为多个数据指标的卡片式环形图表，下方为横跨页面宽度的趋势折线图。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「B」206.5个/千像素高 vs 「A」57.4个/千像素高；整页高度：「B」1191px vs 「A」10001px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「带环形图表的仪表盘」那一份神似（紧凑的仪表盘布局，页面分为上下两大板块，上方为多个数据指标的卡片式环形图表，下方为横跨页面宽度的趋势折线图。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「带书籍封面的落地页」在这一面是：典型的营销单页滚动长布局，包含左右分栏的图文介绍、三列平铺的特点卡片以及居中对齐的引言区块。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带书籍封面的落地页」那一份（典型的营销单页滚动长布局，包含左右分栏的图文介绍、三列平铺的特点卡片以及居中对齐的引言区块。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「米黄底复古排版长文页」在这一面是：传统的文档式流式布局，内容主体单列居中，通过横穿页面的细线分隔不同段落和多栏表格，图文穿插较少。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 15.5px、元素密度 57.4个/千像素高、整页高度 10001px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「米黄底复古排版长文页」那一份（传统的文档式流式布局，内容主体单列居中，通过横穿页面的细线分隔不同段落和多栏表格，图文穿插较少。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「A」份「带书籍封面的落地页」：标题使用深蓝色大号粗体衬线字，正文使用浅灰色常规无衬线字，字族与颜色反差构成明显的层级划分。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「A」60px vs 「B」40px；字族：「A」lora/open/themify vs 「B」arial/inter/times。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带书籍封面的落地页」那一份基本一致（标题使用深蓝色大号粗体衬线字，正文使用浅灰色常规无衬线字，字族与颜色反差构成明显的层级划分。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「带环形图表的仪表盘」在这一面是：全局使用现代风格的无衬线字体，主要通过加粗和显著放大字号来突出核心数据数值，辅以极小的标签文字。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带环形图表的仪表盘」那一份（全局使用现代风格的无衬线字体，主要通过加粗和显著放大字号来突出核心数据数值，辅以极小的标签文字。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「米黄底复古排版长文页」在这一面是：全局使用传统的中文宋体/明体作为主要字体，字号较小且各层级字号差异不大，呈现出类似传统活字印刷的质感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「米黄底复古排版长文页」那一份（全局使用传统的中文宋体/明体作为主要字体，字号较小且各层级字号差异不大，呈现出类似传统活字印刷的质感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「B」份「带环形图表的仪表盘」：冷静、专业的医疗与科技感，呈现出严谨、数据驱动和客观克制的情绪调性。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「B」206.5个/千像素高 vs 「A」57.4个/千像素高；底色种类数：「B」2种 vs 「A」5种；整页高度：「B」1191px vs 「A」10001px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 把成品和这 3 份参考并排看，成品的整体气场（情绪调性、松紧克制）最接近哪一份？必须挑出一份（不许答「都差不多」）。候选：「带书籍封面的落地页」（现代商业感，明快且带有一定的推销性，情绪偏外向，属于常规的现代营销风格。）；「带环形图表的仪表盘」（冷静、专业的医疗与科技感，呈现出严谨、数据驱动和客观克制的情绪调性。）；「米黄底复古排版长文页」（复古、传统的学术感，安静且极度克制，具有阅读旧书或档案文献的沉淀感。）。答案是「带环形图表的仪表盘」才算通过，挑了别的份即为跟错。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（radius_zero）。判法：按钮/卡片的计算 border-radius 全部 = 0。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：按钮和卡片我要方角，一点圆角都别留（判法：按钮/卡片的计算 border-radius 全部 = 0）？
keypoints.spec_check: 按钮/卡片的计算 border-radius 全部 = 0

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「米黄底复古排版长文页」那样：采用高度复古的米黄色作为全局底色，文字以深棕黑色为主，仅使用暗红色细线作为视觉分割线。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「米黄底复古排版长文页」那一份（采用高度复古的米黄色作为全局底色，文字以深棕黑色为主，仅使用暗红色细线作为视觉分割线。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：元素密度 57.4个/千像素高、底色种类数 5种、整页高度 10001px。分派表没有把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 整体气质是否**没有**沿用第「A」份的特征？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求构建 'a free, web-based pixel art canvas'，供社区用户 'create, edit, and export sprite sheets or standalone pixel illustrations'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一个像素画绘制工具的工作台（包含绘图网格、工具栏、图层与颜色面板等编辑器要素），而非其他主题的页面？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Standard click-to-draw, click-and-drag for continuous lines'
keypoints.question: 在中央绘图网格上单击某个格子后，该格子是否被填上当前颜色（即点击可绘制像素）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The final delivery must be a single-file HTML page containing all necessary styles and scripts, running entirely offline'
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求顶部栏含 'the current project title input (defaulting to "Untitled Canvas")'
keypoints.question: 顶部导航栏中的项目标题输入框默认值是否精确为 "Untitled Canvas"？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提供文件操作下拉菜单，并列明 New Project、Save State、Export PNG 三项操作。
keypoints.question: 点击顶部栏的文件操作下拉菜单后，展开的菜单中是否包含 New Project、Save State、Export PNG 这 3 个菜单项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求顶部栏含 'a standard link for help and about us'
keypoints.question: 顶部栏中是否存在指向帮助/关于我们（Help / About）的链接项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Left Column: A vertical stack of tool icons'
keypoints.question: 上部工作区左列是否为垂直堆叠排列的工具图标栏（工具按钮自上而下纵向排列）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求左列工具栏包含 Pencil、Eraser、Fill Bucket、Line Tool 和 Marquee Select。
keypoints.question: 左列工具栏是否包含 Pencil（铅笔）、Eraser（橡皮）、Fill Bucket（油漆桶）、Line Tool（直线）、Marquee Select（选区）这 5 种必备工具？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Below that, a small 1:1 preview window showing the actual unzoomed size of the artwork'
keypoints.question: 左列工具栏下方是否有一个小的 1:1 预览窗口，用于按原始未缩放尺寸显示作品缩略图？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The main drawing grid... take up the bulk of the upper real estate. The grid lines should be faintly visible'
keypoints.question: 中央绘图网格是否占据上部区域的主体面积，且网格线以淡色可见的方式呈现（能看出格线但不喧宾夺主）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Right Column: A panel managing the document layers... and basic canvas properties'
keypoints.question: 上部工作区右列是否同时包含图层管理面板与画布属性两部分内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确列出图层管理所需的 Add Layer、Delete Layer、Move Up 和 Move Down 按钮。
keypoints.question: 图层面板是否包含 Add Layer、Delete Layer、Move Up、Move Down 这 4 个操作按钮？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'basic canvas properties with numeric inputs for Width and Height'，且 'canvas dimensions must have text input fallbacks'
keypoints.question: 画布属性区是否为 Width 和 Height 各提供一个可输入的数值输入框（文本/数字输入，而非仅滑杆或只读展示）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求底部 'color tools on the left side... and a timeline or frame manager on the right side'
keypoints.question: 底部横向面板是否左侧为颜色工具区、右侧为帧/时间线管理区，二者共同横跨页面底部？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'featuring predefined swatches, a hex code input field, and RGB sliders'
keypoints.question: 底部颜色工具区是否同时包含预设色板（swatches）、Hex 色值输入框、RGB 滑杆这 3 类组件？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求提供 RGB sliders，因此红、绿、蓝三个通道应各有可辨识的滑杆，但未禁止额外颜色控制。
keypoints.question: RGB 控制区是否分别提供对应 R、G、B 三个通道且带有可辨识标注的滑杆？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求帧管理器提供 Add Frame、Duplicate、Play、Pause 按钮，但未限制不得提供其他控件。
keypoints.question: 帧管理区是否包含 Add Frame、Duplicate、Play、Pause 这 4 个按钮？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Clicking a tool in the left column should give it an active, depressed state'
keypoints.question: 点击左列某个工具按钮（如 Eraser）后，该工具是否呈现出与其他工具明显区分的激活/按下状态？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'When adding a new layer, a small modal form should pop up prompting the user to type in the layer name'
keypoints.question: 点击 Add Layer 按钮后，是否弹出一个包含图层名称文本输入框的模态窗口，提示用户输入新图层名称？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求 'A panel managing the document layers'，图层管理面板必然含至少一个默认图层条目
keypoints.question: 图层面板中是否默认至少显示一条图层条目（如 Layer 1），构成可管理的图层列表？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求底部右侧设置 timeline or frame manager for basic GIF animations，但未指定初始帧的数量或呈现形式。
keypoints.question: 底部右侧是否提供可见的时间线或帧管理区域，用于基本 GIF 动画的帧管理？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求 “click-and-drag for continuous lines”，并要求画布支持 “zooming via the scroll wheel and panning via middle-click or holding the spacebar and dragging”。
keypoints.question: 中央画布是否完整支持以下操作：按住左键拖过多个格子可形成连续笔画；滚动鼠标滚轮可缩放画布；按住鼠标中键拖动或按住空格键再拖动均可平移画布，并且缩放、平移不会误画像素？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求实现 “a basic history stack”，使用户可以通过 “standard keyboard shortcuts to undo their last strokes”；已有条目仅检查可见入口，未验证撤销功能。
keypoints.question: 在画布上完成一笔绘制后，按标准撤销快捷键 Ctrl+Z（macOS 上为 Cmd+Z）是否会实际撤销最近一次笔画，而不只是显示撤销提示或静态按钮？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确指定 Pencil、Eraser、Fill Bucket、Line Tool 和 Marquee Select 作为编辑工具；已有条目只检查这些按钮存在及选中状态，没有检查其编辑行为。
keypoints.question: 除铅笔外的四种工具是否均执行与名称相符的实际编辑操作：Eraser 清除像素、Fill Bucket 对连通区域填色、Line Tool 在起止点之间绘制直线、Marquee Select 建立可见的矩形选区？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求文件操作菜单提供 “New Project, Save State, Export PNG”；已有条目只核对菜单项文字，没有验证这些文件操作能够执行。
keypoints.question: 文件菜单中的三项操作是否均可用并产生对应结果：New Project 建立或重置为空白项目，Save State 将当前项目保存为之后可恢复的状态，Export PNG 导出包含当前作品的有效 PNG 文件？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求右栏用于管理文档图层，并指定 Add Layer、Delete Layer、Move Up、Move Down；已有条目只检查按钮和命名模态框存在。
keypoints.question: 图层管理是否真正可操作：提交 Add Layer 模态表单后会以输入名称新增并选中图层，Delete Layer 会删除当前图层，Move Up 与 Move Down 会改变选中图层在列表和合成中的顺序？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求颜色工具包含 predefined swatches、hex code input field 和 RGB sliders，并强调 Hex 必须具有文本输入方式；已有条目仅检查组件存在。
keypoints.question: 预设色块、Hex 文本输入和 R/G/B 三条滑杆是否都能改变当前绘图颜色，并使随后绘制的像素使用所选颜色；Hex 输入是否能接受并正确解析有效的 #RRGGBB 色值？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求提供 Width 和 Height 数值输入，并特别要求画布尺寸具有文本输入 fallback；已有条目只检查输入框存在，未检查输入是否实际改变画布。
keypoints.question: 用户在 Width 和 Height 输入框中键入有效正整数并确认后，中央绘图网格的列数与行数是否分别更新为所输入的宽度和高度？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求提供用于基础 GIF 动画的 timeline/frame manager，并指定 Add Frame、Duplicate、Play、Pause；已有条目只检查按钮和初始帧存在。
keypoints.question: 帧管理器的四项功能是否均能实际工作：Add Frame 新增帧，Duplicate 复制当前帧的像素内容，Play 按时间顺序播放多个帧，Pause 停止播放并保留当前帧？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 验收标准明确要求 “Every single tool button, layer action, form input, and menu item must be reachable and triggerable via keyboard navigation” 且 “Focus states must be highly visible”。
keypoints.question: 仅使用键盘时，是否能依次聚焦并操作所有工具按钮、图层动作、文件菜单及菜单项、帧动作和表单输入；按钮与菜单可用 Enter 或 Space 触发，且每个当前焦点都具有持续清晰可见的焦点指示？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求在较小屏幕上 “the side panels should hide behind menus so that the central canvas area remains usable”。
keypoints.question: 在手机等窄屏视口下，左右侧工具面板是否会收纳到可打开和关闭的菜单中，而中央绘图画布仍保持可见、可绘制且不会被侧栏覆盖或挤压到不可用？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.question: 正文文字对比度是否不低于 4.5:1？

ambiguities: The request mentions both sprite sheets and standalone illustrations, later introduces a frame manager for basic GIF animations, but specifies only Export PNG. It does not define GIF export or sprite-sheet packing, so the core export endpoint is limited to exporting the current artwork as PNG.
Save State is requested, but no Load State or other restoration action is specified. A later-recoverable persistence workflow therefore cannot be assumed as a core endpoint.
Checklist items 10 and inv_1 refer to references "A" and "C" without identifying which supplied reference each label denotes.

outcomes.endpoint: The drawing grid stores user-selected pixel colors, supports continuous drawing and meaningful pixel edits, and can restore the exact prior artwork state when the latest stroke is undone.
outcomes.quote: create, edit, and export sprite sheets or standalone pixel illustrations for their own projects
test_cases: On a blank canvas, enter the valid Hex color #3366CC, select Pencil, click one known cell and drag through two adjacent cells; verify the three traversed cells are exactly #3366CC and a nearby untouched cell retains its prior value.
Create a solid 3-by-3 colored block, select Eraser, clear its center cell, and verify only that cell returns to its pre-drawing value while the other eight cells remain colored.

Create an earlier mark, then draw a separate multi-cell stroke and invoke Ctrl+Z or Cmd+Z once; verify every cell changed by the latest stroke returns to its exact prior color while the earlier mark remains unchanged.

outcomes.endpoint: The current artwork can be exported through Export PNG as a valid PNG whose pixel data represents the latest canvas contents.
outcomes.missing_check: Only mixed checklist items are mapped; a standalone endpoint assessment is required.
outcomes.quote: dropdown menu for file actions (New Project, Save State, Export PNG)
test_cases: Using the normal drawing controls, create a small pattern with two known colors, edit one of its pixels, and invoke File > Export PNG; open or decode the downloaded file locally and verify that it is a valid PNG, its dimensions match the currently declared canvas Width and Height, and the tested pixel coordinates contain the latest expected colors rather than stale or blank data.

core_scope.purpose: Enable community users to create and revise sprite-sheet or standalone pixel artwork in a browser and export the resulting artwork for use in their projects.
review_notes: Collapsed drawing, color application, erasing, continuous strokes, and undo into one end-to-end artwork-creation outcome rather than treating individual tools as separate core goals.
Item 32 is mixed because continuous drawing contributes to the core artwork flow, while wheel zoom and alternate panning methods are supplementary interaction features.

Item 34 is mixed because actual pixel editing, such as erasing, contributes to the core flow, but requiring every named convenience tool, including Marquee Select, is broader than the non-substitutable creation goal.
Item 37 is mixed because applying a selected color to subsequent pixels is core, while requiring all three interchangeable color-entry mechanisms is supplementary.
Item 35 is mixed because valid PNG export is core, while New Project and the underspecified Save State behavior are supplementary file-management features.

Layer management and frame-animation controls remain scored requirements but are not separate core outcomes: standalone pixel artwork can still be created, edited, and exported without them, and no GIF export endpoint is declared.
Layout, styling, responsive panel folding, offline packaging, and accessibility checks remain supplementary quality and delivery requirements rather than separate business endpoints.

ambiguities: No authoritative annual purchasing-volume figures or units are supplied, so tests can verify only that the page's own year/value data are intelligible and internally presented, not that the business figures are factually correct.

The full application sentence introduces the multi-step form with "maybe". It is therefore unclear whether retention, live updating, and no-reload progression are requirements for every acceptable application design or characteristics of the suggested design; they are treated as supplementary rather than core gates.

The request does not define a backend, delivery destination, validation contract, or persistence requirement for applications. A visible client-side result is testable, but actual receipt by the company must not be inferred.
The referenced screenshots are not included in the task data, so exact visual similarity and color-distance checks cannot be independently grounded here.

outcomes.endpoint: Prospective suppliers can clearly understand that they are being invited to the purchasing network, obtain intelligible yearly purchasing-volume information, and read four distinct partnership criteria. Chart animation, exact card styling, and section layout are not required for this informational endpoint.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item verifies that the purchasing-volume visualization exposes any intelligible year-and-value data; item 11 can pass based only on a title, axis label, or legend identifying the topic.
outcomes.quote: Let's start with a big main top area welcoming new vendors to our network. Right under that, I would love a section featuring some interactive data visualizations or animated charts that draw themselves to show our yearly purchasing volume. Next, we can have a grid of cards spelling out our four main criteria for new partners.
test_cases: From a fresh load, use normal scrolling to review the welcome, purchasing-volume, and criteria content; confirm the page clearly invites new suppliers, the visualization communicates at least one intelligible year-and-volume pairing through its declared labels, legend, values, or normal controls, and exactly four distinct supplier partnership criteria can be read.

From a fresh load, review the major headings, section labels, and criteria copy across the page and confirm they form a coherent supplier-partnership message rather than presenting Doclab or medical-industry content.

outcomes.endpoint: A prospective supplier can enter application-relevant details and complete the page's provided application interaction to reach a meaningful visible result. A multi-step design, cross-step retention, instant previews, and no-reload behavior are optional implementation qualities under the sentence's "maybe" wording, and no backend receipt or persistence is implied.
outcomes.missing_check: There is no implementation-neutral checklist item verifying completion of the application interaction. Item 21 partially checks the endpoint but assumes the optional multi-step implementation and a final-step submit button.
outcomes.quote: Finally, we need a really smooth interactive application area at the bottom, maybe a clever multi-step form that remembers what you typed and updates instantly on the screen without ever reloading the page.
test_cases: From a fresh load, navigate to the application area, enter valid supplier details according to the field labels and any rules declared by the page, use the interface's normal controls to complete the flow, and verify that it reaches a clear visible completion, confirmation, or equivalent application result without assuming server-side transmission.

core_scope.purpose: Enable prospective suppliers to understand the partnership opportunity, annual purchasing scale, and partner criteria, and to provide supplier-specific application details through a usable on-page interaction.
review_notes: Collapsed the welcome, purchasing-volume, and four-criteria sections into one supplier-information outcome because together they serve the page's prospective-supplier communication purpose rather than representing separate transactions.

Removed animation and chart interaction from the core endpoint. The requested yearly purchasing-volume information remains core, while animated drawing or interactive feedback is a supplementary visualization treatment and the request permits either interactive visualizations or animated charts.
Items 9, 10, 13, and 14 are mixed because they combine core content coverage with exact ordering, hero prominence, card formatting, or terse-copy presentation requirements.
Treated the interactive supplier application as a core user goal but did not require the suggested multi-step implementation. Items 8, 18, 19, and 20 therefore remain supplementary.
Item 21 is mixed because a clear completion state supports the core application endpoint, while its final-step and no-reload assumptions are implementation-specific.

Hover effects, visual fidelity, typography, palette, layout resilience, packaging constraints, and generic JavaScript robustness remain supplementary because they do not independently establish the supplier-information or application endpoints.

Item 9 is assigned once to the supplier-information outcome as an omnibus mixed check; it also mentions the application area's placement but is not duplicated, preserving the required one-time partition of checklist IDs.

ambiguities: The actual owner phone number and property address are not supplied, so an offline review can verify only that concrete, non-placeholder values are immediately visible and internally consistent, not that they are the owner’s real-world details.

The twelve seasonal prices and the state lodging-tax percentage are intentionally unspecified. Compliance can therefore be checked for completeness, currency or percentage formatting, non-placeholder values, and the declared pricing hierarchy, but not against predetermined amounts.

The month and booked dates for the static calendar are unspecified. Any coherent typical month with a subset of dates marked as requested could satisfy that supplementary requirement; it must not be treated as live availability.
References to the blue, beige, sports-gear, and portfolio designs are not accompanied by the source designs, so only the request’s textual descriptions can be evaluated.

“Standalone” clearly distinguishes the page from a platform listing, but it does not unambiguously require a single file with no remote assets; checklist items imposing that technical interpretation remain supplementary.

outcomes.endpoint: On initial load, users can see a concrete direct mobile number and full property street address without scrolling or opening a menu, and the Call Now action initiates a telephone handoff to that same number; the footer may repeat the contact details.
outcomes.quote: making sure they can instantly see my phone number and the exact property address.
test_cases: Load the page at a normal desktop or phone viewport and, before scrolling or opening a menu, verify that a non-placeholder mobile number and full street address are visible; scroll to the footer and confirm the same contact values are repeated, then return to and activate Call Now and confirm the browser’s tel: handoff targets the same normalized phone number.

outcomes.endpoint: The page is intelligibly presented as a single coastal vacation-rental listing, identifies the property as "The Seaglass House," and communicates the four named key amenities: Ocean View, Chef's Kitchen, Private Dock, and Fire Pit.
outcomes.quote: legitimate, standalone property listing page
test_cases: Load the page and read through the property overview using normal scrolling; verify that it is a single coastal vacation-rental detail page rather than a platform index or unrelated page, that the property name is exactly "The Seaglass House," and that all four named amenities are clearly associated with the property.

outcomes.endpoint: Guests can read complete seasonal rates, exact capacity and property measurements, supplementary charges and a percentage lodging tax, together with the stated check-in and check-out times.
outcomes.quote: Since this business runs on specifics, I need a very dense, detailed data table breaking down our pricing tiers: columns for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter, intersecting with rows for Nightly, Weekly, and Monthly rates, all filled with realistic dollar amounts.
test_cases: Locate the seasonal rates data and verify the exact Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter columns and Nightly, Weekly, and Monthly rows; verify all 12 intersections contain non-placeholder positive dollar amounts and that Nightly is less than Weekly and Weekly is less than Monthly within every season.

Continue through the property and charge information and verify Maximum Occupancy is 8 guests, Total Square Footage is 2,450 sq ft, Distance to Water is 150 feet, Parking Spots is 3 vehicles, Cleaning Fee is $200, Pet Fee is $75 per dog, Damage Deposit is $500, and state lodging tax is shown as a numeric percentage; then verify the page states check-in at 4:00 PM and check-out at 10:00 AM.

core_scope.purpose: Enable repeat guests to evaluate The Seaglass House’s essential rental details and costs and contact the owner directly using an immediately visible phone number and property address, without relying on a booking platform.
review_notes: Added the property’s identity and named amenities as a core informational outcome. A rental-listing page that does not identify the rental or communicate its principal amenities would fail its end-user purpose.

Kept the requested rates, exact property specifications, fees, tax format, and practical stay times in one consolidated business-specific information outcome rather than creating separate trivial gates for each table or footer fact.

Checklist item 23 is mixed because it combines access to the three core datasets with a specific three-table presentation structure. Item 34 is mixed because it checks the exact stay times together with the requested enlarged typography.

Checklist item 33 is mixed because it confirms core contact content but requires its repetition in a particular footer location. Item 45 is mixed because it tests the core tel: destination and number consistency together with visual prominence.

Removed the inquiry form from core membership. The request specifies its fields and controls but no submission result, persistence, delivery, or confirmation endpoint, while direct telephone contact is the expressly emphasized path for direct bookings.

Moved the static availability-calendar mockup to supplementary scope. It depicts an unspecified typical month for promotional context rather than reporting actual availability or completing a booking decision, so its removal would not defeat the page’s primary direct-listing and contact purpose.

Navigation placement, sticky behavior, responsive column arrangements, visual references, typography, colors, square corners, hover styling, local-town/map presentation, self-containment, and stress-layout probes remain supplementary requirements rather than independent core outcomes.
Core tests were rewritten as complete user scenarios that combine navigation or scrolling setup with verification of the final informational or direct-contact result.

ambiguities: The request calls for a "simple calendar" but does not require a seven-column month grid, date selection, appointment submission, availability data, or a booking backend.
The instruction to change "everything" between languages is interpreted as all translatable interface copy, including visible calendar copy, not proper nouns such as the brand and stylist names.

The single-HTML and double-click requirement is a delivery constraint. It remains supplementary rather than becoming a separate core booking outcome; whether it categorically forbids every external resource is not explicit in the request itself.
The versioned semantic amendment's endpoint/test wording supersedes any narrower legacy checklist or review wording; original provenance is retained.

outcomes.endpoint: The page is intelligibly a Kettle & Co. salon booking page and presents named stylists as the available choices, rather than unrelated or anonymous cards.
outcomes.quote: This is a booking page for my salon, Kettle & Co.
test_cases: On a fresh load, verify the exact brand name "Kettle & Co." is present, the visible content clearly establishes a haircut or salon-booking context, and every card offered in the stylist grid is identifiable as a stylist and displays that stylist's name.

outcomes.endpoint: Using the language switch immediately changes all translatable user-facing copy between intelligible English and Chinese in the current page state without a reload or navigation; brand names and personal names may remain unchanged.
outcomes.quote: The main thing is a toggle switch somewhere obvious that changes everything between English and Chinese instantly.
test_cases: Starting with the normal page, note translatable labels from the menu, top panel and stylist cards. Activate the language switch and verify in the same document that those areas change to the other language, then switch back and verify they return.

Select Chinese and open a stylist's calendar; verify that translatable month/weekday/control labels are intelligible Chinese. Verify the corresponding calendar labels in English as well. If the language control is available inside or alongside the open calendar, use it directly; if a standard modal correctly blocks the background control, close the calendar normally, change language and reopen the same stylist's calendar. Do not force background clicks through a modal, require a non-modal design, or require preservation of unrequested transient calendar selections. Brand/personal names and numeric dates may remain unchanged.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating a stylist card once directly presents an intelligible date calendar on the same page, without an intervening stylist-detail page, login, or multi-step booking flow. No date-selection transaction or backend booking is required.
outcomes.quote: When you click a stylist's card, it should just bring up a simple calendar.
test_cases: For each visible named stylist card, start from a reset page state, activate that card once, and verify that an intelligible calendar with identifiable dates and period or weekday context appears directly, without first requiring login, navigation to a detail page, or another booking step; accept any clear calendar format rather than requiring a particular month-grid implementation.

core_scope.purpose: Enable Kettle & Co. customers to identify a stylist and directly reach a simple booking calendar, with the usable interface available instantly in English or Chinese.
review_notes: Removed the proposed layout outcome from core scope. Sidebar positioning, the horizontal panel, the card grid arrangement, and sticky behavior are requested layout requirements but are not non-substitutable booking endpoints.
Removed standalone-file packaging from core scope while retaining all related checklist items as supplementary requirements.
Kept salon identity and named-stylist content as core because those are the information customers need to understand the page and choose the subject of the calendar flow.

Collapsed control discovery and language-state checks into end-to-end switching scenarios. Item 14 is mixed because it combines access to the core switch with the presentational requirement that its placement be obvious; the switch's own state indicator in item 16 remains supplementary.

Narrowed the calendar endpoint to the requested visible calendar state and direct one-step opening behavior. Item 18 is mixed because calendar intelligibility supports the endpoint, but its mandatory month/year and seven-column representation is more specific than the request.

Calendar closing behavior, reference-copy hygiene, custom-name provenance, terse wording, visual styling, resilience stress tests, and generic exception checks remain supplementary rather than separate core gates.

Semantic amendment: The request permits a normal modal calendar. It does not require a background language control to remain clickable through a modal backdrop, nor mandate a non-modal implementation. Verify calendar translation in both languages using the page's available controls without forcing blocked background actions.

Initial cart quantities and decrement behavior at zero are not specified. The cart test uses an increment followed by a reversing decrement and does not impose removal or quantity-floor behavior.

outcomes.endpoint: Using the available temperature, material, functional-attribute, and price filters changes the exact visible product set according to product data, with active facets combining under rules declared by the page.

test_cases: On a fresh load, record the product IDs and environmental ranges exposed by the page, choose a temperature value or range known to retain at least one product and exclude at least one, operate the temperature slider, and verify that the exact remaining ID set matches the declared environmental rule.

On a fresh load, choose material and functional-attribute selections for which the displayed product data gives a known expected result. Apply them using the page’s declared AND/OR semantics and verify that the exact visible product set, not merely the card count or generic DOM state, matches the expected combination.

On a fresh load, activate a temperature or technical facet, then set a price bound that excludes a known product. Verify that the final visible IDs equal the exact intersection of the active facet results and the products whose displayed prices satisfy the selected bound.

outcomes.endpoint: The front-end cart opens on the current page with three seeded line items, and changing a line quantity updates both that quantity and the displayed total by the correct monetary amount.
outcomes.quote: 购物车侧滑面板（需要完整的前端假数据逻辑）
test_cases: From a fresh load, activate the cart entry and verify that a right-side cart appears without navigation and contains exactly three seeded rows with product names and prices plus applicable specifications. Compute the displayed baseline total from unit prices and quantities, increase a line with unit price p by one, and verify its quantity increases by one and the total becomes the prior total plus p; decrement the same line once and verify both values return to their baseline values.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access intelligible URBAN NOMAD seasonal narrative, actual featured-product content, and identifiable accessory product information; the precise block-cutting layout is not part of the core endpoint.
outcomes.quote: 把“季度概念引言”、“核心单品大图”、“配件区域”等不同功能版块粗暴、直接地切割开来。
test_cases: Navigate through the loaded page and verify that it provides a substantive AURA-7/URBAN NOMAD concept narrative rather than placeholder copy, then continue to the featured-product and accessory content and verify that each contains identifiable, season-relevant merchandise information rather than empty headings or decorative placeholders.

core_scope.purpose: Enable shoppers to recognize and browse the AURA-7 Season 4: URBAN NOMAD catalog, narrow products through data-driven filters, access the requested seasonal merchandising content, and use the front-end cart’s seeded state and quantity/total logic.
review_notes: The dark palette was removed as a core outcome because color and theme are visual requirements, even though the request emphasizes them strongly; item 10 remains supplementary.
The actual seasonal narrative and merchandise information remain core, while aggressive block separation and large-image layout are represented as mixed or supplementary presentation requirements.

Cart opening, seeded content, quantity mutation, and exact total arithmetic were collapsed into one end-to-end stateful scenario. Amount-scroll animation, panel easing, and smoothness remain supplementary.

Filtering tests now verify exact result sets from declared product data and combined rules rather than accepting a generic content or DOM change. Exact control styling and control-presence-only checks remain supplementary.

Hover glitches, animated macro imagery, decoding text, blur/reflow effects, frame-rate quality, typography, component styling, layout imitation, viewport robustness, and generic DOM-change probes are supplementary because they do not establish the business endpoints.

Embedded schema richness and the exact sample product copy in items 29-33 remain supplementary. They are detailed implementation/content requirements but cannot substitute for the missing check that ordinary catalog information is actually accessible to the end user.

ambiguities: The request names a final booking confirmation block but does not specify a post-confirmation state, persistence behavior, or backend transaction, so no such transaction is made a core requirement.
No fixed repair prices, fees, discounts, or tax rules are supplied; quote correctness must therefore be checked against the rules and amounts actually declared by the page rather than assumed values.
The quick customer detail form does not enumerate required fields; the checklist's name and contact fields are an implicit interpretation rather than an explicit endpoint specification.
Checklist references to versions “A” and “C” are not unambiguously mapped in the supplied request and concern supplementary visual comparison.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a Quiet Harbor customer to select damaged boat areas and immediately receive an intelligible, itemized, arithmetically correct repair quote.
review_notes: Collapsed diagram selection, visible toggle state, line-item updates, and total recalculation into one end-to-end quote-building outcome because they are parts of the same primary user flow.
Removed the single-file and heavily commented-code outcome from core scope. Those are delivery and maintainability requirements, not non-substitutable end-user goals, and remain supplementary.
Kept the number-rolling animation supplementary because animation is not required to obtain or verify the repair quote.

Kept the customer form, booking block, navigation, broad four-section organization, branding, responsive layout, and visual treatment supplementary. They remain requested and scorable, but their removal would not prevent the primary quote calculation outcome, and the request defines no booking transaction.

Kept the SVG implementation-format check supplementary: the core endpoint is recognizable interactive boat-region selection, while requiring a particular vector technology is substitutable implementation detail.
Core tests verify exact row correspondence and arithmetic rather than accepting a generic DOM or number change.

ambiguities: "live sparkline graph" does not specify a real data source or backend connection. For an offline self-contained page, simulated visual updates are a reasonable supplementary implementation, but real-time infrastructure is not a core requirement.

The request asks for a prominent "Run Explain Plan" button but does not define an explain-plan result, loading protocol, success state, failure state, or backend transaction. Button presence and optional mock feedback remain supplementary rather than an invented core transaction.

The phone-use sentence mentions being able to "acknowledge database alerts," but it does not define an acknowledgement control or clearly equate every slow-query event with an alert. Checklist item 47 therefore cannot establish a mandatory per-query acknowledgement workflow.

"like Prod or QA" presents example environment values rather than unambiguously requiring both exact options. Core filtering should follow the environments declared by the page instead of treating both labels as separate hard gates.

outcomes.endpoint: The dashboard provides an intelligible operational summary containing a concrete average-latency value with a time unit, a total slow-query count for today, and a specifically identified worst-offending database node.
outcomes.quote: At the top of the main content area, build a metrics row featuring a big card for "Average Latency" with a live sparkline graph, a block for "Total Slow Queries Today" using that giant weight we discussed, and a "Worst Offender" block highlighting a specific database node.
test_cases: From a fresh offline load, use the overview to report the Average Latency as a numeric value with a time unit, Total Slow Queries Today as a concrete non-negative integer, and Worst Offender as a specific node identifier; verify each value is intelligibly paired with its correct metric label.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can review distinct slow-query event summaries containing SQL, execution duration, timestamp, and origin IP, then activate an event to read that event's complete SQL details.
outcomes.quote:
The main body should be a dense, organized grid of cards where each card represents a distinct slow query event captured by the monitoring system.
- Inside these query cards, show the truncated SQL string at the top, place the exact execution time in a bold colored pill shape, and list the timestamp and the origin IP address right below it.
- Make these query cards interactive so that clicking one expands it smoothly in place to reveal the full SQL query formatted with proper code syntax highlighting, along with a prominent button to "Run Explain Plan".
test_cases: On a fresh load, inspect two query-event cards and verify they represent distinct events through their combined details, each exposes a recognizable SQL preview, a positive numeric execution time with a time unit, a valid timestamp, and a syntactically valid origin IP; activate one card and verify that card reveals complete readable SQL consistent with its preview while the other event remains distinct.

outcomes.endpoint: The displayed query events can be filtered jointly by date range, a declared server environment, exact SQL-hash equality, and a minimum execution-time threshold, with events faster than the threshold excluded.
outcomes.quote: Below the top metrics, put in a robust filtering strip containing a calendar date range picker, a dropdown for the server environment like Prod or QA, a text input field to paste an exact SQL hash, and a slider to filter out queries faster than a certain millisecond threshold.
test_cases: Using one event from the page's seeded data whose date, environment, exact SQL hash, and execution duration are known, choose a date range containing it, its matching environment, its exact hash, and a threshold no higher than its duration; verify the target remains and every displayed event satisfies all four criteria, then change each criterion in turn to exclude the target and verify it disappears before restoring the criterion.

Choose an environment known to contain events, use the broadest available date range and a threshold that retains those events, then enter an exact hash guaranteed not to occur in the seeded data; verify that zero query cards remain, and clear the hash to verify that the otherwise eligible cards return.

core_scope.purpose: Enable operations users to monitor and investigate database slow-query incidents by reading key operational metrics, reviewing individual query events and full SQL details, and narrowing the event set with functional filters.
review_notes: Retained the requested operational metric values as core informational content, while moving the sparkline visualization, live animation, row layout, and giant typography to supplementary scope.

Collapsed query-card summaries and expansion into one end-to-end investigation outcome. Grid density, truncation styling, and in-place expansion mode make items 31, 32, and 35 mixed rather than purely core.

Kept only checklist item 43 as a core filtering check because it verifies the actual combined filtering result; items that only establish the strip or controls, labels, options, or changing slider text do not prove the business endpoint.
Removed the proposed acknowledgement action from the expandable-query core outcome because it is not stated in the quoted query-card interaction and its event-level behavior is underspecified.
Did not make Run Explain Plan feedback core: the request specifies a button but no result semantics, and a review should not invent a deployment or database-execution API.

Responsive reflow, sidebar behavior, visual references, animation smoothness, component styling, self-containment, overflow resilience, and general implementation-health checks remain scored supplementary requirements rather than core user outcomes.

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「E」份「纯黑底3D圆环演示页」在这一面是：按钮为带有很细深色描边、极深底色和微小圆角的暗黑幽灵风格方块，难以察觉。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「E」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：最大圆角 8px、圆角档数 1档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「纯黑底3D圆环演示页」那一份（按钮为带有很细深色描边、极深底色和微小圆角的暗黑幽灵风格方块，难以察觉。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「E」份「纯黑底3D圆环演示页」：深邃、极简的未来科技实验氛围，通过纯黑环境和抽象3D图形营造出神秘与高度聚焦的气场。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给了「E」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「E」13个/千像素高 vs 「A」44.9个/千像素高；底色种类数：「E」2种 vs 「A」4种；间距中位数：「E」14px vs 「A」24px。产出应落在「E」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 把成品和这 5 份参考并排看，成品的整体气场（情绪调性、松紧克制）最接近哪一份？必须挑出一份（不许答「都差不多」）。候选：「带侧边栏红点缀博客」（平铺直叙的常规内容展示氛围，相对传统且偏向功能性呈现。）；「米黄底橙色复古按钮页」（活泼且富有现代感的创意展示氛围，排版错落有致，显得轻松有呼吸感。）；「大图居中全圆角按钮页」（通透清新的视觉日记氛围，极大的图片占比带来了强烈的文艺感和舒展感。）；「粉色强调色通栏落地页」（严肃专业的商务宣传氛围，规整的布局传达出克制与效率导向。）；「纯黑底3D圆环演示页」（深邃、极简的未来科技实验氛围，通过纯黑环境和抽象3D图形营造出神秘与高度聚焦的气场。）。答案是「纯黑底3D圆环演示页」才算通过，挑了别的份即为跟错。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够比较同一组信息的散乱原文和 Markdown 结构化版本，并从标题、列表等语法中理解信息流如何被重组。
outcomes.quote: 右侧「文档工程」面板：采用左右对比的结构，左边是原始的散乱文本，右边嵌入一个高度还原的代码块，直接展示我如何用Markdown结构化信息流。
test_cases: 通过页面正常控件进入「文档工程」，确认原始散乱文本和带有可辨识 Markdown 标记的结构化版本均可读；对照两部分的主题、短语或事实，确认右侧确实重组了左侧的同一组信息，并通过标题、列表或其他层级标记体现结构，而不是展示两段无关示例。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够读到多项真实、可辨识且与技术文档负责人工作相关的技能或工具关键词。
outcomes.quote: 右侧「技能栈」面板：把技术栈关键词做成可快速过滤的标签阵列
test_cases: 通过页面正常控件进入「技能栈」，核对可见技能内容包含多项可辨识的真实技能或工具关键词，并确认它们与技术文档、信息架构或 Docs-as-Code 工作相关，而不是占位文本、编号标签或无关词语。

core_scope.purpose: 提供一份围绕「手边」的在线个人简历，使访客能够访问并理解技术文档负责人的经历、量化成果、文档结构化能力和相关技能。
review_notes: 将单视口、无滚动条、桌面左右框架、移动端底部图标栏和窄屏适配从核心结果降为补充要求；这些是明确的布局约束，但不是在线简历不可替代的业务目的。
将实时标签过滤降为补充要求。技能关键词本身是核心信息，而输入框和即时过滤是访问该信息的增强机制；移除过滤不会消除技能展示这一主要用户目标。
补入原提案遗漏的核心信息结果：技术文档经历与量化成果、Markdown结构化能力证据以及岗位相关技能。
「连线」表单保留为补充要求。该请求未提供实际联系方式、发送结果或本地状态变化，表单因而是简历中的附带界面，不能据此发明后端提交核心事务。
检查项29同时检查核心的三项数字成果和补充性的视觉突出方式，因此列为混合项；检查项30同时检查核心的前后信息对照和补充性的左右并置布局，因此列为混合项。
检查项21把核心简历信息与补充性的联系方式及站点类型排除条件合并在一起，因此列为混合项，而未假装它能单独完整验证任一具体信息结果。
核心测试已改写为完整场景：通过正常控件到达目标内容后直接核验最终信息结果，而不是把加载、寻找控件和点击拆成独立的琐碎测试。

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「A」份「黑底紫字深色落地页」：典型的着陆页分块布局：Hero区左侧大标题右侧图，中部采用左大右四小的非对称卡片网格，下方是居中突出的三列定价卡片和多列页脚。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「A」4.5个/千像素高 vs 「B」33.3个/千像素高；整页高度：「A」119264px vs 「B」4978px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「黑底紫字深色落地页」那一份基本一致（典型的着陆页分块布局：Hero区左侧大标题右侧图，中部采用左大右四小的非对称卡片网格，下方是居中突出的三列定价卡片和多列页脚。）？

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「米白底居中极简主页」那一份基本一致（全局使用偏轻/较细的无衬线字体，字号偏小，字体颜色为深灰而非纯黑，标题与正文字重反差微弱，排版呼吸感强。）？

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「蓝白大方块交替网格页」那一份（以常规无衬线体为主，小标题频繁使用全大写字母，正文颜色较浅（浅灰），整体字重适中且无极粗字体。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「彩色弥散光晕卡片页」那一份（现代粗黑体风格，标题极度粗壮紧凑且带彩色强调，正文偏细，字号层级与字重对比都极其强烈。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「蓝白大方块交替网格页」那一份（明快的白底配高饱和天蓝色，蓝色直接作为交错出现的正方形容器背景填充色，顶部带有黑灰遮罩图。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「紫底波浪背景博客页」那一份（极简扁平无阴影，按钮为微圆角的纯紫矩形，最显著的是输入框仅有一条底边线（无四周外框）。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「彩色弥散光晕卡片页」那一份（强软 UI 风格的悬浮卡片，带有大圆角、明显的弥散高斯模糊阴影，以及特殊的彩色渐变顶边线，按钮为全圆角胶囊状。）？跟成了即为不通过。

ambiguities: The request does not specify a canonical English spelling of 小满, so coherent forms such as “Xiaoman” or “Xiao Man” should be accepted.
No factual biography, affiliation, publication list, or project data is supplied; the rubric can assess specificity and academic relevance but cannot validate real-world factual accuracy.
The destinations for the three entry blocks are not specified, so relevant external links, internal anchors, or information expansion are all reasonable supplementary implementations.
No delivery destination or backend behavior is specified for the contact form; a real message-sending transaction should not be inferred.
Checklist references to source labels “B” and “D” are not independently defined in the supplied request, making items 15 and inv_1 ambiguous comparison checks.

outcomes.endpoint: An English-speaking visitor can determine whose academic homepage this is and understand the scholar's academic title, position, or affiliation; all page-authored visible copy is in English and relevant to Xiaoman's academic profile.
outcomes.quote: 弄个叫小满的学术主页，给老外看的全英文啊
test_cases: Load the page and verify that its visible content identifies the scholar using an English or pinyin rendering of 小满 and provides a concrete academic title, position, or institutional affiliation, making the result recognizable as a personal academic homepage rather than a product, blog, or company site.

Inspect all page-authored visible text, including headings, cards, entry labels, form labels, placeholders, and controls, and verify that it is intelligible English with no Chinese characters or leaked reference-site brands.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can read concrete highlighted publications and research projects, with specific English titles and brief scholarly descriptions sufficient to understand the nature of the work.
outcomes.quote: 用来放重点论文和科研项目
test_cases: Load the homepage and review the highlighted scholarly-work content, verifying that it includes at least one publication and at least one research project, each with a specific English title and a brief intelligible academic description rather than generic placeholders or unrelated commercial content.

Review every displayed publication or project title and description and verify that the text is fully readable without clipping or overlap and remains focused on scholarship rather than copied pricing, blog-comment, paint-brand, or business-card material.

core_scope.purpose: Provide English-speaking visitors with an intelligible personal academic homepage for Xiaoman that clearly identifies the scholar and presents highlighted publications and research projects.
review_notes: Reduced the core to the non-substitutable informational goals of an academic homepage: identifying the scholar in English and presenting intelligible scholarly work.

Moved first-screen fit, absence of scrollbars, responsive reflow, exact card counts, exact square-entry layout, and source-inspired visual structure to supplementary status because they are layout constraints rather than the academic information endpoint.
Removed the contact form from the core because the request introduces it with “顺带,” marking it as incidental to the primary academic-homepage purpose; no backend submission requirement was invented.

The exact one-large/four-small card arrangement and three bottom entry blocks remain supplementary even though they are explicitly requested, since the academic profile can fulfill its main purpose without those exact presentation devices.

Item 22 remains mixed because it checks substantive publication/project content while tying that content to exactly five cards. Items 28, 29, and 31 are mixed because they combine core content completeness, legibility, or relevance with first-fold layout or supplementary entry/form components.
Self-containment, external-resource restrictions, JavaScript cleanliness, visual styling, component appearance, and navigation behavior remain supplementary implementation requirements.

ambiguities: The request does not state whether the programming-language field is required or define language-value validation, so core tests should follow any rules declared by the page rather than inventing constraints.
No backend or deployment endpoint is requested; a clear self-contained front-end subscribed state is sufficient for the valid submission path.
“Searchable” permits either per-preview controls or one shared control and permits visible highlighting or filtering, as reflected in the request checklist.
No concrete API-reference destination is supplied, making the exact expected link target indeterminate; the footer link remains a supplementary requirement.

The request mentions a centralized vertical flow for subscription options or plans without otherwise defining any options or plans, so this is treated as layout guidance rather than an additional business outcome.
Checklist references named only as “A” and “C” cannot be unambiguously associated with the prose descriptions in the supplied request.

outcomes.endpoint: The page is clearly about developer-documentation newsletter updates and makes substantive Current Focus and Code Snippets content accessible; Current Focus describes actual documentation work, and Code Snippets contains recognizable code rather than placeholders.
outcomes.quote: Add a structured left-hand sidebar to provide quick jump links to 'Current Focus', 'Archive', and 'Code Snippets'.
test_cases: Using normal page controls or scrolling, locate the named content destinations and verify that the page is recognizably a developer-documentation newsletter, Current Focus contains substantive current update information rather than placeholder text, and Code Snippets contains at least one recognizable monospace code sample with programming syntax.

outcomes.endpoint: A visitor can enter an email address and programming-language preference and complete a self-contained front-end subscription flow, while an invalid email produces visible validation instead of a false success.
outcomes.quote: Set up a straightforward subscription form with text fields for an email address, preferred programming language, and a clear submit button.
test_cases: Enter a valid email address and programming-language preference through clearly identified fields, activate the clearly subscription-oriented submit control, and verify that the page reaches an explicit success or subscribed state without retaining a validation error or silently discarding the action.

In a fresh form state, enter an obviously invalid email such as 'abc', optionally enter a language preference, submit, and verify that a visible email-validation message appears and that no success or subscribed state is shown.

outcomes.endpoint: The Archive presents exactly three distinguishable past newsletters, each with an embedded code preview, and users can obtain a visible, preview-appropriate match result when searching every preview.
outcomes.quote: Build an 'Archive' section showcasing three past newsletters, each featuring an embedded, searchable code block preview.
test_cases: Inspect the Archive and verify that it contains exactly three distinguishable past-newsletter entries, identified by meaningful titles, issues, or dates, with a recognizable code-block preview embedded in every entry.

For each of the three previews in turn, choose a visible token occurring in that preview, enter it through that preview's search control or the declared shared control, and verify that matching source text in the appropriate preview is visibly highlighted or retained as a filtered result; clear or reset the search before testing the next preview.

core_scope.purpose: Enable visitors to understand the developer-documentation newsletter, submit a subscription with an email address and language preference, and inspect and search the requested past-newsletter code previews.
review_notes: The original responsive/page-purpose outcome was split by user goal. Mobile single-column fit, desktop sidebar placement, hamburger behavior, and quick-jump mechanics are supplementary layout and navigation requirements rather than indispensable subscription or content endpoints.

Current Focus and Code Snippets were retained as one informational core outcome because their substantive developer-update content must be accessible and intelligible; the specifically left-hand or hamburger-based delivery mechanism is substitutable and therefore supplementary.

The form checks were consolidated into two end-to-end scenarios: a verified valid front-end completion and a verified invalid-email path. Mere control discovery is setup within those scenarios, not a separate test.

The duplicate archive-search checks were mapped to one outcome and strengthened into a scenario that exercises all three previews and verifies the specific highlighted or filtered result rather than accepting a generic DOM change.

The footer privacy text and API link remain scored supplementary requirements because they support the page but their removal does not eliminate the primary abilities to understand the newsletter, subscribe, or search its archive.

Visual references, color, typography, flat component styling, viewport fit, single-file packaging, runtime robustness, and overflow resilience remain supplementary and were not promoted to core gates.

ambiguities: The request specifies a stateful client-side success presentation but no mailing-list service, persistence mechanism, or deployment API, so successful submission should not be interpreted as proof of actual remote enrollment.
The phrase "capitalized font" may refer to uppercase visual styling rather than the underlying brand text. Checklist item 15 mixes essential brand identification with that presentational requirement.

The request does not define a custom email-validity algorithm or required error message. Invalid-input testing should use native email semantics or validation rules declared by the page and should only require that invalid input not reach the success state.

outcomes.endpoint: The rendered page clearly identifies the newsletter as Frontend Signal and intelligibly explains that it provides weekly coverage of UI architecture and performance patterns.
outcomes.quote: The top left grid cell should hold the main branding: "Frontend Signal" in a tight, capitalized font, followed by a punchy sub-headline explaining that this is a weekly breakdown of UI architecture and performance patterns.
test_cases: Load the page and verify that the visible branding identifies "Frontend Signal" and that the accompanying subtitle communicates both the weekly cadence and the UI architecture/performance-pattern subject matter.

outcomes.endpoint: Submitting an email accepted as valid by the page changes the existing page to the exact requested confirmation state without navigation or reload; a malformed email does not produce that success state. This is a client-side visible state, not an implied mailing-list backend transaction.
outcomes.quote: Add a stateful JavaScript interaction to this subscribe block: when a valid email is submitted, the input and button should transition into a smooth, CSS-only checkmark animation and display a "You're on the list, check your inbox" success state without reloading the page.
test_cases: From the initial page state, enter a valid email such as test@example.com and activate Subscribe; verify that the same document remains loaded and displays the exact text "You're on the list, check your inbox" as the resulting subscription state.

From a fresh initial state, enter a malformed email such as abc and activate Subscribe; verify according to the page's declared or native email-validity rules that the success text is not shown and the page instead retains the form or presents an invalid-input indication.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a visitor to understand what the Frontend Signal newsletter covers and submit a valid email to reach the requested in-page subscription confirmation.
review_notes: Kept the subscription result as the primary functional core and added the minimum informational core needed for visitors to know what they are being asked to subscribe to.

Classified item 19 as mixed because it checks the no-reload success endpoint together with the decorative checkmark transition. The checkmark shape, CSS animation technique, and exact control existence remain supplementary rather than independent core gates.

Demoted the sparkline, archive accordion, profile, value bullets, footer, palette, typography, hover effects, and load animations because removing them would not prevent visitors from understanding and completing the principal subscription flow.

Demoted iPad viewport fit, CSS Grid usage, responsive behavior, single-file packaging, resource weight, and self-containment to supplementary implementation or layout requirements. They remain requested and scoreable but are not primary end-user outcomes.
Replaced separate presence, click, and visual-inspection probes with self-contained end-to-end scenarios that submit data and verify the specific resulting state.

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「合唱协会那个」那一份（细字重的现代黑体为主，字号普遍偏小，整体排版轻盈疏朗。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「B」份「带红色大标题的」：顶部导航栏带有一组包含深灰色图标的浅灰色圆底图标组件，无其他硬性框线。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大圆角：「B」4px vs 「A」25px；圆角档数：「B」1档 vs 「A」5档；是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「B」无 vs 「A」有。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「米黄底带粗边框的」那一份（所有的板块、表格、按钮均采用了强烈的粗黑或深棕色实线直角边框设计。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户希望页面“更像是一篇带有空间叙事感的随笔”，并要求历史与重塑部分“文字要考究”。
keypoints.question: 「历史与重塑」的三段正文是否以具体的厂房历史、保留或修复的建筑细节及更新后的空间使用为线索形成连贯的空间叙事，读起来像考究的随笔，而不是三段彼此重复的通用招商口号？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求悬停“不同单元分割区块”时，对应表格行“跟着做平滑的底色高亮切换”；现有条目只验证单个单元是否产生高亮。
keypoints.question: 在平面图的至少两个不同单元之间依次移动鼠标时，硬指标表格是否始终只高亮当前单元所对应的行，上一行会恢复，并且底色变化具有可见的平滑过渡而非瞬间跳变？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确规定姓名、拟经营业态（下拉菜单）和联系方式为三个必填项，因此字段不完整时必须阻止提交，但未限定具体校验提示形式。
keypoints.question: 快速预约表单的姓名、拟经营业态和联系方式是否全部为必填项，并且任一项为空时均会阻止提交，且不会提前显示提交成功文案？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求滚动超过 100px 后导航“平滑吸顶，并加入轻微的毛玻璃背景模糊效果”；现有条目只验证吸顶和持续可见。
keypoints.question: 导航进入吸顶状态时，背景是否出现轻微的毛玻璃模糊与适度半透明效果，并通过平滑过渡完成状态变化，而不是在滚动阈值处生硬闪切？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户验收要求“正文字号在任何情况下不能小于 15px”。
keypoints.question: 在约 390px 的手机视口下，所有正文、表格内容、表单文字、画廊语录及页脚目录的实际渲染字号是否均不小于 15px？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“在高分辨率屏幕下必须保持锐利，不能发虚”。
keypoints.question: 在高分辨率或高设备像素比显示环境下，粗体标题、边框、表格线和平面图轮廓是否仍边缘清晰，没有因将文字或线框整体栅格化、低分辨率缩放而出现明显发虚或锯齿？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 题面把「D」份点名为反面参考（别做成它那样）
keypoints.question: 配色是否明确**不像**第「D」份参考？

ambiguities: 请求只固定了楼板承重为 500kg/㎡，没有指定 A、B、C 的面积数值、客货梯配比或电力容量数值；应要求页面给出具体且可理解的数据，但不应臆造唯一标准答案。
“异步”没有定义真实后端、网络协议或数据持久化要求；离线单文件场景只需验证有效提交后的可见成功状态以及不刷新、不跳转，不应额外要求部署或预约 API。
联系方式的格式规则未定义，因此核心验证只要求该字段非空，不应擅自增加手机号格式、验证码或其他校验门槛。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够明确识别这是“东岸1930”老厂房园区的商业地产招商页，理解其由国营纺织厂房更新而来的具体故事、空间使用方向及目标入驻业态，而不是看到通用招商文案或其他行业的参考内容。
outcomes.quote: 我们要上线一个名为“东岸1930”的商业地产招商页。
test_cases: 加载单页并完整阅读项目介绍与“历史与重塑”内容，确认项目名为“东岸1930”、用途为商业地产招商，并能从连贯叙事中得知原址是国营纺织厂房、具体保留或修复了哪些建筑细节以及更新后的空间用途。
检查主要内容区、表格和文字条目，确认招商定位明确面向精品咖啡馆、独立书店和中小型设计工作室等业态，且没有混入 DESIGN、天文观测、合唱曲目或装帧材料等参考页面内容。

outcomes.endpoint: 潜在租户能够从“空间与平面图”板块比较 A、B、C 三栋楼的面积分布，查看与租赁决策相关的楼板承重、客货梯配比和电力容量等具体指标，并通过有实际楼层或单元含义的平面示意图理解空间划分。
outcomes.quote: 提供A、B、C三个核心楼栋的面积分布概览，以及诸如楼板承重（500kg/㎡）、客梯货梯配比、电力容量等硬指标表格。
test_cases: 进入“空间与平面图”板块，逐一核对 A、B、C 三栋均提供带单位的具体面积或面积范围，并确认硬指标表明确列出楼板承重 500kg/㎡、有具体值的客梯货梯配比以及有具体值和适当单位的电力容量；面积、配比和容量采用页面声明的数值，不另行假定未给出的标准答案。
结合板块标题、标签或图例检查平面示意图，确认图中存在多个可区分的楼层单元，并且这些区块与楼栋或空间信息有可理解的对应关系，而不是无关的装饰图形。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客可以使用仅含姓名、拟经营业态和联系方式的表单提交预约；三个字段均必填，业态通过下拉控件选择。有效提交后页面不刷新或跳转，而是在原提交按钮位置显示指定成功文案。
outcomes.quote: 非常精简的留资表单，仅包含姓名、拟经营业态（下拉菜单）、联系方式三个必填项。
test_cases: 在预约表单中确认只有姓名、拟经营业态和联系方式三个留资字段，且拟经营业态是包含咖啡、书店或设计工作室等相关选项的下拉控件；随后分别让三个字段中的每一项为空、其余项填写有效值并提交，确认每次都阻止提交且不出现成功文案。
填写姓名，选择一个具体拟经营业态并填写联系方式后提交，确认未发生整页刷新或页面跳转，原提交按钮位置出现精确文案“已收到，我们的主理人会尽快与您联系”。

core_scope.purpose: 帮助精品咖啡馆、独立书店和中小型设计工作室了解“东岸1930”的园区背景与可租空间条件，并完成预约看房留资。
review_notes: 将原提案中的手机端单栏、无横向溢出和最小字号从核心移至补充要求；这些属于视口适配与排版质量，不是招商页的业务终点。
把笼统的 property_content 拆为项目背景与空间租赁信息两个不可替代目标：前者承载指定的老厂房叙事和客群定位，后者承载潜在租户作出空间判断所需的楼栋、硬指标和平面信息。
保留预约提交为独立核心结果，并将字段结构、逐项缺失验证和有效异步提交整合为完整的无效输入与有效输入端到端场景。
第16项同时检查核心板块是否出现、七部分是否齐全以及固定顺序，第23项同时检查参数内容及首屏位置和醒目程度，第47项同时检查核心信息与左右栅格布局，因此归入 mixed_item_ids，而不是作为纯核心正确性检查。
精确板块顺序、锚点导航、首屏视觉、对比图、主理人画廊、页脚博客式归档、悬停联动、吸顶毛玻璃、焦点样式、配色、高清锐利度和自包含实现均保留为补充要求；移除这些不会使用户无法理解主要招商信息或提交预约。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「紫底黑框表格排版那份」在这一面是：典型的中文黑体与英文无衬线体混排，字重对比鲜明，部分数据排版带有等宽字体特征。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 13px、最大标题字号 32px、字号档数 12档、字族 noto/times、字重档数 1档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「紫底黑框表格排版那份」那一份（典型的中文黑体与英文无衬线体混排，字重对比鲜明，部分数据排版带有等宽字体特征。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「C」份「暖橙色渐变背景那份」：大量运用带有柔和阴影的宽大圆角白色卡片，配有高亮且带微渐变的药丸形实心按钮，卡片内含彩色小圆角标签。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「C」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「C」有 vs 「B」无。产出应落在「C」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「暖橙色渐变背景那份」那一份基本一致（大量运用带有柔和阴影的宽大圆角白色卡片，配有高亮且带微渐变的药丸形实心按钮，卡片内含彩色小圆角标签。）？

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「A」份「带圆形黑白人像那份」在这一面是：包含带图卡片和纯文字直角白底卡片，按钮样式较轻，包含半圆角实心和带边框的样式。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带圆形黑白人像那份」那一份（包含带图卡片和纯文字直角白底卡片，按钮样式较轻，包含半圆角实心和带边框的样式。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「黑底深色极简文字那份」在这一面是：几乎摒弃了具象化的常见网页组件，仅用极其简单的纯色暗灰方块或单根线条来暗示内容区块。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「黑底深色极简文字那份」那一份（几乎摒弃了具象化的常见网页组件，仅用极其简单的纯色暗灰方块或单根线条来暗示内容区块。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「紫底黑框表格排版那份」在这一面是：完全去除了阴影和圆角设计，所有区块和卡片均表现为带有粗黑线条描边的直角方块，类似原生表格。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：圆角档数 0档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「紫底黑框表格排版那份」那一份（完全去除了阴影和圆角设计，所有区块和卡片均表现为带有粗黑线条描边的直角方块，类似原生表格。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'做一个同城步行的互助社区……城市步行地图的聚合页，主要方便大家分享和发现有意思的街巷漫游路线'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一个城市步行/街巷漫游路线的分享与发现聚合页（而非其他行业主题）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'页面最上方是一个带自适应的全局导航，除了品牌标识和基础路由，核心是一个搜索输入框'
keypoints.question: 页面最上方的全局导航是否同时包含品牌标识、若干基础导航链接、以及一个搜索输入框三部分？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求搜索框能够让用户按区划或街区名寻找路线，因此应检查其用途是否明确并具备相应检索或筛选能力。
keypoints.question: 导航搜索框是否明确支持用户按区划或街区名输入并检索或筛选路线，且可通过提示标签、placeholder 或结果变化确认其用途？

keypoints.basis: 指令称文案“可以写类似用脚步重新丈量城市肌理这种”，要求语义和引导方向一致，而非逐字或高度复用示例。
keypoints.question: 首屏头图区的主文案是否围绕“用脚步重新丈量或探索城市”的核心含义，形成明确的城市步行号召？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求首屏'配一个发起路线的引导操作'
keypoints.question: 首屏头图区是否配有一个明确的'发起路线'（或语义等价）的引导操作按钮？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'首屏是一个带有强引导属性的视差头图区'
keypoints.question: 向下滚动首屏时，头图的背景图像层是否与其上的文案以不同速率位移，呈现出可见的视差效果？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求首屏之后紧接核心精选路线展示区，并要求各条路线使用卡片包装，但未限定所有断点下都必须并列排列。
keypoints.question: 首屏之后是否紧接一个核心的精选路线展示区，并在其中提供多张独立的路线卡片？

keypoints.basis: 指令使用复数形式描述精选路线和路线卡片，可要求存在多条不同路线，但不能无依据地限定至少三张。
keypoints.question: 精选路线区是否包含至少两张路线卡片，且路线名称彼此不同并分别指向具体的城市步行或街巷漫游路线？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'比如封面图悬浮要有平滑的微放大，底下要有路线距离、预计步数等数据'
keypoints.question: 每张路线卡片内部是否同时具备：一块可辨识为街景/路线的封面图区域、路线距离数据、预计步数数据？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'点缀几枚那种彩色的小圆角标签用来区分古建巡礼、深夜觅食这类不同主题'
keypoints.question: 路线卡片上是否点缀了若干枚小标签，且标签文案为'古建巡礼''深夜觅食'这类漫游主题分类？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'卡片内部的微交互要细腻，比如封面图悬浮要有平滑的微放大'
keypoints.question: 将鼠标悬停在某张路线卡片的封面图上后，封面图是否出现可见的平滑微放大变化？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求在路线内容下方设置具有明确点击暗示的操作锚点；本条仅检查行动入口的存在、语义和可用性，组件视觉样式由对应风格条目检查。
keypoints.question: 每张路线卡片或精选路线区是否提供文案明确的路线行动入口，例如“查看路线”或“开始漫游”，并可用于进入或启动对应路线？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'再往下是一大块沉浸式的单线拆解说明，比如本周主推的城南旧事路线'
keypoints.question: 页面中是否有一整块专门拆解单条路线的沉浸式说明板块，并明确点名该路线名称（如'城南旧事'本周主推）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'左边固定留出充足的呼吸空间只放简短的视线引导小标题，右边大尺寸的版心用来展开大段的正文叙述'
keypoints.question: 单线拆解板块中，左栏是否只放简短的视线引导小标题，右栏承载大段正文叙述（而非左右两侧都是大段文字）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求右栏'用来展开大段的正文叙述和途径点的坐标信息'
keypoints.question: 单线拆解板块的正文中是否给出了途经点的坐标信息（如经纬度数值或等价的定位标注）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'页面的最后是一个路线共创的表单容器，包含路线名、途经点、避坑指南等几个多行文本域'
keypoints.question: 页面底部是否有一个路线共创表单，且至少包含路线名、途经点、避坑指南这三个字段？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求这些字段是'几个多行文本域'
keypoints.question: 表单中的途经点、避坑指南等字段是否为可容纳多行的文本域（明显高于单行输入框），而非单行 input？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“这里表单的聚焦态也要做好微动效的平滑过渡”。
keypoints.question: 当共创表单中的多行文本域获得或失去焦点时，是否出现清晰可见的聚焦态变化，并通过平滑过渡呈现而非瞬时跳变？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'一个路线共创的表单容器'，表单必然需要提交入口
keypoints.question: 共创表单是否带有一个提交按钮，用于提交所填写的路线内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'最后是常规的页脚和版权信息'
keypoints.question: 页面最底部是否有页脚区域，且其中包含明确的版权信息行？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'特别是在移动端下，不对称的左右栏要能优雅地折叠成上下流'
keypoints.question: 在移动端窄视口（约 390px 宽）下，单线拆解板块原本左右分栏的内容是否折叠为上下单列流，且无横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'圆角卡片的内边距也要自适应缩减，保证单手滑动的防误触区域'
keypoints.question: 在移动端窄视口下，路线卡片的内边距是否较桌面端明显缩减（内容未紧贴屏幕边缘、也未被过大留白挤压）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借用参考的设计语言，页面内容须是'城市步行地图的聚合页'
keypoints.question: 页面正文是否全部围绕城市步行路线主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名或标题（如 Pfolio、Kane Williams、Oyster Beds、Saffron Hearth、高山茶园/Highland Tea Estate）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求的内容为步行路线聚合页，参考截图仅提供设计语言而非文案素材
keypoints.question: 页面中是否没有出现参考截图的行业内容条目（如生蚝养殖/潮汐记录、地中海菜品与价格、茶叶批次表、Website Design/SEO Marketing 等服务卡片）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联且不引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户将页面定义为“城市步行地图的聚合页”，应有能够体现地图与路线空间关系的可视化内容。
keypoints.question: 页面是否提供了可辨识的城市地图或路线空间可视化，用于呈现路线的大致走向、街区位置或途经点分布，而不是仅展示纯文字路线卡片？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求搜索框“让大家能按区划或者街区名找路线”，因此应具备实际检索或筛选行为。
keypoints.question: 在搜索框输入页面已有的区划或街区名并执行搜索后，精选路线结果是否会被实际筛选或更新，并对无匹配结果给出明确反馈，而非搜索框仅作装饰？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求页面顶部包含“品牌标识和基础路由”，基础路由应能到达其所指向的内容。
keypoints.question: 全局导航中的基础导航链接是否均可用，点击后能够滚动至对应页面板块或切换到相应内容视图，而不是空链接或无响应控件？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求卡片底部设置具有明确点击暗示的“操作锚点”，该操作应能通向相应路线内容。
keypoints.question: 精选路线卡片上的主要操作按钮是否与各自路线正确对应，点击后能够打开、定位或展开该路线的详细信息，而不是所有按钮无响应或指向同一无关内容？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“沉浸式的单线拆解说明”，并提到“每一段路程的起伏转折”以及途经点坐标信息。
keypoints.question: 单线拆解板块是否将主推路线组织为多个有先后关系的路程段或途经点，并为这些分段分别提供叙述及位置/坐标信息，而不是只有一整段未拆解的概述？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求提供用于路线共创的表单；作为可用的共创入口，应具备基本提交处理和状态反馈。
keypoints.question: 提交路线共创表单时，页面是否会对必填内容进行基本校验，并在提交后给出可见的成功或错误反馈，而不是点击提交按钮后毫无响应？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“带自适应的全局导航”并强调“全端需要做好响应式断点控制”。
keypoints.question: 在约 390px 宽的移动端视口下，全局导航是否会自适应折叠、换行或重排，同时仍保留可使用的品牌入口、基础导航入口和街区搜索能力？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求全端响应式，并特别要求移动端卡片内边距自适应缩减；已有条目未检查卡片内容整体重排后的完整性。
keypoints.question: 在移动端窄视口下，精选路线卡片是否重排为适合单手纵向浏览的布局，且卡片封面、距离、步数、主题标签及主要操作均保持完整可读、不会互相遮挡？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求移动端“保证单手滑动的防误触区域”，现有条目只检查了卡片内边距，没有直接检查触控目标和操作间距。
keypoints.question: 移动端的导航控件、路线卡片按钮和表单提交按钮是否具有足够大的可点击区域及合理间隔，避免相邻操作过密而造成单手触控误触？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把 palette 指给了「D」份
keypoints.question: 整体配色是否取自第「D」份参考，而不是别的份？

ambiguities: “城市步行地图的聚合页”可能被理解为必须包含地图可视化，但后文明确描述的是路线卡片、坐标信息和单线拆解，并未明确要求独立地图组件或交互地图，因此检查项42不作为核心门槛。
路线卡片下方“操作锚点”的视觉形式被明确要求，但其目标页面或业务结果没有被说明；不能据此强制要求每张卡片都拥有独立详情视图或启动路线流程，因此检查项28和45保留为补充要求。
请求要求路线共创表单，但没有指定服务器、账户、持久化或发布流程；核心提交测试仅要求离线页面可完成的输入校验和可见确认，不推定真实后端分享已经发生。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够按页面已有路线所标注的区划或街区名实际筛选路线，并在没有匹配路线时获得明确反馈。
outcomes.quote: 核心是一个搜索输入框，让大家能按区划或者街区名找路线
test_cases: 从现有路线卡片中选取一个明确显示的区划或街区名，在搜索框输入该名称并按页面提供的方式执行搜索；验证结果非空、展示的路线与该地点相符，且不匹配路线不再作为匹配结果显示。
输入一个确定不存在于页面路线数据中的唯一地点字符串并执行搜索；验证页面明确显示无匹配结果，且不会把无关路线继续呈现为搜索命中。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面提供可理解的城市步行精选路线集合，至少包含两条名称不同的具体路线，并为每条路线呈现封面、距离、预计步数和主题分类等用于发现与比较的信息。
outcomes.quote: 紧接着是核心的精选路线展示区
test_cases: 检查首屏之后的精选路线区，验证其中至少有两张名称不同且明确属于城市步行或街巷漫游的路线卡片；逐张确认具有可辨识的路线或街景封面、带单位的正数距离、标注清楚的正数预计步数，以及与路线内容相符的主题标签。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面提供一条明确命名的主推路线拆解，将其组织为多个有先后关系的路程段或途经点，并为各段提供叙述和坐标或等价的明确定位信息。
outcomes.quote: 再往下是一大块沉浸式的单线拆解说明，比如本周主推的城南旧事路线
test_cases: 在主推路线说明中确认路线名称，并按页面给出的顺序检查多个路程段或途经点；验证各段均有可理解的行程叙述和与该段对应的位置标注。若使用经纬度，确认纬度和经度分别处于有效范围；若使用页面声明的等价定位方式，确认其能明确区分各途经点。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够在页面底部填写路线名、途经点和避坑指南，其中适合长文本的字段支持多行内容；表单按其声明的规则校验输入，并对有效提交给出明确的客户端结果反馈。
outcomes.quote: 页面的最后是一个路线共创的表单容器，包含路线名、途经点、避坑指南等几个多行文本域
test_cases: 依据表单标注的必填规则保留必填内容为空并提交；验证提交未被当作成功路线接受，相关字段出现清晰且可见的错误提示，而不是按钮点击后毫无响应。
填写一个独特的路线名，并在途经点和避坑指南文本域中分别输入包含换行的有效内容后提交；验证换行内容能够被完整录入，且页面出现明确的成功确认，并通过路线名或提交摘要表明反馈对应本次填写的数据。

core_scope.purpose: 构建一个城市步行路线聚合页，使用户能够按区划或街区发现路线、浏览精选路线及主推路线的具体信息，并通过共创表单分享自己的路线。
review_notes: 将城市步行主题、精选路线内容、地点搜索、主推路线拆解和路线共创保留为核心，因为它们直接支撑路线发现与分享目的。

未将配色、字体、卡片外观、视差、悬浮缩放、焦点动画、响应式折叠、触控尺寸和参考稿布局提升为核心，这些仍按补充要求评分。

检查项30主要约束左右栏排版，但也涉及核心叙述内容的承载方式，因此保留为混合项，而不是独立核心结果。

ambiguities: The request does not prescribe usage dimensions, thresholds, rates, currency, billing period, or whether tiers are progressive or volume-based. Numerical correctness must therefore be evaluated against the pricing model declared by the page rather than an invented model.

No exact desktop viewport dimensions are stated for the no-scroll requirement, so viewport fit should remain a supplementary layout check at an agreed reference size rather than a core calculator gate.
The word "instantly" provides no numeric latency limit; continuous updates during slider movement without a separate submission action are the observable requirement.

outcomes.endpoint: The user can independently adjust at least two usage sliders, see their selected quantities, and receive a continuously updated total that preserves and combines all inputs, applies the page's declared tier rules correctly, remains valid at input extremes, and identifies the price currency and applicable billing period.
outcomes.quote: The tool itself must be a stateful interactive calculator where dragging multiple usage sliders instantly evaluates tiered logic.
test_cases: Using the tier thresholds, rates, and calculation method declared by the page, hold all but one usage slider at known values and set the selected slider below a threshold, exactly at it, and above it. At each setting, independently calculate the expected combined price and verify that the displayed usage and total, including currency and billing-period labeling where applicable, match exactly.

Set the first of at least two sliders to a non-default value, then drag a second slider through multiple values while the pointer remains held. Verify that the first value is retained, the second value and total update during the drag without an Apply or Calculate action, and sampled totals equal the combination of all current inputs under the declared pricing rules.

For each slider, set it to its minimum and maximum while keeping the other inputs at known values. Verify that the displayed quantities and independently calculated combined totals agree and remain finite, non-negative numeric values rather than NaN, undefined, blank, or otherwise invalid output.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a user to estimate a usage-based price by adjusting multiple usage inputs and receiving an immediate, correctly tiered, and intelligible total.
review_notes: Collapsed slider state, tier evaluation, combined totals, boundary handling, and price interpretation into one end-to-end calculator outcome because they form a single user flow.

Moved the CSS chart, its labels and animation, and the oversized presentation of the total to supplementary scope. They are requested visualization and styling features but are not indispensable to obtaining a correct usage-price estimate.
Item 23 is mixed because it checks both the core real-time total update and the supplementary CSS chart update.
Kept quantity units and currency or billing-period labeling in the core flow because otherwise the calculator's inputs and resulting price are not intelligible.

Treated single-file delivery, external-resource restrictions, screenshot fidelity, viewport behavior, navigation wording, and general implementation hygiene as supplementary constraints rather than separate end-user outcomes.

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带红色细线的中文那套」那一份基本一致（大量使用中文传统衬线体（宋体/明朝体）和古典英文衬线体，字距、行距非常宽松，具有强烈的古籍或传统印书气质。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「深蓝与亮黄配色的那套」在这一面是：通篇使用现代感极强的无衬线体，标题粗壮，大号加粗的无衬线数字尤为醒目。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「深蓝与亮黄配色的那套」那一份（通篇使用现代感极强的无衬线体，标题粗壮，大号加粗的无衬线数字尤为醒目。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「黑白红新闻报纸那套」在这一面是：主标题、报头使用了醒目的大号粗衬线体（Serif）强化新闻感，而正文和红色的全大写小字栏目标签则使用无衬线体搭配。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「黑白红新闻报纸那套」那一份（主标题、报头使用了醒目的大号粗衬线体（Serif）强化新闻感，而正文和红色的全大写小字栏目标签则使用无衬线体搭配。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「黑白红新闻报纸那套」那一份（组件极其克制，图片直角无圆角无遮挡，文章列表无外框底色，按钮为体积很小的暗红色微圆角矩形。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「黑白红新闻报纸那套」那样：极致的黑白灰底色，只在最关键的分类标签、序号和交互按钮上点缀暗红色（深红），典型的数字报纸经典配色。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。

ambiguities: “几个分类筛选下拉框” does not state an exact count; checklist item 18 interprets it as at least two, so that interpretation remains supplementary rather than a core gate.

The request asks for visible search and email-subscription forms but does not specify real filtering, persistence, mailing-list integration, or another backend transaction; none is inferred as a core endpoint.
“网格里如果带配图” makes article imagery conditional. The enlargement behavior applies to cards that have images, but the archive itself does not require every card to contain one.

A three-column grid does not itself prescribe a minimum article count. Checklist item 19 combines archive-content existence with the layout-motivated requirement of at least three cards, so it is mapped as mixed.
The request does not define an exact mobile breakpoint; the approximately 390px interpretation in checklist item 22 is a supplementary responsive-layout test.

outcomes.endpoint: The visible page clearly identifies itself as “无声电台” and presents a nonempty, intelligible archive of distinct podcast/radio article entries with recognizable titles and theme-appropriate content, rather than unrelated reference-site material.
outcomes.quote: 这是我本学期 Web 课程的期末作业，需要做一个名为「无声电台」的文章归档页。核心思路是做一个有质感、信息展示清晰的独立博客站点。
test_cases: Open the delivered page and verify that the visible site identity is “无声电台”; then inspect the past-articles area and confirm it contains distinct entries with readable article titles and podcast/radio-archive content rather than an empty placeholder or unrelated construction, news, or engraving material.

Read at least two displayed archive entries and confirm they are distinguishable article records with recognizable titles; for any entry that includes artwork, confirm its image or placeholder is visibly rendered rather than broken.

outcomes.endpoint: The submitted artifact opens as a single self-contained HTML page without network access, with no externally hosted scripts, styles, fonts, or images and with all visible imagery implemented using solid-color or embedded data resources.
outcomes.quote: 必须完全满足作业的交付约束：必须能离线打开，不许有任何外链资源（字体用系统自带的衬线族兜底，图片全用纯色色块或 Base64 占位）。
test_cases: Using a clean browser session with network access disabled, open only the submitted local HTML file and verify that the “无声电台” archive content, styling, and visible image placeholders render without broken resources, while the page load produces no HTTP or HTTPS resource requests.

core_scope.purpose: Deliver a single-file, offline-capable “无声电台” page whose primary end-user purpose is to present a clear, readable archive of podcast/radio articles. The prescribed layout, visual treatment, responsive behavior, forms, navigation, and image lightbox are supporting requirements rather than separate core outcomes.
review_notes: Added the missing informational core: the page must actually identify “无声电台” and expose intelligible, relevant archive entries. The original proposal treated structure and interactions as core while leaving the archive content itself supplementary.

Moved the four-section ordering, desktop/mobile grid arrangement, and viewport-overflow checks out of core because they concern layout and responsive presentation rather than the non-substitutable archive endpoint.

Moved the image lightbox and its close/image-switch behavior out of core. It is an explicitly requested enhancement, but removing it would not prevent users from accessing the article archive’s primary information.
Kept the offline, no-external-resource, single-file delivery requirement as core because violating it makes the requested assignment artifact unusable in its required delivery mode.

Classified items 12, 19, 20, and 28 as mixed because they combine evidence about the core archive with supplementary section ordering, card-count/layout, conditional imagery, or filter-copy requirements.

Collapsed setup and click steps into complete scenarios that verify the final informational or offline-delivery endpoint rather than treating control discovery and individual actions as separate core tests.
No filtering or subscription transaction was invented: the request only specifies those controls/forms, and the available checks do not define a business result for either flow.
