ambiguities: The request does not prescribe exact account or background fields, required-field sets, or validation formats. End-to-end tests should follow the labels and validation rules declared by the implemented page rather than impose unstated email, password, school, company, or experience requirements.
No backend transaction, persistence contract, or specific success message is requested; a clear visible completion state is sufficient for this offline single-page implementation.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can complete an exactly three-step hackathon registration flow covering basic account creation, participant-role selection, and personal background collection. Valid data advances through each step to a clearly visible completion state; invalid required data prevents advancement or completion and produces intelligible field-specific errors.
outcomes.quote: 整个注册分成三步
test_cases: Load the page and verify it presents a hackathon registration with exactly three identifiable stages. Enter valid account data according to the displayed rules in Step 1 and activate the next-step control; verify Step 2 replaces Step 1. Select one offered participant role and advance; verify Step 3 presents personal-background fields. Fill all declared required fields with valid data, submit, and verify a clear visible registration-complete state.

Start a fresh registration, leave required Step 1 account fields empty or violate any explicitly displayed format rule, and attempt to advance. Verify the flow remains on Step 1 and intelligible errors identify the corresponding invalid fields. Correct the values according to the displayed rules and verify advancement to Step 2 succeeds.

Start a fresh registration and complete Steps 1 and 2 with valid data, including selecting a role. In Step 3 leave declared required background fields empty or invalid and attempt final submission; verify no completion state appears and the affected fields receive intelligible errors. Correct those fields, submit again, and verify the registration reaches its visible completion state.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a user to complete a three-step hackathon registration by creating basic account details, selecting a participant role, providing personal background information, and receiving a clear completion result while invalid required data is rejected.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposed content, transition, validation, and completion groups into one end-to-end registration outcome because they are parts and valid/invalid scenarios of the same primary user flow.

Kept checklist IDs 17, 24, 26, 32, and 33 as mixed because they assess core role selection, progression, or validation while also requiring supplementary presentation details such as icons, progress-indicator updates, view hiding, or exact error placement.

Removed the fixed progress indicator from core membership. It is requested navigation feedback, but registration can still achieve its primary endpoint without sticky positioning or a particular visual progress treatment.

Removed mobile reflow, viewport overflow, long-string resilience, reference-inspired layouts, colors, typography, graphics, focus styling, and transition appearance from core membership because they are layout or presentation requirements rather than the registration endpoint.

Kept pill-shaped buttons, exact button wording, required-field stars, and role selected-state styling supplementary even though some are emphatically requested; they remain scored requirements but are not independent user goals.

Kept single-file packaging, external-resource restrictions, and generic JavaScript-error checks supplementary. They constrain delivery and robustness but do not by themselves establish that a user can complete the registration.

ambiguities: The phrase "filtering by date or topic" does not unambiguously require both filter types, while checklist item 24 requires both simultaneously. The acceptance text specifically establishes year navigation but does not define required topic-filter behavior.

The request says the progress bar should update as the reader passes entries, but does not precisely choose between continuous scroll-distance progress and discrete entry-based progress. Checklist item 35 imposes a more specific entry-relative calculation.
The requested chronological direction is not specified; ascending and descending timelines are both compatible with the request, as recognized by checklist item 20.

outcomes.endpoint: The page identifies a specific ongoing news topic and presents multiple dated updates with enough contextual explanation, in one consistent chronological direction, for a reader to understand how the story developed over time.
outcomes.quote: A news timeline tracker for big ongoing stories. It's meant to help readers catch up on long-running events step by step without getting overwhelmed.
test_cases: Load the page and use only its visible content to identify the news topic from the headline or equivalent topic labeling; then inspect the timeline and verify that it contains at least two distinct dated updates about that same ongoing story, with each update providing intelligible progress or background rather than only a title.

Record the dates of all displayed timeline updates in their presented order, verify that they consistently move either forward or backward in time without reversals, and read the contextual text to confirm that a reader can explain the sequence of developments from the entries.

core_scope.purpose: Enable readers to identify a specific ongoing news story and catch up on its development through an intelligible sequence of dated, contextual updates.
review_notes: Collapsed the proposal to the single non-substitutable reader outcome: understanding a long-running news story through dated, contextual, chronologically ordered updates.

Moved the sticky progress bar, hover summary cards, and year-filter navigation out of core. They are explicitly requested enhancements, but removing them still leaves a usable chronological tracker through which readers can catch up by reading or scrolling.

Kept items 17, 18, 21, and 30 as mixed because they partially assess core topic identification, timeline sequencing, or topical coherence while also imposing layout, sizing, node styling, or universal-content constraints.

Kept visual references, desktop width, component styling, animation quality, email signup, theme, self-containment, generic robustness, and anti-placeholder checks supplementary because they do not independently establish the primary informational endpoint.
Replaced the proposal's fragmented interaction steps with self-contained scenarios that verify the final informational result rather than merely locating or observing individual controls.

ambiguities: The request requires a prominent 「检索输入框位」 to support findability, but does not unambiguously require client-side filtering, result navigation, or no-match feedback. Items 29 and 39 therefore should not establish a core search transaction.

The words 「今天」「当天」「每天」 do not specify a live feed, backend, publication date, or factual-freshness source. An offline static-page review should assess content presented as the current edition, not require real-time retrieval.

A fixed-width sidebar and the prohibition on nested horizontal scrolling can conflict in very narrow iframe containers. The request does not state whether the sidebar may collapse, stack, or otherwise reflow at those widths.

outcomes.endpoint: The homepage communicates one clearly identified principal technology event and multiple distinct daily technology briefs, rather than unrelated, placeholder, or reference-screenshot content.
outcomes.quote:
1. 头条区：在最上方做一块全宽的背景大区，放今天最核心的一条科技大事件。
2. 资讯网格：头条下方做成两列或三列的网格布局，铺开罗列当天的日常快讯。
test_cases: Load the page and read the principal-news area; verify that it contains one clearly titled technology event presented as the day’s main story, with enough substantive text to identify what happened rather than only a category label or decorative heading.

Load the page and read the daily-news area; verify that it contains at least two distinct technology updates, and that the entries are actual news briefs rather than placeholders, copied reference-industry material, or repetitions of the principal headline.

outcomes.endpoint: The page explains one genuine technical term from or clearly related to its news content in one or two meaningful sentences.
outcomes.quote: 概念解析：在最下方留一个小区，每天用一两句话解释一个新闻里的技术黑话。
test_cases: Load the page, identify the single term in the concept-explanation section, and inspect the headline and briefs for its stated or evident connection; then verify that the accompanying one or two sentences explain the term’s meaning rather than merely repeating or naming it.

outcomes.endpoint: The headline, daily briefs, and technical-term explanation are intelligible to a reader without prior technical knowledge.
outcomes.quote: 我们的受众是完全的技术小白，所以信息呈现必须极其直白，不能有任何理解门槛。
test_cases: Load the page and read the headline, every visible daily brief, and the concept explanation using only the information supplied on the page; verify that each states what happened or what the term means in direct language, with specialist acronyms or jargon avoided or explained where used.

core_scope.purpose: Enable nontechnical readers to understand the day’s principal technology event, scan additional technology news, and learn a related technical term from the 「长明」 homepage.
review_notes: The headline and daily briefs were consolidated into one news-digest outcome because they form the same primary information flow; the concept explainer remains separate because it provides a distinct educational goal.
Beginner intelligibility was retained as a core outcome because removing it would directly defeat the expressly identified audience and primary purpose.

Items 19, 20, 22, 25, and 36 are mixed because they partly establish requested information or section identity while also enforcing order, sizing, full-width treatment, grid columns, or other layout details.
Items 33 and 34 are mixed because topical, non-placeholder content supports the core news endpoint, while their exact originality and named-reference exclusions are narrower precision requirements.

Sidebar controls, category navigation, search behavior, branding precision, warning/note presentation, semantic implementation details, visual references, colors, typography, and component styling remain supplementary rather than independent core goals.

Single-file packaging, external-resource restrictions, narrow-iframe overflow handling, and long-token resilience were removed from core membership because they are delivery or layout constraints, not the end-user informational endpoint.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「D」份「深色带渐变条的主页」：极具视觉冲击力的无衬线排版，主标题字号极大（占据大半屏幕宽度），与正文形成极其强烈的字号反差。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「D」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：字号档数：「D」17档 vs 「A」9档；字族：「D」inter/times vs 「A」barlow/montserrat/themify；字重档数：「D」5档 vs 「A」2档。产出应落在「D」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「深色带渐变条的主页」那一份基本一致（极具视觉冲击力的无衬线排版，主标题字号极大（占据大半屏幕宽度），与正文形成极其强烈的字号反差。）？

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「三列卡片排版的博客」在这一面是：常规的无衬线字体，标题和正文字号对比度适中，主要依靠字重区分层级。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「三列卡片排版的博客」那一份（常规的无衬线字体，标题和正文字号对比度适中，主要依靠字重区分层级。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「浅绿导航的单栏文章」那一份（大标题使用了略微窄体的无衬线大写字母，正文为常规字号，整体偏向文档阅读风格。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「带侧边栏的数据面板」在这一面是：典型的后台UI字体排版，字号普遍偏小，信息密度高，通过加粗和低对比度颜色区分数据标签。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 14px、最大标题字号 56px、字号档数 9档、字族 barlow/montserrat/themify、字重档数 2档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带侧边栏的数据面板」那一份（典型的后台UI字体排版，字号普遍偏小，信息密度高，通过加粗和低对比度颜色区分数据标签。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「三列卡片排版的博客」：文章卡片采用极简的白底无边框扁平设计，直角或极小圆角，底部有带红色短横线的文字链接。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大圆角：「A」4px vs 「C」100px；圆角档数：「A」1档 vs 「C」7档；是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「A」无 vs 「C」有。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带侧边栏的数据面板」那一份（数据卡片具有清晰的浅灰色细描边，明显的圆角，内部包含胶囊状（Pill）标签和细长进度条。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「深色带渐变条的主页」那一份（组件采用深色背景，带有发光效果或微妙描边，大圆角，大量使用蓝紫霓虹渐变色的进度条和输入框。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本全部内联，无任何外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求「全屏沉浸式 AQI 渲染地图」以及「高信息密度的全景底图」，因此地图需同时具备可辨识的地理信息与空气质量数据覆盖层。
keypoints.question: 主地图是否实际呈现可辨识的地理底图，并叠加覆盖多个位置或区域的 AQI 热力着色、监测点或数值标记，而不是仅以静态渐变背景或空白占位元素模拟地图？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「表单支持输入经纬度自动聚焦地图坐标」，同时要求顶部设置搜索定位组件。
keypoints.question: 在顶部搜索定位组件或其关联定位表单中输入有效经纬度并提交后，地图是否可见地聚焦到对应坐标，并通过中心标记、坐标回显或其他明确视觉反馈显示定位结果？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求实时地图顶部包含时间轴；作为数据地图的时间轴不能只是静态装饰，应能切换对应时段的数据状态。
keypoints.question: 拖动或点选时间轴上的另一个时刻后，当前时间指示是否移动，且地图热力层、AQI 数值或更新时间至少有一项随所选时间产生可见变化？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户将页面定义为「空气质量监控与数据分发的实时地图页」，需要让用户能够判断当前展示的是实时数据还是历史时段数据。
keypoints.question: 页面是否明确显示当前数据的实时性或新鲜度信息，例如「实时/Live」状态、最近更新时间或当前观测时刻，并且该信息与时间轴当前选中时间一致？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求「切换污染物指标（如 PM10, NO2）时，主图层热力数据平滑重绘」；现有条目仅检查数据发生变化，未检查平滑重绘过程。
keypoints.question: 污染物指标切换时，热力图层是否通过连续的颜色、透明度或分布过渡完成重绘，而不是瞬间闪烁、整层消失后重现或完全静止不变？

keypoints.basis: 用户将多维组合筛选器以及多区域、多污染物指标的叠加明确列为实时地图页的核心诉求。
keypoints.question: 多维筛选器是否允许同时选择多个区域和多个污染物，并在组合条件变化后由地图叠加图层及配套图例或概览清楚反映全部当前筛选条件，而非退化为单区域或单指标切换？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求地图支持多区域、多污染物指标的下钻，但没有规定下钻详情必须包含哪些固定字段。
keypoints.question: 点击地图中的区域、监测点或筛选结果后，是否能够进入或展开更细粒度的空气质量详情，并清楚呈现与所选对象及当前筛选条件对应的数据？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求提供用于历史报告下载的查询表单，因此应验证查询条件能够生效并产生实际可下载的报告，但不应额外规定未明确要求的固定字段。
keypoints.question: 提交历史报告查询表单后，是否会依据表单中实际提供并选定的查询条件生成可下载的报告文件，且下载结果与所选条件相符，而非按钮仅有外观或点击后无反馈？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户的明确验收要求是「地图缩放平移无明显掉帧卡顿」；现有条目只验证缩放和平移能力存在，未覆盖流畅度。
keypoints.question: 连续执行地图拖拽和平移，并快速多次放大、缩小时，地图内容与叠加层是否持续跟随操作且无明显卡顿、长时间冻结、跳帧或图层错位？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

ambiguities: “实时”未指定数据源、刷新周期或远程 API；离线自包含页面可使用内置数据和可见时间状态，但不应被要求连接真实实时服务。
“下钻”未指定必须到站点、独立详情页或其他固定层级；核心测试应接受页面规则所定义的、与所选对象一致的有意义细粒度详情。清单项 24 额外指定了从区域到站点，因此作为混合覆盖项处理。
历史报告的文件格式、字段和生成方式未指定；应依据页面声明的查询字段检查下载结果，不应擅自要求 CSV、PDF、服务器事务或特定模式。
经纬度定位和时间轴是明确要求的功能，但请求另行将多区域、多污染物叠加与下钻称为“核心诉求”。本提案因此将定位和时间轴保留为补充要求，而未把它们提升为独立的核心业务门槛。

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access and understand current air-quality conditions on a recognizable geographic map showing AQI or pollutant data at multiple locations, together with an internally consistent live status or observation time.
outcomes.quote: 需要搭建一个空气质量监控与数据分发的实时地图页。
test_cases: Load the page in its default state and verify that a recognizable geographic base map displays AQI heat, monitoring markers, or numeric readings at multiple locations; using the visible labels, legend, or location details, confirm that the pollutant and value, unit, or level are intelligible and that a live or observation-time indication is present and internally consistent.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can apply multiple region and pollutant selections concurrently, see the exact active combination represented in the map and its legend or overview, change pollutant data without merely changing a control label, and open a mapped result to obtain finer-grained air-quality details consistent with the active context. Smooth animation is supplementary.
outcomes.quote: 核心诉求是建立高信息密度的全景底图与多维组合筛选器，支持多区域、多污染物指标的叠加与下钻。
test_cases: Using the page's available choices, select two regions and two pollutants concurrently and verify that the map plus its legend or overview explicitly represents all four active choices rather than retaining only the last region or pollutant.

Starting with a multi-region selection, replace one selected pollutant with another for which the page declares different data and verify that the map distribution or labeled pollutant values and legend correspond to the new exact pollutant set while the retained region selections remain active; do not accept an unchanged map accompanied only by a changed button state.

With a combined filter active, select a region, monitoring point, or mapped result and verify that the resulting finer-grained detail identifies the selected object and presents air-quality data consistent with the currently selected regions and pollutants.

outcomes.endpoint: Submitting the report query produces a nonempty downloadable historical report whose content or metadata represents the date range and other criteria actually selected in the form; no remote backend or particular file format is required.
outcomes.quote: 用于历史报告下载的查询表单
test_cases: Choose a valid date range and any region or pollutant criteria offered by the form, submit through normal page controls, and verify that a file is downloaded and that its content or embedded metadata identifies the selected range and filters rather than containing unrelated generic data.
Repeat the query after changing one available criterion and verify that the newly downloaded report represents the changed criterion and differs accordingly from the first result.

core_scope.purpose: Enable users to monitor current air quality geographically, compare combined region and pollutant data, drill into finer details, and distribute selected historical data through downloadable reports.
review_notes: 移除了全屏铺图、悬浮布局、移动端折叠和大字号不断行等核心结果；这些是布局或视口适配要求，仍由补充清单评分。
将污染物切换并入多维组合筛选流程，避免把同一数据筛选流程拆成重复核心结果。清单项 23 同时检查实际数据更新和连续过渡动画，因此放入 mixed_item_ids；纯动画检查项 33 保持补充。
空气质量地图核心只映射能够验证地理数据呈现和数据新鲜度的检查。主题文字、面板存在以及视觉风格本身不能证明监控端点成立。
历史报告下载保留为核心，因为它是请求中“数据分发”的具体业务端点；表单和字段存在性检查项 18、19 只是该端点的准备条件，实际下载及条件一致性由检查项 36 覆盖。
经纬度定位、时间轴操作、地图缩放平移性能、自包含交付和无脚本异常均保留为补充要求；它们重要但不是此页面主要监控、组合分析和数据分发目标的独立不可替代结果。

items.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「深色带渐变条的主页」那一份基本一致（极具视觉冲击力的无衬线排版，主标题字号极大（占据大半屏幕宽度），与正文形成极其强烈的字号反差。）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「B」份「青色医疗资讯那份」：标题采用深色粗体无衬线字，正文行距宽松且字号适中，标题与正文之间有清晰明显的字号和字重层级对比。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「B」15px vs 「A」20px；字族：「B」font/roboto vs 「A」lato/times。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「青色医疗资讯那份」那一份基本一致（标题采用深色粗体无衬线字，正文行距宽松且字号适中，标题与正文之间有清晰明显的字号和字重层级对比）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「浅色极简大留白那份」在这一面是：全站无衬线体，标题多采用全大写、细字重和浅灰色，与正文的字重对比偏弱，整体呈现轻盈感。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「浅色极简大留白那份」那一份（全站无衬线体，标题多采用全大写、细字重和浅灰色，与正文的字重对比偏弱，整体呈现轻盈感）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「浅色极简大留白那份」：组件高度极简，去除了常规卡片容器，按钮多为直角线框或简单的直角实心色块（如底部的红色按钮），表单输入框仅保留下划线。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「浅色极简大留白那份」那一份神似（组件高度极简，去除了常规卡片容器，按钮多为直角线框或简单的直角实心色块（如底部的红色按钮），表单输入框仅保留下划线，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「青色医疗资讯那份」在这一面是：使用了典型的现代界面组件，包括带有圆角的实心青色按钮、带圆角的线框标签（Tags）以及包含图片的列表项结构。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「青色医疗资讯那份」那一份（使用了典型的现代界面组件，包括带有圆角的实心青色按钮、带圆角的线框标签（Tags）以及包含图片的列表项结构）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（ground_dark）。判法：渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：整页底色我要深的，字浮在深底上（判法：渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35）？
keypoints.spec_check: 渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（nav_left_rail）。判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：导航我要竖着放在左边，不要横在上面（判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度）？
keypoints.spec_check: 导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'做个能单文件跑起来的精品咖啡馆官网'
keypoints.question: 整个页面的主题是否整体呈现为一家精品咖啡馆的官网（出现咖啡豆/手冲/菜单/风味等咖啡馆语境的内容），而非其他行业主题？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'屏幕进来先是大头图区，放咖啡馆手冲吧台的照片'
keypoints.question: 首屏是否有一块大尺寸主视觉区域，其中的图像可辨识为咖啡馆手冲吧台场景（而非与咖啡无关的图形或纯色占位）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'压上两句显眼的介绍“寻找世界尽头的微批次”'
keypoints.question: 首屏主视觉上的文案是否精确出现“寻找世界尽头的微批次”这句话？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求在首屏大头图区“压上两句显眼的介绍”。
keypoints.question: 首屏主视觉上是否叠加了两句彼此可区分的显眼介绍文案，而不是只出现一句孤立文案？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'左侧的导航要一直固定在那'
keypoints.question: 页面向下滚动到中部或底部后，左侧的竖向导航是否仍固定停留在视口左侧可见（而不是随内容滚走）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求设置左侧竖向导航；作为导航，其条目应能够将用户带到对应页面区域。
keypoints.question: 左侧导航是否包含指向页面内容板块的可用条目，且点击条目后能够定位到对应的页面区域？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'能在“意式经典”和“特调创意”两个列表间无缝无感切换'
keypoints.question: 特色菜单区是否提供了“意式经典”和“特调创意”这两个精确命名的切换项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'这块一定要做个平滑的状态切换功能，能在“意式经典”和“特调创意”两个列表间无缝无感切换'
keypoints.question: 点击“特调创意”切换项后，菜单列表内容是否被替换为与“意式经典”不同的另一组条目，且停留在当前页面内（未跳转或刷新为空白）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'加一个展示咖啡豆风味的图表区，用原生代码手写一个稍微复杂点的数据可视化雷达图'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个咖啡豆风味的雷达图（多边形/蛛网形的数据可视化图形，而非柱状图、条形进度条或图片占位）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'展示当季豆子的酸度、甜感、醇厚度、余香、平衡这五项指标'
keypoints.question: 雷达图是否恰好为五轴结构，并逐一标注出“酸度”“甜感”“醇厚度”“余香”“平衡”这五项指标名称？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求用雷达图展示当季豆子的酸度、甜感、醇厚度、余香和平衡五项指标，因此图中应包含承载这些数值的数据多边形。
keypoints.question: 雷达图除了网格与轴线外，是否还绘制了一个代表当季豆子五项指标实际数值的数据多边形，使其不是只有空白蛛网网格？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'旁边配的长文刚好能体现刚才说的那种排版对比'
keypoints.question: 雷达图旁侧是否配有一段关于当季豆子的长篇说明文字（多段或至少数行连续正文，而不是一两句短标注）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'底部区域放一个干练的留资表单，收集顾客的邮箱和想咨询的问题'
keypoints.question: 页面底部的留资表单是否至少提供“邮箱”输入项和“想咨询的问题”输入项，以收集这两类信息？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'旁侧写明具体的营业时间和地图坐标'
keypoints.question: 留资表单旁侧是否同时写明具体的营业时间（包含明确营业时段）和可识别的地图坐标（如经纬度或明确的坐标数值）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'右下角再固定一个直角的“立即预订”按钮块'
keypoints.question: 页面右下角是否固定有一个文本精确为“立即预订”的按钮块，且滚动页面时它始终停留在右下角？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'点一下能丝滑滚动到最底下的留言区'
keypoints.question: 点击右下角的“立即预订”按钮后，页面是否通过可见的平滑滚动动画定位到底部的留资/留言表单区域，而非瞬间跳转或无响应？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'整个长页面往下滚的时候，图文内容要有序地从下往上渐渐浮现'
keypoints.question: 向下滚动页面时，尚未进入视口的图文板块是否处于隐藏/下移状态，滚动到位后才逐个显现（即存在滚动入场的显现效果，而非一开始就全部静态可见）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'手机端浏览的时候左边的垂直导航记得收折起来'
keypoints.question: 把浏览器宽度缩到手机尺寸后，左侧竖向导航是否收折起来（隐藏为汉堡/折叠触发器，点击后才展开导航项），而不是继续占据大片屏幕宽度？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求只借参考截图的设计语言（字体排版、组件极简形态），不复用其文字与行业内容
keypoints.question: 页面所有可见文案是否全部围绕精品咖啡馆主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名（如 Medic、Twenty、HTML5 UP）或医疗类条目（如 Alumni、Psycology、Sonogram、X-Ray、Dental、Appointment 等）？

ambiguities: “收集” specifies a fillable inquiry form but does not define persistence, a delivery destination, or a success response; the core endpoint therefore does not require an invented backend transaction.

No numeric values or scale are prescribed for the five radar metrics, so chart correctness must be evaluated against the values and scale declared by the page rather than an arbitrary expected profile.

“无缝无感” is subjective and combines the functional ability to switch lists with transition polish; bidirectional content replacement is core, while animation smoothness remains the mixed portion of item 30.
The request requires two prominent hero introduction lines but supplies exact wording for only one, so no arbitrary second sentence is treated as a core content gate.

outcomes.endpoint: A recognizable boutique coffee shop website loads from one self-contained HTML file, with its content, styling, imagery, and interactions available without external network dependencies.
outcomes.quote: 做个能单文件跑起来的精品咖啡馆官网
test_cases: Disable network access, load the sole HTML file from disk, and traverse its menu, bean-flavor, and bottom contact content; verify that the rendered page remains recognizably about a boutique coffee shop and that no required image, style, font, or script depends on a remote request.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can switch in both directions between distinct, multi-item lists of semantically appropriate Italian-classic and creative-specialty coffee drinks without leaving or reloading the page.
outcomes.quote: 能在“意式经典”和“特调创意”两个列表间无缝无感切换
test_cases: In the menu section, record the initially displayed multi-item list, activate “特调创意”, and verify that a different multi-item set of appropriate creative drinks replaces it without navigation or reload; then activate “意式经典” and verify that the original appropriate classic-drink list is restored without duplicated or overlapping content.

outcomes.endpoint: The seasonal-bean section communicates a five-metric flavor profile through a locally rendered five-axis radar chart with a non-empty data polygon and an intelligible accompanying long-form bean description.
outcomes.quote: 加一个展示咖啡豆风味的图表区，用原生代码手写一个稍微复杂点的数据可视化雷达图，展示当季豆子的酸度、甜感、醇厚度、余香、平衡这五项指标，旁边配的长文刚好能体现刚才说的那种排版对比。
test_cases: Open the flavor section offline and verify that the visualization is a five-axis polygonal radar chart, not a bar chart or image placeholder, with exactly the labels “酸度”, “甜感”, “醇厚度”, “余香”, and “平衡”; using the values declared by the page in its visible or inline local data, verify that one five-vertex data polygon represents those values rather than showing only an empty grid, and read the adjacent multi-line seasonal-bean explanation to confirm it is substantive and intelligible.

outcomes.endpoint: The bottom section provides a usable lead form in which a visitor can enter an email address and a consultation question and has an explicit submission control; no remote delivery backend is implied.
outcomes.quote: 底部区域放一个干练的留资表单，收集顾客的邮箱和想咨询的问题
test_cases: At the bottom form, enter “guest@example.com” in the email control and a distinctive multi-line consultation question in the question control, move focus between the controls, and verify that both exact values remain associated with the correct fields and that an enabled, explicit submission control is available for the completed form.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can read concrete opening hours and recognizable numeric map coordinates beside the bottom inquiry area.
outcomes.quote: 旁侧写明具体的营业时间和地图坐标。
test_cases: Reach the bottom inquiry area and use the displayed information to identify at least one explicit opening interval with concrete times and a recognizable numeric coordinate pair; verify that both pieces of visit information are legible and are not vague placeholders such as “营业中” or “查看地图” alone.

outcomes.endpoint: A non-technical owner can find clearly commented editable areas in the single-file source, including the exact “在这里修改店名” anchor adjacent to the source value that controls the visible shop name.
outcomes.quote: 所有代码区块都要留好清晰的中文注释，小白店主只要一搜“在这里修改店名”就能找到地方替换，对新手绝对友好。
test_cases: Copy the HTML file, search its source for the exact comment “在这里修改店名”, replace the adjacent shop-name value with a unique test name, save and reload the file, and verify that the visible shop name changes to that exact test value rather than the comment being an ineffective marker.

Inspect the major HTML, CSS, and JavaScript sections and the editable menu and business-information locations, follow their clear Chinese comments to change one menu item or opening-time value, then reload the local page and verify that the corresponding visible content reflects the edit.

core_scope.purpose: Deliver a self-contained, novice-editable boutique coffee shop website that lets visitors understand the menu and seasonal bean profile, obtain visit information, and enter inquiry details without relying on external network resources.
review_notes: The dark theme, left-side fixed navigation, responsive navigation collapse, section order, typography, component styling, scrolling reveals, and smooth-scroll booking control were removed from core scope because they are layout, appearance, animation, or incidental navigation requirements rather than non-substitutable visitor goals.
The menu items and switching behavior remain core, but item 30 is mixed because it combines bidirectional endpoint behavior with visual transition quality.
The seasonal-bean long-form explanation in item 18 was promoted from supplementary scope because it is requested information accompanying the emphasized flavor-profile section, not merely decoration.
Concrete opening hours and map coordinates in item 20 were promoted to a distinct core informational outcome because they support the non-substitutable visitor goal of planning a visit.
The form outcome is limited to a usable offline collection interface with the requested fields and control; it does not invent remote submission, storage, validation rules, or confirmation behavior.

The single-file and coffee-site checks were collapsed into one delivery outcome, while source customization remains separate because novice owner editing is an independent primary purpose of the requested scaffold.

Hero treatment and exact promotional presentation remain supplementary: their removal would affect branding and composition but would not eliminate the menu, bean information, visit details, inquiry interface, or novice-editable single-file scaffold.

ambiguities: The request requires multi-select method filtering but does not explicitly define its Boolean semantics. GET, POST, and PATCH would ordinarily form a union while category and method filters form an intersection, as assumed by items 34 and 35, but testing should follow any clearly declared page rule rather than inventing an alternative.

No authoritative endpoint inventory, schemas, or sample payload values are supplied. Endpoint and JSON correspondence can therefore be checked only against metadata or schemas declared consistently within the page; the benchmark should not invent required financial-domain fields.

The global search input is requested as a header element, but no search behavior or result semantics are specified. Its existence and labeling remain supplementary rather than implying an unrequested search transaction.
The versioned semantic amendment's endpoint/test wording supersedes any narrower legacy checklist or review wording; original provenance is retained.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly identifies the enterprise high-frequency ledger synchronization offering, communicates its value proposition, and provides intelligible summaries of the three named platform capabilities.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 14 checks that descriptive paragraphs exist but does not check that their content is intelligible and relevant to the named capabilities.
outcomes.quote: We are building a comprehensive, single-page Developer API Portal for an enterprise financial data pipeline, specifically focusing on high-frequency ledger synchronization.
test_cases: Load the page and read the hero and all three capability cards. Verify that the hero intelligibly explains an enterprise high-frequency ledger synchronization or financial-data-pipeline value proposition, and that cards titled exactly "Secure Authentication (OAuth 2.0)", "Real-time Event Streaming", and "Historical Batch Processing" each include a brief, relevant explanation rather than placeholder text.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can browse a catalog containing more than 200 combined REST routes and WebSocket channels, narrow it by sidebar category and multiple method filters, and traverse the resulting client-side pages with no more than 12 endpoint rows per page.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 24 permits a reported count or page total but does not independently verify that more than 200 unique entries are actually navigable and filterable rather than represented by a claim backed by only a small static sample.
outcomes.quote: Our documentation encompasses an enormous volume of technical endpoints—over 200 RESTful routes and WebSocket channels. To prevent cognitive overload, the page requires a robust, stateful filtering and pagination architecture, allowing decision-makers to quickly drill down into the specific services they are evaluating.
test_cases: Clear all filters, page through the catalog using its normal controls, and reconcile the displayed total with unique endpoint identifiers across the pages. Verify that the combined catalog exceeds 200 entries, each visible entry exposes a method or channel type plus a path or channel identifier, each page contains at most 12 rows, and the catalog includes clearly distinguishable REST and WebSocket entries.

Choose a sidebar category and multiple method filters with matches according to the page's declared filter rules, then traverse the filtered result. Verify every row satisfies the selected category and multi-method rule, the displayed count and page total match the filtered rows, selected filters remain active after pagination, and changing to a smaller result recomputes pagination and leaves the current page at a valid page number.

outcomes.endpoint: Selecting an endpoint exposes meaningful corresponding request information and response JSON. Applicable JSON request/response data must be valid and agree with the selected endpoint's declared details; JSON may be shown within the requested cURL/Python/Go examples. A bodyless GET may show its method/path/query parameters or a clear no-body indication rather than fabricating a JSON request body.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 25 and 26 check payload presence and visible change, but no checklist item verifies that the payloads are valid JSON or semantically correspond to the selected endpoint's declared schema or metadata.
outcomes.quote: Right Pane: A fixed interactive code block displaying request and response JSON payloads corresponding to the selected endpoint in the center pane.
test_cases: Select an endpoint with distinguishing method/path, operation or declared fields, then inspect its request example and response JSON. Parse the displayed JSON data itself, extracting JSON bodies from code-example wrappers where needed rather than attempting to parse an entire cURL/Python/Go snippet as JSON. For a bodyless GET, accept meaningful method/path/query information or an explicit no-body indication; still require a corresponding valid response JSON example. Verify that identifying values, fields and any declared request-derived relationships agree with the selected endpoint. Select a second endpoint with different declared details and repeat, checking correspondence rather than only that some panel text changed. Do not invent a backend, an unprovided response schema or a mandatory GET request body.

core_scope.purpose: Enable enterprise technical evaluators to understand LedgerSync's high-frequency ledger platform, discover relevant services across a catalog of more than 200 REST and WebSocket endpoints through stateful filtering and pagination, and inspect endpoint-specific request and response payloads.
review_notes: Added a core informational outcome because technical evaluators must be able to understand the product value proposition and named capabilities; informational content is not merely visual decoration.
Collapsed catalog content, category/method filtering, combined filter state, and pagination into one end-to-end discovery outcome because they are parts of the same service-discovery flow.

Removed mobile degradation from core membership. Hamburger behavior, inline mobile details, viewport fit, stacking, and horizontal-overflow constraints are responsive layout requirements rather than the portal's non-substitutable business outcome.

Limited the core code outcome to endpoint-specific request and response payloads. Language tabs, clipboard copying, and the two-second checkmark are useful supplementary interactions but are not indispensable to evaluating endpoint documentation.
Kept three-pane geometry, sticky positioning, badges, pills, and card structure as mixed or supplementary where the checklist combines core information or behavior with prescribed presentation.

Branding precision, uptime display, CTA count, typography, square corners, hover treatment, fixed navigation, self-contained packaging, and robustness probes remain supplementary requirements even when explicitly requested.

Semantic amendment: The request explicitly allows code-example wrappers around request data. A cURL/Python/Go example is not itself raw JSON and must not be parsed as one. GET endpoints need not invent a JSON request body. Required endpoint-specific response JSON and any applicable request data must still be valid and consistent. The more-than-200 catalog requirement is genuinely explicit and remains unchanged.

keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「米色背景带红字按钮的」那一份（大量采用居中单列的菜单排版，以及左侧细文字右侧大图且留白极多的疏朗不对称排版）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「C」份「有全宽大图和图片网格的」：Logo使用手写花体，小标题和分类标签采用极小字号、宽字距的大写无衬线体，主标题搭配现代感强的粗衬线体。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「C」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「C」32px vs 「B」80px；字族：「C」lora/open/themify vs 「B」times/ui-serif。产出应落在「C」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「有全宽大图和图片网格的」那一份基本一致（Logo使用手写花体，小标题和分类标签采用极小字号、宽字距的大写无衬线体，主标题搭配现代感强的粗衬线体）？

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「带深蓝侧栏及图表的网页」在这一面是：仪表盘部分使用常规无衬线体，博客部分以粗壮有力的衬线体作为大标题并搭配黑底白字的小字号标签。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带深蓝侧栏及图表的网页」那一份（仪表盘部分使用常规无衬线体，博客部分以粗壮有力的衬线体作为大标题并搭配黑底白字的小字号标签）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「米色背景带红字按钮的」在这一面是：主标题使用极具古典感、笔画纤细且字号极大的衬线体，正文使用细弱的无衬线体，字号反差极大。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「米色背景带红字按钮的」那一份（主标题使用极具古典感、笔画纤细且字号极大的衬线体，正文使用细弱的无衬线体，字号反差极大）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「带深蓝侧栏及图表的网页」：包含带浅灰色阴影的白色直角面板卡片、彩色胶囊形状的状态标签（如黄、绿），以及纯红色无圆角的按钮。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大圆角：「A」4px vs 「B」160px；圆角档数：「A」1档 vs 「B」8档；阴影档数：「A」1档 vs 「B」3档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「带深蓝侧栏及图表的网页」那一份基本一致（包含带浅灰色阴影的白色直角面板卡片、彩色胶囊形状的状态标签（如黄、绿），以及纯红色无圆角的按钮）？

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「米色背景带红字按钮的」那一份（几乎没有独立的带框卡片，主要组件为仅有微小圆角的砖红色纯色按钮和极细线条边框的手风琴折叠面板）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「有全宽大图和图片网格的」在这一面是：完全没有带外边框或阴影的卡片组件，图文直接平铺在纯色背景上，没有明显的按钮或输入框等独立控件。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：最大圆角 160px、圆角档数 8档、阴影档数 3档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「有全宽大图和图片网格的」那一份（完全没有带外边框或阴影的卡片组件，图文直接平铺在纯色背景上，没有明显的按钮或输入框等独立控件）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「C」份「有全宽大图和图片网格的」：明快轻松的现代生活方式调性，整体透气开阔，传达出一种活泼、休闲的阅览氛围。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给了「C」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「C」133.1个/千像素高 vs 「B」71.1个/千像素高。产出应落在「C」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「米色背景带红字按钮的」那一份（全站大面积铺满独特的浅米色/暖灰色作为基础底色，主文字为深灰，以复古的砖红色作为部分按钮和标识的强调色）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：元素密度 71.1个/千像素高、底色种类数 0种、间距中位数 8.8px、整页高度 5204px。分派表没有把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。

ambiguities: The phrase “能搜人填表单” establishes a person-search form but does not define exact matching, empty-query, reset, or ordering rules; tests should follow any rules declared by the page rather than impose a particular fuzzy-search algorithm.

The request asks for an FAQ explaining how to vote and mentions red buttons stylistically, but it does not clearly request an in-page voting transaction or persistent vote count. Checklist items 26 and 34 therefore remain supplementary and do not establish a core backend-like voting outcome.

The FAQ is introduced with “顺手带个” and its copy is explicitly temporary in “文案先占位我回头自己改”, so its accordion behavior and exact voting prose are treated as requested supplementary features rather than indispensable leaderboard outcomes.

“支持键盘切焦点” clearly requires keyboard focus access, but it does not prescribe one exact tab index sequence. The meaningful requirement is comprehensible reachability, visible focus, reversibility, and absence of traps.
Checklist references to the undefined “B” source in items 12 and "inv_1" are not sufficiently grounded to create any core gate.

outcomes.endpoint: The page is identifiable as the “夕阳红风采” community senior leaderboard and presents a nonempty set of candidates with names, images, and explicit, unique rank numbers in ascending order.
outcomes.quote: 要做个“夕阳红风采”排行榜页面
test_cases: On initial load, verify the page identifies itself as “夕阳红风采” and presents at least one community senior candidate; inspect every displayed candidate card and verify it has an image, a name, and a numeric rank, then verify the ranks are unique and increase sequentially in the cards' displayed order.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can submit a candidate name or supported name fragment through the top search form and receive only candidates matching the page's declared search rules.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item specifically verifies the unmatched-query path and a correct empty/no-results state. Item 33 requests generic validation or feedback but does not establish that unrelated or stale candidates are absent.
outcomes.quote: 最上面加个能搜人填表单的导航
test_cases: Record the full name of a candidate shown in the initial leaderboard, submit that name or a supported unique fragment with the search button, and verify the resulting candidates match the declared search rule and include the recorded candidate rather than unrelated entries.
Restore the initial list, enter the same known candidate name, press Enter from the search field, and verify the resulting candidate set is the same as when the visible submit control is used.

Submit a string that cannot match any displayed candidate under the declared search rule and verify the page presents an intelligible no-results state without retaining unrelated candidates as apparent matches.

outcomes.endpoint: A keyboard user can move focus through all rendered interactive controls in a comprehensible order, see which control is focused, reverse direction without a trap, and complete the primary candidate-search flow without a pointer.
outcomes.missing_check: Only mixed checklist items are mapped; a standalone endpoint assessment is required.
outcomes.quote: 还要支持键盘切焦点
test_cases: Using only Tab and Shift+Tab from the beginning of the page, traverse every rendered interactive control and verify each is reachable in a comprehensible order with a clearly visible focus indicator and no focus trap; record a displayed candidate name, reach the search field by keyboard, enter that name, press Enter, and verify the matching candidate result is produced.

core_scope.purpose: Enable community residents, including keyboard users, to identify and find ranked older-adult participants on the “夕阳红风采” community leaderboard.
review_notes: The leaderboard information itself is the primary content outcome. Hero-image placement, a four-column grid, typography, card geometry, shadows, colors, and overall visual mood remain supplementary presentation requirements rather than separate core gates.

Search-control existence checks 15 and 30 and labeling check 16 were not promoted to core because merely locating controls does not prove the requested search endpoint. Core search coverage uses result-correctness checks 14 and 32.
Item 33 is mixed because clear search feedback is relevant, while its required-field validation condition depends on form rules that the request never defines.

Keyboard access was retained as a core access mode rather than as decoration. Items 24 and 31 are mixed because they assess the core search controls together with card and FAQ controls whose underlying features are supplementary.

The FAQ outcome from the proposal was removed from core because the surrounding wording makes it an incidental, placeholder-content addition. Its location, content, expansion, collapse, and FAQ-specific keyboard checks remain scored supplementary requirements.

High contrast, font sizing, touch-target size, color exclusions, and other visual accessibility measurements remain important supplementary requirements, but they are not independent business endpoints under the core-membership criterion.
No real voting transaction was invented. Vote-button existence and local state changes may still be assessed by supplementary items 26 and 34.

Generic implementation probes such as DOM mutation, absence of JavaScript exceptions, and self-containment do not establish a specific leaderboard or search endpoint and therefore remain supplementary.

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「有全宽大图和图片网格的」那一份基本一致（顶部为全宽无边距大图，下方主体是整齐划一的等宽四列图片卡片网格，图文上下对齐排列）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「B」份「Bingo开头的网页」：常规无衬线体，卡片标题适中且首字母大写，段落正文偏细且呈较浅的灰色，按钮内文字字号小且全大写。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「B」60px vs 「C」40px；字号档数：「B」4档 vs 「C」7档；字族：「B」pt/times vs 「C」montserrat/themify。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「Bingo开头的网页」那一份基本一致（常规无衬线体，卡片标题适中且首字母大写，段落正文偏细且呈较浅的灰色，按钮内文字字号小且全大写。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「深色长文本说明网页」在这一面是：深底白字无衬线体，部分大字号数字配合极小注释文本，层级反差大且带有严密的画册排版感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「深色长文本说明网页」那一份（深底白字无衬线体，部分大字号数字配合极小注释文本，层级反差大且带有严密的画册排版感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「带安全帽人物的网页」在这一面是：主次标题经常使用粗壮的全大写字母（如OUR TEAM），正文颜色深，整体带有对比强烈的硬朗感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带安全帽人物的网页」那一份（主次标题经常使用粗壮的全大写字母（如OUR TEAM），正文颜色深，整体带有对比强烈的硬朗感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「带邮箱输入的单屏页」在这一面是：由一个极其巨大的极粗无衬线主标题，搭配字号较小且偏细的副标题构成，单屏内字号对比极端。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「C」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 16px、最大标题字号 40px、字号档数 7档、字族 montserrat/themify、字重档数 5档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「带邮箱输入的单屏页」那一份（由一个极其巨大的极粗无衬线主标题，搭配字号较小且偏细的副标题构成，单屏内字号对比极端。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「D」份「带邮箱输入的单屏页」：展示了由透明底带白色细边框的输入框、与亮绿色实体填充带微小圆角的提交按钮组合成的表单控件。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「D」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「D」无 vs 「C」有。产出应落在「D」那一侧的数值范围里。

ambiguities: The phrases "really solid" and "for all the performance metrics" do not define a minimum number or type of filter controls. Two controls and compound filtering are not independent mandatory goals, although any combinations the page actually offers should behave correctly.

The Request Demo controls appear in a sentence specifying component appearance, but the request does not define a demo-submission workflow, backend transaction, or success state. Their presence, exact wording, and behavior are therefore supplementary rather than an invented core transaction.
The request provides no source dataset, formulas, units, or time windows against which the factual accuracy of performance figures can be independently validated.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can identify the terminal, understand its intended use, and obtain concrete product specifications or capabilities from complete, semantically meaningful product content.
outcomes.quote: single product detail page for our new data analytics terminal
test_cases: Using only the visible page content, identify the product name and explain its data-analytics purpose from the introductory text; then locate the specifications or feature list and verify that its entries provide concrete numerical parameters or unambiguous supported capabilities rather than placeholders or generic claims.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can inspect performance through a clearly labeled numerical table and chart, apply every offered filter according to its declared semantics, and obtain exactly matching results with consistent values, units, filter scope, time scope, and aggregation across all affected views.
outcomes.missing_check: No authoritative dataset, formula, or expected performance values are supplied, and no checklist item compares the displayed figures with such a source. Real-world numerical accuracy therefore cannot be established; the available checks can establish exact filtering behavior, intelligibility, and internal cross-view consistency only.
outcomes.quote: since i'm a data analyst, i care a lot about accurate numbers and highly readable charts, so we need a really solid interactive filtering section for all the performance metrics.
test_cases: Start from an unfiltered page state and inspect the performance chart and multi-row data table. Use visible axes, labels, legends, direct values, or readable tooltips to identify each displayed metric, unit or magnitude, and category or time basis; wherever the same metric appears in a summary, chart, and table, verify its exact value or page-declared aggregate as well as its unit, filter scope, and time scope across those views.

From a fresh unfiltered state, record the baseline table rows and chart values. For each offered filter dimension, choose a declared condition having at least one matching and one nonmatching baseline record, derive the expected matching rows using the page's visible filtering rule, apply the filter, and verify that the table contains exactly those rows and that every affected chart or summary shows the corresponding recomputed numerical result rather than merely changing generically.

If the interface permits two or more conditions to remain active simultaneously, choose conditions with a known intersection from the baseline data, apply them together, and verify the exact intersected table rows and the corresponding chart and summary values using the page-declared aggregation rules.

core_scope.purpose: Enable prospective users to understand the data analytics terminal and evaluate its performance through intelligible, internally consistent charts and tables with functional filtering.
review_notes: Separated the two non-substitutable user goals: understanding the product and exploring its performance data.
Collapsed chart, table, numerical consistency, and filtering checks into one performance-exploration flow because they describe the same end-to-end user task.
Kept theme, typography, component styling, layout, responsiveness, viewport fit, self-containment, and overflow checks supplementary even where the request emphasizes them.

Items 14, 25, and 26 are mixed because they partly assess core product relevance and meaningful content but also impose broader conversion, reference-artifact, or all-visible-copy conditions beyond the core information endpoint.

Item 30 is mixed because synchronized updates of all affected data views are core correctness, while requiring two or more controls and a compound-filter path is not specified independently by the request. Item 19 remains supplementary for the same control-count reason.

Reset behavior, number-format polish, and Request Demo interaction remain supplementary: they are useful requirements but removing them does not eliminate the primary product-information or performance-filtering outcome.

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「大图配衬线标题的文章页」那一份（主标题使用粗大的衬线体，正文使用常规无衬线体，标题与正文字号反差极大。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「居中极大留白的极简页面」在这一面是：使用极细的无衬线体，副标题全大写且字间距被刻意拉得极大，整体呈现轻飘感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「D」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 20px、最大标题字号 30px、字号档数 6档、字族 lato/times、字重档数 3档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「居中极大留白的极简页面」那一份（使用极细的无衬线体，副标题全大写且字间距被刻意拉得极大，整体呈现轻飘感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「B」份「大图配衬线标题的文章页」：基本没有明显的卡片或按钮容器，依赖图片直角边缘、纯文本链接和留白来构成排版，去组件化。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：圆角档数：「B」4档 vs 「A」1档；是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「B」无 vs 「A」有。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「大图配衬线标题的文章页」那一份神似（基本没有明显的卡片或按钮容器，依赖图片直角边缘、纯文本链接和留白来构成排版，去组件化。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「A」份「黑底带细线网格的那份」在这一面是：没有圆角或底色块，所有区块和按钮都被几何感极强的实心细白线框包裹，呈表格状。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「黑底带细线网格的那份」那一份（没有圆角或底色块，所有区块和按钮都被几何感极强的实心细白线框包裹，呈表格状。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「深色顶栏配蓝按钮落地页」在这一面是：包含带浅色边框的圆角白底卡片、带实色背景的圆角矩形按钮和标准的输入框组件。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「深色顶栏配蓝按钮落地页」那一份（包含带浅色边框的圆角白底卡片、带实色背景的圆角矩形按钮和标准的输入框组件。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「居中极大留白的极简页面」在这一面是：除了顶栏一个毫无阴影和圆角的薄荷绿小方块按钮外，页面没有任何外显的卡片或输入框容器。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：圆角档数 1档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「居中极大留白的极简页面」那一份（除了顶栏一个毫无阴影和圆角的薄荷绿小方块按钮外，页面没有任何外显的卡片或输入框容器。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「布局结构」不要做成「居中极大留白的极简页面」那样：极端的单列居中布局，左右两侧留有巨大的空白区域，头部带有宽大的斜纹背景，所有图文均收束在中心窄列。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「D」份的程序指纹：内边距中位数 40px、元素密度 61.2个/千像素高、整页高度 2778px。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否明显不同于「居中极大留白的极简页面」那一份（极端的单列居中布局，左右两侧留有巨大的空白区域，头部带有宽大的斜纹背景，所有图文均收束在中心窄列。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'卖开发工具的网页'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为「销售开发工具（面向开发者的软件/工具产品）」的商业页面，主标题与正文均围绕该产品展开，而非其他行业主题？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'做个丝滑切换的套餐比对'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个专门的套餐（定价）比对板块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“套餐比对”，因此需要多个套餐及足够的名称、价格和功能信息用于比较，但不限定必须采用静态并列布局。
keypoints.question: 套餐比对区是否提供至少 2 个套餐方案，并为每个方案清楚呈现套餐名称、价格和主要功能或额度，使用户能够比较其差异？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求的是可用的“套餐比对”；应检查方案间是否具有共同的比较维度，但不应强制所有条目采用完全相同的顺序或横向对齐形式。
keypoints.question: 套餐比对区是否使用一致且明确的比较维度呈现各方案（如价格、额度和主要功能），让用户能直接辨识套餐差异，而非各自罗列互不对应的信息？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'丝滑切换的套餐比对'
keypoints.question: 套餐比对区是否配有明确的切换控件（如月付/年付开关、或套餐/规模的 tab 按钮组）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'丝滑切换的套餐比对'，切换必须真实生效
keypoints.question: 点击该切换控件的另一个选项后，套餐区的价格数字或功能内容是否确实随之发生变化（而非点了没有任何反应）？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'丝滑切换'，切换控件需有可辨认的当前状态反馈
keypoints.question: 点击切换控件的另一个选项后，选中态标识（高亮/下划线/加重等）是否从原选项转移到了被点击的选项上？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求“电话放显眼”，因此应检查联系电话是否容易被快速发现，但不应额外限定只能位于首屏。
keypoints.question: 联系电话是否置于高可见位置（如顶部、首屏或固定联系入口），能够在浏览时快速发现，并在字号、对比或独立呈现上明显区别于普通正文？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'电话放显眼'，显眼的前提是给出真实可读的号码
keypoints.question: 电话号码是否为一个完整成形的号码串（如含区号/分段数字），而不是 'XXX-XXXX'、'联系电话' 这类占位文字？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借用设计语言（颜色、字体、卡片处理），未要求复用截图文字内容
keypoints.question: 页面所有文案是否全部围绕用户指定的开发工具主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名或行业内容（如 Canal Trust／运河信托、装帧修复、Pressroom、Start Bootstrap、TWENTY by HTML5 UP 等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借设计语言，不复用截图里的条目与文案
keypoints.question: 套餐的名称、价格与功能条目是否为自行撰写的开发工具相关内容，而非照抄参考截图定价卡里的 FREE/PRO/ENTERPRISE、$0/$9/$49、'5GB storage'、'Unlimited public projects' 等原文？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求'输出单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源'
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含的单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“做个丝滑切换的套餐比对”；现有条目只检查内容是否变化及选中态是否转移，尚未检查切换过程是否真正平滑。
keypoints.question: 切换套餐比对模式时，价格或功能内容是否通过连贯的淡入、滑动、数字过渡等方式更新，且没有整页刷新、明显闪烁或导致版面大幅跳动？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求可切换的套餐比对；完整实现应支持来回切换，并保证整个比对区的数据与当前模式同步，而非只完成一次单向或局部更新。
keypoints.question: 套餐切换是否可以在各选项之间双向反复操作，并且每次切换后所有套餐的价格、计费周期或对应功能与当前选项保持一致，不出现部分套餐仍显示旧数据的混合状态？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把 palette 指给了「A」份
keypoints.question: 整体配色是否取自第「A」份参考，而不是别的份？

ambiguities: “丝滑”没有给出可客观判定的时长、缓动或动画形式，因此切换动画质量作为补充要求处理；核心只要求切换后的套餐状态正确、明确且可重复。
“铺满整屏”未说明是仅指横向宽度、首屏覆盖还是禁止页面滚动，因此不将其转化为业务核心门槛。
请求没有指定具体套餐数量之外的价格、计费周期或换算公式；测试应采用页面自己声明的模式和规则，不臆造固定月付或年付算法。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面应清楚说明正在销售面向开发者的软件或工具，并提供足以理解该产品用途的销售内容。
outcomes.quote: 卖开发工具的网页
test_cases: 加载页面后，仅依据可见的主标题和正文，确认能够判断所售的是开发者软件或工具以及它的大致用途；若主要内容属于其他行业、以占位文案为主或被参考页面的无关品牌内容主导，则不满足该结果。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够比较至少两个开发工具套餐，并通过页面提供的模式控件切换到另一组价格、额度或功能数据；当前模式和所有套餐数据应保持一致且可反复恢复。
outcomes.quote: 做个丝滑切换的套餐比对
test_cases: 在初始状态下以购买者身份阅读套餐区，确认至少两个套餐分别给出名称、价格及相互对应的主要功能或额度，并且这些维度足以直接辨识套餐差异。
记录当前模式以及每个套餐显示的完整价格、周期和功能数据，通过正常控件选择另一模式；确认被选模式可识别，所有套餐均切换为与该模式一致的数据且不存在新旧状态混杂。若页面声明了折扣或换算规则，按该规则核对数值，而不只检查数字发生变化。随后切回原模式并核对所有原始值准确恢复，再次切换以确认操作可重复。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面应在容易快速发现的位置展示一个完整、非占位的联系电话，并使其与普通正文有足够区分。
outcomes.quote: 卖开发工具的网页，做个丝滑切换的套餐比对，电话放显眼。别搞极大留白那页的居中单列，我要铺满整屏。颜色
test_cases: 在页面默认显示状态下，以寻找售前联系方式的用户身份查看页面，确认无需通读全部内容即可在顶部、首屏或持续可见的联系入口发现电话号码；核对其为清晰可读、完整成形的号码串，而不是“联系电话”或“XXX-XXXX”等占位内容。

core_scope.purpose: 让潜在客户了解所售开发工具、通过可切换的套餐比较做出选择，并能快速找到联系电话。
review_notes: 将套餐内容、切换控件、状态反馈和双向一致性合并为一个端到端购买比较流程，避免把查找控件和点击动作拆成独立核心测试。
清单 26 只衡量淡入、滑动、闪烁和版面跳动等动画表现；虽然请求强调“丝滑”，动画不是不可替代的业务终点，因此保留为补充项。
清单 23 同时包含核心相关的开发工具内容一致性，以及更宽泛的“所有文案”和参考品牌排除要求，故列为混合项。清单 24 同时检查套餐与开发工具的相关性和未照抄参考文本的原创性，故也列为混合项。
配色、字体、无边框卡片、满屏布局、长串适配、单文件封装和通用运行质量均保留为补充要求，没有因措辞强调而提升为核心结果。
将联系电话结果的引文纠正为请求中的精确连续子串“电话放显眼”，不再使用跨越多个句子的截取。

items.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「黑底带细线网格的那份」那一份基本一致（整体背景为纯黑，文字主要为白色，高亮和强调色使用卡其色/暗黄色。）？
字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「深色顶栏配蓝按钮落地页」那一份基本一致（标准的现代无衬线字族，各级标题通过加粗区分，字重对比明显，字号层级规范清晰。）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「A」份「带深色侧栏的后台页面」：经典的左右分栏结构，左侧深色导航栏固定，右侧内容区采用灰底白卡的卡片式网格布局，区块划分明确。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：栅格/卡片间距中位数：「A」11px vs 「B」18px；元素密度：「A」598.1个/千像素高 vs 「B」111个/千像素高；整页高度：「A」1080px vs 「B」3460px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「带深色侧栏的后台页面」那一份基本一致（经典的左右分栏结构，左侧深色导航栏固定，右侧内容区采用灰底白卡的卡片式网格布局，区块划分明确。）？

ambiguities: The request does not require a genuine backend or deployment transaction. For an offline self-contained HTML benchmark, frontend-simulated training pushes and hardware readings should be accepted if the requested visible states and update behavior are present.
“高并发” describes the intended project context but provides no workload, node-count, throughput, or stress-test threshold, so it should not create an arbitrary concurrency gate.

“支持状态切换” does not define which hyperparameter states must exist or their transition rules. The named inline editing behavior can still be assessed as a supplementary interaction without inventing additional states.

outcomes.endpoint: Engineers can distinguish GPU compute nodes and access node-associated hardware readings, including numeric VRAM usage and core temperature. A matrix layout and animated hover overlay are requested presentation mechanisms rather than the underlying monitoring endpoint.
outcomes.quote: 左上角规划一个GPU集群的拓扑矩阵，这里需要比较细腻的微交互，鼠标划过某个计算节点时，要求平滑渐现出当前显存占用和核心温度的数据浮层。
test_cases: Using the page's normal GPU-node controls, including hover if that is how details are exposed, inspect at least two identified compute nodes and verify that each exposes clearly labeled numeric VRAM-usage and core-temperature readings associated with the selected node.

outcomes.endpoint: Engineers can read Loss progression and the current Epoch completion state, and the Loss series extends when the page receives or simulates a new training update. The breathing animation is supplementary feedback rather than the business endpoint.
outcomes.quote: 右上角放核心的Loss曲线图和Epoch进度，每次有新的日志推流过来时，曲线末端要有轻微的呼吸态更新动效。
test_cases: Inspect the training-progress area and verify that the Loss display is a progression curve with multiple ordered points rather than a lone static number, and that Epoch progress gives a valid current/total or completion percentage; if both ratio and percentage are shown, verify they agree.

Record the current terminal Loss point and Epoch readout, then wait for the page's next declared push or simulated training update; verify that a new terminal point is added or the series otherwise advances according to the page's stated update rules, rather than only showing an unrelated CSS pulse.

outcomes.endpoint: Engineers can follow an ongoing training log stream in which new readable log records are appended over time. Smooth motion and the particular background treatment for severe errors are supplementary presentation requirements.
outcomes.quote: 最下方留给持续滚动的训练日志流，支持平滑滚动和严重错误级别的底色高亮。
test_cases: Record the full content and order of the newest visible training-log entries, wait for the next automatic update, and verify that at least one new readable record with meaningful log content is appended after the prior newest entry and that the view continues to expose the newest portion of the stream without resetting to unrelated static content.

core_scope.purpose: Provide algorithm engineers with an intelligible model-training monitor for live training progress and per-node GPU hardware status, including an ongoing training log stream.
review_notes: Restricted core membership to the primary monitoring goals: per-node GPU hardware information, live Loss/Epoch progress, and an ongoing training log stream.
Moved the hyperparameter matrix and inline editing flow to supplementary scope because removing configuration editing does not defeat the page's primary purpose as a training and hardware monitor.

Treated matrix placement, fixed navigation, dark theme, typography, card styling, hover fading, breathing animation, smooth scrolling, severe-error background color, viewport fit, and self-containment as supplementary presentation or implementation requirements rather than independent core outcomes.

Classified checklist items 13, 15, 26, 12, 18, 27, and 29 as mixed because they combine endpoint-relevant content or updating with layout, interaction mechanism, animation, or smoothness requirements.

Replaced fragmented presence/click/observe steps with self-contained scenarios that verify node-associated hardware values, valid Epoch information, actual Loss-series advancement, and ordered log appends.

ambiguities: The referenced map and dark-gradient interfaces are not included in the task data, so their exact visual hues, typography, shapes, and overall atmosphere cannot be independently operationalized here; those requirements remain supplementary.

The request does not define the dataset, searchable fields, available filter dimensions, page size, or compliance decision rules. Tests therefore use values exposed by the page and verify consistency with its declared labels and rules rather than assuming an external regulatory algorithm.
“smooth pagination” could refer to animation or responsiveness in addition to working page navigation. Functional navigation is core; animation and visual smoothness are supplementary.
The fixed or sticky behavior of the right panel is a layout requirement rather than the compliance-evaluation endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access distinct, readable, non-placeholder document or clause summaries that are recognizably about green-building standards rather than unrelated template content.
outcomes.quote: I am speccing out a digital repository for the new green building standards published by the architecture association.
test_cases: Load the repository and inspect several feed entries; verify they have distinct titles and intelligible summaries about green-building standards, and that the substantive content contains neither placeholder/source-template text nor unrelated local-business material.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can narrow the document feed by keyword and by the page's declared filter dimensions, see which filters remain active, and modify or reset them to recover the appropriate result set.
outcomes.quote: We have a massive volume of clauses to display, so the interface needs stateful data filtering and smooth pagination to manage the density.
test_cases: From the initial feed, note a distinctive substring from a visible clause title, enter it in the top search and submit; verify the known clause remains, every returned entry matches the query in a field the page declares searchable, and clearing the query restores the initial unfiltered result set.

Activate a category, status, or chapter value represented in the data; verify the condition remains visibly active and every returned entry satisfies it, then change or reset the condition and verify the feed updates or returns to the full result set.
Submit a deliberately nonmatching keyword; verify the page presents an unambiguous empty-result state rather than stale or unrelated entries, then clear it and verify normal results return.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can move between distinct pages of the large result set, identify the current page, and retain applicable filtering state while paginating.
outcomes.quote: We have a massive volume of clauses to display, so the interface needs stateful data filtering and smooth pagination to manage the density.
test_cases: With unfiltered results, record the entries shown on page 1 and activate page 2; verify the current-page indicator becomes 2 and a different batch of clauses is displayed, then return to page 1 and verify the original batch is restored.

Choose a filter for which the page's own controls expose at least two result pages, activate it, and move to page 2; verify the filter remains active and every displayed entry still satisfies it, then narrow the filter enough to reduce the available pages and verify the current page is reset or clamped to a valid page.

outcomes.endpoint: Selecting a clause loads its corresponding multi-step compliance evaluation; users can move through the steps, provide answers, and reach a summary tied to the selected clause and their choices.
outcomes.quote: Instead of a map, that right panel will house a step-by-step compliance evaluation wizard that updates as users select items on the left.
test_cases: Select clause A from the feed and verify the wizard identifies or presents information specific to A, then select a different clause B and verify the wizard updates to B rather than retaining A's content.

Select a clause, provide an answer in the first wizard step, advance, and verify both the step indicator and step content move to the next declared step; use the back control and verify the indicator and content return to the corresponding prior step.

Select a clause and complete every wizard step using the available controls; verify the final summary identifies that clause and accurately reflects the choices made according to the rules and labels declared by the page.

core_scope.purpose: Provide an intelligible digital repository where users can browse and retrieve green-building standards from a large collection and evaluate a selected clause through a step-by-step compliance workflow.
review_notes: Added a standards-content outcome because an informational repository fails its primary purpose if its requested information is irrelevant, placeholder text, or unintelligible.

Collapsed keyword search and stateful filtering into one retrieval outcome. Checklist items 11 and 31 are mixed because they combine core filtering behavior with non-core placement, sizing, or result-count requirements.

Reframed pagination as complete page-transition scenarios that verify the resulting records, active page, restoration, and interaction with filtering rather than listing click and observation steps separately.
Expanded the wizard endpoint through its requested evaluation summary, while testing consistency with the page's declared rules rather than inventing a backend or external compliance formula.
Items 12, 13, and 16 remain mixed because they combine core content or wizard checks with left/right placement, scrolling, tags, or fixed-panel presentation.

Exact metadata fields, category vocabulary, result counts, navigation links, sticky viewport behavior, visual matching, robustness probes, and implementation packaging remain supplementary because removing them does not eliminate the repository's main retrieval or evaluation outcomes.
The generic DOM-change probe int_1 is supplementary because an unspecified DOM mutation cannot establish search, pagination, filtering, or compliance-wizard correctness.

ambiguities: The request requires a two-column content area and also requests responsiveness, but it does not unambiguously require two columns to remain side by side at a 375px viewport; checklist item 24 imposes that additional interpretation.

The searchable corpus and matching algorithm are not specified. Search correctness should therefore be tested against content and matching rules declared by the page rather than an invented external service database.

“高频办事入口” does not specify live external destinations or backend transactions. The core interpretation is that concrete municipal service access options are available and intelligible, without requiring an invented online government backend.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can submit a term against the page's declared municipal-service content and receive query-specific results or a clear no-results state.
outcomes.missing_check: Checklist item 11 checks only that visible feedback appears; no checklist verifies that returned results actually correspond to the submitted query or that an absent query produces a correct empty state.
outcomes.quote: 首屏搞个全局搜索
test_cases: Load the page, choose a distinctive term from its own searchable municipal-service content, enter that term in the global search, trigger the search using the offered mechanism, and verify that the feedback identifies the corresponding relevant content under the page's declared matching rules rather than merely showing an arbitrary change.
Load or reset the page, search for a unique string absent from the page's municipal-service content, and verify that a clear no-results state appears and that no stale result is presented as a match.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can identify multiple specifically named high-frequency municipal service access options rather than generic or placeholder entries.
outcomes.quote: 接着铺几个高频办事入口
test_cases: Load the page and inspect the high-frequency service section; verify that it presents multiple separately identifiable options with concrete municipal-service names and intelligible labels, rather than generic numbering, unrelated content, or placeholders.

outcomes.endpoint: Using the appointment form's declared rules, users are prevented from submitting invalid required data and receive visible appointment confirmation after a valid submission.
outcomes.quote: 再往下是带表单的在线预约
test_cases: Load or reset the page, leave the form's declared required fields empty or invalid, submit the appointment form, and verify that submission is blocked, no success confirmation appears, and clear validation feedback identifies what must be corrected.

Load or reset the page, provide valid values for every field the form declares required, submit through the normal control, and verify that a visible success or appointment-confirmation state appears for that submission.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can read at least one recognizable announcement containing intelligible municipal-policy information rather than blank or placeholder content.
outcomes.quote: 最后收尾放个政策公告
test_cases: Load the page, locate the policy-announcement section, and verify that at least one notice has an identifiable municipal-policy subject and meaningful readable content rather than Lorem ipsum, an empty card, or unrelated material.

core_scope.purpose: A municipal service page that lets residents search for and identify common services, complete an online appointment flow, and read municipal policy announcements.
review_notes: Removed the strict two-column layout from core outcomes because column arrangement and viewport behavior are layout requirements, not non-substitutable municipal-service endpoints; items 7 and 24 remain supplementary.
Kept visual references, palette, typography, component styling, navigation behavior, responsive fit, footer treatment, source organization, and self-containment as supplementary requirements.
Items 9, 12, and 19 are mixed because they combine core content presence with first-screen or section-order placement requirements.
Items 10 and 14–16 assess controls, field prescriptions, or setup rather than the completed search or appointment endpoint. They remain supplementary instead of becoming separate core gates.
Replaced fragmented locate/click/observe steps with end-to-end valid and invalid scenarios that verify the resulting user-visible state.
A real reservation backend was not required; for an offline self-contained page, validation and a visible confirmation state are the appropriate appointment endpoint.

ambiguities: The request does not define currency, the exact accounting period of 已付总额, whether the visible lists are exhaustive, or whether category spending covers paid bills, unpaid bills, or both. Consistency tests must follow scope rules declared by the page rather than assume an accounting convention.

The number and names of subsidiaries are unspecified. The phrase introduced by “比如” illustrates the switching use case but does not authorize requiring particular company names or a particular number of options.
“快逾期” has no stated day threshold, so no arbitrary due-date cutoff should be imposed; its red treatment remains a supplementary presentation requirement.

The chart request mentions a mouse or laser pointer, but an ordinary laser pointer does not necessarily generate browser pointer events. Hover effects should only be tested with supported browser controls and are not part of the core expense-information endpoint.
The invoice action permits either “马上支付” or “催促开票”. No payment service, invoicing backend, or exact post-action state is specified, so a real external transaction must not be invented.
The checkmark after export is phrased with “最好”, making that animation preferential rather than indispensable. Export and its feedback are also secondary to the projection-and-reconciliation purpose.

outcomes.endpoint: For the currently selected account, the dashboard exposes numeric values for both 本月未结总额 and 已付总额, without contradictions against the records and accounting scope the page declares as included.
outcomes.quote: 顶上先来一个大区块，直接标出「本月未结总额」和「已付总额」
test_cases: Select an account and use the page's declared period and inclusion rules to read both top totals; calculate the unpaid and paid amounts from all records the page declares included in those totals, and verify the displayed numeric totals match those calculations and do not contradict the displayed bill statuses or category data.

outcomes.endpoint: The dashboard provides an intelligible expense-share breakdown that includes equipment purchases, travel, and outsourcing, with numeric shares that agree with the represented proportions.
outcomes.quote: 往下是一个环形的图表，用来显示买设备、出差、外包这些分类花销的占比
test_cases: For the selected account and the period declared by the page, read every labeled expense share; verify that equipment purchases, travel, and outsourcing are included, that all displayed percentages are numeric and total approximately 100% allowing for stated rounding, and that the represented sector sizes are consistent with those percentages.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can review bills by payment status, see each bill's invoice number, issue date, counterparty company, and amount, and access each bill's item name, unit price, and quantity details.
outcomes.quote: 再下面就是具体的发票清单了，分「待付款」和「历史账单」两个大标签
test_cases: Activate 待付款 and verify that every visible record is identified as unsettled and shows an invoice number, issue date, counterparty company, and numeric amount; then operate each visible record independently and verify that its own details become accessible with item name, unit price, and quantity rather than another invoice's details.

Activate 历史账单 and verify that every visible record is identified as paid or archived and contains the four required summary fields; then operate each visible record independently and verify that its corresponding item-name, unit-price, and quantity details become accessible.

outcomes.endpoint: Selecting another available subsidiary changes the account context and replaces the totals, expense breakdown, and invoice records with data belonging to that subsidiary.
outcomes.quote: 屏幕右上角留个位置放公司名字的下拉菜单，比如我们要看不同子公司的账，点一下就能选
test_cases: Record the selected subsidiary and its visible totals, category data, and invoice identities; select a different available subsidiary through the normal company control, then verify the selected company context changes and all three data areas show that subsidiary's declared data, with no stale invoice identities or account labels from the previous selection.

core_scope.purpose: Enable meeting participants viewing a projected invoice dashboard to reconcile financial activity by reading unpaid and paid totals, distinguishing unsettled from historical bills, inspecting invoice line items, understanding expense-category shares, and changing the subsidiary account context when needed.
review_notes: Collapsed invoice tabs, record fields, and detail disclosure into one end-to-end invoice-review flow instead of treating setup actions such as finding or clicking controls as separate tests.

Kept requested financial information as core while leaving its prescribed visual treatment—large typography, colors, donut form, hover enlargement, fades, smooth motion, borders, symmetry, font, and viewport behavior—supplementary.

Item 29 is mixed because it checks core category labels and proportional correctness together with the prescribed donut-sector presentation. Items 16, 19, and 33 are mixed because they check access to the correct list or details together with animation requirements.

For subsidiary selection, only item 34 establishes the business endpoint of changing account data. Items 22 and 23 merely check control placement, existence, and options, so they remain supplementary.

Payment/reminder controls and monthly export are useful secondary actions but are not non-substitutable to the primary meeting reconciliation goal. Their existence, feedback, and offline behavior remain supplementary, and no backend transaction is assumed.

Item 35 was retained as a core correctness check for the displayed totals, but its application must respect whatever aggregation scope the page declares and must not assume that every historical record belongs to the current month.

review_notes: Removed the proposed broad board-structure core gate. Single-column layout, exact section order, minimal copy, absence of unrelated blocks, and viewport behavior affect presentation and usability but are not separate non-substitutable business outcomes.

Form/control existence, field minimalism, and generic submission feedback remain supplementary. Checklist item 26 is the adequate core check because it verifies actual insertion, exact retained data, category retention, and subsequent filterability.

The filter scenario creates known categorized fixtures through normal controls to avoid assuming undocumented categories for preloaded requests. No reload persistence or invalid-input policy is imposed because neither was requested.
