test_cases: From a fresh load, scroll to the dashboard and record the selected industry, salary-bin labels, and count or percentage scale. Choose a different available industry and confirm that the selected label and represented distribution change together; using the chart's declared axis scale, labels, legend, or tooltips, verify that at least one bin represents a different count or proportion rather than accepting an unrelated generic DOM change.

core_scope.purpose: Enable prospective learners to understand the value and content of an advanced data science course, examine relevant outcome evidence, and begin an enrollment flow; the page also supports exploration of industry-specific alumni starting-salary distributions.
review_notes: Separated the enrollment action from general course information because beginning enrollment is the page's primary conversion endpoint, while the information supports an informed decision.

Retained the salary dashboard as core because it is a substantive requested decision-support interaction, not merely a decorative dashboard. Only the industry-to-distribution result is core; animation smoothness and the 100ms timing target remain supplementary.
Classified item 17 as mixed because it combines the core industry-filtered histogram result with non-core latency and animation requirements.
Classified items 18 and 33 as mixed because they combine core content or controls with first-viewport placement, sequencing, and layout requirements.

Kept column layouts, mobile folding, typography, color, emotional tone, component styling, hover feedback, animation, performance timing, single-file packaging, and generic robustness checks supplementary because they do not independently establish the course-information or enrollment endpoints.
The enrollment test requires only a visible self-contained next step and does not invent a payment service, account system, or deployment backend.

ambiguities: The request does not define a search corpus, ranking algorithm, or presentation format. Filtering help topics, revealing matching FAQs, or displaying a query-specific no-results state are valid alternatives, but an unrelated or generic change is not sufficient.

No backend or persistence contract is specified for support tickets. Passing native constraints and reaching the page's declared frontend submission behavior is therefore the endpoint; receipt by a real support service must not be assumed.

The request does not mandate email as the reply-contact method. Checklist item 17 meaningfully tests native validation when an email field is declared, but its email-specific assumption must not make other usable, natively constrained contact methods fail the core outcome.
No particular product or prescribed body of help facts is supplied, so content should be judged for support relevance, substance, and intelligibility rather than against invented product details.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can recognize the page as a product help center and read substantive, intelligible information about product use, accounts, troubleshooting, or support without reference-site copy or placeholder content replacing that information.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can submit a help query and receive visible feedback that specifically corresponds to that query, such as matching help content, filtered FAQs, or an explicit no-results state.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can browse substantive question-and-answer content by selecting among meaningfully named FAQ categories, with exactly the selected category's panel shown at a time.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can provide reply contact information and a meaningful issue description, receive browser-native constraint validation for invalid input, and reach the form's declared normal frontend submission path when all declared constraints are satisfied.

test_cases: Using the form's normal submit control, attempt submission with its required fields empty and verify that browser-native constraint validation blocks submission, identifies an invalid required control, and does not enter the successful submission path.

Where the form declares a typed or patterned contact constraint, fill the other required fields correctly but enter a value that violates that declared rule—such as abc for a type=email field—and verify that native constraint validation blocks submission with the corresponding browser validation state.

Fill the contact, summary, detailed description, and any other required fields with values satisfying the page's declared constraints, submit normally, and verify that no native invalid state blocks the action and that the declared frontend submission behavior is reached; no server-side ticket creation is required.

core_scope.purpose: Enable users to find and read relevant product-support information through search and categorized FAQs, and to prepare and submit a support ticket with native client-side validation.
review_notes: Kept the product-help information, functional search, stateful FAQ browsing, and validated ticket flow as distinct non-substitutable user goals.

Layout resemblance, responsive breakpoints, colors, component appearance, imagery, serif typography, semantic implementation details, self-containment, and general robustness remain supplementary. Their emphatic wording does not make them separate core user outcomes.

Item 12 is mixed because it combines the core ability to trigger search with hero placement and control-presence criteria. Item 31 is mixed because it combines visible FAQ-state consistency with supplementary ARIA and DOM implementation requirements. Item 17 is mixed because it tests a core invalid-input path while imposing an email-specific choice not stated in the request.

ambiguities: The request supplies no geographic dataset, postal-code list, or boundary rule for delivery eligibility. A coherent deterministic client-side rule is acceptable, but random or arbitrary success and failure messages cannot establish that an address was actually checked.

The platform is introduced as offering affordable meals and groceries, while the builder requirement specifically names meal choices. Grocery options should not be imposed as a separate core gate without a more explicit builder requirement.
The request does not require order submission, payment, dispatch, account creation, persistent storage after reload, real geocoding, or another backend transaction.
“click through their meal choices” does not unambiguously require a multi-step wizard; a stateful single-section builder can satisfy the outcome.

The one-sheet interpretation is supported by “an A4 sheet” and checklist item 36, but hiding every named non-summary element is one possible print treatment rather than the only way to achieve a clean driver copy.

outcomes.endpoint: Using the visible meal choices and pricing rules, a user can add, remove, or change selections through normal controls; prior selections remain represented as state, and the displayed total updates immediately in the same document to the mathematically correct amount.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item explicitly verifies that the builder total is mathematically equal to the selected quantities and displayed unit prices, including any disclosed fees or rounding; items 15 and 16 only establish updating and no reload.
outcomes.quote: dynamic, stateful order builder where neighbors can click through their meal choices and see the total update instantly on the screen without reloading
test_cases: Using the item names, unit prices, quantities, fees, and rounding rules displayed by the page, select one unit of one item and two units of another. Verify that both selections remain visibly identifiable after the later action, that the displayed total equals the exact sum required by the declared rules, and that the document does not reload or reset during the interactions.

Starting with a nonempty order created through the visible controls, remove or decrement one selected item. Verify that its state and quantity change accordingly, the other selections remain intact, and the total immediately becomes the exact recalculated amount without a full-page reload.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can enter an address and receive a deterministic, input-corresponding statement that it is inside or outside the volunteer delivery zone. The implementation may use self-contained local rules and does not need real geocoding or a backend.
outcomes.missing_check: The checklist does not require a disclosed deterministic delivery-zone rule or test fixtures, so the factual correctness of both in-zone and out-of-zone results cannot be independently verified when no rule or examples are presented.
outcomes.quote: below the builder, a tool to check if their address falls within our volunteer delivery zones.
test_cases: Using an address that the page's displayed zone rules or examples unambiguously identify as inside the delivery area, enter and submit that address through the normal controls. Verify that the result refers to that submission and explicitly reports that delivery is available.

In a fresh check, use an address that the page's displayed zone rules or examples unambiguously identify as outside the delivery area. Verify that the result explicitly reports that delivery is unavailable and replaces or clearly distinguishes any result from a prior submission.

outcomes.endpoint: The final summary is generated from the current builder state, accurately lists the selected items and quantities or equivalent selection details, shows the same correct final total, and produces a readable single-sheet A4 print presentation without clipping, overlap, or disruptive page splits.
outcomes.quote: the final order summary view has to print cleanly to an A4 sheet so our drivers can take physical copies on their routes without things getting jumbled.
test_cases: Create an order with at least two distinct items and a non-default quantity, record the displayed selections and total, and open the final summary through the page's normal controls. Verify that every selected item and quantity is reproduced, no unselected item is introduced, and the summary total exactly matches both the builder and the sum under the page's declared pricing rules. Open browser print preview with A4 selected and verify that the complete summary is readable on one sheet with no clipping, overlap, or key row split across pages.

Create an order containing all distinct choices supported by the normal builder controls, open its generated summary, and inspect A4 print preview. Verify that the populated summary—not a static example—remains on one A4 sheet and that unrelated navigation or interactive controls do not jumble, obscure, or displace the driver-relevant information.

core_scope.purpose: Enable neighbors to build an affordable meal or grocery order with a live, stateful total, determine whether an address is eligible for volunteer delivery, and produce an accurate A4-printable order summary for drivers, without requiring a real backend transaction.
review_notes: Collapsed selection, retained state, live total, and no-reload behavior into one end-to-end order-builder outcome instead of treating finding, clicking, and observing controls as separate tests.
Replaced the proposed observational total test with exact arithmetic checks based on the prices, quantities, fees, and rounding rules declared by the page.
Separated the delivery tool's in-zone and out-of-zone business paths and removed the proposal's allowance for random simulated validation. No real delivery API is required.

Kept the accurate generated summary and A4 print result as one end-to-end driver outcome; mere summary existence in item 23 remains supplementary because it cannot establish state accuracy or print fitness.

Item 13 is mixed because it combines the core delivery decision with the supplementary placement requirement that the tool appear below the builder. Item 36 is mixed because it combines the core A4 result with prescriptive print-cleanup details.

Items 28 and 38 are attached once as mixed, cross-cutting checks: they partly support intelligibility of core selections, totals, and zone results, while also imposing broader labeling and non-color presentation requirements across multiple controls.

Reference-derived layouts, collage and card counts, visual mood, typography, pill buttons, responsive reflow, content ordering, branding details, and viewport fit remain supplementary rather than becoming substitutes for the ordering, eligibility, or print endpoints.
Self-containment and absence of generic JavaScript errors remain supplementary implementation checks; they do not by themselves prove any requested business endpoint.

ambiguities: The request supplies neither a target timestamp nor a current-user feed, update cadence, or counting rule. Countdown correctness should therefore be judged against a clearly stated implementation rule, accepting either a time-based or user-count-based countdown without inventing a backend transaction.

The chart metrics, regional datasets, units, and meaning of “real-time” are unspecified. Tests should use the page's declared refresh rule and verify numerical and graphical consistency rather than assume external real-world values or a particular refresh interval.

“tons of community photos taking up most of the space” does not define a photo count or measurable area threshold. Community-photo content is needed for the photo interaction, while quantity and visual dominance remain presentation requirements.
The names and units of the requested raw hourly metrics are not specified. The core requires labeled numeric values tied to concrete hours, not an invented mandatory metric schema.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly identifies the billionth-user milestone and presents a continuously updated, numerically correct remaining-time or remaining-user countdown based on a stated target or data rule.
outcomes.quote: countdown milestone tracker for our upcoming billionth user event
test_cases: Using the page's stated countdown basis, verify the complete flow end to end: for a target-time countdown, independently calculate the difference between the stated target and current time, compare it with every displayed countdown field, wait several seconds, and confirm the fields decrement consistently; alternatively, for a user-count countdown, verify that current users plus remaining users equals 1,000,000,000 before and after an update and that the update follows the page's declared rule rather than changing randomly.

outcomes.endpoint: At least two readable data charts automatically refresh without a page reload, with their displayed numbers, labels, scales, and graphical encodings remaining mutually consistent.
outcomes.quote: interactive charts that update in real-time
test_cases: On the loaded tracker, identify at least two distinct charts and record their exact displayed values, labels, axis or tooltip scales, and corresponding bar dimensions; remain on the page through a declared or observable refresh interval, then verify that at least one data value updates without reload and that every updated bar, value, label, and scale continues to encode the same numerical state rather than merely animating or changing arbitrary DOM content.

outcomes.endpoint: A region selection with at least two identifiable options changes the charts to the data associated with the selected region while preserving numerical and visual consistency.
outcomes.quote: make sure the charts can be filtered by region
test_cases: Within one chart refresh interval, select a first region and record the exact chart labels and values, select a second region and verify that the selected-region state and chart data change to that region's declared dataset with bars, values, scales, and labels synchronized, then return to the first region and verify that its expected data is restored or advanced only according to the declared live-update rule.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating a recognizable community-photo block reveals labeled raw numeric metrics paired with specific hour labels; an actual card-rotation animation or a particular reveal container is not required for the core result.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item cleanly tests that activating a community photo reveals the hourly metrics regardless of presentation: item 22 combines that endpoint with a mandatory flip animation and rejects otherwise valid reveal containers such as a modal.
outcomes.quote: when users click on the photo blocks, they should flip around to reveal the raw metrics filtering down to the hour
test_cases: Activate a recognizable community-photo block through normal page controls and verify that the resulting content contains metric names, exact numeric values, and explicit hour labels such as 14:00 with an unambiguous value-to-hour pairing; repeat with another available community-photo block to confirm the interaction is functional rather than a single static caption or unrelated description.

core_scope.purpose: To help viewers track progress toward an upcoming billionth-user milestone and inspect live regional and hourly community metrics through charts and community-photo interactions.
review_notes: Combined chart existence, plurality, automatic updating, and numerical readability into an end-to-end live-chart outcome, while retaining regional filtering as a distinct user goal with its own meaningful scenario.
Replaced setup-only tests such as locating or clicking controls with scenarios that perform the interaction and verify the final numerical result and synchronized chart state.
Kept community identity and access to hourly metrics in core, but treated photo quantity and page-area dominance as mixed or supplementary layout concerns.
Classified item 22 as mixed because it checks the core reveal endpoint together with a non-core flip animation and an unnecessary restriction on the reveal container.
Moved item 13 to supplementary because it specifically requires a billion-scale user-progress number even though the request and item 30 allow a valid countdown based on an explicit target time.

Kept dark coloring, boxed layout, typography, card styling, hover bounce, photo dominance, and other visual hierarchy requirements supplementary even where emphatically requested, because removing them does not eliminate the tracker, chart filtering, or hourly-metric endpoints.
Did not require a live deployment or external analytics backend; an offline page may use a stated target and internally consistent data/update rules.

ambiguities: The request assigns a bright orange outer glow to selected or hovered permission cards but later assigns bright magenta to selected-state highlights. These can be interpreted as separate layers or component classes, but the precedence for a selected permission card is not explicit.

The action-button sentence says "like" and uses "or" between "Save Configuration" and "Revoke All" while specifying their capsule styling; it does not unambiguously require both controls or define persistence behavior. Checklist items 19 and 28 assume both are mandatory and functional.

The exact hierarchy and data relationship among permission cards, user roles, and granular toggles is left flexible, so endpoint tests should follow the labels and relationships declared by the implementation rather than impose an unstated permission model.

outcomes.endpoint: Changing the selected profile updates the security-clearance information so it consistently represents the current profile rather than stale data from the previous selection.
outcomes.quote: The top section will house the primary user selection dropdown and a dynamic data visualization block showing the current security clearance level of the selected profile.
test_cases: With profile A selected, record the exact clearance label/value and graphic state; select a different profile B and verify the visualization identifies or otherwise corresponds to B and presents B-specific clearance information; then reselect A and verify A’s original label/value and graphic state are restored exactly.

outcomes.endpoint: An administrator can choose a permission card for editing, open its nested role configuration, and change individual granular access permissions while the interface preserves and displays the correct card, role, and toggle states.
outcomes.quote: We need a complex stateful view where expanding a user role smoothly reveals a nested, cascading list of granular data access toggles.
test_cases: Choose permission card A and verify the editor identifies or displays configuration corresponding to A; expand one of its roles, change a named granular permission to the opposite state, collapse and reopen the role to verify that exact state is retained; select permission card B and verify its corresponding configuration replaces A’s rather than leaving the same content displayed, then return to A and verify the changed A permission is still represented correctly.

Within an expanded role, operate the same granular permission from off to on and back to off, verifying both the visible indicator and the control’s checked or accessible state after each operation; collapse the role and verify its nested controls are no longer operable, then reopen it and verify the final off state remains correct without overlapping or stale content.

core_scope.purpose: Enable field administrators to select an Open Window user profile, understand that profile’s current security clearance, and inspect and change its granular permission configuration in a stateful frontend prototype.
review_notes: Removed the testimonial carousel from core membership. It is a requested trust-building feature hook, but removing it would not prevent administrators from selecting profiles or configuring permissions; its content, looping, touch behavior, and scroll snapping remain supplementary requirements.

Kept mobile fit, one-column layout, responsive behavior, colors, component styling, animation quality, semantic markup, CSS organization, and implementation architecture supplementary. They are important requirements but are not separate business endpoints.

Collapsed permission-card selection, role expansion, and granular toggle operation into one stateful configuration outcome because they are stages of the same administrator flow rather than independent goals.

Did not retain a separate save/revoke core outcome. The request introduces those names as examples in a component-shape sentence using "like" and "or," and the prototype is expressly awaiting API wiring. Requiring both functional actions would therefore overstate the core request; checklist item 28 remains supplementary rather than inventing a persistence transaction.

Moved control and section existence checks such as items 11, 12, and 14 to supplementary status. Core mapping uses checks that establish the resulting profile update or permission-state behavior, while the revised test cases include the controls only as setup within complete end-to-end scenarios.
Item 27 remains mixed because it combines supplementary animation smoothness with the core requirement that expansion and collapse finish in the correct usable state.

ambiguities: The request does not define submission fields, required values, or particular formats, so validation must be tested against constraints the page itself declares rather than assuming an email or date field.

“一键提交” does not specify a server, persistence layer, or external destination. For an offline self-contained page, a clear client-side success state is the feasible submission endpoint; a real backend transaction is not required.
The request does not state that reordered cards or status changes must survive a reload, so only the immediate post-interaction state is required.

“地名一点就能看详请” is interpreted as viewing place details despite the apparent typo in “详请”. It does not unambiguously require every occurrence of every place name to be interactive, so checklist item 38 is mixed because it adds universal coverage and consistency.

outcomes.endpoint: The page provides an intelligible travel itinerary with multiple identifiable trip nodes and an unambiguous current order.
outcomes.quote: 我要做一个旅行行程规划页
test_cases: Load the finished page and verify from its visible content that it is a travel itinerary: at least two ordered cards or nodes are present, each has a distinguishable destination plus at least one date, time, or activity detail, and the current sequence can be understood unambiguously.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can drag an itinerary card to a different list position, and the exact visible order reflects the move after release without immediately reverting.
outcomes.quote: 承载行程卡片的拖拽排序
test_cases: Record the visible destination labels in their initial order, drag the first card past the second and release it, then verify that those labels appear in the exact resulting order implied by the drop and remain there rather than snapping back.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can activate a node's status control and change that same node to a different, intelligible itinerary status.
outcomes.quote: 节点状态切换交互
test_cases: Record one itinerary node's visible or accessible status value, activate its status control, and verify that the same node now exposes a different status value recognized by the page rather than merely showing an unrelated DOM or decorative change.

outcomes.endpoint: The itinerary submission flow rejects values that violate the form's declared client-side rules and gives clear confirmation when a rule-compliant itinerary request is submitted.
outcomes.quote: 底部的行程一键提交，记得加上前端基础校验
test_cases: Leave the form's declared required fields empty and submit it; verify that visible validation feedback identifies the missing input and that no success confirmation is shown.

For any field that declares a format constraint, fill the other required fields validly, enter a value that clearly violates that declared constraint, and submit; verify that the value is rejected with a nearby clear message and no success state.

Fill every required field with values satisfying the page's declared rules and submit once; verify that validation errors are absent and a visible success state explicitly confirms submission of the itinerary or planning request.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating a place name reveals substantive details for that place within the current page context instead of navigating away.
outcomes.quote: 地名一点就能看详请，不用跳出视图
test_cases: Record the current page context and activate a displayed itinerary place name; verify that an in-page expansion, modal, or side panel presents that place's name and substantive non-placeholder descriptive text while the user remains in the same document rather than being sent to another page.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a user to review and organize a travel itinerary by reading ordered trip nodes, reordering them, changing node statuses, viewing place details without leaving the current context, and submitting the itinerary through basic client-side validation.
review_notes: Replaced the proposal's fragmented find/click/observe steps with self-contained scenarios that perform each flow and verify its business result.
Kept drag sorting, meaningful status changes, inline place information, and validated itinerary submission as distinct non-substitutable user goals.
Classified item 20 as mixed because it checks essential itinerary-card content together with the supplementary requirement that the cards sit specifically in the right-hand layout region.
Classified item 29 as mixed because travel-focused content supports the core informational purpose, while banning copied reference brands and industries is supplementary content hygiene.

Classified item 38 as mixed because opening corresponding place details supports the core endpoint, but requiring consistent treatment and working details for every principal place name is broader than the minimum unambiguous request.

Items 23 and 24 remain supplementary because they only establish form and control existence; items 25, 35, 36, and 37 measure whether the itinerary-specific submission flow actually rejects invalid input and reaches a valid success result.

Dashboard layout, typography, component styling, palette, atmosphere, sidebar behavior, viewport robustness, self-containment, and generic runtime quality remain supplementary rather than separate core outcomes.

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「黑底配白云背景网页」在这一面是：表单输入框极为克制，去除了所有外包边框和底色填充，仅保留一条极细的下划横线构成组件。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「D」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：圆角档数 0档、阴影档数 2档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「黑底配白云背景网页」那一份（表单输入框极为克制，去除了所有外包边框和底色填充，仅保留一条极细的下划横线构成组件。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'为咱们的高端生活方式社区「青苔巷」落地一个全新的问答主页'，且为单页
keypoints.question: 页面是否整体呈现为「青苔巷」社区的单个问答主页——即全页围绕同一个核心问题展开（提问、背景、回答、相关话题），而非博客/作品集/会议等其他类型页面？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'最终导向“立即回答”的核心 CTA'
keypoints.question: 页面是否存在文案为「立即回答」（或与之完全同义的中文行动号召）的核心 CTA 按钮？

keypoints.question: 每条高赞回答是否以带引号或引用标识的引语形式呈现，并配有用户头像以表明回答者归属？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确提到页面中的“数据高亮”，因此页面应存在与问答主题相关的可见数据指标。

keypoints.question: 将页面向下滚动越过首屏后，是否出现一条精简版的提问栏吸顶固定在视口顶部，且其中仍带有回答入口按钮？

keypoints.question: 将鼠标悬停在时间线的某个年份节点上时，该节点是否出现可见的轻微放大反馈（悬停前后节点尺寸有变化）？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求设置“底部的 CTA 提交按钮”，且页面的核心转化目标是引导用户立即回答，因此该 CTA 应连接到可填写回答的前端入口。
keypoints.question: 底部回答提交 CTA 是否提供或唤起可供用户填写回答的输入区域，而非仅作为无响应的装饰按钮？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'移动端下图片与文本交错部分平滑折叠为单列'
keypoints.question: 在窄视口（移动端宽度）下，原本左右交错的图文穿插区块是否折叠为单列上下堆叠，且没有内容被裁切或横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'底部的三列卡片转为横向滑动'
keypoints.question: 在窄视口（移动端宽度）下，底部的三列卡片网格是否变为可横向滑动的单行卡片列表（而非继续三列挤压或直接堆叠成长列）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借用参考页的设计语言（配色、字体反差、区块摆放、组件质感），内容须为青苔巷问答主题
keypoints.question: 页面全部正文是否围绕「青苔巷」问答主题原创撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名或条目名（如 Eventre、Annie、Fiction、Redcodder、Johnathan Franco、API Gateway、Data Pipeline 等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令的页面结构只列出四个板块：首屏提问区、问题背景与沿革、高赞回答穿插、更多热门连结
keypoints.question: 页面是否没有照搬参考截图中与主题无关的板块（如会议日程表/DAY 选项卡、演讲者人像阵列、网络节点图谱画布、作品集项目列表）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'纯前端静态单页交付，单文件结构，确保极速秒开'
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件交付（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求页面面向「高端生活方式社区『青苔巷』」，需要「一眼抓住那些高净值用户的眼球」并「撬动他们的表达欲」；因此核心问题不仅要存在，还应贴合目标社区并具备开放讨论价值。
keypoints.question: 首屏核心问题是否符合「青苔巷」高端生活方式社区的语境，具有明确且具体的讨论对象，并采用能激发用户分享观点或经历的开放式问法，而非宽泛口号、封闭式问题或与生活方式无关的提问？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求「精选 2-3 个头部回答，用引语的形式透出，激发跟风效应」；要实现该目的，回答应真实回应问题且各有观点，不能只满足条目数量和引语外形。
keypoints.question: 2-3 条高赞回答的引语内容是否都在直接回应同一个核心问题，彼此提供不同且具体的观点或经历，并具有足够完整的语义，而非重复文案、泛泛赞美或占位句？

keypoints.basis: 用户强调缩短转化路径、以“立即回答”为核心 CTA，并要求滚动后保持回答入口常驻，因此这些入口应直接衔接到可操作的回答区域。
keypoints.question: 首屏及吸顶栏中的“立即回答”入口是否能够直接滚动到、展开或聚焦可填写并提交回答的界面或区域，而不是无响应的装饰按钮？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把 palette 指给了「D」份
keypoints.question: 整体配色是否取自第「D」份参考，而不是别的份？

keypoints.basis: 参考页程序抽取的强调色是 #337ab7（refspec，1920px）
keypoints.question: 强调色是否与参考一致（ΔE76 ≤ 15）？

ambiguities: 需求将交付物限定为纯前端静态单文件，但没有规定回答提交后的文案、验证规则、持久化方式或服务器行为；可要求可见的本地完成状态，不应推定存在后端 API 或跨会话保存。
需求未指定核心问题、历史事件或年份的固定事实内容，因此应按页面内部的一致性、时间顺序和主题相关性检查，不宜擅自加入外部事实正确性门槛。
“更多热门连结”需要可点击目的地，但单文件离线交付不适合强制外部页面；对应的页内详情、对话框或本地状态均可构成有效目的地。
相关话题池使用三列网格属于视觉布局要求，并不能单独推出恰好或至少三项的核心业务门槛；检查项 28 因同时覆盖话题的复数性和布局衍生的数量阈值而列为混合项。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面围绕一个明确、具体且开放式的生活方式问题展开；用户可通过主要“立即回答”入口到达可用的回答编辑区，输入回答并通过纯前端交互获得明确的本地提交结果，不要求后端持久化。
outcomes.missing_check: 现有检查项 32 和 40 能验证 CTA 可到达可填写、可提交的回答界面，但没有检查输入非空回答并触发提交后的明确结果；需要补充纯前端提交完成状态检查，且不应要求后端或跨会话持久化。
outcomes.quote: 用首屏冲击力撬动他们的表达欲，最终导向“立即回答”的核心 CTA。
test_cases: 进入页面后读出核心问题，确认其具有具体讨论对象、属于生活方式语境且允许分享观点或经历；随后激活主要“立即回答”入口，确认回答编辑区被显示或聚焦，按页面声明的规则输入一段可唯一识别的有效回答并提交，验证出现明确的本地完成结果（例如成功提示或新回答条目），不要求服务器保存。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够理解核心问题的历史背景，并阅读 2-3 条直接回应同一问题、内容具体且观点有所区别的精选引语回答。
outcomes.quote:
加入一个时间线钩子，展示这个话题的历史脉络，拉升讨论深度。
- **高赞回答穿插**：精选 2-3 个头部回答，用引语的形式透出，激发跟风效应。
test_cases: 先记录首屏核心问题的讨论对象，再沿页面阅读背景时间线，确认存在多个按时间先后排列的明确年份或年代节点，且各节点事件均与该问题相关；继续阅读精选回答，确认总数为 2 或 3 条、以可辨识的引语形式呈现，并逐条核对其均直接回应同一问题、语义完整且提供不同的具体观点或经历。

outcomes.endpoint: 暂不回答的用户可从页面底部的相关话题池选择多个标题不同且与当前讨论相关的话题，并通过正常控件到达或展开与所选标题对应的有效话题目的内容。
outcomes.quote: 底部放置相关话题池，确保没兴趣答题的用户也能留在流量漏斗里
test_cases: 到达底部相关话题池，核对其中存在多个标题不同且与核心问题相关的入口；依次激活每个可见入口并在每次操作后返回或重置，确认其到达或展开的站内、页内话题内容与所选标题对应，而不是空链接、无响应控件或仅有静态图片。

core_scope.purpose: 让用户围绕同一个具体的高端生活方式问题理解讨论语境并完成回答；对暂不回答的用户，提供继续探索相关话题的有效入口。
review_notes: 将原提案中的时间线与高赞回答合并为一个连续的讨论语境阅读结果，避免把同一内容理解流程拆成多个琐碎核心门槛。
保留相关话题导航为独立结果，因为原需求明确为不愿回答的用户定义了另一条不可由回答流程替代的继续探索路径。
检查项 32 和 40 同时包含核心的回答入口功能与非核心的位置、底部或吸顶栏约束，因此移入 mixed_item_ids；仅检查 CTA 文案或控件存在的 18、20、31 不足以证明作答终点，保留为补充项。
首屏布局、吸顶效果、悬停放大、宽屏或移动端适配、配色、字体、组件装饰、网格与技术封装均未提升为核心结果；这些仍可按原检查项评分，但移除它们不会阻断主要用户目标。
核心测试改为完整场景：从理解问题到填写并提交、从问题到时间线及回答的语义核对、以及从相关话题入口到对应目的内容；不再把打开页面、寻找控件和点击控件拆成独立测试。

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「米白底色设计作品集」那一份基本一致（利用大量留白构成左右不对称的图文穿插（如图7左图右文），并在底侧配合标准的三列式卡片展示网格。）？
配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「黑底配白云背景网页」那一份基本一致（极度深沉的暗色模式，以纯黑底色统领全局，搭配黑白灰的去色图片，仅有少量浅铜金色的标题文字作为点缀。）？
组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「彩色气泡网络连线页」那一份基本一致（圆球节点带有强烈的高光与 3D 立体拟物质感；顶部按钮带有小圆角、渐变色及细微投影，主画布背景自带浅色网格线。）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「深色流体模拟界面」那一份基本一致（极深色（接近纯黑）背景，主体视觉为带发光效果的亮蓝色或橙色，面板为半透明深灰。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「配色」；错误来源「B」份「绿顶博客文章页面」在这一面是：纯白底色，浅亮绿色作为导航栏等强调色，文字采用不同明度的灰色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「绿顶博客文章页面」那一份（纯白底色，浅亮绿色作为导航栏等强调色，文字采用不同明度的灰色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

ambiguities: The word "like" may make the three named data sections sound illustrative, but the surrounding sentence directly identifies all three as the intended dashboard sections; they are therefore treated as the requested information set without making their exact placement core.

The request names date-range inputs but does not explicitly state their filtering behavior. Item 25 interprets them as functional dashboard filters; if only editable controls were intended, that item would exceed the literal wording.

The dataset and aggregation definitions, especially what qualifies a campus rep as active, are unspecified. Correctness should therefore follow rules declared by the page rather than an externally invented formula.

Charts are referenced generically without a required chart type or metric. Their presence, labeling, and visual treatment remain supplementary because the named sales information can be fully intelligible through cards and ranked tables.
The raw export format is unspecified; CSV and JSON are valid alternatives.

outcomes.endpoint: The page communicates creator-merch sales performance for a student audience, including an intelligible currency-valued total revenue, a labeled active campus-representative count, and a breakdown of at least two named study guides with associated sales metrics.
outcomes.quote: sales performance dashboard built for my creator merch store, tracking stuff i sell to my student audience
test_cases: Use the dashboard's visible content to determine, in one pass, the total revenue and its currency, the number of active campus reps, and which at least two named study guides lead performance with each guide's stated sales metric; confirm the labels make clear that these are creator-merch sales for a student audience.

outcomes.endpoint: Selecting a valid date range filters and correctly recalculates the relevant sales-performance information for records within that range.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 25 checks that some relevant display changes, but no checklist item verifies the numerical or ranking correctness of the filtered result or confirms that out-of-range records are excluded.
outcomes.quote: form inputs for date ranges
test_cases: Using the page's raw records and declared aggregation rules, choose a broad valid range and a narrower valid range containing a different record set; apply each through the date controls and verify that displayed revenue, and any affected count or ranking, equals the result computed only from records inside the selected range rather than merely changing arbitrarily.

outcomes.endpoint: The user can export usable machine-readable sales-detail records corresponding to the currently selected date range.
outcomes.quote: a raw data export button
test_cases: Set a valid date range known to contain sales, activate the raw-data export, open the downloaded CSV or JSON, and verify that it parses as machine-readable detail rows, contains creator-merch sales records within the chosen dates, excludes out-of-range records, and is not merely an export of summary-card values.

core_scope.purpose: Enable a creator-merch store operator to understand student-audience sales performance for selected periods and obtain the underlying sales records.
review_notes: Removed the proposed layout outcome from core scope. Side-by-side columns, width allocation, left-side placement, and sticky behavior are requested layout qualities but are not the dashboard's business endpoint.
Kept the requested sales information as one consolidated informational outcome rather than separate gates for each card or section.

Split date filtering and raw-data export into distinct outcomes because they produce different user results, while making each test an end-to-end scenario rather than separate control-discovery and click steps.
Item 16 is mixed because it checks the core presence of the three data sections together with supplementary right-column and vertical-stacking requirements.
Item 14 is mixed because it combines the core download behavior with button existence and labeling; item 26 directly assesses the usable export endpoint.

Items 22 and 23 are mixed because topical sales semantics support the core informational purpose, while requiring every piece of copy to avoid all reference-page terminology is broader than the core endpoint.
Chart existence and chart-specific labeling, visual styling, hover feedback, packaging constraints, and resilience details remain supplementary.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「A」份「带素描头图的浅色页」：全局使用偏纤细秀气的无衬线体，字号偏小，字重反差克制，仅依靠深灰和浅灰色来区分大标题与说明文字的层级，整体气质柔和。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「A」16px vs 「C」20.8px；最大标题字号：「A」25px vs 「C」56px；字号档数：「A」11档 vs 「C」4档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带素描头图的浅色页」那一份神似（全局使用偏纤细秀气的无衬线体，字号偏小，字重反差克制，仅依靠深灰和浅灰色来区分大标题与说明文字的层级，整体气质柔和。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「星空背景的深色面板」在这一面是：包含大量非拉丁字符的无衬线体，信息密度极高，存在大量小字号的标签和说明文字，排布紧密。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「星空背景的深色面板」那一份（包含大量非拉丁字符的无衬线体，信息密度极高，存在大量小字号的标签和说明文字，排布紧密。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「左黑右绿的敬请期待页」在这一面是：大标题使用了带有明显粗细对比和倾斜效果的复古衬线体（Serif），与下方常规细体的无衬线正文形成了极其强烈的家族反差。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「左黑右绿的敬请期待页」那一份（大标题使用了带有明显粗细对比和倾斜效果的复古衬线体（Serif），与下方常规细体的无衬线正文形成了极其强烈的家族反差。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「深蓝头部的帮助中心页」在这一面是：使用现代风格的无衬线体，大标题字号极其庞大且字重极粗（如“I'm a Developer”），视觉冲击力极强。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「C」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 20.8px、最大标题字号 56px、字号档数 4档、字族 dm/times/tinos、字重档数 2档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「深蓝头部的帮助中心页」那一份（使用现代风格的无衬线体，大标题字号极其庞大且字重极粗（如“I'm a Developer”），视觉冲击力极强。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（nav_left_rail）。判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：导航我要竖着放在左边，不要横在上面（判法：导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度）？
keypoints.spec_check: 导航容器的包围盒在页面左侧 1/3 内且高度 > 宽度

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「星空背景的深色面板」那样：特征极强的深色半透明通栏卡片（带微小圆角），内嵌发光紫色的胶囊开关、带圆点的细线滑块和暗色下拉框。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「星空背景的深色面板」那一份（特征极强的深色半透明通栏卡片（带微小圆角），内嵌发光紫色的胶囊开关、带圆点的细线滑块和暗色下拉框。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「深蓝头部的帮助中心页」那样：大量使用浅色轻微阴影的纯白正方形卡片、两端完全半圆的巨大胶囊形搜索框，以及带有复古纯黑错位阴影的亮色直角按钮。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「B」份的程序指纹：最大圆角 28px、圆角档数 9档、阴影档数 2档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「深蓝头部的帮助中心页」那一份（大量使用浅色轻微阴影的纯白正方形卡片、两端完全半圆的巨大胶囊形搜索框，以及带有复古纯黑错位阴影的亮色直角按钮。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面把跨形态要求抬到了档 1（移动端优先 / 严格响应式）。参考截图只有桌面宽度，所以窄屏形态是**推断**出来的，不是照抄；判定看窄屏帧与 1920px 主帧之间结构是否真的不同。
keypoints.question: 窄屏（390px）下的信息层级是否**重排**过（导航收起、多列变单列、主次顺序按小屏重新安排），而不是把桌面版等比缩小？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“我想做一个长租公寓品牌的介绍网站”
keypoints.question: 页面整体主题是否呈现为一个长租公寓品牌介绍站（围绕房源、公寓公共设施、看房预约展开），而不是其他行业或通用模板？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“因为模拟的数据条目非常多，所以这里必须要带上筛选和分页的功能才行”
keypoints.question: 房源列表区是否同时提供了可交互的筛选控件与分页控件（两者都在页面上可见且可点击）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“一开始是几句俏皮的品牌宣言，接着马上切入房源列表……往下是公寓内部公共设施的图文展示，最底下一个收集预约看房信息的表单”
keypoints.question: 主内容区的板块顺序是否严格为：品牌宣言 → 房源列表 → 公共设施图文展示 → 预约看房表单？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“主打稍微俏皮幽默一点的风格……一开始是几句俏皮的品牌宣言”
keypoints.question: 开篇品牌宣言是否由多句（≥2 句）文案组成，且用词明显带俏皮幽默口吻（例如调侃、双关、口语化表达），而非严肃的企业套话？

keypoints.basis: 指令说明“模拟的数据条目非常多”，并要求因此提供筛选和分页功能。
keypoints.question: 页面是否通过总条数、总页数或实际分页数据明确表明房源数量超过单页容量，而不是只有少量静态示意房源？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求房源列表“必须要带上筛选……的功能”
keypoints.question: 在房源筛选控件中选择某一个条件后，列表中剩下的房源卡片是否只有符合该条件的那些（筛选前后列表内容确实发生了对应变化）？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求房源列表具备筛选功能，筛选条件应基于可区分房源的实际属性。
keypoints.question: 房源筛选控件是否提供至少一种与长租房源真实相关的条件（如户型、租金区间、区域、朝向或家具配置），而不是使用与房源无关的条件？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求房源列表“必须要带上……分页的功能”
keypoints.question: 点击分页控件中的第 2 页（或“下一页”）后，房源列表是否换成了另一批不同的房源卡片，而不是内容不变？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求可用的分页功能，用户需要能够判断当前所处的分页位置。
keypoints.question: 分页控件是否明确反馈当前分页状态（如当前页选中态或“当前页/总页数”文本），并在翻页后同步更新？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求展示房源列表，房源条目应提供足以识别和比较房源的基本信息。
keypoints.question: 每张房源卡片是否包含可识别的房源名称或位置、户型或面积等关键属性，以及租金价格？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求“公寓内部公共设施的图文展示”。
keypoints.question: 公共设施板块是否同时包含可辨识的设施图片或图标，以及与这些视觉内容对应的设施名称或说明文字？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提供“公寓内部公共设施的图文展示”，复数至少对应 2 项设施。
keypoints.question: 公共设施板块是否以图文结合的方式展示了至少 2 项不同的公寓内部公共设施（如健身房、共享厨房、洗衣房或休闲区等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“最底下一个收集预约看房信息的表单”
keypoints.question: 页面最底部的表单是否明确用于“预约看房”，且字段至少包含姓名、联系方式、期望看房时间，并配有提交按钮？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求收集预约看房信息的表单，需具备基本可用的提交反馈
keypoints.question: 在必填项为空时点击表单提交按钮，页面是否给出了可见的校验提示（而不是毫无反应）？

keypoints.basis: 指令列出了四个板块并要求“导航我要竖着放在左边”
keypoints.question: 左侧竖向导航中的链接项是否与页面的四个主要板块（品牌宣言、房源列表、公共设施、预约看房）一一对应？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求左侧竖向导航，导航须能定位到各板块
keypoints.question: 点击左侧导航中的任一链接后，页面是否确实滚动/跳转到了对应板块（锚点生效，非死链）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求做“长租公寓品牌的介绍网站”
keypoints.question: 页面是否展示了一个明确的长租公寓品牌名称（出现在左侧导航顶部或首屏），并在全站保持同一名称？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“因为期末要上交纸质报告，得保证页面直接打印成A4纸也排版不乱”
keypoints.question: 页面在打印（A4 纸张）时是否做了专门处理，例如打印预览下内容不被截断、左侧导航等交互控件不干扰正文排版？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求：输出单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本全部内联，无任何外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求房源列表同时具备筛选和分页功能；现有条目分别验证了两者，但未验证组合操作时的数据与页码状态是否一致。
keypoints.question: 筛选条件改变后，分页总页数、当前页和当前展示的房源是否会依据筛选后的结果同步重新计算（例如从较后页筛选到少量结果时回到有效页），而不会出现空白页、越界页或混入不符合条件的房源？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 用户要求表单能够收集预约看房信息，因此有效提交后应提供明确的完成反馈。
keypoints.question: 完整填写姓名、联系方式和期望看房时间等有效信息并提交后，页面是否给出清晰可见的预约成功反馈？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 题面的呈现约束把窄屏体验列为要求（cross_form 档 1）
keypoints.question: 768px 窄屏下页面是否没有横向溢出（内容不被裁、不出现横向滚动条）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 列表/表格被灌到 300 条后，布局是否仍不横向溢出（不撑破）？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把 palette 指给了「C」份
keypoints.question: 整体配色是否取自第「C」份参考，而不是别的份？

keypoints.basis: 参考页程序抽取的强调色是 #2a5555（refspec，1920px）
keypoints.question: 强调色是否与参考一致（ΔE76 ≤ 15）？

ambiguities: 请求没有规定具体筛选维度、每页容量或房源总数；核心测试应采用页面声明的房源规则，但数据必须实际跨越至少两页。
请求没有规定预约表单的精确字段格式、校验规则、持久化方式或后端接口；应遵循页面声明的必填规则，并将离线页面中的明确成功状态视为提交终点，不额外要求真实预约后台。
视觉参考页面本身未随任务数据提供，且 pal_1 所称第“C”份参考没有明确映射；这些配色要求保留为补充项，不据此建立核心业务门槛。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够识别这是一个名称前后一致的长租公寓品牌，并读到至少两句清晰可理解的品牌宣言；俏皮幽默的语气属于与核心内容混合的表现要求。
outcomes.quote: 一开始是几句俏皮的品牌宣言
test_cases: 进入页面后阅读首段品牌内容，确认页面明确呈现同一个长租公寓品牌名称，并包含至少两句可理解、与该品牌相关且具有口语化或幽默表达的宣言，而不是其他行业内容或只有通用占位文案。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够从包含多页数据的房源列表中读取关键房源信息，按房源条件得到准确的筛选结果，并在筛选后的有效分页范围内浏览不同批次的房源。
outcomes.quote: 接着马上切入房源列表，因为模拟的数据条目非常多，所以这里必须要带上筛选和分页的功能才行
test_cases: 在无筛选状态下，根据页面声明的总条数、单页容量或总页数确认房源确实超过一页；核对房源卡片包含可识别的名称或位置、户型或面积以及租金，记录第1页房源标识后切换到第2页，确认展示的是另一批房源，同时当前页明确更新为2且总页数与页面声明的数据规则一致。
选择页面提供的一个房源相关筛选值，确认筛选后的每张可见卡片都满足该值、至少有一个实际结果，并核对筛选结果数、总页数和当前页依据筛选后的数据同步更新，而不只是列表发生任意变化。
先进入较后的有效页，再应用一个会显著缩小结果集的筛选条件，确认当前页被调整到筛选结果的有效范围，所有可见房源均符合条件，且没有空白越界页或混入不符合条件的房源。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够理解至少两项不同的公寓内部公共设施；每项设施都有可辨识的名称或说明，并与相应图片或图标正确对应。
outcomes.missing_check: Only mixed checklist items are mapped; a standalone endpoint assessment is required.
outcomes.quote: 往下是公寓内部公共设施的图文展示
test_cases: 浏览公共设施板块，确认至少展示两项不同的公寓内部公共设施，并逐项核对其名称或说明清晰可读、确实描述公寓公共设施，且对应的图片或图标不会与文字指向另一项设施。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够按页面声明的规则提交预约看房信息：缺少必填信息时提交会被阻止并得到可见提示，填写有效信息后会进入明确的预约成功状态；不要求真实后端交易。
outcomes.quote: 最底下一个收集预约看房信息的表单
test_cases: 保留至少一个页面标明的必填预约字段为空并提交，确认页面显示可见且可理解的校验提示、不会显示预约成功，并允许用户修正输入。
使用唯一测试值完整填写页面要求的姓名、联系方式、期望看房时间及其他必填信息，遵循页面声明的格式和时间规则提交，确认页面给出明确的预约看房成功反馈，而不是无响应或仅发生无关的界面变化。

core_scope.purpose: 向访客介绍长租公寓品牌、房源及公共设施，并让访客通过筛选和分页查找房源、提交预约看房信息。
review_notes: 将原提案中合并的页面结构与表单拆分为品牌介绍、房源发现、公共设施信息和预约提交四个不可相互替代的用户目标。
左侧竖向导航、板块严格顺序、响应式重排、无横向溢出和A4打印均属于布局或呈现要求；即使明确要求，也不构成独立核心用户结果，因此移入补充项。
筛选和分页的核心映射仅采用能验证结果正确性、分页状态和筛选后边界重算的条目；仅检查控件可见可点击的第14项以及仅检查筛选条件存在的第19项保留为补充项。
第16项同时检查品牌宣言内容与俏皮语气，第23、24项同时检查设施信息与图文呈现形式，因此放入 mixed_item_ids，而不是把语气或视觉形式单独提升为核心。
第25项只检查表单字段和按钮是否存在，不能单独证明预约流程完成；核心预约结果由无效提交反馈和有效提交成功状态第26、33项覆盖。
没有把预约表单解释为真实后端交易或持久化系统；对自包含离线页面，页面声明规则下的校验与明确成功状态即可作为可测终点。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「A」份「珊瑚粉大色块页面」：页面利用跨越深浅底色交界处的居中悬浮短标签连接上下半区，中段图文条目呈现两列居中且大图标居左的结构，底部表单区为左宽右窄的不对称双列。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「A」37.5px vs 「B」13.5px；元素密度：「A」44.6个/千像素高 vs 「B」84.5个/千像素高；整页高度：「A」5293px vs 「B」2532px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「蓝绿渐变顶栏页面」那一份（主体基于大面积纯白背景，顶部包含深色的暗蓝至青绿色平滑渐变区块，页面中核心强调色和图标为明亮的浅蓝色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「蓝紫底戴眼镜男页面」那一份（头图和底部大量使用深邃的蓝紫色实色背景，主内容区为白底配浅灰细字，强调文字色也保持使用深蓝紫。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令开篇要求'做个睡眠记录可视化的网页'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为「睡眠记录 / 睡眠数据可视化」主题的看板页（标题、板块名、指标文案均围绕睡眠展开），而非其他主题？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'周和月的睡眠周期折线图'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个展示睡眠周期的折线图（以折线/连线形式绘制，而非柱状图、饼图或纯文字表格）？

keypoints.basis: 指令主要诉求是'通过点击按钮平滑切换周和月的睡眠周期折线图，这部分逻辑能不能帮忙实现下'
keypoints.question: 点击「周」/「月」切换按钮后，折线图的曲线形态与横轴标签是否确实随之改变（即切换逻辑真实生效，而不是点了没反应）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求通过按钮切换周和月视图；激活态用于清楚反馈当前视图，但不应据此禁止其他可选时间范围。
keypoints.question: 视图切换控件是否至少提供「周」与「月」两个选项，且当前选中项有明确的激活态，并会在点击后正确转移？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提供睡眠数据的「周」视图，因此应能明确识别其一周时间范围，但数据采样粒度可以自由设计。
keypoints.question: 周视图的横轴标签和数据范围是否清晰对应完整一周，例如按星期或具体日期展示一周内的数据？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求切换周、月两套睡眠周期视图；月视图必须体现月度范围并真实更新，但不限定具体采样点数量。
keypoints.question: 切换到月视图后，图表是否显示覆盖一个月的时间标签和数据，并与周视图呈现出明确不同的数据或曲线？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'平滑切换周和月的睡眠周期折线图'
keypoints.question: 点击月/周按钮后，图表是否在原位就地更新（页面不跳转到新页面、不整页刷新），且更新过程带有可见的过渡动画而非瞬间硬切？

keypoints.basis: 睡眠数据折线图应使时间范围和指标含义可以被理解，但指令未限定具体纵轴指标。
keypoints.question: 折线图是否提供可读且与所展示睡眠指标相符的坐标轴或刻度说明，例如横轴使用日期/星期，纵轴表示睡眠时长、睡眠评分或周期阶段？

keypoints.basis: [行业惯例] 数据看板类页面的图表通常需标注单位或图例；指令要求'睡眠记录可视化'
keypoints.question: 图表是否标明了纵轴单位（如「小时 / h」）或给出图例说明所绘曲线代表的睡眠指标？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'数据项排成图标在左的两列'
keypoints.question: 两列排布的数据项中，每一项是否都同时具备图标、指标名称与对应的数值/说明三要素（而非只有图标加一行标题）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求页面是'睡眠记录可视化'，数据项即为其数据内容
keypoints.question: 这些数据项的指标内容是否均为睡眠相关（如平均睡眠时长、入睡时间、深睡比例、夜醒次数等），而不是与睡眠无关的通用功能介绍文案？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'靠居中悬浮短标签连着上下'
keypoints.question: 跨深浅区域交界处的居中悬浮短标签，其文字是否为与睡眠数据主题相关的自撰短标题（如「本周概览」一类），而非无意义占位或参考截图原文？

keypoints.basis: 指令只借用参考页面的结构与配色语言，内容主题为'睡眠记录可视化'
keypoints.question: 页面所有可见文字是否全部围绕睡眠记录主题自行撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名（如 Escape Velocity、Soundstage、GymFit、Promodise、Untitled 等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令仅要求沿用参考页面的结构与配色，内容须为睡眠数据可视化
keypoints.question: 页面是否未复用参考截图里的条目内容（如曲目名/时长列表、黑胶与卡带价格表、健身房「WHY CHOOSE US」六宫格、营销机构 01–04 序号文案、Lorem ipsum 占位段落）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML、CSS/JS 内联且不引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 指令提到'底部放个左宽右窄的不对称双列'以及'输入框和按钮我想要柔和圆角跟一点点阴影'
keypoints.question: 底部左宽右窄的双列区域中，是否包含至少一个输入框与一个可点击按钮（如睡眠记录录入/备注提交）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求做真实可读的'睡眠记录可视化'

ambiguities: “睡眠周期”未规定纵轴必须表示睡眠时长、评分还是睡眠阶段，也未规定月视图的采样密度；应接受页面明确声明且与睡眠相关的指标，以及按其自述日期规则覆盖完整周/月的实现。
请求引用了若干未随任务提供的参考页面；其文字描述足以评估补充性的布局、配色和组件风格，但不应据此推断额外核心功能。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面提供可辨识睡眠指标及单位的折线图，并提供明确的“周”和“月”状态控件；用户选择任一周期后，同一图表区域会显示覆盖对应时间范围的标签和数据，当前周期状态清晰，周、月数据集确实不同且可来回恢复。平滑动画属于补充表现要求，不是该核心结果的独立门槛。
outcomes.quote: 主要诉求是通过点击按钮平滑切换周和月的睡眠周期折线图
test_cases: 加载页面后通过正常控件选择“周”：确认“周”为当前状态，页面标题及图表说明指向睡眠记录，图表为折线形式；逐一核对横轴标签按页面声明的星期或日期规则覆盖完整一周，并依据纵轴刻度、单位或图例确认折线表示一个明确的睡眠指标且数值范围与该指标相符。记录周视图的标签和曲线数据位置。
在已记录周视图的同一页面中选择“月”：确认当前状态转移到“月”，没有导航到其他页面或用无关图表替换原区域；核对横轴按页面声明的规则覆盖一个月，曲线数据与周视图确实不同，并依据已标明的指标和刻度核对其含义。随后切回“周”，确认先前记录的周标签和曲线数据恢复，而不是继续显示月数据或生成任意新数据。

core_scope.purpose: 让用户在睡眠数据可视化页面中，通过周/月控件查看对应时间范围内清晰、可解释的睡眠折线数据。
review_notes: 将睡眠主题、折线图可读性和周/月切换合并为一个不可分割的主要查看流程，避免把打开页面、找到按钮和点击按钮拆成多个琐碎核心测试。
平滑过渡是动画表现，不属于不可替代的业务结果；同时检查切换正确性与动画的条目20和31因此列为混合项，而不是纯核心项。
条目30同时覆盖核心图表数值和补充数据项中的数值，因此列为混合项；测试只按页面声明的睡眠指标判断合理性，不强行假定必须是0至12小时。
两列数据项、悬浮标签、底部表单、指定参考布局、配色、字体、圆角阴影、自包含封装及抗溢出等均不决定用户能否完成周/月睡眠图查看，保留为补充要求。
重写测试为周视图核验及周—月—周往返的端到端场景，并要求比较时间标签和实际曲线数据，而非仅观察到DOM或外观发生变化。

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「浅底超大标题那个」那一份（极简无衬线字体，页面标题字号极其巨大，与极小的辅助正文和标签形成极其夸张的字号反差。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「深色带紫光那个应用」那一份（深色半透明卡片，带有明显的圆角，辅以彩色发光、渐变色块或内发光效果，按钮采用高饱和度渐变或高亮色填充。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

outcomes.endpoint: The same page can be switched without reloading between Chinese and English, and all translatable interface copy—including the titles, labels, search prompt, instructions, and both tables' headings—is intelligible in the selected language.
outcomes.quote: 因为最终答辩是要面向全专业学生和外教展示的，所以页面必须得有**中英双语可切换**的功能。
test_cases: In a fresh session, place the page in Chinese using the language control if necessary and record representative text from the page title, section titles, metric labels, search prompt, instructions, and both tables. Switch to English and verify those same elements have meaningful English text, including Table A headings equivalent to Generation, Birth Year, Average Lifespan, and Sex Ratio and Table B headings equivalent to Year, Origin, Destination, and People, without a navigation or document reload; switch back and confirm the recorded Chinese text returns.

outcomes.endpoint: The archive provides an intelligible population-distribution section containing a five-generation comparison table and a substantive migration matrix, with all requested fields populated by concrete data.
outcomes.quote: 主画布-迁徙数字区：文案方向为“从江南到海外：百年人口分布”。直接上两个高密度数据表格。表A“近五代核心指标对比表”列出代数、出生年份、平均寿命、男女性别比。表B“迁徙矩阵”列出年份、原籍、迁入地、人数。
test_cases: In a fresh page session, locate the population-distribution section and Table A by their Chinese or equivalent English titles. Verify that Table A contains five distinct generation records and that every record has a concrete generation, birth year, numeric average lifespan, and male-to-female ratio rather than blanks or placeholder text; after changing language, verify the corresponding table title and field meanings remain identifiable.

In a fresh page session, locate the migration matrix and verify it has several substantive records rather than only one or two examples. For each inspected record, verify the year is concrete, origin and destination are recognizable place names, and headcount is numeric; switch language and confirm the same records remain associated with headings equivalent to Year, Origin, Destination, and People.

outcomes.endpoint: The genealogy content is accessible as a clearly connected four-level tree rooted at a founding ancestor, with meaningful family-member names and intelligible parent-child relationships.
outcomes.quote: 主画布-族谱拓扑图区：需要一块巨大画布，以始祖为根节点，用树状层级展示4层名单。
test_cases: In a fresh page session, inspect the genealogy tree, using normal node controls only if a branch is initially collapsed. Identify the founding-ancestor root and trace visible connectors through four successive levels; verify sampled nodes across the path and sibling branches contain recognizable person names rather than Lorem text or bare numeric identifiers, and that their parent-child relationships are unambiguous.

core_scope.purpose: Enable students and international viewers to access and understand a family-history archive through bilingual generational and migration records plus an intelligible four-level genealogy hierarchy.
review_notes: 将核心范围收敛为三个不可替代的用户目标：双语获取内容、读取代际与迁徙数据、理解四层族谱关系。
原提案把固定控制台、统计看板和搜索合并成核心结果；这些是摘要、导航或布局辅助，移除后仍可通过表格和族谱完成档案页的主要信息目标，因此改为补充要求。
族谱的四层命名关系保留为核心，但拖拽平移和点击折叠属于具体交互方式，不是族谱信息本身的不可替代端点，故第29、30项改为补充。
表格行悬浮、数字动画和代表人物 Tooltip 增强互动呈现，但不决定代际及迁徙记录是否可读，故第27、28项保持补充。
第35项同时覆盖核心的全局语言切换和按钮、Tooltip 等附属界面文案，因此放入双语结果的 mixed_item_ids；第25项直接验证核心表头翻译。
窄屏适配、英文防溢出、固定侧栏、板块顺序、单页与单文件约束，以及视觉主题均是明确的补充验收要求，但不是档案内容端点。
第13项只做宽泛题材识别，具体的表格和族谱检查已经更直接地验证核心内容，因此未将其另立为重复的核心门槛。

ambiguities: 需求没有给出真实账户、预算公式或固定数据集，因此可使用前端模拟数据；数值测试应依据页面公开显示的数据和20%规则，不应臆造外部账本真值。
需求没有保证页面公开的数据中一定存在低于20%的月份，也没有指定通过正常控件构造该状态的方法。低余额行为应优先使用页面暴露的月份或演示状态验证；若没有可达状态，条件行为难以通过纯端到端操作完整覆盖。
Pro 转化区的具体落地形式没有指定。展示方案、权益或清晰下一步即可形成有意义的前端端点，不应把真实购买、登录、支付或会员开通作为隐含核心要求。
分类过滤、月份切换、新增流水及周榜重算都可以由自包含页面中的客户端模拟数据实现，不需要持久化数据库或部署 API。
The versioned semantic amendment's endpoint/test wording supersedes any narrower legacy checklist or review wording; original provenance is retained.

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够明确读到本月当前可支配金额及剩余比例，并能依据严格低于 20% 的规则识别低余额状态；水位球、环形进度、加载动画和模块位置属于呈现方式。
outcomes.quote: 右侧核心区第一眼必须是“本月可支配生活费”，搞一个带动态加载效果的水位球或者环形进度条，数据要是跌破20%直接触发爆红预警状态，给足情绪价值。
test_cases: 在默认月份读取‘本月可支配生活费’区域，确认当前可支配金额和剩余比例均以明确、可解析的数值及相应单位呈现，而不是只有模糊状态或装饰图形；根据所显示的比例核对其低余额表述是否遵循严格低于20%的规则。

使用页面公开提供的月份或正常数据操作，比较一个显示比例低于20%的可达状态与一个不低于20%的可达状态；验证前者有明确低余额预警，后者不会被错误表述为跌破20%。若正常输入确实能构造恰好20%，同时检查它不按低于20%处理；若页面只提供离散演示数据，不得额外要求生成未提供的精确边界数值。不得调用内部应用函数或直接改数据来制造通过。若连低于/不低于阈值的两类状态都无法通过公开操作观察，应明确记录仍未验证的条件，不把没有观测到的分支自动判为正确。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够查看连续七天的每日消费，并针对选定日期取得带有具体分类和数值金额的消费构成，从而判断当天哪类消费更高。
outcomes.quote: 紧接着往下铺近七天的消费柱状图，鼠标一划上去必须立刻弹出丝滑的悬浮提示框，展示这天到底是吃外卖花得多还是买游戏花得多，数据的引导要强。
test_cases: 在同一页面状态下确认消费报表覆盖七个可辨认且连续的日期；依次悬停至少两个不同日期的柱子，验证每个提示框对应当前目标日期，并列出具名消费分类及可解析的具体金额，使用户可以根据金额比较当天各分类，而不是只看到一个总额。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够阅读具体流水明细，并从每条记录中识别消费项、所属分类和金额；卡片样式及分类无刷新过滤是附加的浏览方式。
outcomes.quote: 流水明细不要做死板的死表格，做成卡片列表，支持点击分类标签进行无刷新过滤，比如点一下“恋爱经费”，底下行云流水地只筛选出相关的账目。
test_cases: 检查默认显示的全部流水记录（若数量很多则检查至少三条及列表首尾记录），确认每条都提供具体消费项描述、具名分类和可解析的金额，且三者的对应关系清楚，不是占位文字或只有无含义的数字。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够识别大学生特惠 Pro 的升级入口，并通过其行动按钮看到明确的方案信息、具体权益或可执行的下一步；不要求真实支付、账户升级或后端会员交易。
outcomes.quote: 整个体验的终极目标是商业化，所以左侧栏最显眼的位置必须留给“升级大学生特惠Pro”的转化区，给这个区域加上呼吸灯或者流光扫过的微动效，死死钩住他们的眼球。
test_cases: 从标有“升级大学生特惠Pro”的转化区触发行动按钮，确认页面在离线前端范围内展示可识别的大学生特惠方案，并至少给出一项具体权益或明确升级步骤，而不是无响应、仅播放装饰动画或跳到无关内容。

core_scope.purpose: 让大学生在“极光账本”中快速理解本月可支配生活费、近七日消费和具体流水，并获得清晰的学生特惠 Pro 升级入口；布局、视觉冲击和动效用于强化体验，但不是独立的核心结果。
review_notes: 将核心范围收敛为三个主要财务信息目标和一个被需求明确称为“终极目标”的 Pro 转化目标；这些内容被移除后，页面将不再完成资产概览或转化的主要目的。
水位球或环形进度、加载动画、红色表现、模块先后位置、柱状图位置和 Pro 区醒目位置均含有呈现或布局要求，因此相应的 12、15、16、23 被标为 mixed，而不是独立核心门槛。
分类过滤、卡片外形、右侧记账表单、月份切换、快速导航和每周红黑榜仍是应评分的明确需求，但它们是浏览便利、次级录入流程或装饰性仪表盘；移除它们不会使个人资产概览及 Pro 入口失去主要用途，因此保留为 supplementary。
没有把“记一笔”表单提交提升为核心：本任务的主页面被定义为个人资产概览页，而该表单是附带的创作流程；同时仍保留相关清单项用于补充评分。
核心测试均合并了必要的定位、操作和最终业务结果，没有把打开页面、寻找控件或单纯出现 tooltip 拆成独立测试；仅检查 tooltip 出现的第17项因此没有作为核心端点证据。
周榜图形及其重算逻辑即使可交互，仍属于请求中的生动化辅助仪表盘，不是理解当前可支配资金、近期消费或流水明细所不可替代的目标。

Semantic amendment: The strict less-than-20% rule remains. The task does not supply a dataset or require a control capable of constructing every exact percentage. The test should not demand an unreachable exact20% state when it can already compare the page's offered below/above-threshold states; test the exact boundary if normal inputs actually permit it.

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「深蓝色星空3D网页」在这一面是：采用全屏无边界布局，视觉重心集中在画面中央的3D模型，角落边缘散布极小的固定定位数据面板。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：栅格/卡片间距中位数 9.8px、内边距中位数 12px、元素密度 245.9个/千像素高、整页高度 1269px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「C」份「深蓝色星空3D网页」：极端的暗色调，以极深的幽蓝色星空为背景，发光的高饱和荧光色（紫、蓝、红、黄、绿）作为视觉主体，UI文字为浅蓝色。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「深蓝色星空3D网页」那一份基本一致（极端的暗色调，以极深的幽蓝色星空为背景，发光的高饱和荧光色（紫、蓝、红、黄、绿）作为视觉主体，UI文字为浅蓝色。）？

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「配色」；错误来源「A」份「带粗黑边框的文本网页」在这一面是：整体为复古暖色调，大面积使用米黄色作为背景，文字为纯黑色，局部色块使用了暗红、棕色等低饱和色彩。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带粗黑边框的文本网页」那一份（整体为复古暖色调，大面积使用米黄色作为背景，文字为纯黑色，局部色块使用了暗红、棕色等低饱和色彩。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「配色」；错误来源「B」份「带折线图的数据看板」在这一面是：现代清爽的浅色调，背景为极浅的灰色，内容区为纯白色卡片，主色调和强调色为深绿色，文字为深灰或黑色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带折线图的数据看板」那一份（现代清爽的浅色调，背景为极浅的灰色，内容区为纯白色卡片，主色调和强调色为深绿色，文字为深灰或黑色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「B」份「带折线图的数据看板」：采用现代SaaS常见的卡片式设计，白色背景搭配细微的圆角和极轻微的阴影，图表内的折线和进度条有实色填充，按钮有细边框。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：圆角档数：「B」7档 vs 「A」1档。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「带折线图的数据看板」那一份神似（采用现代SaaS常见的卡片式设计，白色背景搭配细微的圆角和极轻微的阴影，图表内的折线和进度条有实色填充，按钮有细边框。，允许调整）？

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带粗黑边框的文本网页」那一份（所有容器和表格均采用直角、无阴影、粗黑线描边风格，内部填充色通常为纯底色或大面积深色块，按钮也类似标签文字外加粗框。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「深蓝色星空3D网页」在这一面是：几乎没有传统的表单或卡片组件，仅有的UI元素是位于角落的半透明HUD数据面板，采用极细的亮蓝色线条描边，无实体背景色填充。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：圆角档数 1档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「深蓝色星空3D网页」那一份（几乎没有传统的表单或卡片组件，仅有的UI元素是位于角落的半透明HUD数据面板，采用极细的亮蓝色线条描边，无实体背景色填充。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求做'a digital onboarding flow for our new community volunteer network, matching local residents with elderly folks who need companionship or help with groceries'
keypoints.question: 页面主题是否整体呈现为「社区志愿者报名/入驻流程」，且文案明确指向为老年人提供陪伴或代买菜等帮助的志愿服务（而非其他行业或主题）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'The whole thing will be a single-page, multi-step application journey'，并要求点击 next 后过渡到第二步
keypoints.question: 整个流程是否为单页多步骤形式：页面同时只展示当前一步的内容，点击「下一步」后当前步骤内容被下一步取代，而不是整页跳转或把所有步骤一次性平铺？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'The progress bar tracking their application'以及'so they always know how many steps are left'
keypoints.question: 页面是否有进度条/步骤指示器，且在点击「下一步」进入第二步后，其填充或高亮状态相应前进（能看出当前处于第几步、共几步）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'keeping the progress bar anchored at the top'
keypoints.question: 进度条是否锚定在流程顶部，在切换到第二步/第三步后依然停留在内容上方可见位置？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求第一步提供法定姓名、常用名、出生日期和联系方式偏好的输入项，但未要求只能包含这四项。
keypoints.question: 第一步（基本资料）是否至少包含法定姓名、常用名/昵称、出生日期和联系方式偏好这 4 类输入项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'I want the inputs to be large and touch-friendly'，且强调受众年龄跨度大、以清晰可达性为首要目标
keypoints.question: 第一步的输入控件是否明显是大尺寸、易点击的（输入框高度较高、点击区域宽大），而不是紧凑的小号表单控件？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'a dynamic calendar widget where they can click to toggle days of the week they are free'
keypoints.question: 第二步是否包含一个可点击的日历/星期选择控件，列出一周七天供用户逐个选择空闲日？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'click to toggle days... turning those selected blocks into one of our glowing neon colors for immediate visual feedback'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'a section for them to select what they can help with, like light lifting, cooking, or just chatting'
keypoints.question: 技能/可提供帮助类型的选择区是否至少包含「轻体力搬抬（light lifting）」「做饭（cooking）」「陪聊（chatting）」这三类可选项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Below the calendar, we need a section for them to select what they can help with'
keypoints.question: 技能/帮助类型选择区是否位于第二步中日历控件的下方？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Right after this step, before the final background check agreement, I want to insert a rotating carousel of short quotes'
keypoints.question: 志愿者/受助老人证言轮播是否被安插在第二步（可用时间与技能）之后、最终背景审查同意步骤之前的位置？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求展示“short quotes from our current volunteers and the seniors they help”，但没有规定至少三条。
keypoints.question: 轮播是否包含来自现役志愿者和受助老人的多条简短引语，并通过姓名或角色标签明确标示每条引语的说话人身份？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求证言轮播“allow manual swiping”。
keypoints.question: 证言轮播是否支持用户通过触摸滑动或鼠标拖动手动切换到另一条引语？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'This testimonial slider should auto-play slowly'
keypoints.question: 证言轮播是否会自动播放——在无任何操作的情况下，间隔数秒后自动切换到下一条引语？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'a large, scrollable text area for the terms'
keypoints.question: 最终步骤是否包含一块固定高度、内部可独立滚动的条款文本区（安全承诺与背景审查条款），而不是把全文直接铺在页面里？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求最终步骤是'the safety pledge and background check consent'
keypoints.question: 条款区下方是否有明确的同意/授权背景审查的勾选或确认控件，且可被点击选中？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求数字签名板可供用户“use their mouse or finger to sign”。
keypoints.question: 最终步骤是否有数字签名板，且既支持用鼠标按住拖动画出连续笔迹，也支持在触控设备上用手指签名，并能将笔迹保留在板上？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提交后“the entire white card should dissolve into a prominent ... success message confirming their orientation date”。
keypoints.question: 点击最终提交按钮后，原白色表单卡片是否通过可见的溶解或淡出过渡消失，并由成功提示取代，且提示中明确确认一个具体的入职培训（orientation）日期？

keypoints.basis: 指令提到要用高饱和霓虹色表现'validation states'，即流程需具备校验状态反馈
keypoints.question: 在必填项为空时点击「下一步」或「提交」，页面是否给出可见的校验反馈（错误提示文字或输入框错误态）而不是直接放行？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联且不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本全部内联，无任何外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求点击下一步时以“a smooth, stateful slide animation”过渡到第二步。
keypoints.question: 点击第一步的“下一步”进入第二步时，步骤卡片是否通过平滑的横向滑出与滑入动画完成过渡，同时不触发整页刷新并保留已填写的表单状态？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求步骤转换为“stateful slide animation”，因此切换步骤不应丢失已填写的申请状态。
keypoints.question: 步骤切换时，先前填写的姓名、日期、联系方式偏好、空闲日和技能选择是否保存在应用状态中，并在用户通过已有导航重新进入相应步骤时恢复，而不会因前进或滑动动画被重置？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求申请者“select what they can help with”。现有条目只核对轻体力、做饭和陪聊文案是否存在，未检查这些项目能否真正选择。
keypoints.question: 第二步的帮助类型是否是可实际点击或键盘切换的选择控件，支持选择一个或多个项目，并为已选与未选状态提供即时且清晰的视觉反馈？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求证言轮播缓慢自动播放，同时允许手动滑动；未特别指定桌面端必须使用鼠标拖拽。
keypoints.question: 证言轮播是否支持用户在触屏内容区域左右滑动切换引语，并提供可操作的手动切换方式，而不是只能等待自动播放？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求展示“quotes from our current volunteers and the seniors they help”，应同时体现志愿者与受助老人两类视角。
keypoints.question: 证言内容是否同时至少包含一位现役志愿者和一位受助老人的引语，而不是所有引语都只来自同一类说话人？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求申请者可以使用鼠标或手指在数字签名板上签名。
keypoints.question: 数字签名板是否同时支持鼠标拖动和触屏手指连续书写，并能在签名区域中保留可见笔迹？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 最终步骤被定义为“safety pledge and background check consent”，并要求数字签名；这两项应构成提交成功前的有效确认，而非仅作为可跳过的装饰控件。
keypoints.question: 最终提交是否必须在背景审查同意控件已确认且签名板存在有效笔迹后才能成功；缺少任一项时是否阻止提交并就地指出具体缺失项？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“the entire white card should dissolve into”成功消息；现有条目只检查卡片被成功提示取代，没有检查 dissolve 动效。
keypoints.question: 提交成功时，原白色申请卡片是否通过可见的淡出、溶解或粒子消散式过渡逐步消失，再显现确认信息，而不是无动画地瞬间替换？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户强调不同年龄与技术能力的受众，并将“clarity and accessibility”列为绝对优先；自定义日历、轮播和签名流程尤其需要键盘可达及可见焦点。
keypoints.question: 所有输入框、星期按钮、技能选项、同意控件、轮播控制和步骤导航是否可通过键盘按合理顺序聚焦与操作，并始终显示清晰的焦点状态？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户将清晰度和无障碍列为首要目标；仅有霓虹错误色不足以让不同能力的申请者理解字段含义和失败原因。
keypoints.question: 每个表单控件是否都有持续可见、含义明确且与控件正确关联的文字标签，并且校验错误不只依靠颜色表达，还提供可读的具体错误文字？

ambiguities: The request does not define the available contact-preference choices or exactly which profile fields are required; validation tests should follow the labels, required markers, and rules declared by the page rather than assuming every field is mandatory.

The orientation date's calculation or source is unspecified. A self-contained page may use a fixed or locally calculated date, but the confirmation must identify a concrete calendar date rather than only saying that orientation will occur later.
The requested calendar is described as toggling days of the week, so the core check requires seven weekly choices and does not impose a month grid or date-specific scheduling model.

outcomes.endpoint: The community-volunteer application collects the applicant's legal name, preferred name, date of birth, and offered contact preference before accepting the profile step.
outcomes.quote: The first step of our flow is basic profiling. We need inputs for the volunteer's legal name, preferred name, date of birth, and contact preferences.
test_cases: Start the community-volunteer application, enter distinct values for legal name, preferred name, and date of birth, choose one offered contact preference, and activate Next; verify the profile is accepted and the availability-and-skills stage becomes available.

Start again and leave a field that the page declares required empty, then activate Next; verify the application remains on the profile stage and provides specific readable validation feedback for the missing field.

outcomes.endpoint: The applicant can provide weekly availability and select one or more offered help categories used for volunteer matching.
outcomes.quote: The second step dives into their availability and skills. Here we need a dynamic calendar widget where they can click to toggle days of the week they are free, turning those selected blocks into one of our glowing neon colors for immediate visual feedback. Below the calendar, we need a section for them to select what they can help with, like light lifting, cooking, or just chatting.
test_cases: Complete the prerequisite profile and proceed to availability; verify all seven weekdays are offered, select one day and confirm it is selected, toggle it again and confirm it is no longer selected, then leave two other days selected.

Complete the prerequisite profile, proceed to availability and skills, select light lifting, cooking, and chatting using the available controls, verify the exact three options have clear selected states, and advance to establish that the choices are accepted.

outcomes.endpoint: After reviewing the safety and background-check terms, the applicant must provide consent and a retained digital signature; a valid submission replaces the application with confirmation containing a concrete orientation date.
outcomes.quote: The final step is the safety pledge and background check consent. This part needs a large, scrollable text area for the terms, followed by a digital signature pad component where they can use their mouse or finger to sign. Once they hit submit, the entire white card should dissolve into a prominent, neon-highlighted success message confirming their orientation date, using those glowing accents to make the confirmation feel celebratory.
test_cases: Complete all prior stages, reach the final stage, scroll through the terms and confirm they communicate the safety pledge and background-check consent, draw a continuous mouse stroke that remains visible, leave consent unconfirmed, and submit; verify submission is blocked with a specific consent error.
Complete all prior stages, confirm background-check consent but leave the signature pad empty, and submit; verify submission is blocked with a specific signature error rather than showing success.

On a touch-capable browser or touch-emulation run, complete all prior stages, review the terms, confirm consent, draw a continuous finger stroke and verify it remains visible, then submit; verify the application is replaced by a success confirmation containing a concrete, intelligible orientation calendar date.

outcomes.endpoint: The application presents intelligible labels and validation messages and permits keyboard operation of its standard form and navigation controls, allowing the stated audience to complete the flow.
outcomes.quote: Because our audience spans various age groups and technical abilities, clarity and accessibility are my absolute top priorities
test_cases: Complete one full application using the keyboard for all non-signature controls and a permitted mouse or touch input for the signature pad; verify focus remains visible and follows a logical order, each control has a persistent meaningful label, any available carousel and step controls are keyboard-operable, and a deliberately triggered required-field error includes readable text rather than color alone before it is corrected and the application is successfully submitted.

core_scope.purpose: Enable local residents, including users with varied technical abilities, to complete an accessible volunteer application that collects profile and matching information, records safety/background-check consent and a signature, and confirms an orientation date.
review_notes: Profile information, matching preferences, consent, signature, and dated submission confirmation were retained as core because removing any of them prevents the requested volunteer onboarding application from fulfilling its primary purpose.

The testimonial carousel and its placement, attribution mix, autoplay, swipe, and drag behavior were moved to supplementary scope because it is a motivational interstitial rather than a non-substitutable application goal.

Single-page replacement behavior, progress presentation, anchored positioning, slide animation, back-navigation restoration, touch-target sizing, layout, typography, palette, and component styling remain supplementary implementation or presentation requirements rather than separate core outcomes.

Items 25, 28, and 38 are mixed because they combine core terms or submission-confirmation checks with prescribed scrolling, dissolve, fade, or particle presentation. Item 39 is mixed because it covers core application controls as well as the supplementary testimonial carousel.

Accessibility was retained as a core completion concern because the request expressly identifies users with varied technical abilities and prioritizes accessible operation; decorative styling and general visual polish were not elevated with it.

No real background-check service, application backend, or orientation-booking transaction is required. The offline endpoint is recording the requested consent and signature state and displaying the requested dated confirmation.

ambiguities: The request mentions primary conversion buttons, header secondary CTAs, and booking a demo but does not prescribe a particular booking destination or backend transaction. A label-consistent local section, modal, or form is therefore sufficient; a real external booking service must not be assumed.

The request says "a few" fictional Fortune 500 company names without defining a count. Checklist item 29 interprets this as at least three, but social proof remains a supplementary persuasion requirement rather than a core user outcome.

The styling directions say both "zero borders anywhere on the page" and that secondary header CTAs should have a white outline. This conflict concerns supplementary component styling and should not become a core gate.

outcomes.endpoint: The rendered hero intelligibly identifies the offering as a predictive analytics SaaS product for enterprise marketing teams, displays the exact requested H1, and communicates both the 40% churn-reduction claim and use of machine learning.
outcomes.quote: The first screen needs a strong H1 saying "Stop Guessing, Start Predicting" with a subheadline about reducing churn by 40% using machine learning.
test_cases: Load the rendered page and verify that its hero visibly displays the exact H1 "Stop Guessing, Start Predicting" and an intelligible subheadline that connects machine learning with reducing churn by 40%, within an enterprise predictive-analytics product pitch.

outcomes.endpoint: The page provides intelligible product explanations for Automated Segmentation, Churn Risk Scoring, and Omnichannel Attribution, with substantive copy explaining the relevant pain point or solution for each.
outcomes.quote: The core feature section should highlight three major pain points: Automated Segmentation, Churn Risk Scoring, and Omnichannel Attribution, utilizing the two-column text and image pairing to explain the solution.
test_cases: Scroll through the core feature content and verify that all three exact feature names—Automated Segmentation, Churn Risk Scoring, and Omnichannel Attribution—are present and that each has meaningful, product-relevant explanatory copy rather than placeholders or unrelated text.

outcomes.endpoint: The landing page offers a primary conversion CTA, and activating the applicable conversion controls produces a visible destination or interface consistent with each control's declared action rather than a dead or no-op control.
outcomes.quote: We need a high-converting landing page for our new predictive analytics SaaS platform targeting enterprise marketing teams.
test_cases: Identify the page's primary conversion CTA, record its displayed action, activate it through normal browser controls, and verify that the resulting visible section, panel, form, or page is relevant to that action and is not a dead link or no-op.

Identify the secondary CTA in the navigation header, activate it, and verify that its resulting visible destination or interface is consistent with its own label; do not require a real booking or deployment backend.

outcomes.endpoint: The page provides an operable email-capture form that rejects invalid input with clear feedback and accepts a valid email with a visible confirmation state.
outcomes.quote: Include a simple email capture field right above the footer to grab the leads who scroll all the way down but aren't quite ready to book a full demo yet.
test_cases: At the email-capture form, enter a malformed address such as "not-an-email" and submit; verify that a clear validation message is shown, no success state is presented, and the invalid submission is blocked.

At the email-capture form, enter a valid address such as "buyer@example.com" and submit; verify that the page shows an unambiguous success confirmation and a visible follow-up indication rather than silently refreshing or reporting validation failure.

core_scope.purpose: Help enterprise marketing buyers understand the predictive analytics SaaS value proposition and capabilities, then take an appropriate lead-conversion action such as requesting a demo or submitting an email.
review_notes: Kept the indispensable informational content as two core outcomes: the requested value proposition and substantive explanations of the three named capabilities.
Removed social proof from core membership because it is a requested persuasion aid but is substitutable and not itself the landing page's primary informational or conversion endpoint.

Feature image pairing, two-column presentation, and analytics-themed graphics remain supplementary because they assess layout or decorative visualization rather than whether buyers can understand the three capabilities.

Added the primary conversion path as a core outcome because lead conversion is part of the stated end-user purpose. Item 42 is mixed because it combines the primary CTA endpoint with a specifically positioned secondary header CTA.

Email submission behavior remains core because an email-capture form must meaningfully accept valid input and reject invalid input. Item 35 is mixed because it combines the core form's existence with its supplementary placement immediately above the footer.

Status bars, navigation layout, typography, colors, fixed positioning, section ordering, reference-page resemblance, technical packaging, and overflow robustness remain supplementary requirements rather than independent core outcomes.

ambiguities: The request says v2.5.2 should focus purely on community-driven bug fixes while also requiring every version block to contain features and deprecated-API areas. Those areas may therefore state none or not applicable rather than inventing non-bug-fix changes.
No exact calendar dates are supplied for the releases. Date checks should accept any intelligible release-date metadata and must not impose unrequested specific dates.
“Download Source” appears as an example of a clickable element whose styling should be pill-shaped, rather than as an independently specified download transaction or required destination.

outcomes.endpoint: The visible page clearly identifies itself as the Chronos Engine documentation/changelog and explains that the project preserves early web-rendering techniques and behaviors.
outcomes.quote: "Chronos Engine" — a specialized developer toolkit dedicated entirely to preserving early 2000s web rendering techniques and behaviors.
test_cases: Load the page and read its introductory content; verify that a visitor can identify it as the Chronos Engine changelog/documentation and understand that the project’s mission is preserving early web-rendering techniques and behaviors, rather than having to infer that purpose from decoration alone.

outcomes.endpoint: The version history includes v3.0.0, v2.5.2, and v2.0.0 from newest to oldest, with readable release metadata and substantive, version-specific summaries, feature lists, deprecated-API areas, and bug-fix lists containing the requested facts.
outcomes.quote: Each version block requires a narrative summary of the release focus, a structured list of new features, a dedicated area for deprecated legacy APIs, and an itemized list of bug fixes.
test_cases: Load the page and review the version history from newest to oldest. Confirm that it includes v3.0.0, v2.5.2, and v2.0.0 in that order; each release has an intelligible date or equivalent release-date metadata, a narrative summary, a features list, a deprecated-APIs area, and an itemized bug-fix list, with an explicit none/not-applicable entry accepted where appropriate. For v3.0.0, also verify the Epoch title, rebuilt canvas pipeline, authentic CRT pixel-bleed and scanline artifacts, the 45% efficiency increase, and replacement of modern CSS Grid support with the table-based layout emulation engine.

Review the complete v2.5.2 release entry and verify that its substantive focus is community-driven bug fixes, including resolution of the legacy <marquee> parser memory leak and stabilization of MIDI background-audio playback; any required features or deprecations area must not invent changes that contradict the bug-fix-only focus.

Review the complete v2.0.0 release entry and verify that it is presented as the foundation release with a manifesto-like explanation of preserving fragile digital history and making it accessible in modern browsers, while retaining the required clearly identified release-detail areas.

core_scope.purpose: Enable public visitors and weekly contributors to understand Chronos Engine’s preservation mission and review a detailed, intelligible history of the specified releases.
review_notes: The detailed release history is the principal changelog outcome, so the overlapping version-content checks were consolidated into one outcome with separate end-to-end scenarios for the three requested releases.

Project identity and preservation mission were retained as a distinct informational outcome. Item 8 is mixed because it checks that content together with a giant full-width hero treatment, which is supplementary layout styling.
Sticky positioning and anchor jumps were moved to supplementary scope because they are convenient navigation mechanisms but are substitutable; users can still read the changelog without them.
The community and newsletter forms remain supplementary incidental forms. The request explicitly says no feedback backend is required, so no submission transaction was invented as a core outcome.

Exact semantic tags, single-file packaging, viewport fit, responsive behavior, visual references, typography, pill styling, retro tone, source-link existence, JavaScript robustness, and overflow stress tests remain supplementary implementation, presentation, or quality requirements rather than separate core user goals.
