ambiguities: Checklist item 6 describes an extremely thin, low-weight main-title treatment, while the request asks for a massive, extremely heavy, tightly packed sans-serif hero title. This conflict concerns supplementary typography and is not resolved as a core gate.

outcomes.endpoint: The page is clearly identifiable as a landing page for one consistently identified CLI developer tool, opens with an overarching value proposition, and presents its main reader-facing explanation in coherent, predominantly English technical prose rather than placeholders or an unrelated product format.
outcomes.quote: dedicated landing page for this new CLI developer tool I've been working on. Since a huge chunk of my readership and the target audience for this tool are based overseas, the primary language will be English, and I really want the reading experience to feel seamless and engaging. I want it to read more like a well-crafted technical essay rather than a dry, corporate software manual.
test_cases: Starting from a fresh load, read the hero and introduction and verify that they consistently identify one CLI developer tool, provide a meaningful overarching value proposition, and use recognizable CLI context rather than presenting a blog index or another product category.

Continue through the main explanatory content and verify that reader-facing headings and paragraphs are predominantly English and include coherent multi-sentence technical discussion rather than placeholder text or only disconnected marketing slogans.

outcomes.endpoint: A working tabbed capabilities component has exactly named Installation, Local Setup, and Deployment choices, begins in a valid single-panel state, and lets readers switch within one container among distinct, semantically appropriate installation, local-configuration, and deployment material represented through code, configuration, or terminal-style output.
outcomes.quote: The tabs should let people switch between 'Installation', 'Local Setup', and 'Deployment' views instantly in the same container.
test_cases: On a fresh load, verify that the component includes labels exactly reading 'Installation', 'Local Setup', and 'Deployment', with one selected tab whose matching panel is visible and no other panel simultaneously exposed.

Using the normal tab controls, activate Installation and then Local Setup; verify that the visible content changes, that Installation provides a recognizable installation method or command, that Local Setup provides local configuration or run instructions, and that only the selected panel remains visible.

Activate Deployment and verify that the container changes to distinct deployment steps, commands, or deployment output; across the three views, confirm that the material substantively represents code or commands, configuration content, and terminal-style output rather than repeating one generic marketing example.

outcomes.endpoint: A dedicated, clearly identified section explains both the tool's practical benefits and concrete everyday CLI use cases through brief, relevant card copy; its visual grid, equal sizing, and icon treatment are not part of the core endpoint.
outcomes.quote: dedicated section breaking down the main benefits and everyday use cases.
test_cases: Read the complete benefits and use-cases section and verify that its title and card copy concern this CLI tool, collectively covering both practical product benefits and at least one concrete everyday usage scenario rather than unrelated team, pricing, or customer material.

Check the explanatory copy across the cards and verify that every presented entry is intelligible and relevant to a benefit or use case; card icons, equal dimensions, and the number of visual columns are not required for this core result.

outcomes.endpoint: The page includes a substantive deeper technical or implementation section that gives readers concrete CLI information, such as command execution flow, configuration conventions, deployment behavior, or error handling, rather than ending after high-level benefits or supplying only generic marketing claims.
outcomes.quote: guiding visitors smoothly down to the nitty-gritty implementation details.
test_cases: Proceed through the page to its deeper technical content and verify that an actual implementation or technical-archive section is present and explains at least one concrete topic—command execution flow, configuration conventions, deployment behavior, or error handling—with enough detail to teach the reader something specific about the CLI.

core_scope.purpose: Enable overseas developers to understand a CLI tool—its value, setup and deployment capabilities, everyday benefits and use cases, and implementation details—through an intelligible English technical landing page.
review_notes: Combined overlapping product identity, English-language delivery, value proposition, and coherent explanatory prose into one reader-facing informational outcome rather than making each a separate gate.

Retained the capability tabs as core because the request identifies them as the critical mechanism for accessing three distinct kinds of technical material. The revised scenarios exercise complete states and verify semantic content, not merely clicks or generic DOM changes.

Retained requested benefits, use cases, and deeper implementation information as core content of this informational page. Three-column geometry, equal card dimensions, icons, and section position are visual or layout requirements, so pure layout checks are supplementary and mixed checks remain mixed.

Moved the sticky sidebar table of contents and its anchor behavior to supplementary scope. It improves navigation and reading continuity, but removing it does not prevent users from accessing and understanding the requested CLI information; stickiness and unobtrusiveness are also layout concerns.

Hero prominence, benefits-section placement, card icon presence, and the late-page position of technical content are mixed with relevant core content in their checklist wording, so items 23, 26, 27, and 30 are mapped as mixed rather than treated as wholly core.

CTA behavior, exact section ordering, visual references, palette, typography, hover styling, single-file packaging, generic JavaScript health, overflow resilience, and generic DOM-change probes remain supplementary. No backend, download transaction, or deployment API was invented.

ambiguities: The request describes color coming from “user-uploaded food photography” but does not request an upload workflow or persistence mechanism; this is treated as a description of the supplied imagery, not as an unrequested transaction.

“toggle between the polished essay and the raw source text” could mean that the raw text replaces the essay or expands alongside it. The core endpoint therefore requires access to both content types without imposing replacement behavior.

No source corpus or factual ground truth is supplied for the recipes or bibliography, so tests can establish topical, non-placeholder, identifiable content but cannot independently certify historical accuracy.
Checklist item "pal_1" refers to reference “E,” but the request does not map letter E unambiguously to a named reference page; it remains supplementary rather than becoming a core interpretation.

outcomes.endpoint: Readers can browse recognizable, intelligible archive content about historical recipes and culinary deconstruction, including distinguishable recipe entries with titles, food imagery, and period associations.
outcomes.quote: single-page reading notes archive focused on historical recipes and culinary deconstructions.
test_cases: From the initial page state, review the archive introduction and at least two recipe entries; verify that the content is intelligibly about historical recipes or culinary research, that sampled entries have distinguishable recipe titles and food or dish imagery, and that each has a period association either stated by the page or demonstrated through its declared chronological filtering rules.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating a chronological tag updates the current-page recipe collection to the exact subset associated with that period, without navigation or a full document reload.
outcomes.quote: handle stateful content filtering entirely on the client side without full page reloads.
test_cases: Starting from the unfiltered gallery, identify entries associated under the page's declared rules with two different periods. Activate the first period tag and verify that every visible entry matches it, at least one known nonmatching entry is absent, and the current document does not navigate or fully reload.

Starting from a fresh page state, activate one populated period tag and record the visible recipe titles, then activate a different populated period tag; verify that the visible set changes to the entries associated with the second period, excludes entries known to belong only to the first, and updates within the same document.

outcomes.endpoint: Readers can read the polished deep-dive essay and reveal or hide its substantive raw source notes through an accordion interaction.
outcomes.quote: Expandable `<details>` and `<summary>` accordions for the raw notes, allowing readers to toggle between the polished essay and the raw source text.
test_cases: Starting with a raw-notes section collapsed, read a relevant polished-essay passage, focus and activate its raw-notes summary through a normal keyboard or pointer control, and verify that substantive associated source text becomes readable; activate the summary again and verify that the raw text is hidden while the polished essay remains available.

outcomes.endpoint: Readers can expand the bibliography and read recognizable, non-placeholder citations that identify the sources supporting the archive.
outcomes.quote: A collapsible reference bibliography at the footer.
test_cases: Starting with the bibliography collapsed, activate its summary through a normal pointer or keyboard control and verify that one or more distinguishable citations become readable with sufficient identifying information such as author and title or year; collapse it again and verify that the citation list is hidden.

core_scope.purpose: Enable readers to browse intelligible historical-recipe and culinary-deconstruction notes, narrow recipe entries by chronology without leaving the page, compare polished essays with raw source notes, and consult supporting references.
review_notes: Added the archive's actual historical-recipe information as a core outcome because an informational page fails its primary purpose if its requested subject matter and entries are not intelligible.
Consolidated each interaction into an end-to-end scenario that performs the control action and verifies the resulting content state; trivial open/find/click steps were not listed as separate tests.

Kept CSS Grid implementation, section order, whitespace, alternating columns, responsive breakpoints, viewport fit, animation techniques, color, typography, focus appearance, semantic markup, maintainability, and packaging as supplementary requirements rather than independent core user goals.
Items 22 and 23 remain supplementary because they check filter-control organization and selected-state presentation rather than whether the resulting recipe subset is correct.

Item 29 is mixed because it checks access to raw notes but also mandates the native `<details>/<summary>` implementation. Item 31 is mixed because it checks access to citations together with footer placement and specific activation details.

Items 36 and 37 are mixed because topical relevance supports the archive outcome, while their absolute originality, named-reference exclusion, and cleanup conditions go beyond the minimum informational endpoint.
No upload service, database, factual-verification backend, or deployment API was invented for this offline single-page deliverable.

ambiguities: The single maximum-dimension slider does not specify whether fit is determined by width, height, depth, the largest dimension, or another aggregate. Filtering correctness should follow a clearly displayed rule chosen by the page rather than imposing an unstated formula.

The source and timing of "real-time" inventory changes are unspecified. For an offline self-contained page, a deterministic client-side simulation is sufficient; a WebSocket, polling service, or real inventory backend must not be inferred.

The phrase "swipe horizontally to spin the item 360 degrees, or toggle a button" contains an OR construction that may describe alternative available actions rather than requiring both as independent gates. Neither enhancement is indispensable to the storefront’s primary browse-and-reserve purpose.
The request does not define the exact hours constituting Saturday morning. The page may declare a reasonable morning range, which should then be applied consistently.
The reservation request ends with capturing contact information and does not specify server submission, payment, or a confirmation record. Those backend outcomes should not be invented.
Although the showroom is described as low-cost, the request does not ask for per-item prices or define an affordability threshold, so price display is not made a core requirement.

outcomes.endpoint: The inventory feed presents upcycled furniture entries with the substantive information users need to identify and assess each piece: name, source material, exact inch measurements, and a concrete volunteer repair history.
outcomes.quote: Each piece of furniture should be displayed in a dedicated block that lists its name, the original source material, exact measurements in inches, and a short history of how our community volunteers repaired it, keeping the language transparent and honest.
test_cases: Inspect the inventory feed and verify it contains at least one upcycled furniture entry; for every displayed entry, verify it provides a furniture name, original source material, exact numeric dimensions explicitly labeled in inches, and a piece-specific account of volunteer repair work rather than generic promotional copy.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can set a visible maximum-size threshold and the inventory immediately applies the page’s declared dimensional-fit rule, retaining qualifying pieces and excluding over-limit pieces without a full-page reload.
outcomes.quote: interactive filtering tool where users can drag a sliding scale to set their maximum room dimensions, and the page dynamically updates the available inventory below without ever needing to reload.
test_cases: Choose listed pieces with different measurements under the page’s declared fit rule, set the slider threshold between those measurements, and verify the displayed threshold and unit update, every remaining item numerically satisfies the threshold, and at least one over-limit item is removed without a page reload; then raise the threshold and verify the previously excluded qualifying item returns.

outcomes.endpoint: Every inventory item communicates its current pickup state with the specified status mapping, and the visible status reacts to client-side inventory-state changes without reloading the page; the badge color is supplementary presentation rather than part of the core endpoint.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 38 states the expected reactive mapping, but neither the request nor checklist defines a deterministic update trigger or observable schedule usable through normal browser controls. A page-declared client-side simulation path is needed to test the live transition end to end in an offline artifact.
outcomes.quote: Include a live availability indicator for each item, which updates in real-time based on our inventory state, showing a bright green "Ready for Pickup" badge if it is in the shop, or a "Currently being varnished" status if it is still in the workshop area.
test_cases: Inspect every inventory entry and verify it displays exactly one applicable status: "Ready for Pickup" for a piece declared to be in the shop or "Currently being varnished" for a piece declared to be in the workshop.

Run the page’s declared offline inventory-update demonstration for one item, beginning in one declared location/state and triggering or waiting for its declared transition to the other; verify the same item’s status changes to the corresponding required text without a page reload.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can take a unique ID shown on a reservable furniture entry through an in-place wizard, select an allowed Saturday-morning pickup slot, and enter only a first name and phone number, without requiring a backend transaction.
outcomes.quote: multi-step reservation form that changes state in place without reloading, asking first for the furniture item ID, then smoothly transitioning to a calendar for selecting a Saturday morning pickup slot, and finally capturing just their first name and a phone number
test_cases: Verify reservable furniture entries expose clear unique IDs, choose one displayed ID, enter it in the reservation wizard, advance in place to the calendar, select an enabled Saturday-morning slot, and reach the final step without a page reload; verify that step requests only first name and phone number and accepts and retains both values.

Starting with another displayed valid item ID, reach the scheduling step and verify a non-Saturday date and any visibly offered non-morning time are unavailable or cannot be selected, while a Saturday slot within the page’s declared morning hours can be selected and allows progression.

core_scope.purpose: Enable local families to browse and understand available upcycled furniture, narrow the inventory by physical fit, see each piece’s current availability, and enter a Saturday-morning pickup reservation through the page.
review_notes: Added the substantive furniture catalog as a core outcome because access to the requested item details is necessary for users to assess pieces; the proposal omitted this informational core.

Added per-item availability as a core outcome because knowing whether a chosen piece is ready is materially necessary. The aggregate header counter remains supplementary because it is a dashboard summary rather than a non-substitutable user goal.

Kept dimensional filtering as core but replaced separate locate, drag, and reload observations with an end-to-end scenario that numerically checks both exclusion and restoration against the page’s declared fit rule. Slider placement and the requirement to use that exact control type remain supplementary.

Kept the reservation wizard as core and combined its stages into complete valid and scheduling-constraint scenarios. Form placement, touch-target sizing, and helper text remain supplementary usability or layout requirements.

Removed the 360-degree view and dimension-overlay interaction from core membership. They enhance product presentation, but the required measurements are already available in the catalog and their removal does not eliminate the main browse, fit, availability, or reservation goals.

Removed the live aggregate counter from core membership. Its correctness is still scored by supplementary items 13, 14, and 39, but it is not the business endpoint users need to select and reserve a piece.

Single-column layout, viewport robustness, typography, colors, component geometry, footer presentation, mission copy, imagery, and technical packaging remain scored supplementary requirements rather than independent core gates.
No real deployment, inventory backend, or completed server-side reservation was added; offline client-side visible states are the appropriate measurement scope.

ambiguities: 中间栏在账单模块中可展示历史月份卡片“或者”不同子站点入口；但后文又明确要求通过历史月份切换用量，因此月份选择对用量流程是必要的，而子站点入口不应被额外设为核心硬门槛。
验收中的“所有涉及到方案试算和展开折叠的升级操作”既可能要求必须提供试算和折叠功能，也可能只规定这些功能在存在时不得跳页。由于主升级目标可由其他可用的就地方案选择完成，未把试算器和折叠组件本身设为不可替代的核心结果。
“当前右侧区”与“全屏的高斯模糊遮罩”对遮罩覆盖范围表述不完全一致；核心只要求降级警示在当前页面阻断并呈现，具体覆盖尺寸属于呈现要求。
请求未给出历史月份的具体额度数据、升级价格计算规则或密码复杂度规则；测试应采用页面明确声明的规则和数据，不能另行假设数值。
检查项 19、inv_1 和 inv_2 使用 A、C、D 参考编号，但任务数据没有明确给出这些字母与五份参考页面的映射。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够进入与创作者通行证相关的基础档案设置，提交新密码，并在当前视图获得明确的成功或校验结果；不要求真实后端持久化。

test_cases: 从账号设置中心进入「基础档案」，输入两次不一致的新密码并提交，确认页面在当前视图给出明确的校验反馈且不显示修改成功。
重新输入满足页面所声明规则且两次一致的新密码并提交，确认页面在当前视图给出明确的成功反馈；不要求调用真实账号后端。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够查看流量、存储和并发三项具体额度，识别接近上限的资源警报，并切换可辨识的历史月份以获得该月份对应的三项数据。

outcomes.quote: 顶部放置三个容量环形图（流量、存储、并发）。当用户在中间栏切换不同的历史月份时，这里不仅数字要实时更新，还要写纯前端的数字跳动和水波纹猛烈上涨的动效，直观传递出额度见底的紧迫感。
test_cases: 从初始页面选择「用量大盘」，确认当前视图同时清晰标注流量、存储、并发，每项均有具体已用量/配额或百分比，并且至少一项接近上限的数据带有明确警报或升级提示。
进入历史月份选择界面，选择两个具有明确月份标识且由页面声明对应数据的月份；每次选择后，确认选中月份正确，并逐项核对流量、存储和并发数值与该月份所声明的数据一致，而不只是确认数字发生了变化。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够理解与创作者业务相关的具体高级版权益，并通过升级 CTA 在同一页面进入可用的升级方案或选择状态，而不是遇到空链接、页面跳出或新窗口。
outcomes.missing_check: 现有检查项验证了 CTA 存在、权益文案和一般性的就地状态切换，但没有直接核验主升级 CTA 被激活后是否到达一个具体、可用的升级方案或选择状态。
outcomes.quote: 首屏的视觉冲击和行动号召（CTA）必须第一时间抓住他们，顺滑地给他们种草高级版特权。
test_cases: 在账号设置中心找到升级 CTA，阅读其附近明确列出的创作者高级版权益后激活 CTA；确认同一文档内出现可识别的升级方案、选择或确认状态，并且没有打开新窗口、离开页面或停留在空链接上。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户发起降级时，在当前页面看到包含“保留当前档位赠 50G”方案的警示流程；降级确认在完整的 5 秒倒计时结束前不可用，归零后才解锁。
outcomes.quote: 如果用户点击了不起眼的“降级订阅”，当前右侧区直接由前端控制铺上一层全屏的高斯模糊遮罩，弹出一个巨大的警示卡片。卡片倒计时 5 秒后才解锁确认按钮，同时抛出一个带有呼吸光晕动效的“保留当前档位赠 50G”专属特惠按钮。
test_cases: 进入订阅相关界面并激活「降级订阅」，确认当前页面出现警示流程和包含 50G 赠送信息的保留当前档位方案；确认降级确认按钮从 5 秒开始处于禁用状态，归零前尝试激活不会继续，归零后按钮才变为可用。

outcomes.endpoint: 交付物是无需外部网络资源即可刷新、完整显示并执行核心账号设置、用量查询、升级和降级挽留流程的单个 HTML 页面。
outcomes.quote: 所有的 CSS、JS、业务图表、SVG 图标必须百分之百封在一个独立的 HTML 文件里，拔掉网线也要能瞬间完整渲染。
test_cases: 确认交付物只有一个 HTML 文件，关闭网络并在记录 Network 请求的情况下强制刷新；确认内容、样式和图标完整显示且没有远程 CSS、JS、字体或图片请求。随后离线执行密码有效/无效提交反馈、历史月份用量切换、升级 CTA 状态切换以及降级 5 秒倒计时，核对各流程均达到其预期最终结果。

core_scope.purpose: 提供一个可完全离线运行的「创作者通行证」账号设置中心，使用户能够修改账号密码、查看按月份区分的流量/存储/并发额度、了解并进入高级版升级流程，并在降级时获得明确的挽留方案。
review_notes: 三栏栅格、具体列宽、字体、配色、卡片样式和参考页面相似度均保留为补充要求；这些呈现方式不是账号设置、额度查询或升级操作的不可替代终点。
数字跳动、水波上涨和按钮呼吸光晕属于动画反馈，未提升为核心门槛；核心用量结果是三项数据可读、月份对应正确并能识别容量警报。
首屏可见、左栏底部常驻和选中态外观属于布局或视觉要求。检查项同时涉及 CTA 或内容可访问性时列入 mixed_item_ids，纯位置要求则留在 supplementary_ids。
降级流程保留 5 秒解锁和 50G 挽留方案为核心；高斯模糊、巨大卡片、弱视觉权重和呼吸光晕不是完成挽留流程所不可替代的结果。
离线可用是客户端本地预加载场景的必要用户结果；强制使用 inline SVG 的具体实现方式与离线渲染混合在同一检查项中，因此列为 mixed_item_ids。
未虚构真实支付、真实改密或部署 API；离线单页只需提供明确且一致的前端业务状态与反馈。
原提案中拆开的打开、寻找和点击步骤已合并为检查最终业务结果的端到端场景。

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「三栏邮件后台UI」那一份基本一致（三栏式界面布局，左侧深色窄导航条、中间定宽列表列以及右侧宽幅详情预览区）？
字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「横条视频图片卡片页」那一份基本一致（使用极大尺寸且加粗粗壮的无衬线标题，与正文形成极其强烈的字号和字重反差）？
组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「彩色圆标落地页」那一份基本一致（特色鲜明的大尺寸实心彩色圆形底衬加上白色图标，配合极简幽灵按钮和半透明低对比度输入框）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「B」份「带打字机图的浅色网页」：整体为明亮的浅色调，背景为米白色（Off-white），文字为深灰色，强调色为中蓝色（用于按钮和高亮）。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「带打字机图的浅色网页」那一份基本一致（整体为明亮的浅色调，背景为米白色（Off-white），文字为深灰色，强调色为中蓝色（用于按钮和高亮）。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「配色」；错误来源「A」份「带大楼图的深色网页」在这一面是：整体为暗色调，以深色大楼照片为背景，组件多为带透明度的深色，强调色为青绿色（Teal）。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带大楼图的深色网页」那一份（整体为暗色调，以深色大楼照片为背景，组件多为带透明度的深色，强调色为青绿色（Teal）。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「配色」；错误来源「C」份「带发光按钮的深色网页」在这一面是：深色模式配色，背景为极深的海军蓝/近黑色，卡片为略浅的深蓝色，强调色为高饱和的荧光青/亮蓝色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带发光按钮的深色网页」那一份（深色模式配色，背景为极深的海军蓝/近黑色，卡片为略浅的深蓝色，强调色为高饱和的荧光青/亮蓝色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「配色」；错误来源「D」份「有斜角背景块的网页」在这一面是：深色/冷色调，由深石板灰和暗蓝紫色的纯色块交替构成背景，文字全白，无明显的高饱和强调色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「有斜角背景块的网页」那一份（深色/冷色调，由深石板灰和暗蓝紫色的纯色块交替构成背景，文字全白，无明显的高饱和强调色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「带大楼图的深色网页」：采用玻璃拟态（Glassmorphism）风格，卡片是深色半透明并带有细微浅色描边，按钮为青色全圆角（药丸状）实心填充。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大圆角：「A」28px vs 「B」100px；圆角档数：「A」12档 vs 「B」5档；阴影档数：「A」10档 vs 「B」1档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「带大楼图的深色网页」那一份基本一致（采用玻璃拟态（Glassmorphism）风格，卡片是深色半透明并带有细微浅色描边，按钮为青色全圆角（药丸状）实心填充。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「带打字机图的浅色网页」在这一面是：采用极简扁平风格，卡片为纯白底色配极细的浅灰描边（无阴影），按钮为常规圆角矩形实心填充。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带打字机图的浅色网页」那一份（采用极简扁平风格，卡片为纯白底色配极细的浅灰描边（无阴影），按钮为常规圆角矩形实心填充。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「带发光按钮的深色网页」在这一面是：卡片为深蓝色纯色填充、带圆角且无明显边框，按钮包括带青色发光效果的药丸状实心按钮和极细描边按钮。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带发光按钮的深色网页」那一份（卡片为深蓝色纯色填充、带圆角且无明显边框，按钮包括带青色发光效果的药丸状实心按钮和极细描边按钮。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「有斜角背景块的网页」在这一面是：无常规卡片容器（文字直接排在背景上），输入框为细线描边全透明，图片被统一裁剪为圆形。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：最大圆角 100px、圆角档数 5档、阴影档数 1档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「有斜角背景块的网页」那一份（无常规卡片容器（文字直接排在背景上），输入框为细线描边全透明，图片被统一裁剪为圆形。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（font_base_18）。判法：正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：正文字号我要 18px 起，再小我妈就看不清了（判法：正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px）？
keypoints.spec_check: 正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「布局结构」不要做成「带发光按钮的深色网页」那样：典型的SaaS结构：居中的标题介绍 -> 宽幅软件界面截图 -> 下方紧跟规整的 2x3 网格排列的特性卡片。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否明显不同于「带发光按钮的深色网页」那一份（典型的SaaS结构：居中的标题介绍 -> 宽幅软件界面截图 -> 下方紧跟规整的 2x3 网格排列的特性卡片。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「布局结构」不要做成「有斜角背景块的网页」那样：通过贯穿全宽的对角线（斜角）将页面分割成不同颜色区块，内容在区块内采用文字与圆形图片左右交替排列。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「C」份的程序指纹：栅格/卡片间距中位数 16px、内边距中位数 30px、元素密度 55.3个/千像素高、整页高度 5067px。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否明显不同于「有斜角背景块的网页」那一份（通过贯穿全宽的对角线（斜角）将页面分割成不同颜色区块，内容在区块内采用文字与圆形图片左右交替排列。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令开头要求「I'm building a product help center for my new creator tools」
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一个「创作者工具」产品的帮助中心 / 知识库（含搜索、分类目录与教程文章正文），而不是其他主题的网站？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「Start with a dynamic search hero area」
keypoints.question: 页面首屏是否有一个以搜索为核心的 hero 区域，内含可输入的搜索框？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求搜索区「auto-suggests articles as you type」
keypoints.question: 在 hero 搜索框内键入若干字符后，是否在输入框下方实时弹出文章建议列表（自动补全下拉面板）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「auto-suggests articles as you type」，说明建议应随输入内容变化
keypoints.question: 搜索建议列表中出现的条目是否与已键入的字符相匹配（即换一个关键词输入后，列出的建议条目随之改变，而不是固定不变的同一批条目）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「a smooth one-click toggle to switch the whole site between dark and light modes」
keypoints.question: 页面是否有一个明确的明暗模式切换控件（如顶栏的日/月图标或开关），点击一次后整页背景与文字颜色即整体在深色与浅色之间切换？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求的是 dark / light 之间的 toggle，切换必须可逆
keypoints.question: 再次点击该明暗切换控件后，页面是否能切回原先的模式（即切换是可来回的双向状态，而非一次性变化）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「a straightforward sticky table of contents on the left and the article on the right」
keypoints.question: 主体区域是否为左侧目录（table of contents）与右侧文章正文组成的两栏布局，且目录在左、正文在右？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确写的是「sticky table of contents on the left」
keypoints.question: 向下滚动阅读文章正文时，左侧目录是否仍固定停留在视口内可见（sticky），而不是随正文一起滚出屏幕？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求左侧为文章的 table of contents，目录须对应正文章节
keypoints.question: 点击左侧目录中的某一条目后，页面是否跳转/滚动到正文中对应的小节标题处（即目录条目是可用的页内锚点，而非死链）？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 用户要求提供文章的 table of contents，因此目录项应真实对应正文中的章节。
keypoints.question: 左侧目录中的每个条目是否都能在右侧正文中找到对应的实际小节，而不存在指向缺失章节的目录项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「Frame the category directory using the aesthetic from the dark page with the building」
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个分类目录（category directory）板块，由多张分类卡片组成？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 用户要求提供 help center 的 category directory，因此每张分类卡至少应明确标示其分类主题。
keypoints.question: 分类目录中的每张卡片是否都给出了清晰可辨的分类名称，使用户能够判断其对应的内容主题？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「use those fully rounded, pill-shaped cyan buttons for the support calls to action」
keypoints.question: 页面是否含有面向客服/支持的行动号召按钮（如「联系支持」「提交工单」一类文案）？

keypoints.basis: 指令说明「most entries will be medium length, roughly half text and half images」，因此应检查正文图文并重，但不强制固定交替模式或精确数量。
keypoints.question: 文章正文是否同时包含较充实的说明文字与多张教程截图，并呈现大致均衡的图文占比？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「bake in a fluid lightbox feature for clicking and expanding the tutorial screenshots」
keypoints.question: 点击正文中的某张教程截图后，是否打开一个覆盖页面的灯箱（lightbox）层，将该图以放大形式居中展示？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求的 lightbox 功能必须可关闭才能继续阅读
keypoints.question: 灯箱打开后，是否提供可用的关闭方式（关闭按钮或点击遮罩区域），点击后灯箱消失并回到原文章阅读位置？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求「End each page with a stateful feedback widget」
keypoints.question: 文章末尾是否有反馈组件，给出类似「这篇文章有帮助吗？」的提问并提供「是 / 否」两个可点击选项？

ambiguities: The request names a category directory but does not explicitly require every category card to navigate or filter content; checklist item 36 is therefore supplementary rather than a core transaction.
“Stateful feedback widget” clearly requires visible in-page states but does not require persistence across a reload or a backend submission.
The search destination is intentionally flexible: opening, loading, or scrolling to the selected article are valid alternatives, so no single navigation mechanism is required.

outcomes.endpoint: The page provides relevant creator-tool help information through clearly named categories and a titled article with archival metadata, coherent multi-sentence instructional prose, and body paragraphs rendered at the declared minimum size of 18px.
outcomes.quote: product help center for my new creator tools, and since I care deeply about reading experience and proper archiving, I want it to feel like a well-crafted essay collection rather than a dry manual
test_cases: On a fresh load, review the category directory and displayed article together: verify the categories communicate recognizable creator-tool help topics, the article has a clear title and at least one archival field such as category or update date, and its sections contain coherent multi-sentence guidance rather than placeholders or unrelated reference-site content.
Inspect the rendered article prose across its sections and verify every body paragraph has a computed font size of at least 18px, while remaining readable as continuous explanatory text.

outcomes.endpoint: Entering article-related text in the help-center search dynamically returns matching suggestions, and selecting a suggestion opens, loads, or scrolls to the corresponding help content.
outcomes.quote: dynamic search hero area that auto-suggests articles as you type
test_cases: Using a distinctive term from an article title or topic declared on the page, type the term into the search field, verify that dynamically displayed suggestions correspond to that term, select one result, and confirm that the opened, loaded, or scrolled-to help content matches the selected suggestion.

Use a different term associated with another declared article or topic, verify that the suggestions update rather than retaining the same fixed set, then select a result and confirm that its corresponding help content becomes accessible.

core_scope.purpose: Enable creator-tool users to find and read accessible, intelligible, and properly archived help articles.
review_notes: Retained creator-tool information, intelligible essay-like article content, archival context, and the explicit 18px minimum as the core informational outcome.
Retained matching and selectable search suggestions as the primary article-discovery flow; the hero placement and mere existence of an input in item 13 do not independently establish that endpoint.

Moved the sticky two-column arrangement and table-of-contents mechanics to supplementary scope because they are requested layout and secondary navigation choices, not indispensable help-content outcomes.

Moved lightbox behavior, feedback-form states, support actions, theme switching, transitions, colors, component aesthetics, and viewport-fit checks to supplementary scope because they are presentation or secondary interactions.

Item 25 remains mixed because substantial explanatory content supports the core reading goal, while screenshot quantity and an approximately balanced image-to-text ratio are presentational requirements.
The generic DOM-change probe in item int_1 remains supplementary because an unspecified DOM mutation cannot establish search correctness or information quality.

keypoints.question: Our Approach 板块中是否明确给出了免预约的危机接待时段（drop-in crisis hours），包含具体的日期/时间信息？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求解释费用与危机时段时 'without feeling like a dense syllabus or a corporate brochure'
keypoints.question: Our Approach 的文案是否以简短、口语化、非制度化的方式撰写（不是密集的条款式课程大纲或企业宣传语气）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'a dedicated roster area introducing our five counselors'
keypoints.question: 页面是否有一个专门的咨询师名录区域，且其中恰好介绍 5 位咨询师（不是 3、4 或 6 位）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'highlighting their specific focus areas like neurodivergence, academic pressure, and identity exploration'
keypoints.question: 五位咨询师是否各自标注了具体的专长方向，且这些方向中至少涵盖神经多样性（neurodivergence）、学业压力（academic pressure）与身份探索（identity exploration）三项？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求每位咨询师的资料包含“a raw, unfiltered black-and-white portrait followed by a short, first-person text bio”，应检查内容组成与阅读顺序，而不强制所有屏幕尺寸下都采用上下排列。
keypoints.question: 每位咨询师条目是否都包含可辨识为人物肖像的黑白（无彩色）图像，并在内容或阅读顺序上先呈现肖像、随后呈现其简短的第一人称简介？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求简介为 'a short, first-person text bio'，且 'feels deeply personal'
keypoints.question: 每位咨询师的简介是否都以第一人称口吻撰写（如出现 "I"/"my" 等自述表达），而非第三人称履历式描述？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The most critical piece of this build is the intake flow, which needs to be a multi-step responsive form'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个多步骤（分步推进、非一屏铺完所有字段）的入组/预约表单？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求入组流程是 'multi-step' 的表单
keypoints.question: 在表单第一步点击“下一步/继续”类按钮后，界面是否真的切换到下一步并显示新的字段内容，而非停留原地无反应？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'students can quietly select what they are struggling with'
keypoints.question: 入组表单中是否有一步专门让学生勾选/选择自己正在困扰的问题类型，并提供多个具体可选项（如焦虑、学业压力、身份认同等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'utilizing large touch targets for easy mobile tapping'
keypoints.question: 表单中的可选项与推进按钮是否为面积明显偏大的点击块（整块可点的大目标，而非细小的复选框或小号文字链接）？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求学生可以 'select what they are struggling with'，选择须有可见反馈
keypoints.question: 点击某个"我正在困扰的问题"选项后，该选项是否给出可见的已选中状态（与未选中项在视觉上可区分）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Include a section for emergency resources and late-night hotlines'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个紧急资源与深夜热线板块，并列出多条具体资源（含名称与可拨打的号码/联系方式）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求紧急资源 'formatted as a stark matrix that is instantly legible'
keypoints.question: 紧急资源是否以清晰的行列矩阵形式组织（每行一条资源，各列信息如名称／联系方式／可用时段纵向对齐），做到一眼可读？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求页脚 'offering the physical address near campus, basic hours, and a plain text link to our privacy commitment'
keypoints.question: 页脚是否同时给出了三项内容：靠近校园的实际地址、基本营业/开放时间、以及一条指向隐私承诺的纯文本链接？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求页脚提供一条指向“privacy commitment regarding university confidentiality”的纯文本链接，但没有规定必须采用某个固定标题或字面措辞。
keypoints.question: 页脚的纯文本隐私链接是否明确指向或表明一项涉及大学保密关系的隐私承诺，而非仅提供缺乏相关保密含义的泛化链接？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求移动端保持结构张力，让细线布局干净地重新堆叠，同时保证响应式体验；具体列数可按内容需要调整。
keypoints.question: 在窄视口（手机宽度）下，多列内容是否重排为适合窄屏的单列或紧凑布局，分隔线随结构重新对齐，且不出现横向溢出、文字重叠或元素被裁切？

keypoints.basis: 指令仅要求借鉴参考页的设计语言（排版、分割线、组件反例），不得复用其文字内容
keypoints.question: 页面正文是否全部围绕学生心理咨询这一指定主题原创撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名（如 Arcana、HTML5 UP、dtox、Start Bootstrap）或其示例文案？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求只借设计语言，不复用截图里的条目名称与行业内容
keypoints.question: 页面是否没有照搬参考截图里的无关行业内容（如 SEO/仪表盘营销文案、App Store 下载徽章文案、Lorem ipsum 占位段落、天文台竖排中文条目）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML、CSS/JS 内联、不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含的单文件 HTML（样式与脚本内联，无任何外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求导航 stripped back to just the absolute essentials—"Our Approach", "The Team", and "Start Talking"。
keypoints.question: 主导航是否只保留且完整包含 "Our Approach"、"The Team" 和 "Start Talking" 这三个核心入口，没有加入 Home、Features、Pricing 等额外顶级导航项？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户指定了 "The Team" 导航入口，并要求页面提供 dedicated roster area；该入口应可用地指向对应内容。
keypoints.question: 点击导航中的 "The Team" 后，页面是否实际滚动或跳转到包含五位咨询师的名录区域，而不是死链或错误板块？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户将 "Start Talking" 列为核心导航入口，并强调 booking form and the action triggers throughout the site，因此这些入口必须真正接进入组流程。
keypoints.question: 页面中所有 "Start Talking" 或等价预约行动入口是否都会实际打开、聚焦或滚动到入组表单，而不是仅作为无响应的装饰按钮？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求最关键部分是 multi-step responsive intake flow，并称其为 booking form；完整流程应可逐步走通并得到提交确认，不要求真实后端预约。
keypoints.question: 入组表单是否能够从第一步连续推进到最后一步并完成提交，在完成后显示明确的成功或下一步确认信息，而不是只演示一次步骤切换便中断？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求 intake flow 为 responsive form，并要求 large touch targets for easy mobile tapping；仅检查页面整体重排不足以保证后续隐藏步骤也能在手机上使用。
keypoints.question: 在手机宽度下，入组表单的每一个步骤是否都能完整显示当前问题、选项和前进/返回操作，并可在不横向滚动或缩放页面的情况下完成整个流程？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求每位咨询师肖像后跟随 a short, first-person text bio，并希望介绍 feels deeply personal；现有条目只检查了第一人称，未检查简短与个人化。
keypoints.question: 五位咨询师的第一人称简介是否各自保持为简短、个人化的一小段自述，避免写成长篇履历、资格清单或第三人称机构介绍？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求 emergency resources and late-night hotlines；仅列出普通资源名称和联系方式不能证明存在深夜可用的求助渠道。
keypoints.question: 紧急资源板块是否至少包含一项明确标注为深夜可用或 24/7 可用的热线，并同时清楚展示其电话号码和可用时段？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求该矩阵在学生于手机上紧急查看时仍 instantly legible，并特别描述了 through tears at 2 AM 的高压使用情境。
keypoints.question: 在手机宽度下，紧急资源矩阵是否将每条资源的名称、号码和可用时段保持为紧密关联且清晰可辨的信息组，号码无需横向滚动即可立即找到和读取？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

ambiguities: The intake request does not define required personal fields, validation rules, persistence, backend delivery, or appointment allocation. Tests should follow only the form's displayed requirements; an explicit front-end completion or next-step confirmation is sufficient.
No exact sliding-scale amounts, eligibility formula, or drop-in schedule is supplied. The page may declare reasonable values, but it must explain the scale and provide concrete crisis days or times.

Counselor names and the identities of most emergency resources are not prescribed. Evaluation should use the requested counts, profile information, focus coverage, contacts, and availability rather than assume particular names.
The campus is not identified, so the address can be checked for being physical and explicitly presented as near campus, but its real-world proximity cannot be established from the request.

The privacy commitment may be an internal section, dialog, or other self-contained destination. The request does not require an external policy page, but a dead or merely generic privacy link would not establish access to the stated commitment.

outcomes.endpoint: The opening content clearly identifies the service as a therapy collective for students and directly addresses both academic and social burnout rather than offering generic mental-health messaging.
outcomes.quote: We need a digital space for a new student-focused therapy collective
test_cases: Read the opening heading and supporting copy on a fresh load and confirm that, together, they identify a student-focused therapy collective and intelligibly address both academic and social burnout.

outcomes.endpoint: A student can enter the intake flow, select one or more displayed struggles, progress through distinct steps using the form's declared requirements, and reach an explicit completion or next-step confirmation.
outcomes.quote: The most critical piece of this build is the intake flow, which needs to be a multi-step responsive form where students can quietly select what they are struggling with
test_cases: From a fresh load, activate a visible "Start Talking" action, choose any struggle offered by the form, record its label, confirm that exact option gains a visible selected state, and continue using only values required by the displayed rules. Verify that advancing reveals genuinely new step content and that completing all steps produces an explicit success or next-step confirmation rather than stopping mid-flow.

On separate fresh loads, activate every other visible "Start Talking" or equivalent booking action and verify that each makes the actionable intake flow current by opening it, focusing it, or moving the viewport to it rather than remaining inert or leading elsewhere.

outcomes.endpoint: Students can reach and understand an explanation of how the sliding-scale fees work and the concrete days or times when drop-in crisis support is available.
outcomes.quote: an "Our Approach" section that explains our sliding-scale fees and drop-in crisis hours
test_cases: Activate the "Our Approach" navigation entry and, in the reached content, verify both an explicit sliding-scale mechanism or set of fee levels based on the page's declared rule and concrete day/time information for drop-in crisis hours.

outcomes.endpoint: Students can reach a roster of exactly five counselors, understand a personal profile and specific focus area for each counselor, and find coverage of neurodivergence, academic pressure, and identity exploration across the roster.
outcomes.quote: a dedicated roster area introducing our five counselors, highlighting their specific focus areas like neurodivergence, academic pressure, and identity exploration
test_cases: Activate "The Team" and inspect the reached roster from beginning to end. Confirm there are exactly five distinct counselor profiles, each has an intelligible personal bio and at least one specific focus area, and the roster collectively includes neurodivergence, academic pressure, and identity exploration.

outcomes.endpoint: Students can quickly obtain multiple named emergency resources with usable contact information, including at least one hotline explicitly available late at night or 24/7 with its telephone number and availability shown together.
outcomes.quote: Include a section for emergency resources and late-night hotlines, formatted as a stark matrix
test_cases: Inspect the emergency resources content and verify that multiple distinct resources pair a name with a phone number or other direct contact method. Then identify at least one resource explicitly labeled late-night or 24/7 and confirm that its telephone number and stated availability can be unambiguously associated with that resource.

outcomes.endpoint: Students can obtain a physical near-campus address and basic operating hours and can follow a privacy link to information that clearly concerns confidentiality in relation to the university.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item explicitly verifies that activating the privacy link exposes the university-confidentiality commitment; items 31 and 32 can be satisfied by visible link labeling alone.
outcomes.quote: The footer should serve as a grounding element, just offering the physical address near campus, basic hours, and a plain text link to our privacy commitment regarding university confidentiality.
test_cases: Inspect the practical information at the end of the page and verify that it gives a physical address described as near campus and basic operating hours. Activate the privacy link and confirm that its resulting target or revealed content clearly communicates a privacy commitment involving university confidentiality.

core_scope.purpose: Enable students to recognize a student-focused therapy collective, understand its approach and counselors, access urgent support information, and complete a self-contained intake flow.
review_notes: Added the student-focused opening as a core informational outcome because audience identity and the requested academic/social burnout message establish what service the page provides.
Replaced separate open, find, click, and read checks with end-to-end scenarios that use navigation or calls to action as setup and then verify the substantive content or completed intake result.

Kept the working named navigation routes with their corresponding outcomes because those items test arrival at substantive requested content, while exact navigation composition and unobtrusive placement remain supplementary.

Kept visual direction, dark theme, typography, brutalist controls, grid treatment, matrix formatting, touch-target size, and general viewport reflow supplementary rather than treating appearance or responsive fit as business endpoints.
Item 41 remains mixed because it combines the core ability to finish the intake flow with mobile viewport-fit requirements. Core completion is independently covered by item 40.

Items 22, 23, and 42 remain mixed because they help establish that each counselor has a personal bio while also imposing portrait treatment, ordering, grammatical voice, length, and tone requirements that are not independently indispensable to understanding counselor fit.
Item 31 remains mixed because it checks substantive address, hours, and privacy access together with footer placement and plain-text presentation.
Emergency-resource names, contact details, and late-night availability are core; their matrix layout and phone-width arrangement remain supplementary.

No real booking, messaging, deployment, or emergency-service backend is inferred. The offline page only needs to present the requested information and simulate the intake through a clear completion state.

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「有竖排中文字的网页」那一份基本一致（抛弃常规块状容器，依靠大量极细的直线交错来分割版面，包含纯靠留白组织的松散多列文本区和无边框表格。）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「左深色侧导仪表盘」：典型的后台控制台布局，左侧纵向通栏导航，右侧为主内容区，上方并排多个卡片，下方拆分为两列数据列表。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「B」9px vs 「A」45.2px；元素密度：「B」361.9个/千像素高 vs 「A」28.6个/千像素高；整页高度：「B」1202px vs 「A」4447px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「左深色侧导仪表盘」那一份神似（典型的后台控制台布局，左侧纵向通栏导航，右侧为主内容区，上方并排多个卡片，下方拆分为两列数据列表，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「薄荷绿侧栏展示页」在这一面是：分为左右两大列，右侧为固定宽度的通栏颜色侧边栏，左侧为内容滚动主区。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「薄荷绿侧栏展示页」那一份（分为左右两大列，右侧为固定宽度的通栏颜色侧边栏，左侧为内容滚动主区）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「灰白极简大留白页」在这一面是：单列通栏向下流式布局，包含全宽深灰色横幅、图文左右对开区块和多列等宽的统计数字区。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「灰白极简大留白页」那一份（单列通栏向下流式布局，包含全宽深灰色横幅、图文左右对开区块和多列等宽的统计数字区）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「D」份「米黄底中文排版页」在这一面是：居中单列的纯文本排版为主，通过多条贯穿的横向细线分割不同段落，部分区域利用空格或排版划分为两列或表格样式。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「米黄底中文排版页」那一份（居中单列的纯文本排版为主，通过多条贯穿的横向细线分割不同段落，部分区域利用空格或排版划分为两列或表格样式）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「E」份「深空霓虹黑月背景」在这一面是：纯绝对居中布局，无长内容滚动流，单个巨大的圆形视觉元素居中占据主导地位。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 45.2px、元素密度 28.6个/千像素高、整页高度 4447px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「深空霓虹黑月背景」那一份（纯绝对居中布局，无长内容滚动流，单个巨大的圆形视觉元素居中占据主导地位）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「A」份「薄荷绿侧栏展示页」：大标题使用明快的薄荷绿色无衬线粗体，正文使用深灰色无衬线体，字号适中且行距非常宽松。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「A」21.3px vs 「C」15px；最大标题字号：「A」74.5px vs 「C」50px；字号档数：「A」6档 vs 「C」12档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「薄荷绿侧栏展示页」那一份基本一致（大标题使用明快的薄荷绿色无衬线粗体，正文使用深灰色无衬线体，字号适中且行距非常宽松）？

ambiguities: The phrase "zero copy" could literally prohibit all words, which would conflict with an intelligible data dashboard. Checklist item 20 clarifies the intended rule as excluding explanatory prose while permitting concise titles, metric labels, numbers, and units.

The request does not prescribe a disease, geography, reporting period, age range, or numeric dataset, so core validation should use the page's declared data context rather than inventing those parameters.

outcomes.endpoint: The rendered page presents intelligible epidemic or infectious-disease metrics and visualizations as its dominant information, while clearly identifying children as the intended campaign audience. Key values and charts have enough concise labels, units, legends, or adjacent context to communicate what they measure without requiring explanatory prose.
outcomes.quote: epidemic data dashboard for a kids campaign
test_cases: Load the page and review its main content as a campaign viewer: verify that the dominant modules present epidemic or infectious-disease data, and that at least one visible title, campaign mark, data dimension, or graphic unmistakably identifies children as the intended audience rather than presenting a generic or unrelated dashboard.

Using only the rendered dashboard, inspect every key numeric indicator and major visualization: verify that each has a concise epidemic-related label and, where needed under the page's own conventions, a unit, legend, axis, or adjacent context sufficient to understand what is being measured; also verify that unrelated reference-brand or business content does not confuse the campaign information.

core_scope.purpose: Enable campaign viewers to understand epidemic data presented specifically for a children's health campaign.
review_notes: Collapsed epidemic subject matter, intelligible data presentation, and children's-campaign identity into one end-to-end informational outcome; checklist items 19 and 28 are overlapping ways to establish the same audience identity rather than separate core gates.

Moved zero-copy treatment, animations, reference-derived layout, typography, component styling, and icy-blue color direction out of core because removing any one of those presentation choices would not eliminate the dashboard's primary informational purpose.

Kept item 24 mixed because epidemic-topic integrity supports the core endpoint, while its absolute prohibition on every unrelated label and its reference-contamination examples extend beyond the minimum informational outcome.

Navigation wording, hover feedback, single-file packaging, JavaScript cleanliness, accessibility sizing, overflow resilience, and negative palette comparisons remain supplementary quality or implementation checks rather than distinct user outcomes.
No core color outcome or missing color check is reported: the requested icy-blue palette is an important supplementary visual requirement, not a non-substitutable user goal.

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「粉色渐变婚庆工具页」在这一面是：采用圆滑纤细的现代无衬线字体，标题字重偏轻，排版具有呼吸感，整体呈现轻盈秀气的现代风格。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 14px、最大标题字号 64px、字号档数 7档、字族 times、字重档数 5档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「粉色渐变婚庆工具页」那一份（采用圆滑纤细的现代无衬线字体，标题字重偏轻，排版具有呼吸感，整体呈现轻盈秀气的现代风格。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「粉色渐变婚庆工具页」那一份基本一致（大量运用带有柔和浅色投影的大圆角白色卡片来承载界面信息，主操作按钮为全圆角的胶囊形状，输入框也带有明显圆角。）？

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「米色底中文竖排文档」那一份（几乎没有传统的UI组件（如卡片、按钮），界面元素的划分完全依赖于简单的单线表格（如排班表）和排版留白。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

ambiguities: The request does not specify actual plan prices, quota values, annual-discount formulas, or billing units. Correctness should therefore use the page's declared rules, labels, units, plan association, and exact round-trip restoration rather than imposing arbitrary values.

The destination or behavior of the download/get action is unspecified. A valid store/download destination or a concrete in-page acquisition instruction is acceptable; a backend purchase or deployment transaction should not be invented.

“只能在 iPad 横屏状态下浏览” does not define how an offline page should distinguish a physical iPad from another browser with the same viewport. Device detection and orientation blocking remain supplementary layout requirements.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can understand that the product is a professional structural-engineering calculation app for iPad, identify its meaningful capabilities, and use the primary download/get action to reach a concrete product-relevant acquisition path.
outcomes.missing_check: Items 13 and 16 verify the page topic and presence of a download/get entry, but no checklist item verifies that activating the entry reaches a concrete acquisition result.
outcomes.quote: 这次我们在做一款面向结构工程师的专业计算类 iPad 应用下载页。
test_cases: At a typical iPad landscape viewport, use the visible core information to confirm that the product is an iPad structural-engineering calculation app and understand at least one meaningful capability; then activate the primary download/get control and verify that it exposes a concrete product-relevant acquisition result, such as a valid store/download destination or clear in-page acquisition instructions, rather than doing nothing or leading to unrelated content.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can compare the Pro and Enterprise plans using relevant professional resource metrics and obtain state-consistent price and quota values for both monthly and annual subscription modes.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item verifies the exact state consistency, units, declared pricing rules, or round-trip restoration of monthly and annual price/quota outputs. Item 23 only establishes that values change with an animation.
outcomes.quote: 紧接着往下是用来做转化钩子的核心功能，也就是价格与套餐的横向对比卡片。我们要在那张宽大的白底柔影大圆角卡片里放进专业版和企业版的对比表格，密密麻麻列出几十项参数指标，比如最大计算线程、云端存储空间上限等。这个区块顶部需要提供一个切换月度订阅和年度订阅的胶囊开关，重点是这里的交互，当我点击开关时，下面表格里的价格数字以及附带的配额不能直接生硬地闪现过去，必须带有数字平滑滚动增加或减少的动效过程，并且用亮色背景框短暂提示改变的数据。
test_cases: In the plan comparison, select the monthly mode and record the exact Pro and Enterprise prices, units, and period-dependent quotas, including the displayed computation-thread and cloud-storage values. Switch to annual mode and verify that the selected period is unambiguous, all period-dependent fields contain complete numeric values with the correct plan association and units, and any pricing or conversion rule stated by the page is satisfied. Switch back to monthly and verify that every recorded monthly value is restored exactly rather than merely observing that some DOM content changed.

core_scope.purpose: Enable structural engineers to understand the professional iPad calculation app, compare its Pro and Enterprise subscription offerings, and reach a concrete acquisition path.
review_notes: Retained app information and acquisition as the primary download-page outcome; layout placement and visual styling are not separate core goals.
Retained Pro/Enterprise plan comparison as a distinct conversion and information outcome, while collapsing the comparison table and monthly/annual switching into one end-to-end flow.

Moved the iPad-landscape gate, split-column behavior, sticky scrolling, responsive behavior, and overflow checks to supplementary scope because viewport fit and layout do not constitute the business endpoint.

Moved the grid-node dashboard, rendering-state transitions, hover highlights, and related animations to supplementary scope because they demonstrate presentation and rendering capability rather than fulfill the download page's indispensable user goal.
Moved the enterprise-trial footer form to supplementary scope as an incidental lead form; the request does not make a real trial-processing transaction part of the page's primary download purpose.

Kept item 23 mixed because it combines a core subscription-state update with a supplementary rolling-number animation. Item 24 remains supplementary because temporary highlight styling does not establish pricing correctness.
Kept items 19, 22, 27, and 32 mixed because they partially assess usable plan comparison while also imposing layout, component styling, content-volume, or broad reference-hygiene requirements.

core_scope.purpose: Enable residents to author and revise a long-form community newsletter in Markdown while immediately reading an intelligible rendered preview of the same content.
review_notes: Collapsed editable input, real-time transformation, and rendered Markdown output into one end-to-end core authoring/preview outcome rather than treating individual controls or syntax examples as separate outcomes.

Reclassified the draggable divider and its hover or drag feedback as supplementary layout and microinteraction requirements. Removing them would reduce convenience but would not prevent Markdown authoring and previewing.
Reclassified synchronized pane scrolling and internal scroll-container behavior as supplementary long-document navigation enhancements rather than a separate indispensable business endpoint.

Reclassified the floating word-count and reading-time badge as supplementary metadata. It is requested functionality, but the Markdown previewer still fulfills its primary authoring and rendering purpose without it.

Dark coloring, visual atmosphere, typography, component styling, toolbar presentation, self-containment, robustness, and overflow handling remain supplementary requirements and are not promoted to core gates.

ambiguities: The request does not specify a jurisdiction, currency, bracket thresholds, or exact approximation formula for the simulator. Correctness must therefore be evaluated against clear rules declared by the page rather than an assumed real-world tax regime.

The request requires contact details to be immediately findable wherever the user stops but does not prescribe a sticky bar or another implementation. Persistent placement and sufficiently frequent visible repetition are both acceptable if the phone and address are directly visible at representative scroll positions.

The pure-English requirement is interpreted as applying to user-facing authored copy; ordinary names, numerals, currency symbols, and standard tax abbreviations do not constitute a second-language failure.

outcomes.endpoint: The page presents intelligible, fluent English information for overseas and cross-border clients, identifies the business as an accounting and tax firm, and includes a brief introduction, concrete tax service details, core-partner introductions, and substantive compliance information without unrelated placeholders or copied reference content.
outcomes.quote:
3. 接着是具体的税务服务明细，做成图文交错排布的区块。
4. 核心合伙人团队的介绍，排成三列并排的网格。
5. 底部是长篇的合规说明和联系地址。
test_cases: Load the page and review it from the hero through the services section. Confirm that all author-supplied visible prose is fluent English, identifies an accounting and tax firm serving overseas or cross-border businesses, and provides a brief introduction plus concrete service names and explanations rather than lorem ipsum, unrelated brands, or reference-screenshot boilerplate.

Load the page and navigate through the team and footer content. Confirm that identifiable core partners are introduced with names, professional roles, and meaningful biographies, and that the footer provides readable multi-paragraph compliance information relevant to the firm.

outcomes.endpoint: A literal telephone number and office address are directly and prominently available without opening a menu, following a link, or scrolling back, including while the user is stopped at representative positions throughout the page; the hero emphasizes the phone and the footer supplies the full address.
outcomes.quote: 我们是做专业服务的，网站最核心的诉求就是看着正经、靠谱，而且绝对不能把联系方式藏着掖着，客人在任何地方停下来想找我们，都能一眼看到电话和办事处地址。
test_cases: Load the page and verify that a readable telephone number and office address are directly visible at the initial hero. Scroll in turn to the introduction, services and simulator, team, and footer positions; at every stop verify that both contact details remain immediately visible without clicking, expanding navigation, or scrolling back, that the phone is emphasized in the hero, and that the footer contains the full office address.

outcomes.endpoint: The income slider functions as a tax-base simulator: changing its value updates the applicable rate, a numeric estimate with clear units, and the corresponding bar-chart state in real time, with the rate and estimate correct under the brackets and approximation rule declared by the page.
outcomes.quote: 客户拖拽一个收入区间的滑块，旁边的柱状图、适用的税率文本能实时平滑地切换状态，算出大概的数字。
test_cases: Load the simulator and first read its declared income brackets, approximation rule, units, and chart labels or legend. Using the pointer, set low, middle, and high income values, including values on opposite sides of a declared threshold. At each value, verify that the displayed rate matches the declared bracket, the numeric estimate equals the declared calculation for the selected income, the unit is shown, and the chart represents the same result according to its declared encoding.

Load the page, use Tab navigation to reach the income slider without a mouse, and use arrow keys to move across at least one declared bracket boundary. After each change, verify that the visible income value, rate, numeric estimate, and chart state update to the corresponding result; also verify that attempts to move beyond the declared minimum or maximum remain bounded and leave all outputs consistent.

core_scope.purpose: Enable English-speaking overseas and cross-border clients to understand the firm’s accounting and tax services and credentials, obtain a declared-rule tax estimate, and immediately find its phone number and office address from anywhere on the single page.
review_notes: Consolidated the introduction, service details, partner introductions, compliance copy, English language, and cross-border targeting into one informational outcome because they form a single page-reading flow while collectively supplying the requested substantive content.
Retained continuous contact visibility as a distinct core outcome because the request expressly identifies immediate access to both the phone and office address as the site’s central user goal.
Retained simulator correctness as a distinct core outcome, but treated smooth transitions and animation quality as supplementary portions of mixed checks rather than as business endpoints.
Removed single-file packaging as a core outcome. It remains a scored delivery requirement through checklist items 29 and base_1 but is not an end-user business goal.

Removed accessibility as a standalone core outcome. Keyboard access and textual simulator results remain mixed with the simulator’s usable endpoint, while contrast, font size, focus styling, image alternatives, and other accessibility or visual-quality constraints remain scored without becoming independent core gates.

Kept layout order, hero dimensions, alternating composition, three-column presentation, typography, palette, shadows, scroll animation, social icons, and overflow resilience supplementary because they affect presentation rather than the non-substitutable informational, contact, or calculation endpoints.

Placed the simulator element-existence check 23 in supplementary_ids because merely finding controls and displays does not establish that the calculation endpoint works; functional and numeric checks provide the core evidence.

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「字体排版」不要做成「带复杂图表的数据面板」那样：典型的数据面板字体，大量使用极小字号的无衬线体以容纳密集数据，通过轻微加粗和颜色深浅来区分表头和数值。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「B」份的程序指纹：正文字号 14px、最大标题字号 48px、字号档数 9档、字族 barlow/font、字重档数 3档。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。

ambiguities: The request specifies Q3 but does not provide an exact launch date, time, year, or timezone. Countdown evaluation should use the target context declared by the page and should not impose an unstated date.

Because the deliverable is an offline self-contained page, "email capture" cannot establish actual network delivery or backend persistence. Visible validation and an explicit successful subscribed state are treated as the feasible endpoint.

The manifesto's exact claims and wording are not supplied; relevance should be judged against the requested launch, product vision, user value, or future-direction themes rather than an invented product specification.
Checklist references to source "A" and "B" are not explicitly mapped in the task data. Those visual-reference checks remain supplementary and should not affect the core outcomes.

outcomes.endpoint: The page identifies the Q3 product launch, displays the remaining time with intelligible units, and updates the countdown consistently as time passes.
outcomes.quote: We are building the hype pipeline for our Q3 product launch, and I need a countdown page that immediately grabs attention.
test_cases: On a fresh load, confirm the page identifies a Q3 product launch and displays a countdown with labeled time units. Record the displayed values, convert them to a common unit using those labels, wait 3–5 seconds, and verify the remaining total decreases by approximately the elapsed time with valid unit rollover rather than merely changing arbitrarily.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can reach and read a substantial, intelligible manifesto whose content concerns the product launch, product vision, user value, or future direction rather than placeholder or unrelated text.
outcomes.quote: We have a massive, text-heavy manifesto to drop below the fold, so the reading experience has to be pristine.
test_cases: Starting from the loaded page, scroll through the content and verify that a manifesto is accessible in the normal reading flow, contains at least four substantive sentence-level paragraphs, and coherently discusses the launch, product vision, user value, or future direction without Lorem Ipsum, mechanical repetition, or unrelated filler.

outcomes.endpoint: A visitor can submit a valid email address and receive an explicit subscribed or launch-notification confirmation, while invalid or empty input is rejected with a visible explanation; no external delivery backend is required for the self-contained page.
outcomes.quote: a solid email capture form at the very end.
test_cases: From a fresh page state, reach the email signup, submit it empty and then with an invalid value such as "not-an-email", and verify each attempt produces a clear visible validation error without showing a subscribed state.

From a fresh page state, reach the email signup, enter a valid address such as "launch-test@example.com", submit through the visible control, and verify a clear confirmation specifically indicates successful subscription or launch-notification signup rather than only refreshing, clearing the field, or changing an unrelated element.

core_scope.purpose: Provide visitors with a clear, live countdown for a Q3 product launch, substantive launch-manifesto content, and a working email-notification signup path.
review_notes: Collapsed countdown visibility, launch context, labeled output, and time progression into one end-to-end outcome instead of treating page load, timer discovery, and waiting as separate tests.

Retained the manifesto's substantive and relevant information as core because removing it would omit a major requested informational purpose. Centering, exact column geometry, avoidance of side imagery, typography, and other reading-layout choices remain supplementary layout or visual requirements.

Removed sticky navigation as a core outcome. It is explicitly requested, but the countdown, manifesto, and signup remain usable without sticky behavior; checklist IDs 20 and 21 therefore remain supplementary.

Kept valid- and invalid-email submission as distinct core scenarios because they meaningfully challenge the signup endpoint. Form location, control existence alone, helper copy, labeling treatment, and pill-button styling remain supplementary unless combined with an endpoint check.
Marked IDs 16, 19, 22, and 26 as mixed because each combines evidence related to a core goal with prominence, CTA existence, section placement, or form location requirements.

Kept mobile viewport fit, overflow resistance, self-containment, generic JavaScript health, color, atmosphere, component styling, and countdown placement above the fold supplementary rather than promoting them into business endpoints.

keypoints.question: 把成品和这 5 份参考并排看，成品的整体气场（情绪调性、松紧克制）最接近哪一份？必须挑出一份（不许答「都差不多」）。候选：「纯黑底发光粒子特效图」（极其先锋、实验性且充满神秘感的纯视觉互动氛围）；「带深黑波浪底栏的白页」（极其冷峻、克制、甚至略显生硬的现代商务极简感）；「有右边侧栏的绿色版块」（明亮、轻松、充满人情味与亲和力的日常通俗感）；「带大号左侧导航栏页面」（深邃、前卫、带有明显光影质感的高级科技炫酷气场）；「深黑底紫蓝渐变卡片页」（沉稳、复古、结构严谨的传统报纸期刊阅读质感）。答案是「有右边侧栏的绿色版块」才算通过，挑了别的份即为跟错。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「纯黑底发光粒子特效图」那样：使用了极端的纯黑色作为整体背景，画面完全由粒子特效产生的高亮发光色（白、黄、紫粉）充当主导色。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「纯黑底发光粒子特效图」那一份（使用了极端的纯黑色作为整体背景，画面完全由粒子特效产生的高亮发光色（白、黄、紫粉）充当主导色。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「带深黑波浪底栏的白页」那样：以大面积的纯白色为背景，搭配深黑色/深灰色的块状底栏，全局基本为黑白灰，缺乏任何明显的彩色点缀。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「带深黑波浪底栏的白页」那一份（以大面积的纯白色为背景，搭配深黑色/深灰色的块状底栏，全局基本为黑白灰，缺乏任何明显的彩色点缀。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：元素密度 7.4个/千像素高、底色种类数 1种、整页高度 1080px。分派表没有把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。

ambiguities: 请求未指定实际峰会日期、各场次主题、十二位演讲者的真实身份或机构，因此只能依据页面自行声明且内部一致的内容检查完整性，不能假设外部事实答案。
请求只要求报名入口与可填写表单，没有定义提交后的成功状态、数据保存方式或服务端接口；核心测试因此止于有效启动和填写报名流程，不要求真实报名交易。
检查项 19、inv_1 和 inv_2 使用了未在任务数据中明确映射的“A”“B”参考编号，无法确定它们分别指向哪份参考。
“嘉宾导览”与十二位演讲者网格之间的内容关系未被定义；由于演讲者网格已提供核心嘉宾信息，侧栏导览被视为可替代的辅助导航。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面的可见文字应明确表明这是面向中老年群体的银发科技赋能峰会官方站点，而不能仅依靠视觉风格暗示题材。
outcomes.quote: 我正在为一场面向中老年群体的银发科技赋能峰会设计官方网站。
test_cases: 加载页面并仅根据可见的名称与主题定位文案，确认访客能够明确识别这是面向中老年群体的银发科技赋能峰会站点，而不是其他题材的网站。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够查看按上午和下午划分、包含具体时间或时段及主题的详细议程，并能切换到其他峰会日期对应的议程内容。
outcomes.quote: 左侧大面积区域用来承载上午和下午的详细峰会议程
test_cases: 进入议程区域，按页面声明的当前日期逐项核对上午和下午两个分段均存在，并确认每个场次都同时提供时间或时段以及对应主题。
记录当前日期的议程条目后切换到另一个日期，确认选中日期随之改变，旧列表被该日期的新列表整体替换而非追加；新列表仍包含上午、下午及各场次的时间和主题。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够获取恰好十二位可区分的核心演讲者信息，每位均有真实可读的姓名及身份、职务或所属机构。
outcomes.quote: 在界面的下半部分再平铺一个规整的多列网格来展示十二位核心演讲者的信息
test_cases: 进入核心演讲者板块并核对全部卡片：总数必须恰好为十二，每张均有可区分的姓名以及身份、职务或所属机构，且不得使用“嘉宾 1”“姓名待定”或空占位内容。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够从首屏报名入口启动页面内的报名流程，抵达或展开一个可填写姓名和联系方式并提供提交操作的表单；不要求真实网络后端。
outcomes.quote: 同时峰会的首屏报名操作入口一定要使用它里面那种极其抢眼的高饱和紫蓝渐变实心按钮，让行动号召在视觉上绝对聚焦。
test_cases: 从首屏激活报名行动入口，确认页面滚动、展开或切换到可见的报名表单；随后在姓名和联系方式字段中输入测试值，确认内容进入正确字段且表单提供可操作的提交入口，而不是死链或无响应控件。

core_scope.purpose: 为中老年访客提供可识别的银发科技赋能峰会官方信息，使其能够查阅各峰会日期的详细议程、了解十二位核心演讲者，并从首屏进入可填写的报名流程。
review_notes: 新增 summit_identity 核心结果：信息型官方站点必须通过可见内容让用户识别峰会主题，检查项 22 不应仅作为补充项。
将议程的上午/下午信息与日期切换合并为一个完整用户结果；检查项 40 同时涉及内容切换和动画表现，故保留为 mixed_item_ids，而日期控件的单纯存在检查 31 仍为补充项。
十二位演讲者的数量和身份信息属于核心内容；检查项 41 将该内容与板块位置及多列网格样式捆绑，因此归入 mixed_item_ids。
报名核心范围限定为从首屏进入并填写报名流程。固定侧栏、宽屏分栏、悬浮行为、嘉宾导览位置及紫蓝渐变外观属于布局或组件表现，不作为核心端点。
动态倒计时、波纹与切换动画、历史数据图表、拖拽和提示气泡均是辅助信息或视觉交互模块；移除它们不会破坏识别峰会、查阅议程与嘉宾、进入报名流程的主要目的，因此不设为独立核心结果。
移动端重排、无横向溢出、字体、对比度、触控尺寸、配色及参考风格仍是重要的补充评分要求，但依照核心范围规则不提升为独立业务端点。

review_notes: Collapsed project identity, value, and distinct feature information into one informational core outcome because these jointly let developers understand the requested project.

Collapsed the CTA, quick-start guidance, form validation, and confirmation behavior into one end-to-end conversion outcome rather than treating button discovery, form discovery, and submission as separate gates.

Document-style layout, fixed navigation, scroll-spy behavior, mobile collapsing, viewport fit, typography, color, borders, and other visual treatments remain supplementary presentation requirements rather than non-substitutable user goals.

Items 24 and 27 are mixed because they combine the presence of core conversion controls with above-the-fold placement and viewport-fit requirements. Item 31 is mixed because it checks essential project information while also requiring a particular first-screen placement.
Items 19 and 20 check the bottom location, control existence, and CTA wording but do not establish successful conversion behavior; endpoint correctness is instead covered by items 21, 28, and 29.

ambiguities: The request says not to target desktop monitors, but its explicit blocking condition covers widths below 1024px and portrait orientation; it does not state whether a wide landscape desktop viewport must also be blocked.

The opening constraint requires blocking below 1024px wide or in portrait, while the final acceptance criteria describe a minimum 1024x768 screen and checklist item 24 additionally blocks heights below 768px. The treatment of a landscape viewport wider than 1024px but shorter than 768px is therefore not completely consistent.
Checklist item 9 requires a narrow-screen responsive reflow, and rsp_2 expects usable non-overflowing content at 768px, while the request instead requires a hard blocking overlay on those viewports.
The request permits external standard web fonts, whereas checklist items 11 and base_1 prohibit external font links along with all other network resources.

No fixed tuition, material-fee, aggregation, or early-bird formula is supplied. Pricing correctness must therefore be evaluated against rules and values declared by the page rather than an invented formula.

The request does not define whether selections persist when moving between courses or whether the cart may contain cohorts from multiple courses, so either behavior should not become a hard gate unless the page declares it consistently.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can choose among course offerings and access an intelligible, course-specific detail view containing the selected course's instructor philosophy, week-by-week curriculum, prerequisite reading list, available cohorts, and fee data.
outcomes.quote: Inside this expanded view, the user will read through multi-paragraph instructor philosophies, detailed week-by-week curriculum breakdowns, and extensive prerequisite reading lists.
test_cases: At a supported landscape viewport, activate a course card and verify that the resulting detail view identifies the selected course and presents multiple instructor-philosophy paragraphs, a recognizable week-by-week curriculum, and a detailed prerequisite reading list, with available cohort and fee information accessible in the same flow.

Close the first course detail view, activate a different course card, and verify that the title matches the second card and that its philosophy, curriculum, reading list, available cohorts, and fee data are the second course's data rather than unchanged content left over from the first course.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can toggle available cohort dates and immediately receive a numerically correct summary of tuition, material fees, applicable early-bird discounts, and the resulting total based on the current selection.
outcomes.quote: As dates are toggled, a sticky floating summary panel on the right side of the screen must instantly calculate the total tuition, material fees, and applicable early-bird discounts in real-time.
test_cases: Open a course, note its declared tuition, material-fee, and early-bird rules, then select one available cohort date. Verify that the date is visibly selected and that each displayed monetary line and the final total exactly follow the page's declared calculation rules, including either the applicable discount or a zero discount when the selected date is ineligible.

Starting with no selected dates, select two available dates and verify the exact tuition, material-fee, discount, and total values expected under the declared rules. Deselect one date and verify that only the remaining date is selected and every amount is recalculated exactly for that state, with no duplicate or residual charge after repeatedly toggling a date off and on.

core_scope.purpose: Enable prospective students to explore advanced architecture and industrial design masterclasses, read complete course-specific information, select cohort dates, and understand the resulting tuition, material fees, and discounts.
review_notes: Viewport blocking and the exact three-column geometry were removed as core outcomes because they are target-layout constraints rather than non-substitutable booking goals.

Course browsing, opening the selected course, and reading its complete course-specific information were collapsed into one end-to-end exploration outcome. Checks that combine this goal with exact grid, native-dialog, split-screen, or sticky-panel implementation requirements remain mixed.

Date selection and numerically correct real-time pricing remain core because they are the requested booking endpoint. Calendar existence alone, sticky positioning, and animation are supplementary or mixed and cannot establish calculation correctness.
The tests explicitly verify monetary outputs against the page's declared rules instead of accepting an unspecified visual change as evidence of correct pricing.
No final submission, payment, reservation confirmation, or backend transaction was added because the request only specifies inline date selection and pricing state.

The manifesto, seasonal branding, introductory layout, typography, palette, shadows, semantic implementation, self-containment, and code-organization requirements remain supplementary because removing them would not eliminate the primary course-selection and pricing outcome.
