ambiguities: The request does not specify the app identity, exact feature copy, supported platform names, or store URLs, so tests should use the page's declared values and assess internal consistency rather than impose particular products or destinations.
Checklist items 12 and "inv_1" refer to reference "A", but the request does not unambiguously assign that label to one of the described references.

outcomes.endpoint: The page identifies and explains one mobile app and presents a clear download entry whose platform label, supporting content, or declared destination remains consistent with the platform selected by the user. No live app-store response or backend download transaction is required.
outcomes.quote: 要做个移动应用下载页
test_cases: Load the page and use its visible content to identify the app name, what the app does, and at least one capability; verify that a clear download entry is present and that the main copy concerns the same app rather than unrelated reference-site or blog content.

Starting with the initially selected download platform, record its label and the download entry's platform-specific label, destination, or explanation. Select another declared platform through the normal page controls and verify that the selected state, associated content, and download entry all identify that new platform; switch back and verify that the original platform context is restored. Do not require an external store to load successfully.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can switch the app information, navigation text, section headings, body copy, and action labels between intelligible Chinese and English without substantial untranslated remnants.
outcomes.quote: 页面得中英双语可切换
test_cases: Starting in whichever language is initially displayed, record representative navigation labels, section headings, app-description text, and download-control labels. Activate the language control, verify that these areas consistently change to the other language while brand and platform names may remain unchanged, then switch back and verify that the original-language content is restored.

core_scope.purpose: Enable users to understand a mobile app and reach the correct platform-specific download entry, with the user-facing information available in both Chinese and English.
review_notes: Collapsed app information and platform-consistent downloading into one primary end-user flow. Item 19 is mixed because it checks both the core platform-content update and the supplementary smooth animation.

Retained bilingual access as a distinct core goal because users must be able to obtain the app information and download context in either requested language. Item 25 is mixed because it combines this core language behavior with supplementary theme switching.

Removed the documentation-style layout, fixed sidebar, anchor navigation, typography, colors, button appearance, image treatment, and reference resemblance from core membership. These remain scored requirements but are substitutable presentation or navigation choices rather than the download page's business endpoint.
Deep/light theme switching remains supplementary because it is requested preferentially with “最好” and theme switching is not indispensable to the download purpose.

The smooth platform-transition animation remains supplementary. Only the correctness of the platform-specific download context is core; item 28 checks animation alone, while item 19 mixes endpoint correctness with animation.

Item 18 remains supplementary because it checks control existence and an example option count rather than whether the resulting download endpoint is correct. The end-to-end core scenario exercises the available platform controls and validates their result.
Generic DOM mutation, viewport overflow stress tests, self-containment, and absence of runtime exceptions are useful quality checks but do not independently establish either core user outcome.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「E」份「橙色色块压图个人页」：主要特征组件是大面积的直角纯色（亮橙色）信息方块，且有半截压在背景大图上的叠层效果；列表项配有醒目的单色矢量图标。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「E」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「E」有 vs 「A」无。产出应落在「E」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「橙色色块压图个人页」那一份神似（主要特征组件是大面积的直角纯色（亮橙色）信息方块，且有半截压在背景大图上的叠层效果；列表项配有醒目的单色矢量图标。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「A」份「黑白粗体大字网格页」在这一面是：没有常规意义的独立卡片或按钮，主要通过粗黑实线边框来划分信息区块和表格，极具粗野主义风格。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「黑白粗体大字网格页」那一份（没有常规意义的独立卡片或按钮，主要通过粗黑实线边框来划分信息区块和表格，极具粗野主义风格。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「左侧深色导航后台页」在这一面是：标准的数据看板卡片，纯白底色，带有极细的浅灰色边框和非常轻微的直角/小圆角，无阴影。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「左侧深色导航后台页」那一份（标准的数据看板卡片，纯白底色，带有极细的浅灰色边框和非常轻微的直角/小圆角，无阴影。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「米色底复古档案页」在这一面是：类似纸质文档，没有独立的容器卡片，表格采用深色纯色表头，底部有一排复古的纯色直角小标签。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「米色底复古档案页」那一份（类似纸质文档，没有独立的容器卡片，表格采用深色纯色表头，底部有一排复古的纯色直角小标签。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「带侧边筛选的招聘页」在这一面是：典型的现代 Web 组件，卡片带有明显的圆角和极浅的边框；输入框有圆角；主按钮是完全圆角（胶囊形）的实心色块，并大量使用圆角药丸形标签。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：圆角档数 0档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带侧边筛选的招聘页」那一份（典型的现代 Web 组件，卡片带有明显的圆角和极浅的边框；输入框有圆角；主按钮是完全圆角（胶囊形）的实心色块，并大量使用圆角药丸形标签。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「A」份「黑白粗体大字网格页」：冷峻、克制，呈现出极度理性的说明书或严肃纪实报纸的气场，毫无冗余装饰的情绪。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「A」49.1个/千像素高 vs 「D」112.7个/千像素高；底色种类数：「A」4种 vs 「D」1种；间距中位数：「A」16px vs 「D」8.8px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 把成品和这 5 份参考并排看，成品的整体气场（情绪调性、松紧克制）最接近哪一份？必须挑出一份（不许答「都差不多」）。候选：「黑白粗体大字网格页」（冷峻、克制，呈现出极度理性的说明书或严肃纪实报纸的气场，毫无冗余装饰的情绪。）；「左侧深色导航后台页」（现代、高效且理性的工具化气场，是典型的后台管理系统氛围。）；「米色底复古档案页」（怀旧、复古，带有历史文献和旧机构公文般的年代感与温吞气场。）；「带侧边筛选的招聘页」（明快、标准、务实，属于典型的现代商业化互联网服务气场。）；「橙色色块压图个人页」（传统的商业展示感，带有一丝略显过时的企业或个人包装推销气场。）。答案是「黑白粗体大字网格页」才算通过，挑了别的份即为跟错。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「布局结构」不要做成「左侧深色导航后台页」那样：经典的后台全屏布局，左侧固定深色导航栏，顶部顶栏，右侧主区域为多张卡片组成的流式网格。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否明显不同于「左侧深色导航后台页」那一份（经典的后台全屏布局，左侧固定深色导航栏，顶部顶栏，右侧主区域为多张卡片组成的流式网格。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「布局结构」不要做成「带侧边筛选的招聘页」那样：居中定宽的两栏布局，左侧为较窄的筛选表单栏，右侧为较宽的卡片列表信息流，顶部有居中的导航条。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「B」份的程序指纹：内边距中位数 11px、元素密度 190个/千像素高、整页高度 2263px。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否明显不同于「带侧边筛选的招聘页」那一份（居中定宽的两栏布局，左侧为较窄的筛选表单栏，右侧为较宽的卡片列表信息流，顶部有居中的导航条。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「米色底复古档案页」那样：偏暖的米黄/羊皮纸色底色，深灰/褐色文字，搭配复古的暗橄榄绿、土黄色标签和表头，整体呈现复古做旧的暖色调。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「米色底复古档案页」那一份（偏暖的米黄/羊皮纸色底色，深灰/褐色文字，搭配复古的暗橄榄绿、土黄色标签和表头，整体呈现复古做旧的暖色调。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'build a slow query monitoring panel'，用于 'identify bottlenecks'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一个「慢查询监控面板」（围绕 SQL 查询延迟、执行耗时、性能瓶颈诊断组织内容），而非其他主题的页面？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'a complex brushing timeline where volunteers can click and drag over a specific time window on a line chart to filter the query feed below'
keypoints.question: 页面上半部的折线/时间序列图上按住鼠标左键横向拖拽出一个时间窗口后，下方的查询信息流内容是否随之被筛选（条目数量或内容发生变化）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'When a user clicks on a specific query block in the feed, a stateful side-panel should slide in from the right edge containing a flame graph of the query execution plan.'
keypoints.question: 点击信息流中任意一个查询区块后，是否从页面右侧边缘滑入一个侧边面板，且该面板内含有可辨识的执行计划火焰图（分层横条堆叠的图形）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'It should start with a commanding full-width header, flow into a large data visualization area taking up the top half of the viewport, and then stack a full-width feed of the problematic queries underneath.'
keypoints.question: 页面内容是否按照「全宽页头 → 大型数据可视化区（约占首屏上半部）→ 全宽查询信息流」自上而下依次堆叠？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The main header should simply read "SYSTEM HEALTH: QUERY LATENCY"'
keypoints.question: 主标题文本是否精确显示为 "SYSTEM HEALTH: QUERY LATENCY"？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The graph tooltips should display specific metrics: "95th Percentile Execution: 1.2s", "Index Miss Rate: 84%"'
keypoints.question: 将鼠标悬停在主时间序列图的数据点上后，出现的提示框是否显示 "95th Percentile Execution: 1.2s" 与 "Index Miss Rate: 84%" 这两条指标文本？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The feed should open with a direct, helpful summary: "Detected 43 queries exceeding the 500ms threshold in the selected window."'
keypoints.question: 查询信息流的开头是否出现文本 "Detected 43 queries exceeding the 500ms threshold in the selected window."？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Each query card must display the truncated SQL text, total time locked, and rows examined.'
keypoints.question: 每张查询卡片是否同时显示「截断的 SQL 语句文本」「total time locked（锁定总时长）」「rows examined（扫描行数）」这三项信息？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'include small helper text under the main metrics saying, "Compared to the 7-day moving average, lock contention has increased by 14%."'
keypoints.question: 数据区块的主要指标下方是否有小号辅助文本给出历史对比，例如 "Compared to the 7-day moving average, lock contention has increased by 14%."？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'Include an input area in the expanded state where maintainers can leave plain-text notes for each other'
keypoints.question: 点击查询卡片打开的展开/侧边面板状态中，是否包含一个供维护者互相留言的纯文本输入区域（textarea 或文本输入框）？

keypoints.basis: 指令给出示例备注 'like "Adding a composite index on user_id and created_at resolved this on staging."'
keypoints.question: 该留言输入区是否带有类似 "Adding a composite index on user_id and created_at resolved this on staging." 的示例/占位或已有备注文本？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求内容含 'flame graphs, time series charts for execution times, memory usage gauges'
keypoints.question: 页面是否同时出现三类可辨识的可视化图形：执行时间的时间序列折线图、火焰图、内存使用的仪表盘（gauge）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The content volume will be substantial and split evenly: about half text ... and half image/canvas'
keypoints.question: 页面内容体量是否大致「一半文字、一半图形」—— 既有成规模的 SQL 文本/执行元数据/维护者备注，又有占据可观面积的图表画布区域，而不是某一侧压倒性缺失？

keypoints.basis: 指令提到 'the filter inputs' 与 'the primary filter panel' 用于筛选查询信息流
keypoints.question: 页面是否存在筛选面板，且在其中改变某个筛选条件（如阈值、排序或关键字）后，下方查询列表的条目内容或数量随之变化？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The slide-over panel must trap focus while open and close gracefully when the Escape key is pressed.'
keypoints.question: 在右侧滑出面板打开的状态下按 Escape 键，面板是否被关闭并回到原列表视图？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收项 'The interactive data visualizations (brushing, zooming) must have keyboard fallback controls.'
keypoints.question: 图表区域附近是否提供了可见的键盘可操作替代控件（如时间窗口起止输入框、上一段/下一段按钮、缩放按钮或下拉选择），使刷选/缩放不必依赖鼠标拖拽？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求执行统计使用单色向量图标，并明确规定查询卡片中的所有向量图标都必须配有 visually hidden text 供屏幕阅读器读取。
keypoints.question: 查询卡片中的每个向量图标是否都配有能说明其含义的 visually hidden 屏幕阅读器文本，同时对应统计项展示可见的指标名称或数值，避免仅靠图标传达信息？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求可对 'a specific time window' 进行刷选并据此筛选，选区需可被用户确认
keypoints.question: 拖拽刷选完成后，被选中的时间窗口是否在图表上以可见的高亮区域/选区边界形式呈现？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提供由多条 problematic queries 构成的全宽信息流，并使用“Detected 43 queries”作为摘要，因此应以多张不同查询卡片呈现。
keypoints.question: 查询信息流中是否包含多张查询卡片，且不同卡片展示彼此不同的 SQL 内容，而不是只有单张卡片或重复同一条查询？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The tone must remain totally objective and supportive.' 及 'no redundant emotional decoration—just cold, hard facts'
keypoints.question: 全部文案语气是否保持客观、克制、支持性（陈述指标与事实、给出对比说明），没有出现情绪化、指责性或营销式的冗余措辞？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求该工具是 highly efficient, single-page application，因此核心工作流应在同一页面中完成。
keypoints.question: 页面是否以单页应用形式运行，使查询查看、筛选、卡片展开和侧边面板等核心内容与状态切换都在当前页面内完成，而不依赖跳转到其他页面？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求侧边面板为 'stateful side-panel' 且能 'close gracefully'
keypoints.question: 滑出的侧边面板中是否提供了可见的关闭控件（关闭按钮或 ✕）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The page must be delivered as a single HTML file containing all structural markup, scoped CSS, and the necessary JavaScript'
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（结构、样式与脚本全部内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求点击某个 specific query block 后显示该查询的 execution plan flame graph，因此滑出面板的核心可视化状态应对应当前选中的查询。
keypoints.question: 点击两张不同的查询卡片时，右侧面板是否更新为与当前选中查询对应的执行计划和火焰图，而不是所有卡片始终显示同一份通用内容？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 指令要求维护者能够“leave plain-text notes for each other”，并要求模拟 stateful interactions；仅呈现一个不可用或不保存状态的输入框不足以满足该用途。
keypoints.question: 维护者备注输入区是否可实际输入和编辑纯文本，且为某条查询输入备注后关闭并重新打开该查询时，备注仍与该查询关联并保留在当前应用状态中？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求右侧面板具有平滑过渡，并要求在用户系统请求 reduced motion 时立即禁用这些动画；对于其他动画，只应检查页面中实际实现的非必要动画，而不应预设图表必然带动画。
keypoints.question: 在系统未请求减少动态效果时，右侧面板的滑入和滑出是否具有平滑过渡；启用 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 后，面板过渡以及页面中任何实际存在的非必要动画是否立即变为无动画或近乎即时完成？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 验收项明确要求“The slide-over panel must trap focus while open”；完整的无障碍对话框行为还需在关闭后将焦点交还给触发元素。
keypoints.question: 右侧面板打开后，焦点是否自动进入面板，连续按 Tab 或 Shift+Tab 时始终在面板内循环且无法进入背景页面；关闭面板后，焦点是否返回到触发它的查询卡片？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户的明确验收要求是“The text contrast ratios must exceed WCAG AAA standards across the board.”
keypoints.question: 页面所有正文、标签、辅助文字、按钮文字及交互状态文字与其背景的对比度是否达到 WCAG AAA：普通文本至少 7:1，大号文本至少 4.5:1？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 验收项明确要求“The interface must remain perfectly usable at a 200% zoom level without elements overlapping.”
keypoints.question: 将浏览器缩放至 200% 后，页头、图表、重叠式筛选区、查询卡片及右侧面板是否仍能正常重排或滚动，且文字、控件和图表之间没有相互覆盖、裁切或无法操作的情况？

keypoints.basis: 验收项明确要求所有查询卡片中的矢量图标都与 visually hidden text 配对；同时应避免图标图形与隐藏文本被辅助技术重复朗读。
keypoints.question: 查询卡片中的每一个矢量统计图标是否都配有描述其含义的 visually-hidden 屏幕阅读器文本，并在图标本身属于纯装饰或会造成重复朗读时将其从辅助技术中隐藏？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求界面“strictly accessible to all our volunteers, including those using screen readers”；图表承载核心监控信息，必须提供非视觉等价内容。
keypoints.question: 时间序列图、内存仪表盘和火焰图是否具有可被屏幕阅读器识别的名称与说明，并提供包含关键数值、时间范围和执行阶段的等价文本或数据表，而不是仅依赖 canvas/SVG 图形传达信息？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求界面严格支持“screen readers or relying on keyboard navigation”；这不仅包括图表替代控件，还包括全部主要交互组件。
keypoints.question: 筛选输入、图表控制、查询卡片、侧栏关闭按钮和备注输入区是否均能仅用键盘到达与触发，具有清晰可见的焦点指示，并向辅助技术暴露准确的名称、角色及当前状态？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 验收项要求交互可视化的“brushing, zooming”具有 keyboard fallback controls；替代控件必须执行与鼠标刷选和缩放等价的状态更新。
keypoints.question: 仅使用图表旁的键盘替代控件时，是否能实际改变时间窗口和缩放级别，并同步更新图表选区及下方查询信息流，而不是只显示没有效果的按钮或输入框？

ambiguities: The request specifies simulated stateful interactions and mock charts, so query filtering and execution plans should be evaluated against the page's declared client-side data rather than a live database or deployment API.

The request does not define canonical timestamps, filter boundaries, zoom levels, or expected query subsets. Correctness must therefore use labels, metadata, or rules declared by the page; an unexplained list change is insufficient.

The exact 43-query summary is described as the feed's opening text. It is unclear whether that sentence must remain static after filtering or whether its count should update, so the exact wording should be required for the initial state only unless the page declares another rule.

Leaving notes "for each other" could imply shared backend persistence, but the single-file mock requirement does not define a server or cross-session storage. Current-application state is sufficient for that supplementary feature unless stronger persistence is explicitly supplied.

Checklist item "inv_1" refers to reference "C" without defining that label in the task data; it should not be interpreted more narrowly than the request's stated rejection of the warm archival palette.

outcomes.endpoint: The page presents an intelligible slow-query overview with the requested summary, multiple distinct SQL entries, diagnostic execution statistics, historical context, and specified chart metrics so volunteers can identify problematic queries and likely bottlenecks.
outcomes.quote: our volunteer database administrators need a dedicated view to identify bottlenecks.
test_cases: Load the monitoring page and inspect the initial query feed from its summary through multiple cards: verify the exact opening summary is "Detected 43 queries exceeding the 500ms threshold in the selected window.", at least two cards contain different SQL statements, and every displayed card provides truncated SQL, total time locked, and rows examined.

Inspect a metric block associated with the monitoring data and verify that it gives an intelligible historical comparison, including the requested example text "Compared to the 7-day moving average, lock contention has increased by 14%." or an equally explicit comparison under the page's declared data.
Hover a data point on the main time-series chart and verify the tooltip reports both exact metrics and values: "95th Percentile Execution: 1.2s" and "Index Miss Rate: 84%".

outcomes.endpoint: Selecting a time interval by dragging across the timeline applies that interval to the slow-query feed below, returning the subset associated with the selected window under the page's declared mock-data rules.
outcomes.missing_check: Checklist item 16 confirms only that the feed changes after brushing; it does not verify selected boundaries or that included and excluded queries actually correspond to the chosen time window.
outcomes.quote: I need a complex brushing timeline where volunteers can click and drag over a specific time window on a line chart to filter the query feed below.
test_cases: Using displayed chart labels or another page-declared mapping between time ranges and queries, record the initial query identities, drag across an interval known to include a different subset, and verify that the resulting feed contains the queries assigned to that interval rather than merely showing an arbitrary DOM or count change.

outcomes.endpoint: Opening a query exposes a right-side detail panel with a recognizable execution-plan flame graph tied to the selected query, and selecting a different query updates the panel to that query's distinct plan.
outcomes.quote: When a user clicks on a specific query block in the feed, a stateful side-panel should slide in from the right edge containing a flame graph of the query execution plan.
test_cases: From the query feed, open query A and record the query identity and flame-graph stage hierarchy shown in the right-side panel; dismiss it, open a different query B, and verify the panel identifies B and presents a corresponding flame graph that differs meaningfully from A rather than reusing one generic plan.

outcomes.endpoint: Keyboard and screen-reader users can understand the essential monitoring visualizations, operate time-window and zoom functions, open and dismiss query details, and retain focus in the modal side panel without relying on pointer-only graphics.
outcomes.quote: I want the information to be painfully clear and strictly accessible to all our volunteers, including those using screen readers or relying on keyboard navigation.
test_cases: Starting from the page with no pointer use, navigate to the chart fallback controls, set an exact labeled time interval and change the zoom level, then verify the displayed interval and scale reflect those values and the query feed contains the subset prescribed by the page's declared data rules.

Using only the keyboard, activate a query card and verify focus enters the opened side panel; traverse forward and backward through all panel controls to confirm focus cannot escape to the background, press Escape to close it, and verify focus returns to the same query card.

Using a screen reader or the browser accessibility tree, inspect the essential time-series and flame-graph content and verify each has a meaningful name and equivalent text or tabular data exposing its key values, time range, and execution stages; compare representative numeric values, including the declared 1.2s and 84% metrics, with the visual data, and confirm essential controls expose accurate names, roles, states, and visible keyboard focus.

core_scope.purpose: An accessible single-page slow-query monitor that lets volunteer database administrators understand latency and query evidence, filter incidents by time, and inspect query-specific execution plans to identify bottlenecks.
review_notes: Added a core monitoring-information outcome because the requested SQL, execution statistics, historical context, summary, and chart metrics are substantive information needed to identify bottlenecks, not merely decorative dashboard content.

Added accessibility as a core user outcome because screen-reader and keyboard users are expressly part of the intended volunteer audience. Functional keyboard operation, focus containment, dismissal, and equivalent chart information are core; exact contrast styling, 200% viewport behavior, icon implementation details, and reduced-motion animation remain supplementary requirements.

Retained timeline brushing and query-specific execution-plan inspection as distinct core workflows, while consolidating each into end-to-end scenarios instead of separate open, click, and observe steps.

Demoted maintainer-note entry and in-memory retention from core because collaboration notes are useful but substitutable; removing them would not prevent the panel's primary bottleneck-identification purpose.

Treated item 17 as mixed because it combines the core query-specific flame-graph endpoint with right-edge slide presentation. Items 45 and 46 are mixed because they test essential accessible monitoring behavior together with supplementary gauges, note controls, or other incidental controls.

Kept generic filter-panel behavior, visible selection styling, close-control existence, smooth transitions, layout, typography, palette, chart-to-text area balance, single-file packaging, and robustness checks supplementary rather than turning presentation or implementation constraints into separate core gates.
Flagged the brushing coverage gap because the existing checklist checks only that content changes, not that the filtered result is correct for the selected interval.

keypoints.basis: 指令将产品定义为供结构工程师和研究人员监测、评估构造活动的地震记录浏览器，但没有要求介绍文案必须明确写出全部目标用户名称。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求在初始视图下方展示近期地震事件，并将事件组织为卡片。

ambiguities: The request requires primary search controls but makes text inputs conditional through the wording “Any text inputs.” A dropdown, segmented filter, or other functional search control may therefore be valid even though checklist items 22 and 23 assume free-text filtering.

No exact recency window or mandatory event-field set is defined. Evaluation should use any rule declared by the page and require enough labeled scientific metadata to identify and compare events without imposing an unstated schema.

The exact stateful seismograph operations are not specified. Channel selection, time-window adjustment, zoom, playback, or another locally implemented operation may qualify, but its result should follow its declared semantics rather than merely causing an arbitrary DOM or graphic change.

The large top visual may be a live waveform preview or an epicenter-map representation, but no real-time feed, deployment service, websocket, or external seismic API is requested. Local representative data is sufficient.

“Strict accessibility standards” does not name a WCAG version or conformance level. The core accessibility outcome is therefore limited to the explicitly requested keyboard reachability and the checklist's associated names and expanded-state semantics; broader visual accessibility checks remain supplementary.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can access and compare multiple distinguishable recent seismic-event records with intelligible, non-placeholder scientific metadata and clearly labeled values or units.
outcomes.quote: Below this initial view, display the recent seismic events arranged in a regular, multi-column grid of cards, matching how the lower half of that same dark blog is organized.
test_cases: Load the page and inspect at least two listed events under the page's stated definition of recent events; verify that the records are distinguishable and provide intelligible identifying and scientific metadata, and that displayed magnitude, depth, or similar numeric values use meaningful labels or units rather than bare numbers or placeholders.

outcomes.endpoint: The provided primary search or filtering controls allow users to locate or narrow seismic events according to the controls' declared matching criteria; a text query is required only if the implementation actually offers a text input.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 23 covers only a text-keyword implementation. No checklist item validates other permissible primary-search controls, and no item checks the free-text no-match and reset paths.
outcomes.quote: Place the primary search controls and introductory text on the left, and a large visual element—like a live waveform preview or epicenter map—on the right.
test_cases: Using the provided primary search control and its declared matching rule, select or enter a criterion known to match one or more listed events, submit if required, and verify that every resulting event satisfies the criterion while a known nonmatching event is excluded.

For an implementation that accepts arbitrary text, enter a string absent from all records and verify that no unrelated records are returned and that the no-match result is intelligible; then clear or reset the query and verify that the original catalog returns.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating an event exposes a detailed seismograph view associated with that event, and the view's interactive state and output respond meaningfully according to the labels and declared function of its controls.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 26 checks only that waveform content changes after a control is used. It does not verify that the resulting channel, time window, zoom state, playback state, or other output is correct according to the control's declared semantics.
outcomes.quote: Clicking any event card in the grid must trigger a smooth inline expansion, pushing the other cards aside to reveal a detailed, stateful interactive seismograph view without forcing a page reload.
test_cases: Activate an event and verify that the resulting detail identifies the selected event, agrees with its visible record metadata, includes a recognizable seismograph, and exposes an operable control; use that control and verify the selected state, channel, time range, trace, or displayed parameter corresponds to the control's declared function rather than merely observing an unspecified visual change.

Activate a second distinguishable event and verify that the detail identity and relevant scientific data now correspond to the second event rather than reusing the first event's generic detail; repeat for the displayed event triggers as feasible.

outcomes.endpoint: Keyboard-only users can operate the search flow, activate event details, traverse and operate every control in an expanded seismograph, and continue beyond or close the detail without a keyboard trap; relevant controls expose intelligible names and expanded-state semantics.
outcomes.quote: The interface must meet strict accessibility standards, ensuring every text input and expanded state is fully keyboard reachable.
test_cases: Starting with the keyboard only, navigate to the search control, perform a known matching search, continue to an event trigger, activate its detail with the trigger's standard keyboard command, operate every expanded seismograph control, and then reach the collapse control or subsequent page content; verify focus remains visible and no step traps the keyboard.

Using keyboard navigation with assistive-technology output, identify the search control and an event trigger by their accessible names, activate the event, and verify that the announced collapsed/expanded state changes accurately and that the associated detail region and its controls are reachable in a logical sequence.

core_scope.purpose: Enable structural engineers and researchers to locate, compare, and inspect recent seismic records and event-specific seismograph data through an accessible browser.
review_notes: Separated access to intelligible seismic records from the requested card grid, asymmetric split, and source-reference layout. Item 18 is mixed because it checks both the existence of multiple recent records and their card presentation; the other layout checks are supplementary.

Kept functional event search as a core browser goal without turning the conditional text-input wording into a mandatory implementation. Item 15 is mixed because it combines the presence of search controls with introductory content and left-side placement, while item 22 checks only control existence and is supplementary.

Kept event-specific, stateful seismograph details as core. Items 24 and 27 are mixed because they combine detail selection with inline grid behavior and no-reload presentation constraints; smooth transition quality in item 33 is supplementary.

Core seismograph tests verify event correspondence and the declared meaning of control results, not merely that some visual or DOM content changed. A missing semantic-correctness check is reported for item 26.

Retained the explicitly required keyboard access path as core, while typography, color, contrast styling, responsive fit, and other visual-accessibility measurements remain supplementary rather than separate business outcomes.

A4 print adaptation, narrow-screen rearrangement, overflow resistance, visual theme fidelity, component styling, animation, self-containment, and generic JavaScript health are supplementary because they do not constitute the seismic browser's non-substitutable end-user outcome.
The test cases combine setup, operation, and final-result verification into end-to-end scenarios instead of treating page opening, locating controls, and clicking as independent core tests.

ambiguities: The request does not prescribe exact prices, API limits, SLA values, or billing periods. Tests should use the page's declared tier rules while requiring concrete quantities, units, or clearly stated custom-pricing methods.
No backend, delivery mechanism, or real checkout transaction is specified. Browser-side validation and an explicit submission acknowledgment are sufficient for the offline contact-form endpoint.
The request asks for an FAQ area but does not specify indispensable questions or facts that must be conveyed there.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can identify the offering as enterprise documentation membership, select either clearly named tier, and compare tier-consistent pricing, concrete API rate limits, and support SLA metrics.
outcomes.quote: interactive toggle that switches the displayed content between standard and enterprise tier features dynamically. The flow should start with a clear value proposition, transition into the pricing toggle, present a dense grid detailing API rate limits and support SLAs
test_cases: Using normal page controls, explicitly select Standard and verify that Standard is shown as selected, a readable price or billing method is displayed, the API rate limit includes a concrete quantity and unit, and the support SLA includes a concrete response-time, availability, or support-hours metric. Record those displayed values, select Enterprise, and verify that Enterprise is now selected, its pricing display updates, its API and SLA details remain concrete and intelligible, and at least one feature, limit, or SLA value meaningfully differs from the recorded Standard data.

Explicitly select Enterprise and record its exact displayed tier name, pricing method, API limit, and SLA metric; switch to Standard and then back to Enterprise, verifying that the recorded Enterprise values and selected-state label are restored without stale Standard data.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can provide reply contact information and technical requirements for a custom SLA deployment, receive understandable validation for incomplete input, and receive a clear browser-visible acknowledgment after a valid submission.
outcomes.quote: contact form for custom SLA deployments
test_cases: Locate the form identified as serving custom SLA deployment inquiries, leave a required reply-contact or requirements field empty, submit it, and verify that an understandable validation message identifies the missing information without showing a success acknowledgment.

Enter valid reply contact information and a concrete custom SLA request using the form's prompts, such as request volume, availability or response target, deployment method, or support scope; submit through the normal control and verify that a clear submitted or received confirmation appears and the validation errors are cleared.

core_scope.purpose: Enable enterprise documentation-hub visitors to compare Standard and Enterprise membership pricing and concrete technical entitlements, and to submit requirements for a custom SLA deployment.
review_notes: Merged the proposed toggle and technical-benefits outcomes because selecting a tier and reading its pricing, API limits, and SLA metrics form one comparison flow rather than independent user goals.

Kept the dense-grid presentation itself out of the core endpoint. Item 15 is mixed because it combines core technical detail with grid presentation, while item 23 remains supplementary layout scoring.

Item 11 is mixed because it checks the presence of several core sections together with supplementary ordering, the introductory value proposition, and page-ending placement. Item 25 is mixed because it combines core tier-data consistency with the supplementary existence and consistency of a checkout action.

Moved the value-proposition block, collapsible FAQ behavior and content, checkout-button existence, sidebar/grid layout, visual references, typography, packaging, and general robustness checks to supplementary requirements. Removing those does not eliminate the primary tier-comparison or custom-SLA inquiry goals.

Did not invent a checkout transaction or network-backed form delivery. The revised tests check concrete tier information, state restoration, form validation, and visible acknowledgment through normal browser controls.

ambiguities: The phrase "across all these blocks" does not define whether one filter must affect the bracket and registration sections. Because the request specifically identifies a project search and dynamic gallery, the core endpoint is interpreted as in-place gallery filtering rather than cross-filtering unrelated sections.

No objective latency threshold is given for "instantaneous". The feasible browser-level interpretation is that results update directly from the input interaction without submission, navigation, or a blank reload.

The searchable fields, matching mode, and case sensitivity are not specified. Tests should use fields and matching rules declared or visibly demonstrated by the page rather than imposing an unstated algorithm.

"live scoring brackets" does not specify a live data service, and the deliverable must be offline and self-contained. It can therefore be a visible stateful mockup; no deployment or scoring backend is inferred.
The winter registration block does not specify a form, submission result, or backend transaction, so no registration transaction is invented as a core outcome.

outcomes.endpoint: The gallery presents multiple distinct prior winning submissions with an intelligible project or algorithm summary, an associated team, and an explicit award, rank, or winning designation within a clearly identified Global AI Hackathon Showcase context.
outcomes.quote: The core user value here is to provide a seamless discovery experience for developers exploring past winning algorithms and team submissions.
test_cases: Load the page and inspect at least two distinct gallery submissions through normal browsing. Verify that each has a project name, readable project or algorithm description, associated team, and explicit prior award, rank, or winner marker, and that the surrounding context identifies the portal as the Global AI Hackathon Showcase rather than an unrelated site.

outcomes.endpoint: Entering a keyword from the gallery's declared searchable project, team, or algorithm fields immediately updates the gallery in place to show exactly the matching submissions, without navigation or a page reload; clearing the query restores the original gallery.
outcomes.quote: The final deliverable must ensure the stateful filtering transitions feel instantaneous across all these blocks.
test_cases: Load the page, record the initially visible gallery cards, and select a distinctive keyword that is visibly present in one card's declared searchable project, team, or algorithm data. Enter it in the project search using normal controls and verify that the intended card remains, every visible result matches under the page's declared search rules, nonmatching cards are hidden, and no navigation or page reload occurs; then clear the query and verify that the recorded card set returns.

After confirming that a token does not occur in any declared searchable field, enter that token and verify that no unrelated project card remains visible, with either an empty gallery or an intelligible no-results message; clear it and verify that the gallery recovers.

core_scope.purpose: Enable developers to discover and narrow a catalog of past winning Global AI Hackathon algorithms and team submissions.
review_notes: Focused core membership on the explicitly stated primary user value: discovering past winning algorithms and team submissions. The live bracket, introductory header, and winter registration block remain scored supplementary requirements because removing them would not prevent the primary discovery task.
Collapsed gallery identity, readable submission information, team association, and winning status into one end-to-end informational outcome rather than treating card fields as separate gates.
Kept search-control existence items 12 and 14 supplementary; core mapping uses items that assess filtering correctness rather than merely the presence of an input or mechanism.

Classified item 15 as mixed because its in-place filtering behavior supports the core endpoint while its optional selected-state requirement is incidental UI feedback. Classified item 22 as mixed because readable gallery copy supports the core outcome while its body-wide placeholder-text rule extends beyond it.
Layout, color, typography, component styling, hero imagery, self-containment, robustness, and viewport overflow checks remain supplementary even where emphatically requested.
Replaced separate find/type/observe steps with complete scenarios that create a query, verify exact filtering behavior, and check restoration or the no-match path.

ambiguities: "high-conversion" does not specify a conversion metric, destination, checkout transaction, or required result after a button click.
The request does not prescribe exact package names, prices, entitlement fields, or a package count beyond implying multiple tiers; comparison should therefore use the page's declared package rules.
The viewport at which "one screen with zero scrolling" must hold is not specified.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can recognize the Nine Yards brand, understand that the page offers access to a film archive and its principal value, and identify a specifically worded conversion-oriented next action.
outcomes.quote: need a high-conversion entry page for our Nine Yards film archive
test_cases: Using a fresh page load and normal reading/navigation, verify that accessible page content names "Nine Yards" exactly, clearly describes film-archive access and its value, and provides at least one action labeled for subscribing, joining, starting, or choosing a package rather than only a vague information link.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can compare at least two distinctly named packages through displayed entitlement differences, and hovering each tier produces a stable, tier-specific, film-related state in a recognizable preview player.
outcomes.quote: left side is an interactive horizontal package comparison where hovering the tiers triggers slick stateful crossfades in a preview player on the right.
test_cases: At a pointer-capable viewport, use the rendered package comparison to record every tier name and its displayed entitlement values; verify that at least two tiers are distinctly named and that their comparable entries expose at least one concrete difference that supports choosing between them.

On a fresh load at a pointer-capable viewport, hover every tier in turn and record the preview's film-identifying content, such as its title, year, duration, imagery, or text; verify that each tier produces a distinct film-archive preview in a recognizable player context, then hover the first tier again and verify that its original state returns.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「E」份「带紫色波浪头图的」：板块的大标题（如 About Me）使用了字重极粗、粗细对比极强的大号现代衬线体，与普通的无衬线正文形成强烈视觉反差。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「E」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「E」22px vs 「B」14px；最大标题字号：「E」80px vs 「B」36px；字号档数：「E」7档 vs 「B」16档。产出应落在「E」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「多张蓝色手机UI图」那一份（典型的移动端常规无衬线字体，字号普遍偏小，层级主要依靠字体的粗细和颜色深浅来区分）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「黑框粉色块排版」那一份（通篇使用紧凑的基础无衬线字体，字号大小变化极小，主要依靠全大写字母和加粗来划分信息层级）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「全黑底色博客」那一份（大标题和Logo使用具有传统气息的古典衬线体，正文内容使用无衬线体，在深色背景下阅读对比度适中）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'我们是"两只鹿"社区公益组织，最近要上线一门面向街坊的在线课程，想请你搭个详情页'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一门面向社区街坊的在线课程详情页（含课程名、大纲、讲师、费用等课程要素），而非其他主题的网站？

keypoints.basis: 指令自称'我们是"两只鹿"社区公益组织'
keypoints.question: 页面上是否出现组织名称"两只鹿"（如页眉/页脚/开篇署名处），文字与指令一致？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求“内容上开篇先放课程名”。
keypoints.question: 页面开篇是否以显著的大标题给出具体的课程名称，而不是只有组织名或泛泛的口号？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'开篇先放课程名和…大纲。往下排讲师区…接着是费用块…最后加个轻量的数据可视化区块'
keypoints.question: 页面主体板块的先后顺序是否为：课程名与大纲 → 讲师区 → 费用块 → 数据可视化区块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求提供“一段带多节点折叠展开的互动式大纲”，但未规定精确节点数量或初始展开状态。
keypoints.question: 大纲区是否包含至少两个可折叠/展开的节点，并以清晰排列的节点标题供用户选择查看？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求大纲为'带多节点折叠展开的互动式大纲，方便查阅'
keypoints.question: 点击大纲中任一节点的标题（或其展开按钮）后，该节点下方是否真的展开出此前不可见的细目内容？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'折叠展开'的互动式大纲，折叠即包含收起行为
keypoints.question: 在某个大纲节点展开后再次点击其标题，该节点是否能重新收起（可反复开合）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求大纲'方便查阅大块目标'
keypoints.question: 大纲各节点是否给出可查阅的"大块目标"式概述（如本单元学习目标、课时数或涵盖主题），而非只有一个光秃秃的标题？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求设置“讲师区”，因此应至少提供可识别讲师身份的信息。
keypoints.question: 讲师区是否明确标出讲师姓名、称谓或其他身份信息，使用户能够识别授课者？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求讲师区'带出大字号寄语'
keypoints.question: 讲师区是否包含一段寄语/引言文字，且该段文字的字号明显大于该区块内的常规正文？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求费用块'包含全价和减免价'
keypoints.question: 费用块是否同时给出"全价"与"减免价"两个具体金额（而不是只标一个价格）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求费用块含'全价和减免价的动态状态切换'
keypoints.question: 点击费用块中的状态切换控件（如全价/减免价的开关或按钮）后，显示的价格数值或当前选中状态是否随之发生变化？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求“最后加个轻量的数据可视化区块，点亮当前学习的成员分布图即可”，但未限定图表的具体实现技术。
keypoints.question: 页面末尾是否包含可辨识为“当前学习成员分布”的实际图表（如柱状图、环形图或分组方块），而不是仅有纯文字说明或空占位？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'点亮当前学习的成员分布图'，需体现当前学习成员的分布数据
keypoints.question: 成员分布图是否给出了分布维度的标签与对应数值/占比（如按社区、按年龄段的人数），而非只有无标注的色块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'把密集的数据表格也妥当塞进去'，且内容须服务于本课程详情页
keypoints.question: 页面中的密集数据表格是否带有表头行，且列字段为课程相关信息（如课时/日期/时间/地点/名额之类），与本课程内容对应？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借鉴参考网页的设计语言，内容须为'两只鹿'社区公益课程
keypoints.question: 页面正文是否全部围绕"两只鹿"社区课程撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名或专有内容（如 Start Bootstrap、Orchid House、kross、Fiction、喝水助手等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只借参考网页的版式与配色，内容应为社区在线课程的真实信息
keypoints.question: 表格、列表与统计数字等条目是否均为课程相关数据，未照搬参考截图里的行业条目（如兰花物种名、饮水量统计、博客文章标题等）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML、CSS/JS 内联、不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含的单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

ambiguities: The referenced screens are not included in the textual request, so exact visual similarity, color measurements, and reference-specific interaction behavior cannot be determined from the request alone.

No minimum event count or fixed evaluation date is declared. "Multiple" can reasonably mean at least two, while whether dates are upcoming should be judged against any timeframe declared by the board rather than an unstated wall-clock date.
The request does not define a pixel-dimension or file-quality threshold for "high-resolution" gallery images.

outcomes.endpoint: The board clearly identifies Amber Works and presents multiple distinct, family-suitable upcoming weekend activities, each with an understandable title, a concrete readable date, and a short plain-English summary.
outcomes.quote: Below that, we will flow straight into the upcoming events using those centered cards. Each card should feature a fun, bright photo taking up the top half, and the bottom half will hold the event title, the date, and a very short, plain-English summary, like "Community Garden Planting" or "Recycled Art Workshop."
test_cases: Load the board and verify that its main content identifies "Amber Works" as a community weekend activity board and presents at least two distinct activities. For every listed activity, confirm a concrete family-suitable title, a readable non-placeholder date that falls on or explicitly names a weekend under the board’s stated timeframe, and a brief child-friendly plain-English summary, with no unrelated reference-brand or design-article content.

outcomes.endpoint: Selecting an activity exposes a corresponding detailed description that clearly explains what will happen and provides the practical date or start time, location, and participation or preparation information a family needs; users can then return to the activity list.
outcomes.quote: When a child clicks on one of these activity cards, I want it to transition into a detailed view exactly like the one in your reference, where a large, full-width image sits at the top and a single narrow column of text follows directly below it.
test_cases: From the activity list, record the title and date of one event, activate its card, and verify that the resulting detail belongs to that event and explains in short, intelligible paragraphs what participants will do, when it starts, where it takes place, and how to join or prepare. Use the return control to restore the list, then open a different card and confirm that its detail changes to the second selected event.

From a fresh load, use only the keyboard to reach and activate an activity card with discernible focus, read the corresponding practical event information, and activate a clearly named return control to restore a keyboard-navigable activity list. Confirm that non-text controls used in this core route have meaningful accessible names.

core_scope.purpose: Help primary school students and their parents discover Amber Works’ upcoming weekend activities and obtain clear, practical information needed to choose and attend an activity.
review_notes: The core purpose was narrowed to communicating usable weekend-event information to families rather than reproducing the reference’s appearance or implementation details.
The listing and detail states remain separate core outcomes because discovering available activities and obtaining the information needed to attend are distinct, non-substitutable user goals.

The image gallery was removed as a core outcome. The request itself describes it as an "extra feature," and the activity board can fulfill its primary information-sharing purpose without image enlargement; items 21 and 22 remain supplementary requirements.

Card image proportions, detail-column geometry, the fifty-fifty image/text balance, drop caps, typography, colors, hover effects, spacing, and other reference styling remain supplementary because they concern presentation rather than the event-information endpoint.

Static single-page and single-file packaging requirements remain supplementary technical constraints; failures that actually prevent selecting or reading an event are already challenged by the core end-to-end detail tests.

Items 31 and 32 are mixed because they combine accessibility of the core card/detail/return route with supplementary images, bottom-menu controls, gallery behavior, and visual focus treatment. The core tests use only their endpoint-relevant accessibility portions.

The proposed stepwise interaction checks were replaced with self-contained scenarios that select an event, verify the corresponding practical information, return to the list, and meaningfully challenge a second selection or keyboard-only route.

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带红黄蓝绿大色块」那一份（以深藏青色为全局背景，显著特征是在背景图片上叠加了大面积的红、黄、蓝、绿半透明色块，所有文字均反白。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「配色」；错误来源「C」份「亮绿顶栏带圆角卡片」在这一面是：以纯白为主要底色，使用高亮鲜艳的翠绿色作为强烈的品牌强调色（覆盖顶部渐变导航栏、按钮、图标和小标题），中下部穿插大面积的深黑灰深色背景区。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「亮绿顶栏带圆角卡片」那一份（以纯白为主要底色，使用高亮鲜艳的翠绿色作为强烈的品牌强调色（覆盖顶部渐变导航栏、按钮、图标和小标题），中下部穿插大面积的深黑灰深色背景区。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「B」份「带红黄蓝绿大色块」：全无衬线英文字体，特征排版为“极大字号的粗体主标题 + 下方紧贴水平短实线 + 全大写且字间距拉得很宽的小字号副标题”，正文段落行距极为宽松。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「B」18.1px vs 「A」15px；字号档数：「B」7档 vs 「A」13档；字族：「B」source/times vs 「A」eb/times。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带红黄蓝绿大色块」那一份基本一致（全无衬线英文字体，特征排版为“极大字号的粗体主标题 + 下方紧贴水平短实线 + 全大写且字间距拉得很宽的小字号副标题”，正文段落行距极为宽松。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「黑底纯文字细线排版」在这一面是：大标题及特定引言段落使用明显的衬线体（宋体质感），正文使用无衬线黑体，文字排版较紧凑，大量出现类似表格键值对的密集信息排列。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「黑底纯文字细线排版」那一份（大标题及特定引言段落使用明显的衬线体（宋体质感），正文使用无衬线黑体，文字排版较紧凑，大量出现类似表格键值对的密集信息排列。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「亮绿顶栏带圆角卡片」在这一面是：常规的无衬线英文字体，各层级字号对比适中，标题多为常规粗体且常居中对齐，段落文本字距正常，无夸张的大字号或特殊的字间距排版。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 15px、最大标题字号 66px、字号档数 13档、字族 eb/times、字重档数 2档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「亮绿顶栏带圆角卡片」那一份（常规的无衬线英文字体，各层级字号对比适中，标题多为常规粗体且常居中对齐，段落文本字距正常，无夸张的大字号或特殊的字间距排版。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（two_column）。判法：主内容区在 1280px 下存在两条并排列轴，且各占 30%–70% 宽。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：内容区我要左右两栏并排着看（判法：主内容区在 1280px 下存在两条并排列轴，且各占 30%–70% 宽）？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「亮绿顶栏带圆角卡片」那样：大量依赖白色卡片容器承载内容，卡片边缘和内部图片均带有明显的圆角处理，且卡片四周带有柔和的浅灰色外阴影；下拉菜单也呈现为带轻阴影的圆角白框。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「C」份的程序指纹：最大圆角 35px、圆角档数 4档、阴影档数 2档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「亮绿顶栏带圆角卡片」那一份（大量依赖白色卡片容器承载内容，卡片边缘和内部图片均带有明显的圆角处理，且卡片四周带有柔和的浅灰色外阴影；下拉菜单也呈现为带轻阴影的圆角白框。）？跟成了即为不通过。

ambiguities: “内容区” does not specify exactly which sections must participate in the requested two-column layout, so that layout should not become a core endpoint.

The responsive-navigation mechanism is intentionally flexible: folding, wrapping, or stacking can all satisfy the request, but navigation and viewport adaptation remain supplementary because the primary content can still be reached by scrolling.
The offline requirement forbids external resources but does not explicitly require delivery as one HTML file; a bundle containing only local assets may satisfy the stated requirement.
Because the page must operate offline, “预购表单” should be measured as a validated local submission with acknowledgment, not as proof of a real payment, inventory, or backend order transaction.

The request does not prescribe an exact preorder field schema. Tests should follow the page’s declared required fields and contact format rather than imposing email when another usable contact method is provided.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly identifies the band and album and communicates that it is a new or upcoming release, so visitors can understand what is being released.
outcomes.quote: 搞个乐队新专发布页，顶部带响应式导航，下面顺着铺开主视觉、试听片段
test_cases: Load the page and verify that readable content identifies both the band and album and clearly presents new-release, upcoming-release, or release-date context; this information must remain understandable without relying on the visual treatment or its placement in a hero section.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can play and pause at least one identifiable album audio preview entirely offline, with clear playback-state feedback.
outcomes.quote: 专发布页，顶部带响应式导航，下面顺着铺开主视觉、试听片段、套餐档位的横向对比以及底部的预购表单。交付要求
test_cases: With the network disabled, load the page, activate a clearly identifiable track or preview control, verify that actual playback progress advances and the visible state indicates playback, then pause it and verify that progress stops and the state indicates that it is paused.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can meaningfully compare at least two preorder tiers using readable tier names, prices, benefit lists, and substantive differences between the tiers; horizontal presentation is a supplementary layout requirement.
outcomes.quote: 套餐档位的横向对比
test_cases: Review the package area and verify that at least two tiers each show a readable name, numeric price, and included-benefits list, then compare the lists and confirm that at least one substantive inclusion differs between tiers.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can provide the information required by the page, select one of the displayed packages, receive validation for invalid input, and obtain a clear local success acknowledgment for a valid submission without requiring an online transaction.
outcomes.quote: 开主视觉、试听片段、套餐档位的横向对比以及底部的预购表单。交付要求必须能纯离线跑绝对不许挂任何外链资源。
test_cases: Using the form’s declared validation rules, leave a declared required field empty or enter malformed contact information where a format is declared, submit the form, and verify that a visible, relevant validation message appears without showing success.

Choose a package that is listed in the comparison area, complete all fields according to the page’s declared rules, and submit; verify that a clear local success acknowledgment appears and that submission neither sends an outbound request nor redirects to an unavailable online endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: All requested content and core interactions operate from local files with the network unavailable, and the page neither depends on nor attempts to load external resources. A single-file package is not required by the request itself.
outcomes.missing_check: The existing checks conflate the required no-external-resource/offline behavior with an unrequested single-HTML-file packaging constraint. A direct check allowing a fully local multi-file bundle while forbidding all external requests is missing.
outcomes.quote: 交付要求必须能纯离线跑绝对不许挂任何外链资源。
test_cases: With networking disabled and request activity observed, load the delivery locally and exercise the release information, audio preview, package comparison, and valid preorder flow; verify that they remain usable and that no HTTP(S) resource or endpoint is requested.

core_scope.purpose: Enable visitors to understand a band’s new album, listen to a preview, compare preorder packages, and complete a locally acknowledged preorder while the release page remains fully usable offline without external resources.
review_notes: Split the original broad page-structure outcome into distinct, non-substitutable visitor goals: release information, listening, package comparison, preorder, and offline operation.

Moved responsive navigation, exact section ordering, bottom placement, two-column composition, and narrow-screen behavior to supplementary scope because they concern navigation or layout rather than the business endpoints.
Kept the visual palette, typography, corners, borders, shadows, and reference-template matching supplementary; they are strongly requested presentation requirements but not separate core outcomes.
Marked item 15 as mixed because it checks core band/album/release information while also requiring that information to appear specifically in the hero area.
Marked item 18 as mixed because track identification supports the listening outcome, while requiring a particular independent section and visible control is partly structural.
Marked item 20 as mixed because multiple comparable tiers are core, but horizontal side-by-side presentation is a layout requirement.
Marked item 24 as mixed because contact and package selection support preorder, while its exact name/contact/tier field prescription is narrower than the request.
Marked the single-file checks as mixed and reported the measurement gap because offline, no-external-resource operation is core, whereas one-file packaging was not stated.
The preorder endpoint is limited to local validation and success feedback; no backend transaction was invented.

Generic absence of uncaught JavaScript errors remains supplementary because it does not by itself establish any requested user outcome; the end-to-end tests directly exercise the relevant interactions.

ambiguities: No authoritative syllabus or prerequisite content is supplied, so 'full class syllabus' can be assessed for presence, intelligibility, and consistency with the selected class, but not for external factual completeness.
The request does not prescribe attendee fields or validation rules; tests should use the form's declared required fields and must not invent an invalid-input requirement.
The exact week boundary, locale, and time zone are unspecified; current-week checking should use the browser's local date and the dates the page declares.
Sortable columns, initial sort direction, and capacity-display format are flexible as long as the chosen ordering is clearly indicated and semantically correct.
The booking request is explicitly simulated, so the confirmation and accurate visible payload are the endpoint; no backend transaction or network persistence should be required.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can understand the current week's available sessions, including start time, duration, instructor, and capacity, and can narrow those sessions by class name, instructor, or the requested program categories.
outcomes.quote: Because our catalog is growing rapidly, the information architecture needs to be flawless, allowing users to filter, search, and book sessions without getting lost in a maze of pages.
test_cases: Load the page and verify that the initially accessible schedule represents the browser's current week and that every visible session provides an intelligible start time, duration, instructor name, and capacity status.

Using a class name present in the schedule, enter that name in search and verify that at least one result remains and every remaining session matches it; clear the search, repeat with a displayed instructor name, and verify every remaining session has that instructor.

Clear search, identify the program of a displayed session, activate its corresponding PROGRAMS filter, and verify that the matching session remains while sessions assigned to other programs are excluded.

outcomes.endpoint: Selecting a scheduled class exposes intelligible syllabus and prerequisite information plus booking context for that specific class, and selecting a different class updates that context without retaining stale class data.
outcomes.quote: When a user clicks on a specific class block, I do not want a popup. Instead, the grid should smoothly compress to the left, revealing a detailed booking pane on the right side of the screen. This slide-out pane is where the complexity lies. It must present the full class syllabus, prerequisite information, and the actual booking form.
test_cases: From the weekly schedule, record the identity of one class and select it; verify that the resulting details identify that class and provide a nonempty syllabus, an explicit prerequisite statement or explicit indication that none apply, and a booking form. Then select a different class and verify that the displayed class identity and booking context update to the second selection rather than retaining the first class.

outcomes.endpoint: A technical coordinator can inspect the same currently filtered schedule as identifiable table records and can sort those records by a supported column.
outcomes.quote: Because our primary users are often technical staff coordinating group training, include a toggle switch at the top of the schedule view. This toggle should switch the main area from the visual weekly grid into a dense, sortable raw data table.
test_cases: Apply a search or program filter and record the resulting sessions, then switch to the raw-data view and verify that the table contains the same filtered set with date or time, class name, duration, instructor, and capacity data. Sort a populated column with at least two distinct values, clearing the filter first if necessary, and compare the full displayed sequence with the correctly ordered sequence for that column.

outcomes.endpoint: Submitting the page-declared attendee details for a selected class produces a human-readable booking confirmation and a valid simulated JSON payload whose class and attendee values match that submission.
outcomes.quote: Inside the expanded booking pane, after a user fills out their attendee details and hits the submit button, the state should change to a confirmation view. To cater to our system administrators, this confirmation state should display a stylized code block showing the simulated JSON payload of their booking request alongside the standard human-readable success message.
test_cases: Select a class and record its identifying information, fill every attendee field that the form declares required with distinctive valid values, and submit. Verify that a human-readable success confirmation appears, parse the displayed payload as JSON, and compare its selected-class and attendee values with the recorded class and every value entered during this booking.

core_scope.purpose: Enable practitioners and technical training coordinators to discover suitable sessions in the current weekly schedule, inspect class-specific syllabus and prerequisite information, review the same schedule as sortable raw data, and submit an attendee booking that produces an accurate confirmation and simulated request payload.
review_notes: Collapsed weekly schedule visibility, search, and program filtering into one end-to-end discovery outcome rather than treating the search box and navigation labels as independent core goals.

Kept class-specific syllabus and prerequisite access as core informational content, while treating the pane's compression, right-side placement, slide behavior, and non-modal presentation as mixed layout concerns.
Retained sortable raw-data access as a core goal because the request ties it to technical staff coordinating training; toggle existence and visual density alone are not core endpoints.

Retained payload correctness as part of the booking result because the simulated JSON is requested for system administrators, while code-block styling and the requirement to transition in place remain mixed presentation or SPA concerns.

Demoted typography, persistent-column layout, control existence, labels and placeholders, fluid transitions, no-reload architecture, self-containment, runtime hygiene, and overflow resilience to supplementary requirements because they do not independently establish the schedule-discovery or booking endpoints.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「B」份「青色顶部的博客文章页」：无衬线体，文章主标题全部使用大写字母且字号巨大，正文为适宜长时间阅读的较大行距和字号，段落层次分明。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：字号档数：「B」11档 vs 「C」5档；字族：「B」roboto vs 「C」source/times。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。

ambiguities: The referenced visual examples are not supplied as images, so resemblance and contrast checks can rely only on the request's textual descriptions.

The request does not prescribe exact credentials, additional eligibility rules, days, or hours. Tests should assess role-appropriate specificity and attribution using the page's declared rules rather than imposing unstated professional standards or fixed schedules.

“无障碍” may mean frictionless, clear information access in ordinary usage or formal technical accessibility. Because no accessibility standard is named, keyboard/focus item 35 remains supplementary rather than becoming an arbitrary core gate.
“平滑” is subjective and concerns transition presentation. The in-page state change is core, while animation quality, height movement, and similar polish are supplementary.
Checklist item "inv_1" refers to a reference “C” that is not identified in the provided task data.

outcomes.endpoint: The page intelligibly identifies itself as a volunteer recruitment page for a nonprofit legal-aid project or organization, rather than a generic commercial or unrelated page.
outcomes.quote: 为我们的非营利法律援助项目搭建专业志愿者招募单页
test_cases: As a first-time visitor, use the page's visible text to identify the project or organization and determine that it is recruiting volunteers for nonprofit legal-aid work; verify both the recruitment context and a recognizable project or organization name are available without relying on outside information.

outcomes.endpoint: A prospective lawyer or psychological counselor can quickly determine the specific eligibility conditions attributable to their profession and identify concrete available shift times, without confusing the two professions or relying on vague scheduling language.
outcomes.quote: 核心诉求是信息获取极度清晰无障碍，让他们一眼看清门槛与排班时间
test_cases: As a prospective 执业律师, use the concentrated eligibility and schedule information to identify the credential and any other stated conditions that apply to lawyers and at least one concrete day/date-and-time shift; verify the conditions are explicitly attributed to lawyers and the schedule is specific enough for an availability decision.

As a prospective 心理辅导师, perform the same eligibility-and-availability decision using the page's declared rules; verify the counseling requirements are distinct and clearly attributed, rather than presented as a shared ambiguous condition, and that concrete scheduling information is accessible without opening another page.

outcomes.endpoint: The page provides an intelligible, ordered account of what happens during application and review; a particular sidebar or timeline decoration is not required for the informational endpoint.
outcomes.quote: 用来展示报名和审核的步骤
test_cases: As an applicant, follow the displayed process from its initial application stage through review and recount at least two distinguishable ordered stages; verify the content actually concerns application and review and that the order is understandable rather than being an unrelated chronology or decorative timeline.

outcomes.endpoint: Changing the selected profession updates the certificate-upload requirement and usable schedule-selection state for that profession within the same page, without a full-page navigation or reload. Animation smoothness itself is supplementary.
outcomes.quote: 点击左侧专业类别时，右侧的资格证上传和时间选择框能动态平滑切换，不整页跳转
test_cases: Using normal page controls, select the lawyer state and choose one of its declared time options, then switch to 心理辅导师; verify the same document remains loaded, the upload prompt changes away from a lawyer credential to a counseling-related credential, the counselor time selector is usable, and a lawyer-only stale selection is not represented as a valid counselor selection. Switch back and verify the corresponding lawyer state can be rendered again.

core_scope.purpose: Enable prospective licensed lawyers and psychological counselors to recognize the nonprofit legal-aid volunteer opportunity, quickly decide eligibility and availability from clear role-specific requirements and concrete shifts, understand the application/review process, and inspect the appropriate in-page application state for their profession.
review_notes: Added recruitment identity as a core informational outcome because a page that does not identify the nonprofit legal-aid volunteer context fails its end-user purpose; the requirement that the name appear specifically at the top remains mixed with placement.

Centered the main information outcome on the visitor's eligibility-and-availability decision. Dedicated grids, blocks, and exact placement are supplementary presentation mechanisms; item 31 is mixed because it combines concentration/layout with the core ability to make a first judgment.

Retained the application/review steps as core requested information, but demoted the sidebar, node, and timeline styling aspects. Item 22 is mixed because it combines meaningful ordering with visual stage markers.
Limited the form outcome to the requested visible profession-specific states. No successful submission, upload processing, persistence, or backend transaction was invented.
Treated smooth animation as supplementary. Item 15 is mixed because it checks both the core in-page state update and non-core transition polish; item 33 assesses animation and layout stability only.

Kept items 16 and 23 supplementary because they merely establish that controls exist; the behavior checks in items 15, 24, and 34 provide endpoint evidence. Likewise, selected-state appearance, button existence, inferred contact fields, viewport fit, single-file packaging, and generic runtime robustness remain supplementary.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「A」份「全是粗黑实线框那个」：极具特征的粗黑色实线直角边框，无任何阴影，将页面严格划分为类似表格或说明书的区块，没有按钮形组件。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「A」无 vs 「B」有。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「带粉红色大按钮那个」在这一面是：现代无边框卡片设计，主要依靠留白分隔内容，按钮为无边框的圆润胶囊形状（全圆角）且纯色填充。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带粉红色大按钮那个」那一份（现代无边框卡片设计，主要依靠留白分隔内容，按钮为无边框的圆润胶囊形状（全圆角）且纯色填充。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「B」份「带粉红色大按钮那个」：现代、明快的标准商业风，充满活力、亲和力且具有年轻化的现代感。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。

ambiguities: The request does not specify whether "our educational milestones" means the school's institutional history or milestones in a student's K-12 journey; either interpretation can satisfy the core if the entries are clearly educational and chronological.
Chronological order may be ascending or descending because the request does not prescribe a direction.

The request does not mandate particular introductory sections such as curriculum, school philosophy, or campus life; checklist item 7's examples should establish the school-introduction theme rather than require every example as a separate gate.

outcomes.endpoint: The rendered page clearly identifies Slow Tuesday as a K-12 school and provides meaningful, relevant introductory school information in plain language that its beginner audience can understand.
outcomes.quote: Here is the scope for the "Slow Tuesday" K-12 introductory page, structured as a foolproof static site for an audience of complete tech beginners.
test_cases: Load the page as a prospective parent and read its primary content; confirm that it prominently identifies the school as "Slow Tuesday," explicitly communicates K-12 or an equivalent grade span, provides substantive school-focused introductory information, and remains understandable without unexplained technical jargon or unrelated brands and industries.

outcomes.endpoint: The page presents a meaningful timeline with at least two educational milestones, each pairing a time marker with a substantive event description and arranged in one consistent chronological direction.
outcomes.quote: Feature a chronological timeline display to walk parents through our educational milestones.
test_cases: Load the page and examine the complete milestone timeline; enumerate at least two substantive entries, record each displayed year or year range together with its corresponding educational event description, and compare the recorded time values to verify that every entry proceeds consistently from earlier to later or from later to earlier without an out-of-order date.

core_scope.purpose: Provide parents and complete tech beginners with an intelligible introduction to the K-12 school "Slow Tuesday" and a chronological account of its educational milestones.
review_notes: Retained two distinct non-substitutable outcomes: an intelligible K-12 school introduction and the requested chronological milestone timeline.

Consolidated the proposal's fragmented name, grade-span, timeline-presence, entry-content, and ordering checks into self-contained end-to-end scenarios that verify each complete informational endpoint.

Mapped item 15 to the introduction because school-domain relevance is part of presenting the correct informational subject. Item 16 remains supplementary because avoiding copied reference wording is an originality or contamination safeguard rather than a separate indispensable user goal.

Kept palette, borders, visual tone, body font size, overflow resilience, implementation packaging, and JavaScript cleanliness supplementary. They remain scored requirements but do not independently define the page's primary informational purpose.

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求通过「multi-select toggles」切换不同污染物数据层；现有条目只检查多个按钮能否同时激活，未检查选择是否真正改变或叠加地图数据。

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求使用「interactive time-scrubber to watch historical pollution clouds moving across the region」；若没有起止范围和当前时间标注，历史状态无法被准确解读。
keypoints.question: 时间滑块是否呈现可理解的历史时间范围，并清楚显示当前选中的具体日期或时刻，使用户能够判断地图数据对应哪个时间点？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求「the map should smoothly animate the pollution heatmaps transitioning over time, keeping the stateful views fluid」；现有条目只验证拖动后数据发生变化，没有验证变化是否平滑。
keypoints.question: 连续拖动时间滑块时，污染热力分布是否通过连续插值、渐变或短暂过渡平滑更新，而不是仅在松手后突兀跳换到另一张静态状态？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户强调数据应「highly accurate」且处于可操作的有状态实时视图中，因此时间、图层、汇总数值及区域提示必须同步对应同一数据状态。
keypoints.question: 地图、汇总指标和悬浮提示中的数据上下文是否保持一致，即均对应当前时间滑块所选时刻与当前启用的污染物图层，没有显示旧时间、未启用图层或相互矛盾的读数？
