ambiguities: The request does not provide a source dataset, expected regional values, update service, aggregation formula, or geographic precision standard. Therefore, “live,” “real-time,” and “highly accurate” should not require a network-backed feed or comparison against invented ground truth; an offline client-side dataset is acceptable if freshness is visibly communicated and all displayed states are internally consistent.

The identity of pollutants beyond AQI, PM2.5, and sulfur dioxide is flexible. Checklist item 28 reasonably operationalizes “other critical pollutant levels” as at least one clearly identified additional pollutant.

When multiple layers are enabled, the request does not prescribe whether they must be blended, separately overlaid, or exposed through a combined legend and tooltip. Any representation is valid if users can determine that each selected layer affects the data view and can distinguish its readings.

outcomes.endpoint: The interface presents recognizable regional geography with pollutant data encoded by district or area, identifies the active monitoring context, and visibly indicates that the data is current or recently updated.
outcomes.quote: The core of this project is a live, interactive geographic visualization of AQI, PM2.5, sulfur dioxide, and other critical pollutant levels.
test_cases: Load the interface, use the normal controls to leave AQI as the sole active layer, and confirm that the immediately available main view contains recognizable district boundaries, names, roads, or equivalent geographic cues plus a current/recent update indicator. Compare two regions shown in different concentration colors and verify their displayed readings fall into the corresponding labeled AQI legend bands, establishing that the map is data-bearing rather than a blank base map.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can directly read a labeled AQI scale and named numerical summary metrics for the current map state, with index explanations or measurement units sufficient to interpret the values without navigating through menus.
outcomes.quote: AQI color scale and summary metrics floating as a distinct block in the top left corner of the map.
test_cases: With a displayed time selected and AQI active, read the metrics directly from the monitoring view without opening a navigation menu. Verify that the AQI scale has explicit intervals or level names, each summary has a clear metric name and numeric value, pollutant concentrations have units and AQI values are identified as an index, and any displayed AQI level description agrees with the interval containing its numerical value.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can select an understandable historical time and enable multiple required pollutant layers, with the map, legend, summaries, and district readings consistently reflecting the selected time and enabled layers rather than merely changing control appearance.
outcomes.quote: This bottom area will house our complex interactions: an interactive time-scrubber to watch historical pollution clouds moving across the region, and multi-select toggles for switching between the different pollutant data layers.
test_cases: Set PM2.5 as the only active layer, choose a named district, and record its displayed PM2.5 reading, unit, map category, and selected time. Drag the time scrubber to a different labeled historical time; verify that the selected timestamp exactly reflects the destination, the regional pollution distribution visibly updates, and the same district's PM2.5 reading and map category are mutually consistent under the displayed legend at the new time, with no stale time or disabled-layer labels in the summary or tooltip.

Confirm that the controls offer AQI, PM2.5, SO₂, and at least one other identified pollutant. Enable PM2.5 and SO₂ together and verify both remain selected and both are represented in the map data, legend, summaries, or district tooltip rather than only by active button styling. Disable PM2.5 and verify SO₂ remains represented while PM2.5-specific output is removed and the selected time remains unchanged.

outcomes.endpoint: Hovering a mapped district reveals an promptly available tooltip that identifies the district and gives the applicable pollutant reading numerically for the current time and layer state.
outcomes.quote: clear numerical tooltips popping up instantly as you hover over different city districts on the map.
test_cases: Fix the interface to one displayed time and SO₂ as the sole active pollutant, then hover over two different mapped districts. For each district, verify that the tooltip updates to the correct district name and contains a numeric SO₂ reading with the applicable unit; use the displayed legend or level rules to confirm that each reading is compatible with that district's map category.

core_scope.purpose: Enable users to directly understand current and historical regional air quality through a geographic visualization with intelligible numerical summaries, pollutant-layer exploration, and district-level readings.
review_notes: Combined time scrubbing, pollutant selection, and cross-view state consistency into one exploration outcome because they are parts of the same map-state flow; retained separate end-to-end scenarios for the historical-time and multi-layer paths.

Moved units, freshness context, and state consistency into core coverage because they are necessary to make an informational monitoring interface intelligible and trustworthy. These were supplementary in the proposal despite checklist items 22, 24, and 32 directly assessing the requested information endpoint.

Classified item 16 as mixed because it checks indispensable legend and summary content together with the non-core floating placement. Item 23 is mixed because direct access to metrics supports the user goal while its first-screen and navigation formulation also imposes layout. Item 19 is mixed because it combines the functional historical update with a smooth-animation requirement.

Kept continuous interpolation and smooth animation in item 31 supplementary. Animation quality is requested but is not itself the historical-data endpoint; the functional update portion remains covered through mixed item 19.

Full-viewport placement, reference-derived layout, colors, component shapes, typography, atmosphere, overflow resilience, and packaging remain supplementary requirements rather than separate core gates.

Kept textual warning wording in item 25 supplementary because the request requires an AQI scale and refers to warning-threshold coloring but does not make a particular textual warning vocabulary indispensable when labeled numerical ranges or levels already convey the threshold.

Replaced setup-only checks such as separately finding and clicking controls with self-contained scenarios that select a state and verify the resulting map, numerical readings, units, legend categories, timestamps, and absence of stale layers.

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「首屏是大楼图的橙色网页」：典型的单页宣传滚动结构，首屏全宽背景图配合居中文字，页面中段有特色的大小图片错落叠加排布，底部为规则的居中三列图文。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「B」45.4个/千像素高 vs 「A」145.2个/千像素高；整页高度：「B」3792px vs 「A」8224px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「首屏是大楼图的橙色网页」那一份基本一致（典型的单页宣传滚动结构，首屏全宽背景图配合居中文字，页面中段有特色的大小图片错落叠加排布，底部为规则的居中三列图文。）？

keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「满是打卡卡片的蓝色网页」那一份（功能性仪表盘结构，顶部为横向数据概览，主体部分被大量密集的多列日程卡片网格铺满，无大面积留白。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「D」份「首屏有叠图的绿色网页」在这一面是：现代图文穿插展示结构，首屏左文右侧配有两张图片交错重叠，往下依次为四列图标网格区、以及左右交替出现的大幅图文模块。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：栅格/卡片间距中位数 10px、内边距中位数 15px、元素密度 145.2个/千像素高、整页高度 8224px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「首屏有叠图的绿色网页」那一份（现代图文穿插展示结构，首屏左文右侧配有两张图片交错重叠，往下依次为四列图标网格区、以及左右交替出现的大幅图文模块。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「D」份「首屏有叠图的绿色网页」：清爽现代的排版，最大特点是首屏使用了字号极大但字重极细（非常纤细）的无衬线字体，与页面内中等字重的小标题形成强烈的粗细反差。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「D」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：字号档数：「D」20档 vs 「C」4档；字族：「D」font/muli vs 「C」anaheim/quattrocento/themefisher-font；字重档数：「D」5档 vs 「C」1档。产出应落在「D」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「首屏有叠图的绿色网页」那一份神似（清爽现代的排版，最大特点是首屏使用了字号极大但字重极细（非常纤细）的无衬线字体，与页面内中等字重的小标题形成强烈的粗细反差。，允许调整）？

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「带有粉色方形徽标的网页」那一份（极其古板基础的组件，仅有带微小圆角的纯蓝色实心按钮（内含常规的白色图标），缺乏阴影或交互状态等现代设计质感。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：元素密度 145.2个/千像素高、底色种类数 13种、间距中位数 10px、整页高度 8224px。分派表没有把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 整体气质是否**没有**沿用第「A」份的特征？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'弄个像The Verge那种跟进大事件的新闻时间线追踪页'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否是围绕某一个持续性重大事件的新闻时间线追踪页（有明确的事件主题标题，并以按时间推进的更新条目作为主体内容），而不是泛泛的新闻首页或普通博客页？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'跟进大事件的新闻时间线追踪页'，时间线条目必然需要时间标记
keypoints.question: 时间线中的每个更新条目是否都带有明确的日期或时间标记（如'3月12日'、'2024-05-01'这类可读时间戳）？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 新闻时间线追踪页需要包含多个更新，并以一致的时间顺序组织内容。
keypoints.question: 时间线是否包含多个更新条目，且各条目的日期或时间呈单一方向有序排列（全部由新到旧或全部由旧到新，无明显乱序）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'长正文多得优先阅读体验'
keypoints.question: 时间线的每条更新是否除了标题/日期外，还带有一段可读的说明性正文（而非只有一行标题）？

keypoints.basis: 矩阵要求布局结构 copy 第 2 份；screenshot_4 展示了全宽建筑主视觉图及其上方居中的大标题，用户也明确要求“顶上全宽图加居中字”。
keypoints.question: 首屏是否沿用第 2 份参考的结构，设置全宽主视觉图像区域，并在图像上居中叠放页面主标题，同时保证图像与新闻事件主题相关？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'长正文多得优先阅读体验'
keypoints.question: 页面主体是否包含多段（≥3 段）连续的长篇正文段落，每段占多行文字，以长文阅读为主，而不是把内容全切成短句摘要？

keypoints.basis: 矩阵要求布局结构 copy 第 2 份；screenshot_5 中多张图片通过偏移和叠压形成错落构图，用户也明确要求“中间图片错落叠着”。
keypoints.question: 页面中段是否沿用第 2 份参考的结构，设置由至少两张图像通过位置偏移和相互叠压形成的错落图文区块，而非整齐并列的等大图片？

keypoints.basis: 矩阵要求布局结构 copy 第 2 份；screenshot_6 展示了三个结构一致的并排人物内容列，用户也明确要求“底下放三列内容”。
keypoints.question: 页面下部是否沿用第 2 份参考的结构，设置一个三列并排且各列信息层级一致的内容区块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'底下放三列内容和读者评价轮播'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个读者评价（读者来信/反馈）板块，并以轮播形式呈现（带有左右箭头或指示点等切换控件）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'读者评价轮播'，轮播须可真实切换
keypoints.question: 点击读者评价轮播的'下一条'箭头（或某个指示点）后，展示区内的评价内容是否确实切换成了另一条不同的评价文字？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求“读者评价轮播”，至少需要两条可切换的不同评价才能构成轮播。
keypoints.question: 轮播是否至少包含 2 条不同的读者评价，并可通过切换控件依次看到不重复的内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'我的表单组件简简单单大一点手机上好点就行'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含一个表单（如订阅事件更新/留言），其输入项数量很少（不超过 3 个字段）并配有一个提交按钮？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求页面带表单组件，表单提交需有可感知反馈
keypoints.question: 在表单输入框留空（或填入明显非法内容）后点击提交按钮，页面是否给出可见的校验提示或提交状态反馈文字？

keypoints.basis: [行业惯例] 指令要求'像The Verge那种'新闻页，新闻站点页面通常含站点标识
keypoints.question: 页面顶部是否有站点标识/栏目名称一类的标题标识，使其可被辨认为一个新闻站点的追踪页面？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求'输出单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源'
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 CSS、JS、字体或图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求“长正文多得优先阅读体验”，因此需要检查长文是否具备适合持续阅读的内容层级和分段结构。
keypoints.question: 长正文是否被组织为清晰的导语、多个带小标题的正文小节及时间线更新段落，并通过合理分段避免形成难以持续阅读的整块文字墙？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求制作“跟进大事件的新闻时间线追踪页”，核心内容应是对同一明确事件的多次、连续且非重复更新。
keypoints.question: 页面是否围绕一个明确命名的重大事件提供多条按时间标注的更新，各条分别描述不同的实质性进展，且没有 Lorem ipsum、重复段落或与该事件无关的占位新闻？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“表单组件简简单单大一点手机上好点就行”；已有条目只限制字段数量并检查提交反馈，尚未验证移动端尺寸和操作便利性。
keypoints.question: 在约 375px 宽的手机视口下，表单是否重排为易操作的单列布局，输入框和提交按钮基本占满可用宽度，且交互控件高度至少约 44px、无需横向滚动即可填写和提交？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 列表/表格被灌到 300 条后，布局是否仍不横向溢出（不撑破）？

keypoints.basis: 题面带数据型功能（客户评价轮播），0 条是必然会遇到的状态
keypoints.question: 数据为 0 条时是否给出空态提示，而不是一片空白？

ambiguities: 清单第13项所称的第「A」份在请求中没有定义，无法确定其具体指代。
请求没有指定表单的业务用途、字段规则或提交语义，因此空值或非法值校验只能作为补充实现要求，不能推定为核心业务结果。
请求没有指定具体重大事件或时间排序方向；核心测试应接受页面自行明确的事件主题，以及一致的由新到旧或由旧到新排序。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面围绕一个明确命名的重大事件提供可理解的长篇报道和多条时间线更新；每条更新具有可读时间标记、说明性正文和不同的实质进展，整体按单一时间方向排列，并通过导语、分节标题和合理分段支持持续阅读，不使用占位或无关内容。
outcomes.quote: 像The Verge那种跟进大事件的新闻时间线追踪页，长正文多得优先阅读体验
test_cases: 进入页面并从事件标题浏览完整时间线，确认主题是一个明确命名的重大事件，存在多条更新；逐条核对每条均有可读时间标记和标题之外的说明正文，内容分别描述不同的实质进展，所有时间按同一方向有序排列，且没有占位、重复或无关新闻。
从导语连续阅读至正文小节和时间线区域，确认至少有三段多行长篇正文，内容由清晰的小标题和分段组织，能够连贯解释事件背景与进展，而不是只有短句摘要或难以阅读的整块文字墙。

core_scope.purpose: 让读者阅读并理解围绕某一明确重大事件组织的长篇新闻报道及按时间推进的实质性更新。
review_notes: 将原提案的三个核心结果合并为一个主要信息阅读结果：重大事件的长篇新闻时间线。时间线更新与长文阅读是同一阅读流程中相互依赖的部分。
读者评价轮播、三列区块和表单虽被明确要求，但移除后仍可完成重大事件追踪与长文阅读这一主要目的，因此保留为补充要求而非核心门槛。
深色配色、参考网页布局、巨大细字、图片叠放、组件风格和移动端布局均属于视觉或布局要求，不提升为核心结果。
第18项同时包含核心相关的事件主标题与主题一致性，以及非核心的全宽图片、居中叠字布局，因此归入 mixed_item_ids。
核心测试已改为完整阅读场景，直接验证事件主题、时间顺序、实质内容和长文组织，不再把定位、点击或观察控件拆成独立测试。

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「首屏是大楼图的橙色网页」那一份基本一致（典型的单页宣传滚动结构，首屏全宽背景图配合居中文字，页面中段有特色的大小图片错落叠加排布，底部为规则的居中三列图文。）？

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「B」份「暗底四列网格卡片那套」：顶部为居中大号标题的引导区，下方通栏按四列等宽网格铺排内容卡片，分为单行横向和多行平铺区块。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「B」16px vs 「A」8px；整页高度：「B」4325px vs 「A」1300px。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「暗底四列网格卡片那套」那一份神似（顶部为居中大号标题的引导区，下方通栏按四列等宽网格铺排内容卡片，分为单行横向和多行平铺区块。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「A」份「白底带版本对比的那套」在这一面是：部分为带侧边栏的面板布局，主体部分是左右平分、两列并排的大画幅对比卡片，内容呈长条状列表堆叠。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「白底带版本对比的那套」那一份（部分为带侧边栏的面板布局，主体部分是左右平分、两列并排的大画幅对比卡片，内容呈长条状列表堆叠。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「配色」指给第「A」份「白底带版本对比的那套」：整体为亮色倾向，背景和卡片以大面积白色及极浅灰为主，使用明度较高的清亮蓝紫色作为按钮和图标的强调色。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否与「白底带版本对比的那套」那一份神似（整体为亮色倾向，背景和卡片以大面积白色及极浅灰为主，使用明度较高的清亮蓝紫色作为按钮和图标的强调色。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「配色」；错误来源「B」份「暗底四列网格卡片那套」在这一面是：整体为极暗色倾向，大背景呈深邃的深紫黑色，搭配高饱和度的亮紫/紫红色作为关键按钮和高亮文字的强调色。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「暗底四列网格卡片那套」那一份（整体为极暗色倾向，大背景呈深邃的深紫黑色，搭配高饱和度的亮紫/紫红色作为关键按钮和高亮文字的强调色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（font_base_18）。判法：正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：正文字号我要 18px 起，再小我妈就看不清了（判法：正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px）？
keypoints.spec_check: 正文段落的计算 font-size ≥ 18px

keypoints.basis: 指令要求做'专为社区外展志愿者和邻里组织者设计的笔记记录与归档界面'，'在单一屏上优雅地结合在线编辑区与结构化的历史记录归档'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一个单一屏幕的笔记记录与归档应用（顶部为实时记笔记的编辑区，下方为已保存笔记的归档网格），而非其他主题的页面？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求整个应用采用 single-page、single unified screen，避免用户在嵌套菜单中迷失；这不排斥页面因多行笔记而纵向滚动。
keypoints.question: 应用是否采用单一页面和统一工作区承载完整的编辑与归档流程，且无需通过嵌套菜单、分页或路由跳转访问核心功能？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Start with a prominent, large, centered header area at the very top—though instead of an exploration prompt, we will use this space for our active, expanding text editor'
keypoints.question: 页面顶部是否设置了醒目、宽大的居中活动编辑区，用于实时撰写笔记？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Directly beneath this active editor area, I need a full-width section that displays our saved notes'
keypoints.question: 编辑区正下方是否为通栏（full-width）的已保存笔记展示区？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'First, present a single horizontal row of exactly four cards dedicated exclusively to "Pinned Neighborhood Action Plans." Below that row, flow the rest of the standard meeting notes into a multi-row grid'
keypoints.question: 已保存笔记区是否按'先一行置顶的邻里行动计划卡片、再标准会议笔记的多行网格'的顺序上下排列？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求第一行卡片'exactly four cards dedicated exclusively to "Pinned Neighborhood Action Plans"'
keypoints.question: 第一行是否明确标注/归属为 "Pinned Neighborhood Action Plans"（置顶的邻里行动计划）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'a single horizontal row of exactly four cards dedicated exclusively to "Pinned Neighborhood Action Plans"'
keypoints.question: 置顶行是否恰好包含四张卡片（既不多于也不少于四张）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求该行卡片'dedicated exclusively to "Pinned Neighborhood Action Plans"'，其余标准会议笔记另起多行网格
keypoints.question: 置顶行的卡片是否为专属的置顶内容，且与下方标准会议笔记在内容上可区分（不混排）？

keypoints.basis: 验收标准要求'rigidly follows the four-column card arrangement ... maintaining top alignment even when individual note titles vary in length'
keypoints.question: 同一网格行中的卡片顶部边缘是否保持对齐，并且标题长度或换行数不同时不会导致卡片整体下移或错位？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Each active note needs clearly labeled input fields for "Resident Name," "Neighborhood Block," and "Topic Tags"'
keypoints.question: 活动编辑区是否包含精确标注为 "Resident Name"、"Neighborhood Block"、"Topic Tags" 的三个输入字段？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求这三个输入字段 'directly above the main text body'
keypoints.question: 上述三个输入字段是否位于主文本正文区域的上方？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'The wording should be conversational and encouraging, like "What did the neighborhood discuss today?" rather than sterile system prompts like "Input Text Here"'
keypoints.question: 编辑区正文的提示占位文案是否为对话式、鼓励性的问句（如 "What did the neighborhood discuss today?"），而非 "Input Text Here" 之类的系统化提示？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'When a user clicks into it, the input area should smoothly expand downward to accommodate long-form typing'，验收标准要求'the active editing area expands dynamically based on content length'
keypoints.question: 用户点击进入编辑区并输入较长文本后，输入区域是否向下平滑扩展以容纳内容（而非固定高度截断）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求展开时'gently pushing the four-column grid below it further down the page without jarring jumps'，验收标准要求'without breaking the page width or overlapping the grid section'
keypoints.question: 编辑区展开时是否把下方的笔记网格整体下推，而不与其重叠、也不撑破页面宽度？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Provide a minimalist formatting toolbar that only appears when text is highlighted by the user (a floating tooltip style)'，并明确'We do not want a permanent, cluttered ribbon toolbar'
keypoints.question: 当用户在编辑区选中一段文本时，格式化工具条是否以浮动 tooltip 形式出现，而不是常驻显示？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求工具条'offering just bold, bulleted lists, and a yellow highlight option'

ambiguities: The request calls completed records an archive but explicitly specifies reload restoration only for the active draft. Whether archived cards must also persist across reloads is not defined clearly enough to impose as an additional core endpoint.

No actual content, data source, or editing behavior is specified for the four pinned Neighborhood Action Plan cards. Their exact count, row, and separation are therefore treated as requested archive organization rather than a separate data transaction.

The request says the editor should support rich text but does not define how formatting must be serialized into an archived card or restored. The specified contextual toolbar and its three formatting choices remain supplementary requirements.

outcomes.endpoint: A user can enter the requested note metadata and body, archive the completed note, receive a new identifiable archived card containing the exact entered data, and continue with a cleared editor. Animation, exact grid position, and card-shifting behavior are supplementary presentation details.
outcomes.quote: When a user finishes a meeting note and clicks a prominent "Archive to Board" button, the active editor should clear itself with a gentle fade animation. Simultaneously, the newly created note must instantly slide into the top-left position of the four-column grid below, smoothly shifting the older note cards one spot to the right to make room.
test_cases: On a fresh page, enter unique exact values for Resident Name, Neighborhood Block, Topic Tags, and the note body, activate "Archive to Board," and verify that the editor is cleared and a newly created standard-note card displays the same entered values rather than blank or fixed example content.

outcomes.endpoint: Edits to the current note's body and metadata are automatically stored locally after the declared autosave interval and the latest exact values are restored after a reload without manual saving.
outcomes.quote: The local autosave successfully retains text in the editor even if the browser tab is accidentally refreshed or closed.
test_cases: Starting with cleared local draft state, enter unique values in all metadata fields and the body, wait at least five seconds, change several values, wait another five seconds, reload the page, and verify that every field and the body exactly match the latest values rather than the earlier or empty state.

outcomes.endpoint: The core note-entry and archiving flow is operable without a pointer, its fields and actions expose meaningful accessible names, the resulting archived record exposes meaningful content, and the workflow has no keyboard focus trap. Accessibility requirements concerning optional formatting controls remain supplementary portions of the mixed checks.
outcomes.missing_check: Only mixed checklist items are mapped; a standalone endpoint assessment is required.
outcomes.quote: Keyboard navigation fully supports tabbing through the editor inputs, formatting options, and all cards in the lower grid, ensuring total accessibility for volunteers relying on screen readers.
test_cases: Using only the keyboard with a screen reader or browser accessibility interface, navigate to the labeled metadata and body controls, enter a uniquely identifiable note, activate the archive action, navigate to the resulting card, confirm that its accessible name or content communicates the entered note, and verify that focus can continue through and leave each part of the workflow without becoming trapped.

core_scope.purpose: Enable community volunteers to draft resident and meeting notes, preserve unfinished drafts locally through interruptions, archive completed notes as readable records, and complete the core workflow accessibly.
review_notes: Collapsed note entry, archive activation, editor clearing, and creation of a data-derived card into one end-to-end core flow instead of treating the button or individual fields as separate gates.

Removed the proposed notes-grid outcome from core status. Four-column blocking, the exact four-card pinned row, top alignment, and pinned-versus-standard arrangement are important supplementary structure requirements but are not separate non-substitutable user transactions.

Removed the proposed expanding-editor outcome from core status because expansion, smooth pushing, width fit, and overlap avoidance concern layout and animation rather than the note-taking or archiving endpoint.

Kept the autosave status label supplementary: displaying "Saved locally" does not by itself establish that exact draft data was persisted and restored. Items 27 and 28 test the actual persistence endpoint.

Retained accessibility as a core user outcome because the requested audience explicitly includes keyboard and screen-reader users. Items 25 and 30 are mixed because they combine the core accessible workflow with supplementary formatting-option and card-focus specifics.

Kept exact typography, palette, single-screen composition, self-contained packaging, generic JavaScript health, and overflow behavior supplementary rather than promoting implementation or presentation constraints into independent core outcomes.

Verify monthly/annual results of $2,450/$29,400, $6,500/$78,000, $6,535/$78,420, $20,500/$246,000, $20,525/$246,300, and $33,000/$396,000 respectively; confirm the control cannot select below 10 or above 1000 and each update occurs without a page reload.

Set nodes to 150, select Mission Critical 99.99% SLA, enable Technical Account Manager, and disable On-Premise Deployment Sync. Verify the displayed monthly commitment is exactly $13,250 and the annual projection is $159,000. Then switch only the SLA to Standard and verify that 150 nodes and TAM remain selected while the results update to $9,750 and $117,000 without navigation or reload.

Select Standard SLA and 100 nodes with both add-ons off and verify $6,500 monthly and $78,000 annually. Enable TAM and verify the same SLA and node count remain selected while the figures become $8,000 and $96,000. Then enable On-Premise Deployment Sync and verify the complete $8,000 subtotal is multiplied by 1.15, producing exactly $9,200 monthly and $110,400 annually, again without reloading.

core_scope.purpose: Enable enterprise buyers to configure SLA, compute-node volume, and support add-ons and immediately receive mathematically correct monthly and annual subscription cost estimates.
review_notes: Collapsed pricing logic, annual projection, live updates, and state preservation into one end-to-end configurator outcome because they form a single user flow rather than independent goals.
Removed the SVG visualization and its animation from core membership. It is a requested presentation layer, but the non-substitutable user goal is obtaining correct, intelligible cost projections.

Viewport fit, responsiveness, visual-reference matching, hover effects, selection colors, number animations, and single-card layout remain scored supplementary requirements rather than core business endpoints.
Items 16 and 27 are mixed because they include access to core values while also prescribing placement, prominence, or an incidental quote button.

Items 17 and 18 check the presentation and existence of setup controls rather than independently validating the pricing endpoint. The required selections are nevertheless exercised within the core end-to-end scenarios.
No backend action was assigned to the formal-quote button because the request specifies only its presence and hover treatment.

keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「黑底橙按钮卖车网页」那一份（顶栏加居中搜索框，下方是标准的三列商品卡片，带有一段横向滑块布局。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「D」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「E」份「带手写字的博客页组合」在这一面是：左半边为大图、右侧排列文字介绍的对半开布局，以及一张首屏全宽大图接单列文本的常规博客排版。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「E」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：内边距中位数 9px、元素密度 81.2个/千像素高、整页高度 1762px。分派表没有把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带手写字的博客页组合」那一份（左半边为大图、右侧排列文字介绍的对半开布局，以及一张首屏全宽大图接单列文本的常规博客排版。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「E」份「带手写字的博客页组合」：使用了醒目的手写体作为人名签名，博客正文带有细灰色的斜体引用文字块，排版较松散。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「E」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「E」24px vs 「A」40px；字族：「E」montserrat/open/themify vs 「A」anaheim/quattrocento/themefisher-font；字重档数：「E」3档 vs 「A」1档。产出应落在「E」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带手写字的博客页组合」那一份神似（使用了醒目的手写体作为人名签名，博客正文带有细灰色的斜体引用文字块，排版较松散。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「浅灰与深黑组合页面」在这一面是：常规的现代无衬线体，字重与字号对比中规中矩，层级常规。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「浅灰与深黑组合页面」那一份（常规的现代无衬线体，字重与字号对比中规中矩，层级常规。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「奶油底色杂志风网页」在这一面是：标题无衬线，带有大量全大写的细小无衬线英文字母作为元数据标签，整体呈杂志排版感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「奶油底色杂志风网页」那一份（标题无衬线，带有大量全大写的细小无衬线英文字母作为元数据标签，整体呈杂志排版感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「黑底橙按钮卖车网页」在这一面是：粗壮厚重的无衬线体，数字字号极大且加粗，强调视觉冲击力。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「黑底橙按钮卖车网页」那一份（粗壮厚重的无衬线体，数字字号极大且加粗，强调视觉冲击力。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「E」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「白底蓝字的学校网页」在这一面是：特大且圆润的加粗无衬线标题体，标题与正文段落之间的字号反差极其剧烈。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 16px、最大标题字号 40px、字号档数 4档、字族 anaheim/quattrocento/themefisher-font、字重档数 1档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「白底蓝字的学校网页」那一份（特大且圆润的加粗无衬线标题体，标题与正文段落之间的字号反差极其剧烈。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「浅灰与深黑组合页面」那样：带细微纹理的极浅灰底色搭配亮粉红色（Logo）与亮蓝色（按钮），内部还有一页是深黑灰底色配浅蓝绿字。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「浅灰与深黑组合页面」那一份（带细微纹理的极浅灰底色搭配亮粉红色（Logo）与亮蓝色（按钮），内部还有一页是深黑灰底色配浅蓝绿字。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「黑底橙按钮卖车网页」那样：极其纯粹的暗黑底色，按钮和控件等交互元素使用极高饱和度的亮橙色。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「黑底橙按钮卖车网页」那一份（极其纯粹的暗黑底色，按钮和控件等交互元素使用极高饱和度的亮橙色。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「组件样式」不要做成「奶油底色杂志风网页」那样：极致的直角无框风格，卡片没有底色、没有阴影、没有边框，完全依靠图片的直角边缘和文字对齐来形成视觉上的卡片。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「B」份的程序指纹：最大圆角 160px、圆角档数 3档、阴影档数 2档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 有。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「奶油底色杂志风网页」那一份（极致的直角无框风格，卡片没有底色、没有阴影、没有边框，完全依靠图片的直角边缘和文字对齐来形成视觉上的卡片。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面把跨形态要求抬到了档 1（移动端优先 / 严格响应式）。参考截图只有桌面宽度，所以窄屏形态是**推断**出来的，不是照抄；判定看窄屏帧与 1920px 主帧之间结构是否真的不同。
keypoints.question: 窄屏（390px）下的信息层级是否**重排**过（导航收起、多列变单列、主次顺序按小屏重新安排），而不是把桌面版等比缩小？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'搞个拉新的开发者API文档单页'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'侧边得加那种锚点导航滚过去还能带高亮跟踪的钩子功能'
keypoints.question: 向下滚动到核心文档区中部的某个章节后，侧边锚点导航中对应该章节的条目是否呈现出与其他条目不同的高亮/激活状态？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“代码块一键复制的状态切换动画”，因此应同时验证复制功能和动画状态反馈。
keypoints.question: 点击代码块上的复制按钮后，是否会复制对应代码，并通过可见的过渡或动画将按钮切换为「已复制」一类的新状态？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'首屏转化冲击力要拉满……左边上巨大号的抓手文案'
keypoints.question: 首屏主文案是否是面向开发者接入的转化型抓手句（强调接入速度/规模/免费试用一类卖点），而不是泛泛的公司介绍或无关标题？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求加入极具说服力的高频转化数字，并以“千万级 QPS”作为示例，而非强制指定该指标。
keypoints.question: 首屏下方的数字指标行中，是否至少有一项体现 API 高频、高性能或大规模能力的有说服力数据（例如千万级 QPS、低延迟或高可用性），且各项指标均配有含义清楚的说明标签？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求首屏下方紧贴一行具有说服力的转化数字，可合理检查其是否构成多项指标行，但不应擅自限定为至少三项。
keypoints.question: 数字指标行是否由至少两项横向并列的说服性指标组成（如吞吐量、可用性、平均延迟或接入开发者数），而不是只有一个孤立数字？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'首屏转化冲击力要拉满'、'CTA按钮必须得有……'
keypoints.question: 首屏是否存在指向接入转化的 CTA 按钮，且按钮文案与「获取 API Key / 立即接入 / 免费试用」一类动作相关？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'进到核心文档区就是大量长正文了……沉浸阅读体验要做到极致'
keypoints.question: 核心文档区是否确实包含成段的长正文（多个连续的说明性段落），而不是只有标题加零散短句/占位一两行？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求接口参数面板，但未限定其具体字段数量或要求必须包含“是否必填”字段。
keypoints.question: 核心文档区是否包含接口参数面板，并以表格或结构化列表清楚展示参数名称、类型、说明等必要的参数信息？

keypoints.basis: 指令提出细灰斜体字块适合用于“API 报错说明或者技术引言”，因此任一类内容存在即可。
keypoints.question: 文档区是否包含 API 报错说明或技术引言中的至少一类辅助说明内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'开发者API文档单页'，并给出'首屏…下面紧贴一行数字…进到核心文档区'的顺序
keypoints.question: 整体是否为单页长滚动结构，且板块顺序为首屏抓手文案+拼贴图 → 数字指标行 → 核心文档区，全部内容在同一页内？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求侧边锚点导航；应验证导航目标真实有效，而不额外强制其覆盖全部章节或数量完全一致。
keypoints.question: 侧边锚点导航中的每个条目是否都能清楚对应核心文档区的一个实际章节，并在点击后滚动或跳转到正确章节？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'锚点导航滚过去还能带高亮跟踪'，高亮跟踪需要导航在滚动中持续可见
keypoints.question: 向下滚动到文档区中后部时，侧边锚点导航是否仍保持在视口内可见（随页面固定），而不是随内容滚出屏幕？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“页面里再加个代码块一键复制的状态切换动画”。
keypoints.question: 文档区是否至少存在一个代码块，且该代码块带有清晰可见的复制按钮或图标？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'主要就是限制在iPad横屏上用所以沉浸阅读体验要做到极致'
keypoints.question: 文档正文的阅读区是否限制了行宽（正文栏未通栏铺满整个屏幕宽度），以便在 iPad 横屏尺寸下沉浸阅读？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求：输出单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联，不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'开发者API文档'与'代码块一键复制……无脑接入'
keypoints.question: 代码示例中的内容是否为可辨识的真实 API 调用代码（如 curl/HTTP 请求或 JSON 响应结构），而不是 lorem 之类的占位文字？

keypoints.basis: [行业惯例] API 文档通常需标明端点与请求方法
keypoints.question: 文档区是否给出了具体的请求端点路径与请求方法（如 POST /v1/xxx 一类标注）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确说明“主要就是限制在iPad横屏上用所以沉浸阅读体验要做到极致”；现有条目只检查正文行宽和 390px 窄屏重排，未覆盖目标设备 1024×768 下整套文档界面的实际可用性。
keypoints.question: 在 1024×768 的 iPad 横屏视口下，首屏、侧边锚点、正文、参数面板和代码块是否均无重叠或裁切，文档区仍能保持侧栏与可读正文的合理分栏，代码过长时也有换行或局部滚动处理？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“侧边得加那种锚点导航滚过去还能带高亮跟踪的钩子功能”；已有条目检查映射、固定和滚动高亮，但没有验证点击锚点后的实际定位质量。
keypoints.question: 点击侧边锚点导航中的任一章节后，页面是否实际滚动到对应章节标题附近，并避免标题被固定导航遮挡，同时该章节条目进入激活状态？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求“代码块一键复制的状态切换动画”；现有条目只验证按钮文字或图标发生变化，未验证代码是否真正复制、复制内容是否完整，以及状态切换动画与复位。
keypoints.question: 点击代码块的复制按钮后，剪贴板中是否得到该代码块的完整原文，并通过可见的过渡动画切换为“已复制”状态，随后能够恢复为可再次复制的默认状态？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求首屏“转化冲击力要拉满”并明确提出 CTA；已有条目仅检查 CTA 是否存在、文案是否相关及 hover 反馈，没有检查其核心转化动作是否有效。
keypoints.question: 点击首屏主 CTA 后，是否会到达明确的转化落点（如 API Key 申请、免费试用或快速接入章节），而不是无响应、仅改变按钮外观或跳到无关位置？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 题面的呈现约束把窄屏体验列为要求（cross_form 档 1）

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出

keypoints.basis: 题面点名了状态型功能：锚点导航与滚动高亮
keypoints.question: 点击交互控件后 DOM 是否真的发生变化（不只是源码里绑了事件）？

keypoints.basis: 题面点名了锚点导航与滚动高亮
keypoints.question: 页内锚点链接（href="#…"）是否都指向页面中真实存在的 id？

keypoints.basis: 题面把「A」份点名为反面参考（别做成它那样）
keypoints.question: 配色是否明确**不像**第「A」份参考？

ambiguities: 请求要求 CTA 按钮，但没有指定其最终目标或任何后端流程；离线验收应接受与按钮文案一致的本页快速开始、申请说明或试用说明，不应要求真实账户创建或 API Key 发放。
“真实业务调用截图”没有提供来源素材或真实性判定标准，只能客观检查是否为可辨识的业务调用画面，不能验证其确实来自生产业务。
“比如千万级QPS之类的”是示例而非固定阈值；指标的具体数量、数值和类别不应被任意固化为核心门槛。
inv_1 与 inv_2 所称的第 A、C 份参考没有给出可验证映射，因此只能作为补充性的视觉比较项。

outcomes.endpoint: 潜在开发者能够从首屏理解一项具体的 API 接入价值，并通过主 CTA 到达与其文案一致的接入、试用或快速开始落点；不要求离线页面真实发放 API Key 或完成后端注册。
outcomes.quote: 搞个拉新的开发者API文档单页啊，首屏转化冲击力要拉满
test_cases: 加载页面后，以潜在开发者身份从首屏识别一条具体的接入价值主张，再通过正常点击激活主 CTA；验证最终到达与 CTA 文案相符的本页快速接入、API Key 申请说明或试用说明落点，而不是无响应、仅改变按钮外观或跳到无关内容。

outcomes.endpoint: 开发者能够阅读实质性的 API 文档，并从中确定至少一个接口的请求方法与路径、所需参数及其含义，并取得可辨识的真实请求示例。
outcomes.missing_check: 现有条目分别检查方法与路径、参数面板和代码示例，但没有直接核验三者是否描述同一个接口并且相互一致。
outcomes.quote: 进到核心文档区就是大量长正文了
test_cases: 通过正常滚动进入核心文档区，选择一个已声明的 API 操作，确认能够找到其请求方法和路径，并从参数面板确定参数名称、类型和说明；随后检查真实的 curl、HTTP 或 JSON 示例确实对应所选操作，而不是占位文字。
继续阅读该操作周围的文档，确认存在多个连续且可理解的说明段落，能够说明接入、请求或响应规则，而不是只有标题、零散短句或填充内容。

core_scope.purpose: 让潜在开发者在单页中理解 API 的具体价值与接入方式，并能进入明确的接入下一步；同时提供足以理解至少一个接口的可读技术文档。
review_notes: 将首屏价值主张与 CTA 落点合并为同一个获客流程，避免把标题存在、按钮存在和点击动作拆成多个琐碎核心测试。
把 API 文档内容保留为信息型页面的核心：长篇实质说明、方法与路径、参数信息和真实代码示例共同支持开发者理解接口。
侧边锚点、滚动高亮、固定效果以及代码复制和状态动画都是阅读或操作便利性增强；移除后文档仍可通过正常滚动阅读，因此保留为补充要求。
三图拼贴、指标行数量、版块顺序、字体、颜色、描边、阴影以及各类反向参考均属于呈现与说服方式，不是不可替代的业务终点。高性能指标仍可被补充评分，但不是独立核心门槛。
iPad 横屏适配、390px 或 768px 响应式表现、长串溢出和正文行宽属于视口与布局质量，按要求未提升为核心。
条目 28 同时检查核心代码块的存在和非核心复制控件的存在，因此列为 mixed_item_ids；复制结果与动画条目本身仍为补充项。
未把任何真实部署、注册或 API Key 生成后端加入核心；CTA 只需抵达页面声明的有意义接入落点。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「A」份「左大字右卡片的网页」：首屏采用非对称的左右分栏，左侧为大号文字，右侧悬浮表单卡片；下方转为三列平齐的信息卡片排列。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「A」60.5个/千像素高 vs 「D」12个/千像素高；整页高度：「A」9342px vs 「D」1080px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。

ambiguities: The request does not specify where the news and literature library belongs in the otherwise stated section sequence, so its exact position should not be treated as a core gate.
No department name, canonical facts, or fixed archive dataset is supplied. Core review can establish relevance, specificity, and intelligibility but should not invent external factual requirements.

“无感分页” does not prescribe one interaction model; pagination, load-more, and incremental scrolling are reasonable alternatives. The substantive archive records are core, while the exact batching mechanism is not.
The labels 「A」 and 「D」 in checklist items 19 and pal_1 are not independently defined in the request text, so those supplementary checks require external reference mapping.
The request asks for a contact form but specifies no validation, submission result, recipient, or backend transaction. No successful delivery endpoint should be inferred for an offline HTML page.

outcomes.endpoint: The page clearly identifies itself as a university history department homepage, provides a meaningful department introduction, and keeps its substantive copy relevant to that academic context rather than reusing unrelated reference-site content.
outcomes.quote: 我们准备给大学历史学院做一个全新的主页
test_cases: Load the page and read the main introduction together with representative body content; verify that it meaningfully describes a university history department and does not contain placeholder copy, reference-site brands, or unrelated pet, blog, or app material.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can access and understand historical milestone records spanning multiple page-declared periods, with each record identifying its year or era and its event title or summary.
outcomes.quote: 交互式大事记时间轴，因为这里的历史档案条目非常庞大
test_cases: Starting with a visible milestone, record its year or era and event title or summary, then use any available timeline navigation, scrolling, or era selection to reach a record from another declared period; verify that both records remain intelligible and represent genuinely different periods. A particular horizontal, parallax, or filter animation is not required for this content endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: The page communicates exactly three distinct, concrete history research directions, each with a recognizable field name and an intelligible description.
outcomes.quote: 接着是三个核心研究方向的图文介绍
test_cases: Review the research section as a whole and verify that it contains exactly three distinct directions, that none uses placeholder names such as “方向一,” and that each direction includes substantive explanatory text about a recognizable historical field.

outcomes.endpoint: Accessible alumni content pairs concrete graduate destinations, such as employment or further study, with intelligible alumni evaluations or testimonials.
outcomes.quote: 专门用来展示优秀毕业生去向和校友评价的轮播图
test_cases: Inspect the alumni presentation, following its provided navigation if content is segmented, and verify that accessible graduate entries pair destination information with testimonial or evaluation text rather than presenting only one of those content types.

outcomes.endpoint: Prospective students can read substantive admissions guidance containing at least one concrete and useful detail such as a process, time point, admissions category, or consultation method.
outcomes.quote: 轮播图，作为吸引新生报考的钩子；最后是联络表单和招生指引。新闻文献库那块也要注意，信息密度极高，一定要做
test_cases: Read the admissions guide and verify that it provides actionable information under the page's declared admissions rules, such as a process step, date or period, applicant category, or consultation channel, rather than only a heading or generic invitation.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can access multiple distinct history-department news and literature records and distinguish them through meaningful metadata such as title, date or era, content type, and summary.
outcomes.quote: 新闻文献库那块也要注意，信息密度极高
test_cases: Inspect several archive records, using the page's pagination, load-more action, or incremental scrolling only if needed to reach them; verify that the records are distinct, relevant to the history department, and identified by meaningful titles, dates or eras, content types, and summaries.

core_scope.purpose: Provide an intelligible university history department homepage where prospective students and other visitors can understand the department, its historical milestones, research areas, alumni outcomes, admissions guidance, and news or archival records.
review_notes: Reframed the core around the informational purpose of a university history department homepage rather than its projection-oriented layout, color palette, typography, atmosphere, responsive behavior, or visual effects.

The quick-guide card, prescribed section order, horizontal timeline layout, parallax, smooth filter behavior, visible carousel controls, and exact pagination presentation remain supplementary because they are substitutable presentation or navigation mechanisms.

Items 26, 32, 37, and 43 are mixed because they combine access to substantive records with a prescribed widget behavior. The core scenarios accept equivalent normal-control access while still checking the resulting information.
Item 29 is mixed because it combines core research names and descriptions with the supplementary requirement for an image or graphic in every card.
The contact form checks remain supplementary: the non-substitutable informational goal is readable admissions guidance, and the request does not define a form-submission outcome.
The proposed stepwise checks were consolidated into self-contained scenarios that navigate as needed and verify the actual content reached rather than merely locating or clicking controls.

ambiguities: The overview says a chef should be able to log in and confirm delivery, but it defines neither authentication nor a post-checkout confirmation state. Checklist item 26 checks only for a checkout button, so no backend transaction or invented confirmation behavior is treated as core.

The under-three-minute aspiration has no defined start state, end state, operator protocol, or timing checklist. Item 37 validly tests approximately 50-line capacity and arithmetic, but not human task-completion time.

Because the deliverable is offline and the acceptance criteria specify fixed unit prices from fake data, fluctuating daily market prices are interpreted as clearly displayed current prices, not live market-data retrieval.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can identify orderable produce and unambiguously understand each row's wholesale specification or quantity unit, current fixed unit price, quantity field, line subtotal, and applicable delivery cutoff.
outcomes.quote: We are dealing with bulk quantities, constantly fluctuating daily market prices, and strict delivery cut-offs.
test_cases: Using normal page controls from a fresh load, locate an orderable produce row and verify that its SKU or identity, wholesale pack/weight unit, numeric unit price with currency and pricing basis, quantity entry, and associated line subtotal are intelligible; also verify that an explicit delivery cutoff is visible on the ordering screen.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can add products and modify quantities while the frontend immediately and accurately recalculates each row subtotal, the distinct line-item count, and the grand total without reloading, including for an order of about 50 distinct lines.
outcomes.quote: When a user clicks a button to add a new case, or tweaks a numeric input field to increase an order to 15kg, the running financial total and the line-item count in the right-hand summary column must update instantly without requiring a full page refresh.
test_cases: From a fresh load, create an order line if necessary, then record its fixed unit price p, quantity q, grand total T, and distinct line count. Change the quantity through the normal control to another permitted value q'. Verify immediately that the row subtotal equals q' × p using the page's declared currency rounding, the grand total equals T + (q' − q) × p or the independently summed displayed subtotals, the distinct line count is unchanged, and no page reload occurs.

From a fresh load, record the order summary and use a product's Add control. Verify that the resulting order quantity and subtotal follow the page's declared add increment, that the line count increases only when a new distinct line is created, and that the grand total exactly equals the sum of all displayed line subtotals without navigation or a full refresh.

Using normal controls, build an order containing about 50 distinct products with known quantities. Verify that every quantity is retained, each row subtotal equals its quantity multiplied by its displayed fixed unit price, the reported line-item count equals the number of distinct order lines, and the grand total exactly equals the independently calculated sum of all row subtotals.

core_scope.purpose: Enable restaurant procurement users to identify wholesale fresh produce and rapidly compile a large, financially accurate order with immediate line-count and total feedback.
review_notes: Added order-critical product and commercial information as a core outcome; without wholesale units, current prices, and the delivery cutoff, users cannot make an intelligible or accurate procurement decision.
Collapsed add-item, quantity-edit, subtotal, line-count, grand-total, and large-order checks into one end-to-end cart outcome rather than treating controls or individual clicks as separate outcomes.
Kept the approximately 50-line capacity check core because it directly challenges the stated procurement use case and verifies that cart arithmetic remains correct at the intended scale.

Moved single-file/offline packaging and A4 print formatting to supplementary requirements. They are important delivery and manifest-support constraints, but removing either does not eliminate the portal's primary ordering outcome.

Kept preload state, quantity-control existence, Grand Total label styling, and checkout-button existence supplementary because they are setup or affordance checks rather than proof of the ordering result.
Responsive layout, sticky positioning, viewport fit, visual references, typography, component styling, and robustness stress probes remain supplementary rather than becoming business-outcome gates.
Generic DOM-change and no-exception checks do not establish the specified cart calculations, so they were not mapped as core endpoint checks.

keypoints.basis: 指令只借设计语言，主题应为'海报编辑器界面'
keypoints.question: 参考截图里的行业内容（业务模板宣传、动物角色选择、结账/订单摘要与价格、UI 套件的组件示例清单）是否都没有被搬进页面，页面呈现的是海报模板与排版参数？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求为单文件 HTML、CSS/JS 内联、不引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求制作面向写作者的海报编辑器；作为编辑器，除排版参数外还应允许修改海报中的实际文字内容，但不必限定唯一的编辑方式。
keypoints.question: 界面是否提供实际修改海报文案的控件，例如标题与正文输入框或可直接编辑的预览文字，而不是只有字号、行距、颜色等样式参数？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把 palette 指给了「B」份
keypoints.question: 整体配色是否取自第「B」份参考，而不是别的份？

ambiguities: “海报编辑器界面”没有明确规定交互实现深度；本注释将文案/排版修改和模板选择视为编辑器的核心，但不推定真实保存、文件导出或后端服务。
“横排三列的栏目”没有规定必须展示数字指标；清单1和20所述的数字指标及具体示例内容是附加解释，不作为核心结果。
请求没有明确规定分类导航必须采用严格过滤算法；核心测试按页面声明的分类对应规则验证，不强制某一种实现。
清单pal_1使用“第B份参考”的编号，但给定请求只用参考页面特征进行描述，数据中没有明确给出该编号与描述的对应关系。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够修改海报文案和至少一项页面所声明的排版参数，顶部海报预览会准确呈现输入的文字及所选排版设置，而不是仅展示静态占位画面。
outcomes.missing_check: 清单35只检查文案编辑控件是否存在，清单28只检查排版参数的影响；没有清单项验证用户输入的具体文案会被准确写入海报预览。
outcomes.quote: 想给写字的朋友们弄个海报编辑器界面，日常做图用。
test_cases: 加载页面后，在文案编辑控件中把标题改为唯一文本“雨夜来信”，再依据控件标签选择一个非默认的排版设置（如改为右对齐）；确认顶部海报预览准确显示“雨夜来信”，且同一文字采用所选的右对齐设置，而不只是发生无明确含义的 DOM 变化。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够通过有意义且互不重复的文字分类浏览带名称和可辨识缩略预览的海报模板，并选择一个明确的模板，获得与所选模板身份一致的选中或应用反馈。具体左右排列、卡片数量和信息密度属于补充布局要求。
outcomes.quote: 界面信息密度得高，结构就看那个带网格卡片的工具包页，顶上留宽大头图做预览，往下接横排三列的栏目，核心区是左边文本导航配右边多列网格卡片放模板。
test_cases: 加载页面并记录默认分类后，选择一个不同的具名分类，确认该分类被标为当前项且模板区按页面声明的分类规则显示对应模板；随后选择其中一个具名模板，确认反馈明确指向刚选择的同一模板，并在页面声明会应用模板时核对预览也切换为该模板。

core_scope.purpose: 为写字/文字创作者提供可日常使用的海报编辑器，使用户能够选择文字海报模板、修改文案与排版参数，并在海报预览中确认编辑结果。
review_notes: 将原提案中的独立工作区和参数面板结果合并为一个完整的“编辑并预览”流程，避免把打开页面、找到控件和观察画布拆成琐碎核心测试。
保留模板浏览与选择为独立核心结果，因为移除模板选择会使请求中特别指定的模板型海报编辑器失去一项不可替代的主要用途。
保存或导出未出现在原请求中，且请求强调的是编辑器界面，因此清单30降为补充要求，不推定真实下载或持久化事务。
颜色、字体视觉风格、组件造型、精确布局、三列栏目、卡片数量、长文本适配和单文件工程约束均继续作为补充要求，不因措辞强调而提升为核心业务端点。
清单1同时混合了核心区域、固定布局、信息密度和非核心三列指标，因此保留为mixed_item_ids；清单17只综合确认工作区主题和要素存在，不能单独证明任何编辑流程完成。
清单18、21、26、27和35主要检查容器或控件存在，未验证最终编辑结果，故未用作核心端点正确性证据；文案实际写入预览的缺口已明确记录。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「A」份「大号衬线字米白页」：首屏采用左侧文本右侧半身像的不对称布局，下方的成员展示使用无边框的四列图文垂直堆叠。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：内边距中位数：「A」16px vs 「B」34.5px；元素密度：「A」67.4个/千像素高 vs 「B」135.7个/千像素高；整页高度：「A」5651px vs 「B」2991px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求'写一句"立刻开启智能创作"'
keypoints.question: 页面底部的内测申请区域是否包含引导文案“立刻开启智能创作”？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'让用户留邮箱申请内测的区域...下面放个大点的输入框配个主色调的提交按钮'
keypoints.question: 底部内测申请区域是否同时包含邮箱输入框和提交按钮这两个交互元素？

keypoints.basis: 指令强调'移动端的响应式适配必须做好'
keypoints.question: 页面是否实现了响应式设计，在移动端视口下能够正常适配显示（布局不错乱、内容可读且无横向溢出）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求'页面的导航栏滑下去的时候记得做个吸顶效果'

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'移动端下要把导航折叠成常见的汉堡菜单形式'
keypoints.question: 在移动端视口下，导航栏是否折叠为汉堡菜单图标（三横线或类似菜单标识），而不是始终展开显示全部导航项？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求汉堡菜单时，隐含需要点击展开的交互功能
keypoints.question: 点击移动端的汉堡菜单图标后，是否能够展开或弹出导航菜单（实现菜单的显示/隐藏交互）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'单文件形式的代码'，评测要求单文件HTML交付标准
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求'需要带有顶部导航'
keypoints.question: 页面是否包含顶部导航栏区域？

keypoints.basis: 指令描述'多板块的推广页'，隐含垂直滚动的长页面结构
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为多个垂直排列的板块区域（而非单一平铺或横向滚动布局）？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求应用场景部分做成“一个个带演示图的方块”，并举出“周报”和“公文”两类场景，能够支持检查多个场景，但不能支持至少3个的硬性门槛。
keypoints.question: 应用场景展示部分是否包含多个可辨识的场景卡片，而非仅有一个场景示例？

keypoints.basis: 第2份反面参考采用浓重暗红渐变、黑色区块和彩色高饱和警示条；用户明确要求反其道而行，使用干净纯白底色和局部亮蓝点缀。
keypoints.question: 页面是否以纯白或明亮浅色为主要底色，仅用亮蓝色作局部强调，并明确避免反面参考中的暗红渐变、黑色内容区及大面积高饱和警示色？

keypoints.basis: 指令描述'图文块'，隐含每个块都应包含图文两要素
keypoints.question: 核心特色功能区的图文块是否每个都包含图像元素和文字说明两部分（而非纯文本或纯图片）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求'让用户留邮箱申请内测'
keypoints.question: 底部内测申请表单的输入框placeholder或label是否明确提示用户输入邮箱地址（而非电话号码或其他信息）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求页面“需要带有顶部导航、中间的互动表单”，现有条目只检查了底部邮箱申请表单，没有覆盖中部表单。
keypoints.question: 页面首屏与底部内测申请区之间是否设置了独立的互动写作表单，且该表单包含用于填写写作主题或需求的输入控件和明确的执行按钮？

keypoints.basis: [补全] “互动表单”隐含表单应可实际操作；同时页面主题是AI智能写作助手，因此输入写作需求并触发可见反馈是该中部表单成立所必需的基本交互。
keypoints.question: 中部互动写作表单是否能够接受用户输入，并在触发执行按钮后产生清晰可见的结果、预览、状态变化或操作反馈，而不是仅作为静态装饰？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“带有顶部导航”；现有条目仅检查导航区域是否存在、是否吸顶和移动端是否折叠，未检查导航项能否实际导航到多板块内容。
keypoints.question: 顶部导航栏是否提供指向页面主要板块的清晰导航项，并且点击后能够到达对应区域，而非仅展示无目标或不可用的文字？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求该区域用于“让用户留邮箱申请内测”；现有条目只检查邮箱输入框、提示文字和提交按钮是否存在，未覆盖申请动作是否具备基本可用性。
keypoints.question: 底部内测申请表单是否会校验邮箱格式，并在用户提交后给出明确的成功、错误或处理中反馈，避免按钮点击后毫无响应？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确提出“交付标准得高一点，代码结构必须干净，方便他们接手后自己改文案”；现有自包含单文件条目只检查资源交付形式，没有检查源码组织和文案可维护性。
keypoints.question: 单文件源码是否按导航、首屏、核心特色、互动表单、应用场景和内测申请等板块清晰分区，使用可读的语义标签、类名或注释，并避免将主要文案拆散在难以修改的脚本拼接代码中？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 题面把「B」份点名为反面参考（别做成它那样）
keypoints.question: 配色是否明确**不像**第「B」份参考？

ambiguities: The request does not prescribe the names or behavior of individual core features, so feature content should be judged for relevance, distinctness, and intelligibility rather than against an invented feature list.
The writing form’s output format and generation rules are unspecified. A response clearly tied to the submitted request is sufficient; AI-output quality or a real model call must not be assumed.
The beta section does not specify storage, networking, or a backend. Offline validation and visible acknowledgement satisfy the interaction endpoint; actual enrollment persistence cannot be required.
The phrase describing four feature blocks combines “一排四个” with “垂直排开,” leaving the precise orientation unclear. Count and arrangement remain supplementary rather than an arbitrary core gate.
Checklist item inv_1 refers to reference “B,” but the request does not map its named references to letter labels, so that item cannot establish an unambiguous core requirement.

outcomes.endpoint: A visitor can identify the product as an AI writing assistant and understand its central value proposition, such as rapidly generating work reports tailored to the user.
outcomes.quote: 页面开头首屏我想参考那个带有雕像照片的浅白主页，左边放我们产品的核心价值文案，比如写上“一秒生成懂你的工作报告”，右边配一个产品界面的操作大图，这种左文右图的不对称结构看着挺有张力的。
test_cases: Load the page and read the hero content; verify that it clearly identifies an AI writing assistant and communicates a concrete writing benefit equivalent to quickly generating a user-relevant work report, rather than presenting an unrelated AI product or only generic marketing language.

outcomes.endpoint: The core-features section provides intelligible text explaining distinct capabilities of the AI writing assistant; the exact number, image treatment, and arrangement of the blocks are supplementary presentation requirements.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item verifies that the feature copy communicates distinct and intelligible AI-writing capabilities; item 32 only checks that each block contains an image and some text.
outcomes.quote: 顺着往下划是核心特色功能区，这里我觉得可以直接参考刚才那个主页中下段展示人员的做法，做成一排四个没有边框的图文块垂直排开，客户就喜欢这种不拖泥带水的设计。
test_cases: Read the titles and descriptions in the core-features section and verify that they collectively explain multiple distinct, relevant AI-writing capabilities in understandable language rather than using placeholders, repeated copy, or image-only blocks.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can understand multiple distinct writing use cases from clearly identified scenario cards, with labels such as weekly reports, official documents, or semantically comparable document types.
outcomes.quote: 中间应用场景展示的部分，咱们要做成一个个带演示图的方块。这里的细节你看一下那个放了一堆开会和握手照片的橙色列表页，我们要那种带有极浅色细边框的高度完整的卡片。最关键的是要在卡片图片上面悬浮一个小方块，用来标明这篇是“周报”还是“公文”，就像它那个图片上悬浮的橙色日期一样，然后在卡片最底部也加上一条细细的横向分割线，底下放点类似生成字数或者使用人次的信息栏。
test_cases: Review the application-scenarios section and verify that it contains multiple recognizable writing scenarios whose labels clearly distinguish the represented document or task types, rather than several unlabeled or indistinguishable cards.

outcomes.endpoint: The middle-page writing form accepts a user-supplied writing topic or need and, when executed, produces a clear on-page response tied to that submission, without requiring a real external AI service.
outcomes.quote: 这是个多板块的推广页，需要带有顶部导航、中间的互动表单，且移动端的响应式适配必须做好。
test_cases: Enter a concrete writing request into the middle-page form and activate its execution control; verify that the page returns a visible preview, result, or completed acknowledgement attributable to that request rather than merely changing an unrelated DOM element or doing nothing.

outcomes.endpoint: A visitor can submit a syntactically valid email address for beta access and receives clear on-page acceptance or processing feedback; malformed email input is rejected with understandable feedback. No remote persistence or backend transaction is required.
outcomes.quote: 最后页面底部需要一个让用户留邮箱申请内测的区域，简单干脆点，写一句“立刻开启智能创作”，下面放个大点的输入框配个主色调的提交按钮就行。
test_cases: At the bottom beta-signup area, enter a malformed value such as test_user and submit it; verify that submission is blocked or an understandable email-format error is shown, with no success acknowledgement.

At the bottom beta-signup area, enter a valid address such as user@example.com and submit it; verify that the page provides a clear non-error acknowledgement that the beta request was accepted or is being processed, without requiring a network service.

core_scope.purpose: A promotional landing page that enables prospective users to understand the AI writing assistant’s value, features, and use cases, try its interactive writing experience, and request beta access by email.
review_notes: Added the informational goals for product value, core features, and application scenarios because an informational promotional page fails its primary purpose if those requested messages are absent or unintelligible.

Removed single-file implementation, code organization, responsive fit, sticky navigation, hamburger navigation, layout, typography, card styling, color, and exact block counts from core membership. They remain scored supplementary requirements but are not non-substitutable end-user outcomes.

Kept the writing demo and beta request as core interactions, while mapping only checklist items that assess the resulting endpoint behavior. Control-existence items 22, 33, and 34 remain supplementary setup checks.

Converted the interaction checks into self-contained end-to-end scenarios that enter data, execute the action, and verify the resulting response. Invalid and valid email submissions are retained as separate meaningful paths.

Did not require a deployment API, real AI service, or persistent beta-registration backend because the deliverable is an offline self-contained HTML page and the request does not specify those systems.

keypoints.basis: 系统自动注入：基本可渲染性检查（闸门条目，不计入加权分）
keypoints.question: 页面是否成功渲染出有意义的 UI 而非空白页？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「A」份「竖排文字古风页面」：使用了带有传统古籍气质的中文衬线体，大量采用从右至左的竖向排版，部分信息横竖混排。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：最大标题字号：「A」22px vs 「B」40px；字族：「A」noto/times vs 「B」arial/inter/times；字重档数：「A」2档 vs 「B」4档。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「竖排文字古风页面」那一份基本一致（使用了带有传统古籍气质的中文衬线体，大量采用从右至左的竖向排版，部分信息横竖混排。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「健康数据仪表盘」在这一面是：使用现代无衬线体，常规横排，数据指标数字（如77 bpm）使用较大字号和加粗处理以作强调。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「健康数据仪表盘」那一份（使用现代无衬线体，常规横排，数据指标数字（如77 bpm）使用较大字号和加粗处理以作强调。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「C」份「深色纯图片网格页」在这一面是：几乎无大段文本，仅在每张图片左下角使用了字号极小的全大写无衬线体作为标注。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「深色纯图片网格页」那一份（几乎无大段文本，仅在每张图片左下角使用了字号极小的全大写无衬线体作为标注。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「D」份「绿色渐变顶栏页面」在这一面是：使用现代无衬线体，横向排版，标题粗大饱满，正文字重较轻，层级对比十分强烈。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 15.2px、最大标题字号 40px、字号档数 11档、字族 arial/inter/times、字重档数 4档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「绿色渐变顶栏页面」那一份（使用现代无衬线体，横向排版，标题粗大饱满，正文字重较轻，层级对比十分强烈。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「组件样式」指给第「B」份「健康数据仪表盘」：主要由带有明显圆角和轻微弥散浅阴影的白色卡片构成，包含环形刻度进度条、折线图等数据可视化组件以及胶囊状状态标签。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给了「B」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：是否有胶囊/圆形元件：「B」有 vs 「A」无。产出应落在「B」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「健康数据仪表盘」那一份基本一致（主要由带有明显圆角和轻微弥散浅阴影的白色卡片构成，包含环形刻度进度条、折线图等数据可视化组件以及胶囊状状态标签。）？

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「A」份「竖排文字古风页面」在这一面是：没有常见的网页表单或按钮控件，主要使用极细的线条和简单的几何方框作为内容分隔标识。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「竖排文字古风页面」那一份（没有常见的网页表单或按钮控件，主要使用极细的线条和简单的几何方框作为内容分隔标识。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「深色纯图片网格页」在这一面是：没有任何常规意义上的UI组件（如卡片、按钮、输入框），整个页面仅由图片区块无缝拼接而成。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「深色纯图片网格页」那一份（没有任何常规意义上的UI组件（如卡片、按钮、输入框），整个页面仅由图片区块无缝拼接而成。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「D」份「绿色渐变顶栏页面」在这一面是：没有使用带边框或阴影的封闭卡片容器，包含带有微小圆角的实色填充按钮（深色或亮绿色），以及带有3D光影质感的大图标。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：圆角档数 0档、阴影档数 0档、是否有胶囊/圆形元件 无。分派表没有把组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「绿色渐变顶栏页面」那一份（没有使用带边框或阴影的封闭卡片容器，包含带有微小圆角的实色填充按钮（深色或亮绿色），以及带有3D光影质感的大图标。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（ground_dark）。判法：渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：整页底色我要深的，字浮在深底上（判法：渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35）？
keypoints.spec_check: 渲染页正文区域的中位明度 V < 0.35

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「布局结构」不要做成「深色纯图片网格页」那样：全屏满宽布局，采用了无边距、无缝隙的四列均等图片网格，信息密度极高，没有留出页面空白区域。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否明显不同于「深色纯图片网格页」那一份（全屏满宽布局，采用了无边距、无缝隙的四列均等图片网格，信息密度极高，没有留出页面空白区域。）？跟成了即为不通过。

ambiguities: The request does not prescribe a progress unit, target, percentage formula, or increment size. Endpoint tests should use the rules and units declared by the rendered page rather than impose an arbitrary formula.

The destinations and information architecture of the requested navigation are not specified. Navigation switching is therefore retained as a supplementary requirement rather than made a separate non-substitutable core goal.
“社区” describes the context but does not explicitly require accounts, shared synchronization, or a multi-user backend; no network transaction should be inferred.

outcomes.endpoint: Submitting a non-empty habit name creates exactly one corresponding habit entry, while an empty submission creates none; the created entry is integrated into the tracking workflow with intelligible status, progress, and a usable check-in control.
outcomes.quote: 上面得有个表单让大家自己加习惯
test_cases: Record the current habit count, enter the unique name “晚饭后散步”, and submit. Verify the count becomes exactly one greater and exactly one entry with that full name appears. For the new entry, verify that a numeric progress value, a meaningful Chinese today-status, and an operable check-in control are present; use the control and calculate the exact expected next value from the page’s declared progress unit or rule, then verify the displayed value and status match it.

Record the current habit count, leave the habit-name field empty, and submit. Verify the count remains exactly unchanged and that no blank-named habit is created, whether the page handles this through validation feedback or a no-op.

outcomes.endpoint: A habit can be checked in for the current day, producing an exact rule-consistent progress update and an intelligible Chinese completion state; another same-day attempt is prevented or explicitly handled without counting an additional completion.
outcomes.quote: 习惯打卡小工具就是带大家一起每天打卡喝水看书啥的
test_cases: Create a uniquely named habit through the page’s form, then record that habit’s exact initial numeric progress, displayed unit or target, and today-status. Determine the exact one-check-in result from the page’s declared rule, activate its check-in control once, and verify the resulting number or percentage equals that expected value and the Chinese status explicitly indicates today’s completion. Attempt the same habit’s check-in again and verify the progress remains at the exact post-first-check-in value, or that the duplicate is explicitly rejected or handled without a second count.

core_scope.purpose: Enable community members, including older users, to create personal habits, complete daily check-ins, and understand each habit’s current status and progress.
review_notes: The core was narrowed to the primary habit-tracking goals: creating a custom habit and completing a daily check-in with clear progress and status.

The proposed mobile-usability outcome was removed from core because viewport fit, responsive layout, touch spacing, and hover independence are supplementary presentation/usability requirements. Item 28 remains mixed because it combines mobile conditions with execution of core operations.

Navigation was removed as a separate core gate because the request does not define indispensable destination content and the habit creation/check-in purpose can still be completed without that particular access mechanism. Items 16, 17, and 27 remain supplementary requirements.
Item 25 is mixed under habit creation because it checks the creation result together with status, progress, and check-in capabilities belonging to the broader tracking flow.

Broad theme or control-existence checks such as items 12 and 13 were not used as core endpoint evidence; the mapped core checks verify actual creation, validation, numerical progress, state transitions, and duplicate handling.
Typography, dark coloring, cards, circular gauges, line charts, spacing, responsive fit, and self-contained-file constraints remain supplementary and were not promoted into core outcomes.

keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为 Midnight Syndicate 新专辑《Void Walker》的数字发行落地页（音乐/专辑主题，而非营销、房产、博客等其他主题）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确指定新专辑名为 "Void Walker"，并要求页面作为该专辑数字发行的中心落地页。
keypoints.question: 页面是否以醒目的主标题形式精确出现专辑名 "Void Walker"，从而明确本页的发行主题？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确写明艺人为 'The new Midnight Syndicate album'
keypoints.question: 页面上是否精确出现乐队名 "Midnight Syndicate"？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确写明专辑 "drops next month"，页面应向访客传达相应的发行时间。
keypoints.question: 页面是否清楚给出专辑将在下个月发行的信息，或提供与此对应的具体发行日期？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'hype the release, let the fans sample the tracks, sell the upcoming tour tickets, and capture emails for the street team'
keypoints.question: 页面是否同时包含指令点名的四类核心板块：曲目试听、巡演日期、邮件订阅，以及专辑图文叙事区？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求 'sell the upcoming tour tickets' 并设置 tour dates 板块
keypoints.question: 每个巡演场次是否都含有日期、城市/场馆名称，以及购票按钮或链接三项信息？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'let the fans sample the tracks'，并提到 'swap them for the next track'（存在多首曲目）
keypoints.question: 曲目试听板块是否列出了两首及以上曲目，且每首都标出曲名？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'put the album art on the left'
keypoints.question: 图文板块中的图像区域是否呈现为可辨识的专辑封面视觉（有意设计的封面画面），而非与主题无关的图形或纯色占位块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'We also need a persistent sticky top nav to jump between these beats'
keypoints.question: 页面顶部是否存在滚动时始终固定可见的 sticky 导航栏？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求“The top navigation must smoothly anchor-scroll to the respective sections”。
keypoints.question: 点击顶部导航中的任一有效导航项后，页面是否以可见的平滑滚动动画定位到对应板块，而非瞬间跳转、无反应或滚动到错误位置？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收项：'The sticky top nav must shrink in height upon scrolling past the hero section'
keypoints.question: 当页面向下滚动越过英雄区之后，顶部 sticky 导航栏的高度是否明显变矮（与初始态相比可见收缩）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The track preview section needs custom HTML5 audio controls'
keypoints.question: 试听板块的播放器是否为自定义控件（自绘的播放按钮、进度条等），而不是浏览器原生 <audio controls> 默认控件条？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'when a track is actively playing, the play button should glow with one of our neon highlight colors'
keypoints.question: 点击某一曲目的播放按钮使其进入播放状态后，该播放按钮是否出现霓虹高亮的发光/高亮态（与未播放的其他曲目按钮明显不同）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'The email signup form needs an inline success state showing a thank-you message without bouncing the user to a new page'
keypoints.question: 邮件订阅区是否包含邮箱输入框与提交按钮，且提交后在当前页面内联显示感谢信息（页面未跳转/未刷新到新页面）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求 'capture emails for the street team'
keypoints.question: 邮件订阅板块的文案是否点明其用途是招募/加入 street team（歌迷推广团），而非泛泛的"订阅新闻"？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收项：'The alternating desktop flow must gracefully stack into a single vertical column on mobile devices below the 768px breakpoint'
keypoints.question: 在宽度小于 768px 的移动视口下，原本左右交替的图文板块是否堆叠为单列纵向排列（无横向挤压或溢出）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借用参考页面的设计语言（结构骨架、配色、卡片形态），全部文案主题为 Midnight Syndicate 的 Void Walker 发行
keypoints.question: 页面正文是否全部围绕《Void Walker》专辑主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名（如 loopple、Reader、Housing Market Explorer）或其条目文案（如 "Info number 1/2/3"、"Increase your sales using Social Media"、"What We Do"、房产/汉堡等内容）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求页面服务于专辑发行（试听、巡演售票、street team 邮件收集），参考截图仅供设计语言借鉴
keypoints.question: 页面中的数据（曲目名、巡演城市/场馆等）是否为贴合专辑主题的原创内容，而非参考截图中的行业数据（房价、社交媒体营销、图书等）照搬？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收项：'The entire experience must be delivered as a single, self-contained HTML file'
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [行业惯例] 指令称页面为 'central hub for the entire digital release' 并要求 'hype the release'，唱片发行落地页首屏通常带预存/预购 CTA
keypoints.question: 英雄区是否包含至少一个明确的行动号召按钮（如预存/预购/试听专辑）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求页面捕捉唱片的 'cinematic, isolationist narrative'，并给出 'a late-night drive through an empty, rain-slicked metropolis' 作为核心叙事意象。
keypoints.question: 英雄区及 liner notes 的文案是否明确传达《Void Walker》的电影化、孤独疏离叙事，并具体呼应深夜驾车穿过空旷、雨湿都市的主题，而非仅使用泛化的音乐宣传语？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户描述了明确的滚动节奏：'open with ... hero block'，随后 'As the fan scrolls down, shift into an alternating left-and-right flow'，并要求 'Further down for the tour dates'。
keypoints.question: 页面的主要纵向叙事顺序是否为首屏发行宣传英雄区，其后进入交替左右的专辑/曲目图文与试听内容，再在更下方进入巡演日期区？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求 persistent sticky top nav 能够 'jump between these beats'，因此不应只存在单个可用锚点，而应覆盖页面的主要叙事节点。
keypoints.question: 顶部导航是否为发行/专辑介绍、曲目试听、巡演日期和 street team 邮件报名等主要页面节点提供对应的页内导航项，且每一项均指向正确且唯一的目标板块？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求 'The top navigation must smoothly anchor-scroll to the respective sections'；现有条目只验证到达正确板块，未单独验证平滑过渡及 sticky 导航遮挡问题。
keypoints.question: 点击顶部导航的页内链接时，视口是否通过可观察的连续平滑动画移动至目标板块，而不是瞬间跳转，同时目标标题不会被 sticky 导航遮挡？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求曲目试听使用 custom HTML5 audio controls，并明确要求曲目播放时播放按钮以霓虹强调色发光；因此应验证真实播放、暂停以及播放态反馈同步，但不应额外强制未点名的进度或时间显示。
keypoints.question: 每个曲目试听器的自定义播放控件是否真实驱动底层 HTML5 音频的播放与暂停，并使按钮播放状态及播放时的霓虹发光反馈与实际音频状态保持同步，而非只切换静态图标或样式？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把 palette 指给了「A」份
keypoints.question: 整体配色是否取自第「A」份参考，而不是别的份？

ambiguities: The request says the album drops "next month" but gives no reference date; either that relative wording or a clearly presented concrete release date is treated as sufficient.
No ticketing platform or transaction flow is specified. The core endpoint is therefore an actionable, non-placeholder purchase path, not successful payment or an invented ticketing backend.
No email-storage service or persistence behavior is specified. The requested inline success state is treated as the observable successful endpoint rather than proof of backend storage.

outcomes.endpoint: Clearly communicates that Void Walker is an upcoming Midnight Syndicate album, gives its release timing, and conveys the requested cinematic narrative of an isolated late-night drive through a rain-slicked city.
outcomes.quote: hype the release
test_cases: Starting from a fresh load, read the release and narrative content and verify that it identifies the artist as "Midnight Syndicate" and the album as "Void Walker," states either that it arrives next month or gives a concrete release date, and includes intelligible narrative copy specifically evoking isolation and a late-night journey through an empty, rain-wet metropolis rather than generic music promotion.

outcomes.endpoint: Provides at least two named track previews that play actual audio and can be paused through the page controls.
outcomes.quote: let the fans sample the tracks
test_cases: From a fresh load, use the preview controls for each of at least two distinctly named tracks; for each track, verify that actual media playback begins and its playback time advances rather than only an icon or CSS class changing, then pause it and verify that playback stops.

outcomes.endpoint: Lists upcoming tour stops with a date and city or venue for each stop and provides an actionable ticket-purchase entry point associated with each one.
outcomes.missing_check: Item 16 verifies ticket-button or link presence but does not explicitly verify that activation leads to a non-placeholder ticket path for the corresponding event.
outcomes.quote: sell the upcoming tour tickets
test_cases: From a fresh load, reach the tour section and verify that every listed stop has a date, city or venue, and ticket control; activate each control in turn and confirm that it exposes or navigates toward a non-placeholder purchase or ticket-contact path for that same stop, without requiring completion of an external transaction.

outcomes.endpoint: Accepts a valid email through a form explicitly presented as street-team signup and confirms submission with an inline thank-you state without leaving or reloading the page.
outcomes.missing_check: No checklist item explicitly verifies rejection of empty or malformed email input; item 24 covers the inline success path only.
outcomes.quote: capture emails for the street team
test_cases: Starting with the untouched form, enter a syntactically valid email and submit it; verify that the same document remains loaded and an inline thank-you or success state appears for the street-team signup.

After a fresh reload, submit an empty or malformed email; verify that no success state is shown and that the form remains available with a validation indication instead of treating the value as captured.

core_scope.purpose: Provide fans with a central Void Walker digital-release hub where they can understand and anticipate the album, hear track previews, access tour-ticket purchase paths, and join the street team.
review_notes: Retained four distinct core outcomes because album information and anticipation, track listening, ticket access, and street-team signup are separate non-substitutable user goals.

Moved hero CTA presence, album-art treatment, navigation behavior, responsive layout, viewport behavior, typography, color, component styling, animation, and delivery constraints to supplementary scope because they affect presentation or implementation rather than the four business endpoints.

Item 12 is mixed because it checks the essential album name together with prominent heading presentation. Item 31 is mixed because it checks essential narrative content together with its placement in particular sections.

Custom-control appearance and neon playback glow remain supplementary. Item 35 is mixed because it combines actual audio playback, which is core, with custom-control and visual-state requirements, which are not.
Item 15 remains supplementary because its bundled section-existence probe is a coarse structural check and does not establish that any listening, ticket, or signup endpoint works.

Replaced separate locate, click, and observe steps with self-contained end-to-end scenarios that verify the resulting user outcome, including actual media playback and both valid and invalid email paths.
Did not require a completed external ticket purchase or persistent email backend, since neither is specified and both would be inappropriate assumptions for an offline self-contained HTML artifact.

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「顶部大面积绿色的页面」那一份基本一致（典型的单页长滚动布局，首屏全宽色块，下方内容区采用大量左右图文对排和水平三列数字/图标阵列。）？

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「布局结构」指给第「A」份「全屏绿地游戏界面」：以全屏的场景画布为底层，内容呈现为固定在左上角的悬浮半透明状态面板，偶尔在底部居中出现对话框。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「A」24.1个/千像素高 vs 「B」128个/千像素高；整页高度：「A」1080px vs 「B」3048px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「全屏绿地游戏界面」那一份基本一致（以全屏的场景画布为底层，内容呈现为固定在左上角的悬浮半透明状态面板，偶尔在底部居中出现对话框。）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「B」份「米黄色多表格文档页」在这一面是：包含顶部水平导航条，主体内容单列纵向铺开延伸，内部由横向贯穿的数据参数条、多列数据表格和图文段落交错堆叠组成，信息密度大。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「米黄色多表格文档页」那一份（包含顶部水平导航条，主体内容单列纵向铺开延伸，内部由横向贯穿的数据参数条、多列数据表格和图文段落交错堆叠组成，信息密度大。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「布局结构」；错误来源「C」份「带多色服务卡片的个人页」在这一面是：顶部固定导航栏，主体内容居中定宽排版，页面区块间留白较大，包含两栏图文混排（左图右文/左文右图）以及多列网格平铺的卡片列表。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否**没有**跟成「带多色服务卡片的个人页」那一份（顶部固定导航栏，主体内容居中定宽排版，页面区块间留白较大，包含两栏图文混排（左图右文/左文右图）以及多列网格平铺的卡片列表。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「字体排版」指给第「C」份「带多色服务卡片的个人页」：标题使用大字号、粗字重的无衬线字体，字号层级对比强烈；正文行距宽松，且存在左侧带粗线描边的引言段落排版。。产出这一面应神似这一份（adapt）。程序实测：分派表把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给了「C」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：正文字号：「C」17px vs 「A」13px；最大标题字号：「C」50px vs 「A」16px；字号档数：「C」6档 vs 「A」2档。产出应落在「C」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「带多色服务卡片的个人页」那一份神似（标题使用大字号、粗字重的无衬线字体，字号层级对比强烈；正文行距宽松，且存在左侧带粗线描边的引言段落排版。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「A」份「全屏绿地游戏界面」在这一面是：全页面使用单一的无衬线字体，字号偏小，字重单一，行距紧凑，通过灰/白文字颜色区分数据和标签，缺乏字号上的明显层级。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「全屏绿地游戏界面」那一份（全页面使用单一的无衬线字体，字号偏小，字重单一，行距紧凑，通过灰/白文字颜色区分数据和标签，缺乏字号上的明显层级。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「C」份负责「字体排版」；错误来源「B」份「米黄色多表格文档页」在这一面是：正文以偏小的无衬线字体为主排版紧密，各级标题、表格头部会有轻微的加粗对比，包含斜体英文名和上标引用，呈现学术文档的严肃排版感。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。程序实测：「A」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：正文字号 13px、最大标题字号 16px、字号档数 2档、字族 segoe/times、字重档数 2档。分派表没有把字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否**没有**跟成「米黄色多表格文档页」那一份（正文以偏小的无衬线字体为主排版紧密，各级标题、表格头部会有轻微的加粗对比，包含斜体英文名和上标引用，呈现学术文档的严肃排版感。）？跟错来源即为不通过。
