keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否与「全屏绿地游戏界面」那一份神似（包含深灰色半透明带圆角的悬浮数据面板，面板内有红/绿色粗长条且无描边的进度条，以及跟随角色的胶囊形带描边血条和半透明对话气泡。，允许调整）？

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「B」份「米黄色多表格文档页」在这一面是：几乎没有常规的卡片或按钮容器，主要由极细的单实线作为表格和段落分割，使用扁平细长无圆角的纯棕色矩形作为进度条。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「米黄色多表格文档页」那一份（几乎没有常规的卡片或按钮容器，主要由极细的单实线作为表格和段落分割，使用扁平细长无圆角的纯棕色矩形作为进度条。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「A」份负责「组件样式」；错误来源「C」份「带多色服务卡片的个人页」在这一面是：包含带有黑色极细实线描边且背景为各种低饱和纯色的直角矩形卡片，带有细微阴影的图文资讯卡片，以及扁平纯色直角按钮。。产出出现这些特征即为跟错份（不通过）。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否**没有**跟成「带多色服务卡片的个人页」那一份（包含带有黑色极细实线描边且背景为各种低饱和纯色的直角矩形卡片，带有细微阴影的图文资讯卡片，以及扁平纯色直角按钮。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 分派表把「整体气质」指给第「A」份「全屏绿地游戏界面」：呈现出轻松活泼、复古怀旧的早期 RPG 像素游戏沉浸感。。产出这一面应神似这一份（copy）。程序实测：分派表把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给了「A」份。两份在该侧面上程序实测的差别：元素密度：「A」24.1个/千像素高 vs 「B」128个/千像素高；底色种类数：「A」3种 vs 「B」5种；整页高度：「A」1080px vs 「B」3048px。产出应落在「A」那一侧的数值范围里。
keypoints.question: 把成品和这 3 份参考并排看，成品的整体气场（情绪调性、松紧克制）最接近哪一份？必须挑出一份（不许答「都差不多」）。候选：「全屏绿地游戏界面」（呈现出轻松活泼、复古怀旧的早期 RPG 像素游戏沉浸感。）；「米黄色多表格文档页」（呈现出严谨克制、静谧复古的学术档案图鉴调性。）；「带多色服务卡片的个人页」（呈现出现代常规、明快直接的个人博客与商业服务展示调性。）。答案是「全屏绿地游戏界面」才算通过，挑了别的份即为跟错。

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「配色」不要做成「米黄色多表格文档页」那样：整体呈现复古低饱和质感，全局背景使用米黄色（或浅卡其色），文字大面积使用深灰色/黑色，表格强调色和进度条色块统一使用棕褐色。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。
keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否明显不同于「米黄色多表格文档页」那一份（整体呈现复古低饱和质感，全局背景使用米黄色（或浅卡其色），文字大面积使用深灰色/黑色，表格强调色和进度条色块统一使用棕褐色。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 「B」份在该侧面上的程序指纹：元素密度 128个/千像素高、底色种类数 5种、间距中位数 18px、整页高度 3048px。分派表没有把整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）指给它，产出里出现这些特征即为跟错份。
keypoints.question: 整体气质是否**没有**沿用第「B」份的特征？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'帮朋友弄一个商业地产的招商引导页'，承载'大量的园区介绍和招商细则'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一个商业地产园区的招商引导页（围绕园区介绍、地块租赁与入驻招商展开），而非其他行业或主题？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'详细地块介绍：主推重度图文阅读，点击特定区域后触发'
keypoints.question: 点击画布上的某个商业地块后，是否会打开一个以长篇图文正文为主的地块详细介绍层（而非仅弹出一两行短提示）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求“点击底部的气泡可以直接唤起入驻申请表单”，并将“顺畅地提交入驻意向”列为最终目标。
keypoints.question: 点击底部居中的对话框/气泡后，是否会直接打开可用的入驻申请表单，且表单包含可输入字段和明确的提交入驻意向操作？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'把项目总面积、可租工位等核心指标，做成固定悬浮在左上角的半透明状态面板'
keypoints.question: 左上角的概览数据面板中，是否同时给出了「项目总面积」和「可租工位（数量）」这两类核心指标并附带具体数值？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'直接以全屏的场景画布（比如手绘的园区俯视图）作为最底层来铺开'
keypoints.question: 底层全屏画布是否画出了可辨识为园区俯视图的场景（含可区分的地块/建筑/道路等要素），而非纯色底或与园区主题无关的图形？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求访客能够“点开各个地块了解”，并提到地块上的标牌或小提示，但未规定具体地块数量。
keypoints.question: 画布上是否存在多个可点击的商业地块，并通过名称、编号或提示信息让用户能够区分各个地块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求在底部居中的对话框中放置“滚动播报的最新签约动态，或者表单入口”，两者属于可选方案。
keypoints.question: 底部居中的对话框/气泡是否呈现滚动的最新签约动态，或提供明确的入驻申请表单入口，而非空白或无实际含义的占位内容？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求页面'既能承载大量的园区介绍和招商细则'
keypoints.question: 地块详情长文层中，是否既有园区/地块的介绍性正文，又有具体的招商细则条款（如租金、面积、租期或入驻条件等可核对的条目）？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确要求概览面板中设置招商进度条，但未限定必须采用百分比或特定数值标签。
keypoints.question: 概览数据面板中是否包含可辨识为招商或出租进度的进度条，并通过相邻文案或数值清楚说明其含义？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'鼠标悬停在不同商业地块上有轻微的浮动反馈'
keypoints.question: 把鼠标悬停在某个商业地块上之后，该地块是否出现了可见的反馈变化（轻微上浮、高亮或提示气泡），与未悬停时明显不同？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'底层画布支持拖拽平移'
keypoints.question: 在画布空白处按住鼠标并拖动后，底层画布视图是否发生了平移（场景内容相对视口位置改变）？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收要求'当长文展示层弹出时，底层的游戏感画布要彻底暂停一切动静'
keypoints.question: 长文展示层弹出期间，底层游戏画布的动画、地块浮动反馈和拖拽平移是否全部暂停，动态播报是否停止或隐藏，使长文阅读区域独占焦点？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求长文层'点击特定区域后触发'并在阅读后回到探索式浏览
keypoints.question: 地块长文展示层是否提供了明确的关闭入口（关闭按钮或返回控件），点击后能回到画布主界面？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求'顺畅地提交入驻意向'、'点击底部的气泡可以直接唤起入驻申请表单'
keypoints.question: 入驻申请表单是否至少收集可联系信息（电话或邮箱）和入驻需求（如意向面积或工位数），并提供明确可用的提交按钮？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收要求'移动端下，左上角的悬浮面板必须能自动折叠成精简状态，绝对不能遮挡画布中心的点击区域'
keypoints.question: 在移动端窄视口下，左上角的概览数据面板是否自动收起为精简状态（如收成小图标/一行摘要），且没有遮挡画布中心的可点击区域？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'表单要能在手机端无缝铺满屏幕'
keypoints.question: 在移动端窄视口下唤起入驻申请表单后，表单是否铺满整个屏幕（近似全屏展示），而不是挤在一个小浮窗里？

keypoints.basis: 指令只借设计语言，不得复用参考截图中的文字与行业内容
keypoints.question: 页面全部文案是否围绕用户指定的园区招商主题撰写，未出现参考截图第 2 份的兰花温室内容（如「兰花温室 / Orchid House / Paphiopedilum / 冷房 / 花芽率 / 分株」等）？

keypoints.basis: 指令只借设计语言与视觉手法，不得复用截图里的文字、条目名称
keypoints.question: 页面是否未出现参考截图第 1、3 份的原文字样（如「ARGO 风格 HTML5 Demo / 新手村 / 村长艾尔 / 商人露娜」「ANNIE / MY SERVICES / Web Design / SEO Marketing」等）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML，CSS/JS 内联、不引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求制作单页，并规定概览面板、地块详情和表单入口围绕同一全屏场景画布组织。
keypoints.question: 页面是否实现为单页招商体验，概览数据、可交互地块、地块详情和入驻申请均在同一 HTML 页面内呈现，无需跳转到其他子页面？

keypoints.basis: 用户希望访客主动点开各个地块了解，并明确要求点击特定区域触发详细地块介绍。
keypoints.question: 画布上是否存在多个已标识且可点击的商业地块，并且点击任一地块都会打开与其名称匹配、内容有实质差异的详情，而非所有地块复用同一份通用介绍？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求底部对话框“偶尔弹出”并“放滚动播报的最新签约动态”，已有条目仅检查了动态文案内容，未检查实际播报行为。
keypoints.question: 底部居中的动态对话框是否无需刷新页面即可自动滚动或轮换至少两条不同的签约动态，而非始终显示一条静态消息？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户强调“重度图文阅读”“承载大量的园区介绍和招商细则”，长文弹层必须具备可完整阅读的滚动机制。
keypoints.question: 当地块详情内容超过视口高度时，详情层是否能够独立滚动并让用户抵达全部正文与招商细则，同时不会带动或误操作底层园区画布？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求底层画布支持拖拽平移，并明确提出移动端验收要求；已有条目只验证了鼠标拖动，未覆盖触控操作。
keypoints.question: 在移动端触控设备上，用户是否可以通过单指拖拽平移园区画布，并且该手势不会妨碍详情层或申请表单内部的正常滚动与输入？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户的最终目标是让访客“顺畅地提交入驻意向”；已有条目只检查表单可唤起、字段可输入和存在提交按钮，尚未验证实际提交闭环。
keypoints.question: 填写有效的入驻意向信息并点击提交后，页面是否会完成一次明确的提交状态转换并显示成功确认；缺少必填信息时是否会阻止提交并给出可理解的字段提示？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_js_errors）：运行时没有未捕获的 JS 异常
keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_horizontal_overflow）：指定视口下没有横向溢出（scrollWidth ≤ 视口宽）
keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 程序判定（no_overflow_with_data）：注入对抗数据后不横向溢出
keypoints.question: 灌入 80 字符不换行长串后，布局是否仍不横向溢出？

keypoints.basis: 题面把「B」份点名为反面参考（别做成它那样）
keypoints.question: 配色是否明确**不像**第「B」份参考？

ambiguities: “滚动播报的最新签约动态，或者表单入口”明确允许 OR 选择；后文要求底部气泡能唤起表单，但并未同时强制自动轮换多条签约动态，因此不能把动态轮播作为核心门槛。
请求没有规定申请表的精确字段、格式规则或真实后端接口。测试应遵循页面声明的规则；为形成有意义的入驻意向，至少应有一种联系渠道和一种入驻需求，但本地成功确认即可，不应虚构服务器提交要求。
“大量”和“长篇”没有给出字数阈值，应依据是否提供实质介绍、具体招商细则以及内容能否完整访问判断，不宜设置任意字数硬门槛。
检查项12和“inv_1”使用了未在请求中明确映射的“第B份”标签；即使可从上下文猜测为米黄色文档参考，也不应把该不确定标签用于核心结果判定。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够确认页面属于商业园区招商主题，读取带具体数值的项目总面积和可租工位概览，并逐一打开可区分的地块，获得与所选地块匹配且有实质差异的长篇介绍和具体招商细则；全部内容可读完并能返回继续查看其他地块。
outcomes.quote: 既能承载大量的园区介绍和招商细则，又能让浏览过程像探险一样有趣。最终目标是留住访客，让他们主动去点开各个地块了解
test_cases: 从初始页面开始，确认内容明确围绕商业园区租赁招商，并核验“项目总面积”和“可租工位”均显示非空的具体数字及相应单位或数量含义；请求没有指定应使用的数值，因此不假定固定数值。
从初始页面识别所有已标注的可选地块，依次通过正常控件打开每个地块详情；核对详情标题与所选地块匹配、正文包含实质性的园区或地块介绍及明确招商细则，并确认不同地块并非仅更换标题而复用同一内容。对于超过视口高度的详情，滚动到最后一项细则，关闭详情后再继续查看下一地块，且滚动详情时不应误操作底层画布。

outcomes.endpoint: 访客能够从底部入口打开有意义的入驻申请表单，填写联系信息和入驻需求，按页面声明的规则完成校验，并在有效提交后获得明确的成功确认；离线单页无需真实后端交易。
outcomes.quote: 最后顺畅地提交入驻意向
test_cases: 从初始页面点击底部气泡或对话框打开申请表单，按照表单自身声明的必填和格式规则留空或填写无效值后提交；核验页面阻止成功状态，并在相关字段处给出可理解的提示，而非仅发生不明确的 DOM 变化。
从新的初始状态打开表单，使用符合其声明规则的数据填写全部必填项，其中包含可联系的电话或邮箱以及明确的面积、工位数或其他入驻需求；提交后核验页面进入清晰、可辨认的成功确认状态。

core_scope.purpose: 帮助潜在租户了解商业地产园区的整体情况和各地块的实质招商信息，并顺畅提交入驻意向；游戏化画布、视觉氛围和响应式布局是呈现与吸引方式，不是独立的核心业务结果。
review_notes: 将项目概览、地块选择、匹配的差异化详情、招商细则以及完整阅读能力合并为一个端到端的信息获取结果，避免把打开页面、找到地块和点击控件拆成琐碎核心测试。
把全屏画布、园区俯视图外观、拖拽平移、触控平移、悬停反馈、背景暂停、动态播报、移动端折叠与表单全屏等要求保留为补充项；它们涉及布局、动画、交互表现或视口适配，移除后不会消灭了解地块并提交意向的业务端点。
原提案中的canvas_map和mobile_responsive不是独立且不可替代的用户目标，因此不再作为核心结果；检查项1也从混合核心项移至补充项，因为它只核对参考布局。
地块详情关闭与独立滚动被保留在核心信息结果中，因为它们实际决定访客能否读完内容并继续查看其他地块，而不只是检查控件是否存在。
提交结果只要求页面完成明确的校验和成功状态转换，不要求离线自包含 HTML 实现真实部署或后端交易。

ambiguities: “好多维度” and “非常多” do not define exact counts. Core filtering uses at least two independent dimensions as exercised by the intersection check, while the checklist's exact minimum of nine projects remains a supplementary benchmark operationalization.

The request does not specify the form's exact business purpose, fields, validation syntax, or a backend transaction. Tests therefore follow the purpose and rules declared by the page and require only perceptible local error and success states.

No accessibility conformance level is named. The checklist's 15px and 4.5:1 measurements are treated as mixed visual/accessibility proxies, while keyboard and assistive-technology completion of the primary flows remains core.
The referenced screenshots are not included in the task data, so exact visual similarity cannot be resolved here and remains supplementary.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can identify the site as belonging to an architectural design firm, understand concrete design principles or services, and find recognizable past architecture or spatial projects rather than generic or unrelated placeholder content.
outcomes.quote: 给咱们新推的建筑设计事务所搞个带表单的多板块官网
test_cases: Starting from a fresh load, traverse the main content by scrolling or any provided in-page navigation and verify that it consistently identifies an architectural design firm, states concrete design principles or service categories, and presents a distinguishable works area whose cards have project names and architecture or spatial imagery rather than unrelated placeholder content.

At a narrow viewport, reach the same firm description, services, and project information through normal scrolling and controls and compare it with the desktop content; verify that substantive information has not been removed or hidden, without treating exact wrapping or viewport fit as a core endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can combine independent project-filter dimensions, receive results satisfying the active intersection, browse distinct result pages, and change or clear filters without stale or invalid pagination state.
outcomes.quote: 作品列表区必须带好多维度的筛选和分页
test_cases: Using populated options and the categories or metadata declared by the page, select one value in each of two independent filter dimensions and verify that every displayed project satisfies both; then change one dimension and verify that the other selection remains active and all resulting projects still satisfy the new intersection.
From the unfiltered list, record the visible project names on the first page, switch to another available page, and verify that a nonempty, different batch of project names is displayed.

Begin on a later page, apply a filter that reduces the result set, and verify that the pager moves to a valid page and shows no nonmatching or stale projects; then clear all filters and verify that the original unfiltered first-page projects and pagination are restored.

outcomes.endpoint: Users can complete a clearly stated, firm-related form according to its declared rules; missing required data produces actionable errors, while valid data produces a clear local success acknowledgement without assuming backend delivery.
outcomes.quote: 带表单的多板块官网
test_cases: On a fresh form, leave its declared required fields empty and submit; verify that corresponding visible validation feedback appears and that no success state is shown.

Fill the form with values valid under its displayed labels and rules, submit it, and verify that prior errors are cleared and a perceptible success state or confirmation appears; do not require a real network transaction.

outcomes.endpoint: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can understand and operate the site's navigation, project discovery, and form flows, with perceivable focus, coherent structure, meaningful image alternatives, labeled fields, and accessible validation feedback.
outcomes.quote: 考虑到所有受众群体，整个站点的焦点状态和无障碍阅读体验得严格安排明白。
test_cases: Starting at the top, use Tab and Shift+Tab to traverse every provided navigation or menu control, project filter, pager, action control, and form field, using Enter or Space where appropriate; verify a visible focus indicator at every stop, a logical order, successful operation of each control type, and no keyboard trap.

Review the firm description, project metadata, and form instructions at default zoom, then traverse the same page with a screen reader; verify intelligible visible copy under the checklist's font-size and contrast proxies, coherent landmarks and heading order, meaningful alternatives for informative project images, ignored decorative images, and an announced label for every form field.

Using a screen reader and keyboard, submit the form with a required field empty and verify that the error is associated with the correct field and that focus moves to the first error or an error summary is perceptibly announced.

core_scope.purpose: Provide prospective clients and other audiences with an intelligible architectural-design-firm website where they can learn about the firm and its work, discover projects through multidimensional filtering and pagination, and use a clearly purposed firm-related form, including through keyboard and assistive-technology access.
review_notes: Split the proposed broad site outcome into informational content and the distinct form-completion goal so that each test reaches a meaningful user endpoint rather than merely loading, locating, or clicking controls.

Responsive fit, navigation animation, hover behavior, visual tone, card styling, and exact screenshot resemblance were removed from core membership because they concern layout or presentation rather than the site's non-substitutable user goals.

Checklist item 5 was moved to mixed_item_ids: preserving substantive content across viewports bears on information access, but overflow, font sizing, and responsive layout are not themselves core business endpoints.

Filtering core membership is limited to functional result correctness, intersection behavior, pagination changes, reset behavior, and valid page recomputation. Mere control presence, selected-state styling, and the arbitrary nine-project threshold remain supplementary.

Accessibility remains core because the request explicitly identifies all audiences and site-wide focus and reading access. The skip-link item remains supplementary because it mandates one specific technique even though equivalent bypass and landmark mechanisms may satisfy the user goal.
The form endpoint requires business relevance plus invalid- and valid-input outcomes, but it does not invent message delivery, storage, or any other backend transaction.
The revised test cases combine setup and interaction into complete scenarios and verify specific final content, filter, pagination, form, or accessibility results rather than generic DOM changes.

No authoritative dataset or backend is supplied. The dashboard can therefore be checked for labeled, parseable, and intelligible displayed data, but not for agreement with an external municipal data source.

The terms “实时” and “实时告警” do not specify a polling interval or live service. For an offline self-contained page, visible current-state information is required, but automatic server-backed updates are not inferred.
Checklist references to source labels “A” and “E” are not mapped within the supplied request, so items 15 and "pal_1" cannot establish an independently identifiable core endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: The dashboard presents an intelligible current-day energy overview with electricity and water totals, peak-warning information, trend direction, time context, units, and distinguishable 24-hour electricity and water trends compared with historical averages.
outcomes.quote: 让市政管理人员能一眼看清单日的水电能耗大盘
test_cases: Load the dashboard and verify that a visible date, last-updated time, or real-time marker establishes the reporting period; then read parseable electricity and water totals with appropriate units, a peak-warning metric, and a concise rise/fall statement. In the trend area, verify separately labeled electricity and water views with their units, a 00–23 or equivalent 24-hour axis, and a clearly labeled historical-average comparison; line and bar representations may be arranged in any usable layout.

outcomes.endpoint: The alert feed provides identifiable anomaly entries, and selecting an entry opens details for that selected monitoring node, including its time, affected metric, and actual value or threshold-exceedance information.
outcomes.quote: 支持快速下钻查阅异常节点
test_cases: From the loaded dashboard, choose a visible alert entry that identifies a monitoring point and an exceeded metric or status, activate it, and verify that a detail view opens for the same selected point and shows the anomaly time, metric, and actual value or threshold-exceedance information.

outcomes.endpoint: A generator fuel-consumption form accepts the requested operational data, blocks empty and malformed required values, immediately warns when a numeric value exceeds the page’s declared threshold, and completes a valid local submission with explicit confirmation or a new record.
outcomes.quote: 供巡检员手动登记离网发电机的燃油消耗
test_cases: Enter data in at least one field while leaving another required field empty, submit the form, and verify that submission is blocked with a clear non-empty error, no success state is shown, and already entered data is retained.

Populate the other required fields, enter nonnumeric text in the required fuel-consumption field, submit, and verify a clear numeric-format error with no success state. Then replace it with a value above the threshold declared by the page and verify that an over-threshold warning appears before submission; the warning’s red styling is supplementary.

Complete every required field with valid generator or monitoring-point data and an accepted numeric fuel-consumption value, submit through the normal control, and verify explicit success confirmation or a newly displayed record rather than only disappearance of errors.

core_scope.purpose: Enable municipal managers to understand the current day’s citywide electricity and water consumption, inspect anomalous monitoring nodes, and let frontline inspectors record off-grid generator fuel consumption.
review_notes: Removed mobile responsiveness as a core outcome because breakpoint reflow, hamburger conversion, and chart fit are viewport and layout requirements rather than the dashboard’s business endpoint; items 36–38 remain supplementary.

Removed region and park switching as a separate core outcome. It is a requested navigation capability, but it is outside the sentence identifying the primary core goals of daily energy understanding, anomaly drill-down, and frontline reporting; items 19–20 remain supplementary.
Collapsed alert-list discovery and anomaly details into one end-to-end drill-down outcome instead of treating list presence, clicking, and detail display as separate tests.

Item 18 is mixed because it checks all five modules together, combining core content areas with the supplementary navigation module. Item 25 is mixed because it combines requested chart representations with desktop multi-column placement.

Item 33 is mixed because alert-list availability supports the drill-down flow while its required bottom-right placement is layout. Item 32 is mixed because threshold warning behavior is business-relevant while immediate red coloring is visual styling.

Chart hover behavior, container scrolling, desktop placement, visual references, performance, self-containment, and defensive layout checks remain scored supplementary requirements rather than independent core gates.
The submission endpoint is limited to the requested offline page behavior: explicit success feedback or a newly shown record is sufficient, and no backend transaction or persistence API is invented.

ambiguities: The request describes the executive signature as "personalized" but supplies no recipient data, executive names, or personalization rule. Evaluation should require a clearly presented executive-team signature without inventing a recipient-specific backend or identity.

The acceptance text allows external standard web fonts, while checklist items 37 and "base_1" prohibit all external font resources. Those stricter implementation checks remain supplementary and should not be treated as evidence that the greeting content or interaction endpoint failed.
No agency name, crest artwork, copyright wording, or main studio URL is supplied, so the footer can only be assessed generically rather than against an invented identity.

outcomes.endpoint: The page is recognizably a year-end partner/client greeting and makes the requested reflective hero framing and complete holiday message accessible and intelligible.
outcomes.quote: I want this to be an emotionally resonant piece that celebrates our shared milestones this year while setting a sophisticated tone for the next.
test_cases: Load the page and traverse its greeting narrative: verify the opening displays the exact title "A Season of Reflection" and subtitle "Looking back at a year of momentum.", then scroll to the Heart section and verify the complete requested holiday paragraph is readable and verbatim; the combined content must clearly function as a year-end greeting rather than a generic marketing page.

outcomes.endpoint: The greeting communicates all three requested shared milestones, with final displayed values and labels corresponding to 12 global campaigns, 4 million lives touched, and 1 shared vision.
outcomes.quote: Three distinct scroll-triggered data blocks stacked vertically: "12 Global Campaigns Launched," "4 Million Lives Touched Through Design," and "1 Shared Vision."
test_cases: Load the page, scroll to the Journey section, and allow any reveal or counting sequence to finish; verify there are exactly three milestone statements and that their final displayed outputs are respectively "12 Global Campaigns Launched", "4 Million Lives Touched Through Design", and "1 Shared Vision", rather than merely checking that numbers changed.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating the Gift interaction reveals an executive-team signature and settles into the requested completed thank-you state displaying "Thank You for 2024" in place of the trigger.
outcomes.quote: They can click to "ignite" a digital spark, which transitions the page state to reveal a personalized, handwritten-style signature from our executive team, alongside a bespoke audio chime.
test_cases: Load the page, scroll to the Gift section, activate its ignite control, and wait for the state transition to settle; verify that an executive-team signature is visibly revealed and that the trigger is replaced by the exact text "Thank You for 2024".

core_scope.purpose: Deliver an intelligible year-end holiday greeting for partners and clients that reflects on shared milestones, communicates the requested holiday message, and culminates in an interactive signed thank-you.
review_notes: Single-column behavior, breakpoint fit, full-viewport sizing, and long-string overflow were moved out of core because they concern layout rather than the greeting's end-user outcome.

The hero framing and Heart copy were consolidated into one greeting-message outcome instead of treating every section or text fragment as a separate gate. Item 15 remains mixed because it combines core narrative presence with prescribed ordering and supplementary footer structure.

The milestone statements and their exact final values remain core informational content. Count-up timing, Intersection Observer usage, fading, parallax, easing, and vertical presentation remain supplementary motion or layout requirements; items 21 and 38 are mixed because they combine content checks with those presentation requirements.

The Gift's meaningful core endpoint is the revealed executive signature and completed visible thank-you state. Signature drawing technique, color bloom, transition choreography, pulse animation, replay locking, and the audio chime are supplementary sensory or presentation details rather than separate non-substitutable greeting goals.

Typography, reference matching, palette, contrast styling, component shapes, ambient animation, footer minimalism, and single-file implementation remain scored supplementary requirements and were not discarded.

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确指定弹窗左侧必须是「一个动态的代码高亮演示区」，现有条目只检查了静态语法着色，未检查动态演示。

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户要求用进度条展示完成度，并以「百分之八十五的竞品已集成」之类的数字制造 FOMO；可视化长度应准确表达对应百分比。
keypoints.question: 每张卡片上进度条的填充比例是否与其旁边标示的百分比数值一致，例如标示 85% 时填充长度约占整条的 85%，且切换模块后仍保持数据与图形一致？

keypoints.basis: 用户将「获取密钥」列为页面最显眼的主推动作，并要求在页面最底部的行动号召区「再配一次那个胶囊按钮」，但未明确限定首个按钮的精确板块位置。

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户将「开发指南」和「登录」明确称为导航条右侧的「入口」，因此二者应具备实际可操作性。
keypoints.question: 顶部导航中的「开发指南」和「登录」是否均为可操作的链接或按钮，而非仅作为不可点击的装饰文字？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户强调该页面用于「投放承接」、要「把流量都逼进转化路径里」，并将「获取密钥」定义为主推动作，因此按钮需要提供实际下一步。
keypoints.question: 点击首屏或底部的「获取密钥」按钮后，是否会进入明确的下一步转化流程或产生可见响应（如打开申请、登录或密钥获取界面），而不是完全无响应？

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources

ambiguities: The request does not prescribe exact card names, module datasets, code samples, or parameter schemas. Tests should require intelligible module association and card-specific changes rather than inventing exact API content.

The destination and backend behavior of “获取密钥” are not specified. A visible offline login, application, or request step is sufficient; live authentication, key issuance, and deployment APIs must not be assumed.
“多层级” does not define a specific nesting model for the modal, so no arbitrary number of dialog layers should be required.

The form of the requested dynamic code demonstration is flexible. Animation or timed code-state changes remain supplementary, while access to an actual calling example and corresponding parameters is core.

outcomes.endpoint: A visitor can immediately identify the page as the 青苔巷 API service and understand its stated marketing-growth value proposition.
outcomes.quote: 导航条左边是青苔巷的品牌字样，右边放开发指南和登录入口。视觉主图区的大标题写下一代营销增长API引擎，副标题写一行代码接入，让你的产品长出营销大脑。
test_cases: Load the page and verify that the primary visible introduction identifies the 青苔巷 brand, presents it as an API service for developers, and intelligibly displays the headline “下一代营销增长API引擎” with the supporting proposition “一行代码接入，让你的产品长出营销大脑”.

outcomes.endpoint: A developer can select each declared API module and receive an intelligibly labeled grid of interface capabilities belonging to the selected module.
outcomes.quote: 横向的筛选栏设置成身份验证、用户画像、支付转化这几个核心模块。网格区根据选中的模块动态刷新，每张卡片上不仅要有接口名称，我还要在卡片的底部加入一个非常直观的进度条，作为完成度展示，用来向开发者暗示这个接口的接入进度，比如标上百分之八十五的竞品已集成，用这种功能钩子来制造一点FOMO情绪。
test_cases: Using the visible module controls, select “身份验证”, record the named API cards shown, then select “用户画像” and verify that the active selection changes and the grid is replaced with named capabilities presented as belonging to the user-profile module.
After selecting “用户画像”, select “支付转化” and verify that the active selection and named card content update to the payment-conversion module rather than retaining the previous module’s grid.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating an API card opens usable, interface-specific documentation containing a calling example and corresponding parameter definitions, after which the developer can dismiss the detail view and continue browsing.
outcomes.quote: 如果有开发者想看某个接口的详情，点击卡片后，要像那个房产网一样弹出一个多层级的居中大图弹窗，里面展示接口文档和调用示例。
test_cases: Select a module, record the name of one visible API card, activate that card, and verify that a large dialog identifies the same interface and contains a substantive calling example on the left plus parameter names and explanations or types on the right; dismiss the dialog and verify that the prior module and grid remain accessible.

Open a differently named card, preferably from another module, and verify that the dialog identifies the newly selected interface and that its code example or parameter documentation changes accordingly rather than reusing one unrelated static detail view for every card.

outcomes.endpoint: A developer can activate the clearly labeled get-key call to action and reach a perceivable next step toward requesting, logging in for, or obtaining API access without requiring a real backend transaction.
outcomes.quote: 主推的动作按钮，比如页面最显眼的获取密钥，统统做成带有亮橙色渐变填充的胶囊形状，整体保持扁平，坚决不要任何阴影，就是要这种干脆利落的点击欲。
test_cases: On a fresh page, activate a visible “获取密钥” primary action and verify that the page presents a clear next step related to API access, such as a local application, login, or key-request view; do not require a network request or an actually issued key.

Reach the bottom call-to-action area, activate its repeated conversion button, and verify that it leads to the same or an equivalent intelligible key-acquisition next step rather than producing no response.

core_scope.purpose: Enable developers to understand 青苔巷’s marketing-growth API offering, browse module-specific interface capabilities and documentation, and begin the get-key conversion path.
review_notes: Added the service identity and value proposition as a core informational outcome because removing the requested API content would make the introduction page fail its primary purpose.

Retained module browsing and card-specific documentation as distinct non-substitutable developer goals, while rewriting their checks as complete end-to-end scenarios rather than separate open, click, and observe steps.

Added initiation of the get-key path as a core conversion outcome because the requested page is explicitly a high-conversion acquisition page, but bounded the endpoint to a visible local next step so no backend transaction is invented.
Classified IDs 9, 10, 18, 22, and 35 as mixed because they combine endpoint-relevant content or behavior with placement, visual-state, syntax-coloring, size, or prominence requirements.

Kept the dark palette, reference-page resemblance, typography, component styling, animation, progress/FOMO visualization, exact section arrangement, navigation placement, and robustness constraints supplementary even where emphatically requested, because they do not independently define the page’s primary user outcomes.

items.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否与「深色动物游戏页面」那一份基本一致（主标题采用加粗大字号、带有明亮主题色（橙黄）的无衬线字体，其余文字多为小字号，层级跳跃大且偏向游戏感）？

keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明确地与参考截图相反，而不是照抄？

keypoints.basis: 单参考样本：本侧面要求明确反着来参考截图。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。参考的程序指纹：元素密度 62.8个/千像素高、底色种类数 2种、整页高度 1082px。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 整体气质（调性、信息密度、留白感）是否明确地与参考截图相反，而不是照抄？

keypoints.question: 窄屏（390px）下的信息层级是否**重排**过（导航收起、多列变单列、主次顺序按小屏重新安排），而不是把桌面版等比缩小？

keypoints.basis: 参考只有 2 张帧，整页大部分区域没有出现在参考里（ref_gap 档 2）。缺口部分没有参考真值，判「是否自洽地补全」，不判「是否与参考逐像素一致」。
keypoints.question: 参考没覆盖到的区域（页面下半部分 / 未截到的板块）是否按参考的设计语言**延续**下来，而不是换成另一套风格或直接省略？

ambiguities: 请求明确允许使用本周肌群热力图或训练强度/心率曲线二选一，因此不能要求两种图表同时实现。
请求没有规定训练数据、重量、次数、宏量营养素的固定范围、单位或步长；数值测试应遵循页面自行声明且对用户可见的规则，而不能臆造固定答案。
“联动底下所有模块”在现有内容和清单中可操作地解释为数据可视化、每日训练清单、营养与恢复三个后续板块；若还存在未声明的附加模块，不应任意加入核心门槛。
“训练记录页”没有明确要求刷新后持久化、本地存储、账户同步或后端提交，因此不把跨刷新保存或真实网络事务设为核心结果。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够在两个明确命名的训练模式之间切换、辨认当前模式，并看到数据可视化、每日训练清单和营养板块分别呈现与所选模式对应的不同状态。
outcomes.quote: 用户可以通过长按拖拽，在“增肌撕裂”和“极速减脂”两个主模式间来回切换。这个动作不只是换个字，还要瞬间联动底下所有模块的数据状态展示。
test_cases: 首次加载页面时，确认模式区同时提供“增肌撕裂”和“极速减脂”，记录当前模式以及数据图表、训练清单和营养板块各自的一项可辨识内容；使用页面支持的模式控件切换到另一模式，确认当前模式指示随之改变且上述三个下方板块都出现不同的模式对应数据或内容；再切回原模式并确认其对应内容恢复。

outcomes.endpoint: 页面以热力图或强度/心率曲线中的任一种可读形式展示多个日期的本周训练数据，并让用户能够依据图表自身声明的数值、图例或强度编码正确识别训练强度最高的日期。
outcomes.quote: 紧接着是核心的数据可视化部分，我们要在这里铺一张本周训练肌群的动态热力图，或者是一个随手势滚动而不断生长攀升的训练强度心率曲线。绝不能用静态的死图，这个图表要在进入视线时带出复杂的视觉演变过程，能用极其鲜明的数据对比告诉用户哪天的训练最硬核。
test_cases: 选择任一训练模式后查看本周图表，依据图表提供的日期标签及其数值、图例或强度编码比较多个日期，确定最大强度日期，并确认页面突出标示的“最硬核”日期与该最大值一致；热力图和曲线均为合格替代方案，不要求两者同时存在。

outcomes.endpoint: 每日训练清单包含多个可独立操作的训练动作模块，用户展开任一模块后能够访问该动作的要领说明、组数记录表格和可辨识的视频演示占位区。
outcomes.quote: 当用户点击某一个训练项目时，卡片需要以一种非常有张力的方式向下推开，露出里面的动作要领说明、组数记录表格以及一个用于动作演示的微型视频占位区。
test_cases: 在每日训练清单中选择多个动作模块中的一个并将其展开，确认该模块原先隐藏的区域同时出现动作要领、组数记录表格和带播放图形、图标或明确文字的视频演示占位区，并确认其他训练动作仍作为独立模块可供选择。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够为训练组记录所选重量和次数，并把该组标记为完成；完成后应保留清晰、可辨认的完成状态以及该组记录值。
outcomes.missing_check: 现有清单没有验证操作重量和次数控件后，实际记录值是否精确等于用户所选值；17仅检查录入字段或控件是否存在，18主要限定滑块或拨盘的控件形态。
outcomes.quote: 在记录每一组的重量和次数时，我希望看到类似拉动机械拨盘或者拖拽重力滑块的那种细腻操作感，当用户勾选完成一组训练时，整个模块要呈现一个充满成就感的视觉回弹，就像是完成了一次重击。
test_cases: 展开一个训练动作，在同一组中使用页面提供的控件选择两个非默认且受支持的重量和次数值，确认该组显示或记录的数值分别精确等于所选值；随后标记该组完成，确认完成状态持续可辨且刚才的重量和次数没有丢失或被改写。

outcomes.endpoint: 用户能够识别碳水、蛋白质和脂肪的当前摄入量，并依据控件声明的刻度或数值规则分别、独立地调整三项数值。
outcomes.missing_check: 22仅要求拖动后数值或填充发生变化，没有核对所选刻度与显示数值的正确对应关系，也没有行为性地验证三项控件调整时互不影响。
outcomes.quote: 三大项宏量营养素碳水、蛋白质和脂肪的摄入量，通过几个可以手指拖动调整的带刻度的试管状进度条来表示。
test_cases: 记录碳水、蛋白质和脂肪的初始值；将碳水调到控件上一个明确的非默认刻度，确认显示值或填充位置与该刻度准确对应且蛋白质、脂肪保持不变；再分别对蛋白质和脂肪执行同样操作，确认每次只有目标营养素改变且结果符合各自控件声明的刻度或数值规则。

core_scope.purpose: 让健身用户在专属训练页面中切换训练计划模式、理解本周训练强度、查看并记录每日训练组，并独立调整三大宏量营养素摄入量。
review_notes: 将核心范围收敛到模式化训练计划、周训练信息、动作详情、训练组记录和宏量营养素调整这些不可替代的用户目标；窄屏重排、无横向溢出、视觉主题、自包含文件和激励文案仍是应评分的补充要求。
长按拖拽是指定的交互表现方式，但可替代于“选择训练模式并联动内容”这一核心目标，因此25归为补充；20同时检查核心的模式标签/当前状态和补充性的拖拽限定，故保留为混合项。
6同时检查四个核心板块的存在及固定排列顺序，前者跨越核心内容、后者属于布局要求，因此作为跨页面混合项只映射一次。
进入视口时的图表绘制过程、卡片连续高度动画和完成组的震击回弹属于动画或布局表现，不能单独升级为核心；24和27归为补充，28因同时要求保留可辨识完成状态而为混合项。
滑块或机械拨盘的具体控件形态不是记录重量和次数这一用户目标的必要条件，因此17和18不能冒充记录正确性的覆盖；对应数值记录缺口已明确报告。
所有核心测试均合并为能够到达并核验最终业务结果的端到端场景，没有把打开页面、寻找控件和点击控件拆成独立测试。

ambiguities: The request calls the address and phone section a 'payment form' but does not request card, bank, or other payment-method fields. For an offline self-contained page, order completion means a local confirmation or order summary, not real payment processing or a backend transaction.

The phrase 'daily orders' could mean a batch of all orders received during a day or the current/completed order data available in the page. No order-ingestion backend or daily-history source is specified, so the print outcome does not assume cross-user or cross-session order collection.
No delivery-fee amount, tip presets, tax rule, or rounding rule is specified. Arithmetic tests must use the values and rules declared by the page rather than imposing arbitrary rates.

outcomes.endpoint: Visitors can access intelligible introductory content that identifies the business exactly as Bright Fold and clearly states that it provides same-day local delivery.
outcomes.quote: welcome area introducing our same-day local delivery
test_cases: On a fresh page load, verify that visible introductory copy names the business exactly as 'Bright Fold' and explicitly communicates same-day local delivery, rather than only showing a generic welcome message.

outcomes.endpoint: A customer can identify eligible delivery products, add a chosen product to the cart without leaving the page, review mathematically correct subtotal, delivery-fee, tip, and total amounts, enter the requested delivery details, and complete the order to a recognizable same-page confirmation or order summary.
outcomes.quote: local delivery ordering site for my new business called Bright Fold
test_cases: Review the purchasable catalog and verify its cards describe groceries, hot meals, or pharmacy products and provide intelligible names and prices. Record one product's displayed name, price, and current cart quantity, add it once, and verify in the same document that the exact product line increases by one. Confirm the subtotal equals the sum of displayed unit prices multiplied by cart quantities and that the final total equals subtotal plus the separately displayed delivery fee and tip. Enter a valid delivery address, phone number, and drop-off instructions, complete the order, and verify a recognizable same-page success confirmation or order summary appears.

Build a cart containing at least two distinct products and more than one unit of one product. Using the page's displayed prices and declared fee rules, calculate the expected subtotal, select or enter a nonzero driver tip through the provided controls, and verify the displayed subtotal and final total exactly match the calculation. Change the tip to a second permitted value and verify the subtotal and delivery fee remain unchanged while the tip and final total update by the exact difference.

outcomes.endpoint: Kitchen staff can print the order data available on the page using an A4-specific presentation that preserves product names, quantities, and delivery information legibly without clipping, overlap, or unrelated interface chrome dominating the output.
outcomes.quote: we need to be able to print the daily orders out on A4 paper without it getting all garbled up
test_cases: Create a completed order containing at least two products and populated delivery details, invoke the browser's print workflow, select A4 where necessary, and inspect the preview across all generated pages. Verify that product names, quantities, and delivery information are legible, that content is not clipped or overlapping, and that navigation, catalog controls, and other unrelated interface elements do not occupy the main printed area.

core_scope.purpose: Enable customers to understand Bright Fold's same-day local delivery offer, select eligible products, review accurate charges, provide delivery details, and complete an order; also enable kitchen staff to obtain a legible A4 printout of available order data.
review_notes: The add-to-cart, checkout tally, and submission groups were collapsed into one customer ordering outcome because they are stages of the same primary end-to-end flow rather than independent user goals.

The Bright Fold and same-day-delivery message was retained as a core informational outcome, while the welcome area's size, centering, color, and screenshot resemblance remain supplementary presentation requirements.

Category filtering and quick re-order remain scored supplementary requirements. They are requested convenience mechanisms, but removing either does not prevent a customer from selecting products and completing the main ordering task.

Catalog relevance, product identity and price, exact cart mutation, exact charge arithmetic, and successful local completion were retained in the core ordering outcome because they establish the business endpoint rather than merely the presence of controls.

Checklist item 27 is mixed because it combines access to an operational checkout panel with the presentational requirement that it slide from the right. Item 32 is mixed because it combines the instructions input with a relative-size/layout requirement. Item 18 is mixed because it combines business identity and operability with a prescribed top-level composition.

A4 print usability remains core despite involving print layout because legible kitchen order output is the requested staff-facing business result. Item 41 checks that result; item 37 only checks entry into a print workflow and therefore remains supplementary.

Visual matching, typography, card styling, responsive rearrangement, viewport overflow, page-section ordering, footer treatment, self-containment, and generic runtime robustness remain supplementary rather than separate core outcomes.

ambiguities: The request does not define date-boundary inclusivity, timezone handling, or invalid date-range behavior, so filter verification should follow any rules declared by the page rather than imposing unstated ones.

No database engine or exact execution-plan schema is specified. The detail must expose substantive plan operators or steps and diagnostic values, but particular fields such as cost, rows, and actual time should not all be mandatory unless the page declares them.
Environment switching can operate on local fixture data in the self-contained page; the request does not require a live deployment or database API.
The qualitative goal of identifying queries "quickly" is not converted into an arbitrary timing or density threshold.

outcomes.endpoint: The page presents intelligible, individually structured flagged-query records with timestamp, database, and unit-qualified execution duration; selecting a record displays the corresponding complete SQL and substantive execution-plan information rather than raw undifferentiated logs.
outcomes.quote: The goal is to let DevOps engineers quickly identify, filter, and inspect underperforming SQL execution plans without wading through raw logs.
test_cases: Using the initially displayed data, note the timestamp, database, and unit-qualified duration of a non-default query record, select it, and verify that the detail view changes to that record's corresponding complete SQL and metadata and shows genuine execution-plan content such as an operator or step hierarchy with the diagnostic values the page declares, rather than merely repeating summary fields or raw log text.

outcomes.endpoint: Applying the declared date-range and millisecond-duration criteria restricts the query records to those satisfying the entered filters.
outcomes.quote: The unified control bar needs input fields for start date, end date, and minimum execution time in milliseconds, along with a primary action button to apply these filters.
test_cases: Starting from an unfiltered state, identify displayed records on both sides of a usable duration threshold, enter that threshold in the minimum-execution-time field in milliseconds, apply the filter, and verify numerically that every resulting record meets or exceeds it and that a known below-threshold record is absent.

Reset the filters, choose a start and end date that leave known records both inside and outside the range, apply them, and verify every resulting timestamp is within the range under the page's declared boundary and timezone rules and that the known outside-range records are absent.

outcomes.endpoint: Switching between Staging and Production changes or restricts the visible query list and current detail to the selected environment while clearly exposing the active environment; no real remote database transaction is required.
outcomes.quote: environmental toggles to switch between Staging and Production databases.
test_cases: In Staging, note the active environment and identifiable query/detail data; switch to Production and verify that Production is clearly current and the list and detail are replaced or restricted to Production data rather than only restyling the toggle, then select a Production record to confirm its detail and switch back to verify the Staging context is restored or reloaded.

core_scope.purpose: Enable DevOps engineers to identify and filter flagged slow queries, then inspect the selected query's SQL and execution-plan information in the correct database environment.
review_notes: Collapsed the query list, record selection, SQL display, and execution-plan detail into one end-to-end identification and inspection flow instead of treating layout steps as separate outcomes.
Retained actual execution-plan information as core because inspecting underperforming SQL execution plans is the stated primary purpose; the exact plan fields remain flexible.

Moved desktop columns, responsive stacking, scrolling density, pagination placement and behavior, navigation, visual styling, focus appearance, robustness, and single-file packaging to supplementary scope. They remain requested requirements but are not non-substitutable diagnostic outcomes.
Kept SQL-copy behavior supplementary: exact clipboard copying is useful and explicitly requested, but removing it does not prevent identifying, filtering, or inspecting slow queries.
Treated items 18, 21, 23, and 33 as mixed because they combine core content or selection behavior with density, preformatted presentation, visual selected state, or scan-oriented structure.

Kept control-existence checks 10 and 12 supplementary because the core environment and filtering outcomes are established by end-to-end data-change checks 30, 14, and 29 rather than by the mere presence of controls.
Pagination functionality remains supplementary because it is one requested strategy for handling large outputs, not a non-substitutable diagnostic endpoint.

keypoints.question: 配色（底色/主色/强调色的关系、明暗倾向）是否**没有**跟成「带价格对比表格的」那一份（极其克制的纯白与浅灰背景交替，仅使用单一的标准亮蓝色作为按钮、选中状态或关键高亮色的强调色。）？跟错来源即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 题面点名的硬指标（radius_pill）。判法：主按钮的计算 border-radius ≥ 自身高度的一半。真值来自**题面**，不看参考图。
keypoints.question: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否满足用户在需求里点明的那一条：按钮我要那种两头全圆的药丸形（判法：主按钮的计算 border-radius ≥ 自身高度的一半）？
keypoints.spec_check: 主按钮的计算 border-radius ≥ 自身高度的一半

keypoints.basis: 用户明确要求「字体排版」不要做成「带价格对比表格的」那样：纯粹的无衬线体，主标题极粗大，而表格、列表及FAQ内的正文字号偏小、排版严密紧凑，呈现冷峻的数据化风格。。做成别的任何合理样子都算通过；做成这一份的样子即不通过。程序实测：题面在这一侧面上要求反着来。第「C」份的程序指纹：正文字号 16px、最大标题字号 64px、字号档数 7档、字族 times、字重档数 4档。产出在这些特征上**贴近**参考即为不满足 —— 照抄应判低分。
keypoints.question: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否明显不同于「带价格对比表格的」那一份（纯粹的无衬线体，主标题极粗大，而表格、列表及FAQ内的正文字号偏小、排版严密紧凑，呈现冷峻的数据化风格。）？跟成了即为不通过。

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'We are launching the digital edition for the latest issue of our independent magazine'
keypoints.question: 页面整体是否呈现为一本独立杂志某一期的数字版（含刊头、特稿、文章索引、订阅等编辑类内容），而不是其他行业主题的网站？

keypoints.basis: 指令明确刊物名为 'Slow Tuesday'
keypoints.question: 刊名是否在页面上精确显示为 "Slow Tuesday"（拼写与大小写一致），且出现在页首刊头或首屏显著位置？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Start the hero with text on the left and a dark featured card on the right'
keypoints.question: 首屏右侧的深色卡片是否承载了一篇"本期特稿/精选文章"的实际内容（至少含文章标题与一段导读或栏目标签），而不是空白或纯装饰图块？

keypoints.question: 文章索引区的每张卡片是否都包含可读的文章信息（至少有文章标题，并配有栏目名/作者/摘要之一），而非仅有占位色块？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Start the hero... Below that... article index... finish the page with a dark, horizontally split form area for newsletter subscriptions'
keypoints.question: 页面是否同时具备指令点名的三块内容区：首屏特稿区、文章索引卡片区、底部深色的 newsletter 订阅区，且三者用途与指令描述一致？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'a dark, horizontally split form area for newsletter subscriptions'
keypoints.question: 底部深色订阅区是否左右分为两部分，一侧为订阅说明文案，另一侧为包含邮箱输入框与订阅提交按钮的表单？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求底部为可用的 newsletter subscription 表单

keypoints.basis: 指令要求'Clicking a card seamlessly morphs it into a full-screen reading modal without a hard reload'
keypoints.question: 点击文章索引中的任意一张卡片后，是否弹出一个覆盖视口的全屏阅读视图（modal），且原页面并未跳转到新页面或整页重载（刊头/索引仍属同一文档）？

keypoints.basis: 指令要求卡片展开为“full-screen reading modal”，因此该视图应包含可供阅读的实质性文章正文，但未规定固定段落数量。
keypoints.question: 全屏阅读视图内是否提供与所选文章对应的连续正文阅读内容，而不是仅显示标题、空白区域或一两句占位文字？

keypoints.basis: [隐含] 指令要求索引网格与阅读视图之间可来回切换（'Transition animations between the index grid and reading views'）
keypoints.question: 全屏阅读视图内是否有明确的关闭控件（关闭按钮或 ✕），点击后视图关闭并回到原来的文章索引网格？

keypoints.basis: 指令验收项'The three-to-four column grid collapses logically to a single column on mobile'

keypoints.basis: 用户明确说明这是独立杂志《Slow Tuesday》最新一期的数字版，因此页面应能让用户识别其刊物及本期身份。
keypoints.question: 页面是否明确标识其为《Slow Tuesday》最新一期的数字版，并通过“Latest Issue”标签、期号、发布日期或本期主题中的至少一种信息体现本期身份？

keypoints.basis: 指令只要求借用参考页面的设计语言（布局与配色），内容需围绕杂志 'Slow Tuesday' 撰写
keypoints.question: 页面所有可见文案是否全部围绕独立杂志这一主题撰写，未出现参考截图中的品牌名（如 Frontier Fence Pros、kross、Stratos）或其联系方式？

keypoints.basis: 指令仅要求沿用参考页面的空间层级与配色，内容为杂志数字版，未要求复用参考的业务条目
keypoints.question: 页面是否没有照搬参考截图里的行业内容模块（如栅栏施工/材料条目、按座位定价卡片与套餐对比表、UX 设计师简历的技能/经历条目）？

keypoints.basis: 作答要求产物为单文件 HTML、CSS/JS 内联且不得引用任何外部资源
keypoints.question: 页面是否为自包含单文件（样式与脚本内联，无外部 css/js/字体/图片链接）？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 用户明确要求“Clicking a card seamlessly morphs it into a full-screen reading modal”以及索引网格与阅读视图之间的 transition animations；现有条目只检查了模态出现和无刷新，未检查是否真正实现平滑 morph 动画。
keypoints.question: 点击文章卡片打开阅读视图、以及关闭阅读视图返回索引时，是否都有连续的展开/收拢过渡（如位置、尺寸、圆角或透明度平滑插值），而不是卡片与模态直接瞬间切换？

keypoints.basis: [补全] 验收条件明确要求“Transition animations between the index grid and reading views maintain stable framerates”。
keypoints.question: 连续打开和关闭多篇文章的阅读视图时，过渡动画是否始终流畅，无明显冻结、严重掉帧、布局闪跳或动画结束后残留的遮罩与错位元素？

keypoints.basis: 用户明确强调文章索引的有状态展开交互及微交互之间的组件一致性；检查应聚焦于实际要求的激活、打开、关闭和控件状态，而不强制额外的悬停机制。
keypoints.question: 文章卡片激活、阅读视图打开与关闭及其控件反馈是否采用一致的状态规则与过渡节奏，并且快速重复操作时不会出现重复模态、状态失配或控件失效？

keypoints.basis: 用户要求页面以 newsletter subscriptions 表单区收尾，因此有效邮箱应具有明确、稳定的提交结果；用户未明确要求该表单必须采用无刷新提交。

keypoints.basis: 响应要求里写明 No external resources
keypoints.question: 产物是否单文件自包含、没有任何外部网络资源（CDN/外链字体/远程图片）？

keypoints.question: 页面加载与交互过程中是否没有未捕获的 JS 异常？

keypoints.question: 参考宽度（1920px）下页面是否没有横向溢出？

ambiguities: The request specifies a newsletter subscription form area but does not define validation, success feedback, persistence, or a backend transaction. Those behaviors are therefore supplementary rather than a core subscription endpoint.

outcomes.endpoint: The page intelligibly identifies itself as the latest issue of "Slow Tuesday" and presents relevant, readable editorial information in the featured area and article index rather than placeholders, copied reference brands, or unrelated industry content.
outcomes.quote: We are launching the digital edition for the latest issue of our independent magazine, "Slow Tuesday".
test_cases: Load the page and verify that "Slow Tuesday" appears exactly in a prominent masthead or hero position, that the page identifies the issue as current through at least one declared method such as a Latest Issue label, issue number, date, or issue theme, and that the featured area contains an actual article title plus supporting editorial information.

Review the article index and verify that every card has a readable title plus at least one of a section, author, or summary; confirm the visible copy consistently concerns an independent magazine and does not contain the named reference brands or unrelated fencing, pricing-comparison, or résumé modules.

outcomes.endpoint: Activating an article card opens a full-screen reading view in the same document with the selected article's matching title and substantive continuous body content, and a visible close control returns the reader to the article index with coherent state.
outcomes.quote: Clicking a card seamlessly morphs it into a full-screen reading modal without a hard reload.
test_cases: From the article index, record a card's title and activate that card; verify that a full-screen reading view opens without a page navigation or hard reload, displays the recorded title and continuous article body rather than only a title or brief placeholder, then use its visible close control and verify that the view closes and the article index is usable again.

Open and close two different article cards in sequence, including a quick repeated close/open interaction, and verify that each reading view corresponds to the selected card, only one reading view exists at a time, and no stale overlay, mismatched article, or disabled control remains.

core_scope.purpose: Present the latest digital issue of "Slow Tuesday" so readers can identify and browse its editorial content, then open and read selected articles in stateful full-screen views without leaving the page.
review_notes: Retained the requested magazine information as a core outcome because an informational digital edition fails its primary purpose if its publication identity and editorial content are absent or unintelligible.
Collapsed modal opening, selected-article matching, body display, and closing into one end-to-end reading outcome instead of treating the individual controls and steps as separate goals.

Removed the proposed page-layout outcome from core scope. Hero alignment, column counts, horizontal splitting, mobile collapse, and overflow behavior are layout requirements rather than non-substitutable editorial endpoints.

Removed the proposed newsletter-form outcome from core scope because subscribing is secondary to browsing and reading the issue, and the request does not specify the checklist's validation or success-state behavior.
Item 13 is mixed because it jointly checks the core featured/index content areas and the supplementary newsletter and layout composition.

Item 27 is mixed because prevention of duplicate or stale reading state supports the core reading endpoint, while consistency of control feedback and transition rhythm is supplementary interaction styling.
Animation form and performance, including items 25 and 26, remain supplementary even though they are emphasized in the request; they do not determine whether readers can access the selected article.
Color, typography, pill styling, self-containment, general runtime hygiene, and responsive viewport fit remain supplementary requirements.

items.question: 布局结构（板块排列、栅格、信息层级）是否与「有深色表单区域的」那一份基本一致（首屏为左文字、右深色卡片结构，往下是三至四列的白色圆角卡片网格，底部有一块深底色左右分栏的表单区。）？
